entries.content.mission.string.11667: Recover a transmitter from Fuse's monsters.
entries.content.mission.string.11668: This attack was no accident. An Oil Ogre is using a transmitter to broadcast our position. We need to find that monster and get that transmitter! You ready?
entries.content.mission.string.11669: I defeated an Oil Ogre and recovered its transmitter for Numbuh Two.
entries.content.mission.string.11670: Thanks! But the battle isn't over. Dexter says that you're the kid from the time machine. He's in trouble. You need to go to the infected zone right away.
entries.content.mission.string.11671: You need to find the Oil Ogre that is broadcasting our position. Defeat him and get the transmitter. You can do it!
entries.content.mission.string.11674: You've really got some skills. Good work defeating that monster! Now bring that transmitter you recovered back to me.
entries.content.mission.string.11677: Rescue Dexter from the infected zone.
entries.content.mission.string.11678: This area is getting dangerous. I was supposed to meet Dexter here, but I can't find him. You look in the infected zone while I check outside.
entries.content.mission.string.11679: I went into the infected zone and found Dexter inside Fusion Buttercup's lair. Together, we defeated her! But I don't know if Dexter managed to escape.
entries.content.mission.string.11680: So much for Fusion Buttercup. I hope Dexter got out safely. This area is falling apart. Find Numbuh Two and get yourself on the next ride outta here!
entries.content.mission.string.11681: Come speak to me near the infected zone. Something's happened to Dexter, and we need to find him!
entries.content.mission.string.11685: Use a warp gate to enter the infected zone. Once you're inside, you can look for Dexter.
entries.content.mission.string.11687: Fusion Buttercup has trapped Dexter inside her lair! You need to find him. Look for the Fusion Portal that leads to that monster's hideout.
entries.content.mission.string.11690: You have found Fusion Buttercup's lair. Quick, go talk to Dexter.
entries.content.mission.string.11694: You have found Dexter inside Fusion Buttercup's lair. Now you must defeat Fusion Buttercup!
entries.content.mission.task.1.completion_descri: Thanks for saving my garden. You defeated Fuse's baddies just in thyme!
entries.content.mission.task.1.mission_complete_: I saved Dee Dee's herb garden from monsters.
entries.content.mission.task.1.mission_summary: Save Dee Dee's herb garden from destruction.
entries.content.mission.task.1.offer_description: Those annoying monsters keep trampling my organic herb garden. You think you can take out a few of them and save my saffron from permanent damage?
entries.content.mission.task.1.task_description: Help! Defeat the monsters behind my house to save my herb garden from destruction.
entries.content.mission.task.1.title: Dee Dee's Dilemmas (Part 1 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.10.completion_descr: Thank you for getting my tweezers back! My chin hairs were getting way too long. Do you think I need to pluck my nose hairs, too?
entries.content.mission.task.10.mission_complete: I recovered Lee Kanker's stolen tweezers.
entries.content.mission.task.10.mission_summary: Recover Lee Kanker's tweezers from Fuse's minions.
entries.content.mission.task.10.offer_descriptio: Some Newspaper Ninjas stole my favorite pair of tweezers, and now I can't pluck my chin hairs. I saw them run off in the direction of the Cul-de-Sac.
entries.content.mission.task.10.task_description: Bring the tweezers back here, and I'll give you a reward. Promise.
entries.content.mission.task.10.title: Lee Kanker Likes You! (Part 1 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.100.completion_desc: Thank you for finding the disgusting Fuse monsters that look like eggplants. And for saving some innocent eggplants from certain doom!
entries.content.mission.task.100.mission_complet: I helped Mel Anzana find a group of evil Fuse eggplants.
entries.content.mission.task.100.mission_summary: Figure out who is attacking the Chickens From Outer Space.
entries.content.mission.task.100.offer_descripti: The chickens think the eggplants are attacking them as well? Fuse is behind this. Will you explore the Caponata Catacombs to see what you can discover?
entries.content.mission.task.100.task_descriptio: You've freed the trapped eggplants, and I want to show you my gratitude. Come back and see me.
entries.content.mission.task.100.title: Mutant Eggplants Attack! (Part 2 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.1001.completion_des: Thank you again for what you did for me at the house. It was muy helpful! I hope the piratas liked to have their candy back!

entries.content.mission.task.1001.offer_descript: This Barnacle Balls candy no belong to us. I think it belonging to the Candy Pirates. Maybe you should bring it to that hombre called Stickybeard.
entries.content.mission.task.1001.task_descripti: Stickybeard wants you to go to near his scary ship and look for scary monsters, like Candy Buccaneers. I so scared for you!!

entries.content.mission.task.1003.completion_des: Arrr, ye done a good deed today! Me men are safe and sound, and that lousy Fusion Numbuh Two is sleeping at the bottom of the sea. Well done!

entries.content.mission.task.1151.task_descripti: 'Tis Fusion Scotsman, the vile fellow. I'm not surprised t'find him workin' for Fusion Demongo. Let's send him back from whence he came, lads!

entries.content.mission.task.1218.mission_comple: I took Fusion Bananas to the Dark Engine and supersaturated them with Fusion Matter. Though they became dangerous to Fuse's monsters, they were not very appetizing. So I returned to Galaxy Gardens and recovered a Bananaflange from Fusion Dexter and Fusion Computress.
entries.content.mission.task.1218.mission_summar: Help Dexter with a key experiment.
entries.content.mission.task.1218.offer_descript: The Fusion Bananas Mojo found have interesting properties. I think I might be able to reverse engineer them into something that might be quite harmful to Fuse.
entries.content.mission.task.1218.task_descripti: You have done an amazing job today. Now it is time for the final challenge: defeat Fusion Dexter. If you can best him, you will recover my Power Wrench and be able to make a new Nano in my image!

entries.content.mission.task.1297.completion_des: What a relief! If Belladonna had seen Fusion Buttercup, she might have gotten her memories back! That would have been a bad thing because like, she'd totally beat me up! Aha, what I mean to say is, It's important that she gets her memories back slowly for her health, capiche?
entries.content.mission.task.1297.mission_comple: I used Ace's backstage pass to get into the secret door, and defeated Fusion Buttercup.
entries.content.mission.task.1297.offer_descript: Great job finding that secret door. Look, I gotta come clean here. Belladonna is totally Buttercup. Like, the Powerpuff Girl, you heard of 'em? She lost her memories and I've, er, been tryin' to help her get them back. Anyway, I'm pretty sure the person Little Arturo saw sneaking around was actually Fusion Buttercup, his eyesight ain't so good. You gotta help me get rid of her, man!
entries.content.mission.task.1297.task_descripti: Take this official rock concert all-access backstage pass. That will get you through that secret door. We need to make sure this Fusion Buttercup chick gets lost before Belladonna sees her!

entries.content.mission.task.13.completion_descr: Good job! I can taste victory. We'll hide inside the Trojan Hamburger, and then we'll be inside the Eds' castle. Here I come, Sockhead!
entries.content.mission.task.13.mission_complete: I helped Marie Kanker clear a path to the Eds' fort.
entries.content.mission.task.13.mission_summary: Clear a path from the Park-n-Flush down to the Ed's fort.
entries.content.mission.task.13.offer_descriptio: We're going to roll our giant hamburger down to the Eds' front door so that they let us in to their castle. But I want to make sure the path is clear of monsters.
entries.content.mission.task.13.task_description: Good work, you. Come on back and I'll give you a treat.
entries.content.mission.task.13.title: Hamburger Helper
entries.content.mission.task.130.completion_desc: Wow, that info from the Plumber data miner was interesting. Seems like Planet Fusion has been terrorizing the galaxy for almost a thousand years!
entries.content.mission.task.130.mission_complet: I downloaded some info about Fuse from a remote data miner.
entries.content.mission.task.130.mission_summary: Get Plumber data miner back online and recover data.
entries.content.mission.task.130.offer_descripti: Ben wants us to access some info from a remote data miner. You'll need to synchronize both Plumber access ports and download the data to your NanoCom.
entries.content.mission.task.130.task_descriptio: You need to head over to the junkyard and find the access port. Remember where it is? Ben will contact you with further instructions.

entries.content.mission.task.1416.completion_des: Losing my memory is a real drag, but Ace says I should just roll with the punches. As long as people know I'm okay, I'm cool. I'm sure my memories will come back eventually, right? Besides, being in a rock band is sweet!

entries.content.mission.task.1467.task_descripti: You made short work of those Sneaky Spawns! Sector V is safe now. Come on back to the tree house for a reward.

entries.content.mission.task.1499.completion_des: You performed honorably. Fusion Demongo is an offensive blight that needs to be smothered. Once I regain my full power, Fuse will have nowhere to run.
entries.content.mission.task.1499.mission_comple: I spoke to Demongo, and he confirmed that Fuse is assembling items of power for Fusion Demongo to absorb. Demongo sent me to Jack, who recently had an item of power stolen. I could not recover the item, but tracked Fusion Demongo to the Dark Glade, where I fought and defeated him.
entries.content.mission.task.1499.offer_descript: Fuse is attempting to assemble items of power for Fusion Demongo. In my current state, I am too weak to fight him. But he will grow all-powerful if he isn't stopped.
entries.content.mission.task.1499.task_descripti: Yesss…this cretin called Fuse is trying to assemble items of great power, including the alien totems that you recovered. Fusion Demongo is in this area, and he is using the energy for his own gain. I am too weak to fight him. You must talk to my old enemy, Samurai Jack, in the Forsaken Valley.
entries.content.mission.task.1499.title: Demon Attack
entries.content.mission.task.15.completion_descr: Thanks for helping me find those Terrafusers. Ben says you're doing great. How do you like that gear I gave you? Pretty sweet!
entries.content.mission.task.15.mission_complete: I helped Numbuh Two locate three Terrafusers in Sector V.
entries.content.mission.task.15.mission_summary: Pinpoint locations of three Terrafusers in Sector V.
entries.content.mission.task.15.offer_descriptio: Looking for some new gear, huh? Well, I've got some stuff that I think will do the trick, but I need some help pinpointing the locations of Terrafusers in Sector V.
entries.content.mission.task.15.task_description: Good work. Now you need to find the next Terrafuser and send the coordiantes to me.
entries.content.mission.task.15.title: Gear Up
entries.content.mission.task.150.completion_desc: I am working on a surveillance satellite to learn more about Planet Fusion. Mojo Jojo's launch trajectory coordinates should help me in my research. Thanks!
entries.content.mission.task.150.mission_complet: I got some important information from Mojo Jojo.
entries.content.mission.task.150.mission_summary: Get launch trajectory coordinates from Mojo Jojo.
entries.content.mission.task.150.offer_descripti: The infection at the space port is designed to prevent us from getting off-planet. I want to know more about this Planet Fusion. I believe Mojo Jojo can help us.
entries.content.mission.task.150.task_descriptio: In order to get the launch coordiantes, Ramma Jamma said you can get them from the remote storage computer. Don't give him the chance to change his mind. I think the unit is on the top of one of the nearby buildings.

entries.content.mission.task.1567.mission_comple: I went back to Monkey Mountain, but only found a trace of magic powder, and not the Reincarnation Charm. I then explored Dinosaur Pass, where I invaded the infected zone and fought Fusion Hex to recover the magic powder and make a Nano.
entries.content.mission.task.1567.mission_summar: Help Hex find the Charms of Bezel.
entries.content.mission.task.1567.offer_descript: I seek the Charms of Bezel. I believe the Charm of Reincarnation briefly gave life to your friend's toy monkeys. Return to Monkey Mountain and search for me.
entries.content.mission.task.1567.task_descripti: You must make your way through the treacherous infected zone in Dinosaur Pass to find the entrance to Fusion Hex's lair.
entries.content.mission.task.1567.title: Charmed Life

entries.content.mission.task.1568.task_descripti: You've found Fusion Hex's lair. It's time to show him what it means to interfere with powerful magics. Recover more of that laughable magic powder, and I am certain you will be able to create a Nano.
entries.content.mission.task.1568.title: Charmed Life
entries.content.mission.task.1569.completion_des: Yay! Fusion Juniper Lee is gone. She scared me, big time. She'll be back, I'm sure. At least you taught Vilgax a lesson. Woof!
entries.content.mission.task.1569.mission_comple: I found the secret lair of Fusion Juniper Lee, and taught Vilgax a lesson, too. Hopefully that will be the last time he puts his own interests ahead of beating Fuse. But I doubt it!
entries.content.mission.task.1569.objective: Find the Fusion portal in the Catacombs.
entries.content.mission.task.1569.offer_descript: Hey, I found Fusion Juniper Lee's lair. It's in the Lower Catacombs! I'm not going down there. Way too scary! Are you up for it?
entries.content.mission.task.1569.task_descripti: Fusion Juniper Lee is hiding in the Lower Catacombs. We need to get her!
entries.content.mission.task.1569.title: Avoid the Planetoid (Part 4 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.157.completion_desc: Ben's Omnitrix has been acting strangely ever since Fuse invaded. Thanks for going to Dexlabs to get that capacitor. We need to keep this problem under control.
entries.content.mission.task.157.mission_complet: I got a capacitor from Dexter to stabilize Ben's Omnitrix.
entries.content.mission.task.157.mission_summary: Find a capacitor that should stabilize Ben's Omnitrix.
entries.content.mission.task.157.offer_descripti: Ben's just told me that his Omnitrix is not working properly. Dexlabs has a capacitor that did the trick last time. Can you please go get one from Dexter?
entries.content.mission.task.157.task_descriptio: You should bring those special Fusion Matter samples to Dexbot Q-12 back at City Station. Don't forget to get the capacitor!
entries.content.mission.task.157.title: Omnitrix Fix
entries.content.mission.task.1570.completion_des: So what? So a stupid Indigo Whip fell off of a stupid Aubergine Meanie? Leave it with me and I'll check it out. Meanwhile, Tetrax said that you need to go see him.
entries.content.mission.task.1570.mission_comple: I destroyed the Aubergine Meanies. The floppy stem fell off the head of one of them. It looks a lot like an Indigo Whip. I gave it to Kevin for study.
entries.content.mission.task.1570.offer_descript: The creatures in the Upper Catacombs have started getting really aggressive. I need some help fighting the Aubergine Meanies.
entries.content.mission.task.1570.task_descripti: Just when I get this place under control, these monsters get whipped into a frenzy! I need you to destroy some Aubergine Meanies in the Upper Catacombs.
entries.content.mission.task.1570.title: Going Berserk (Part 1 of 5)
entries.content.mission.task.1571.completion_des: You did great! Fuse is getting stronger all the time, but you showed him a thing or two. And you got a cute little Courage Nano, too!
entries.content.mission.task.1571.mission_comple: Fuse is trying to use Dark Magic to make the creatures in the Darklands more powerful. I fought Ghastly Growths and Bully Behemoths in the Dark Glade. Then I found Fusion Courage in the Firepits and defeated him!
entries.content.mission.task.1571.offer_descript: Hex is scary, but he was right. Fuse is playing around with dark magic in the Darklands. How dark can you get? We need some help!
entries.content.mission.task.1571.task_descripti: Fuse is taking the power of the Dark Tree in the Dark Glade and making his monsters more powerful. You have to go to the Dark Glade infected zone to take care of four Ghastly Growths to prevent them from absorbing the powerful energies of the Dark Tree. Yikes!
entries.content.mission.task.1571.title: Ring Around the Collar
entries.content.mission.task.1572.completion_des: You are proving to be a most resourceful ally. Now that the energy has been restored to the Warrior's Crest, I believe I know how we must continue our quest.
entries.content.mission.task.1572.mission_comple: I brought the Warrior's Crest to Juniper Lee. She was able to restore its mystical energies after I defeated the Cryptworms.
entries.content.mission.task.1572.mission_summar: Restore power to the Warrior's Crest.
entries.content.mission.task.1572.objective: Talk to Juniper Lee in Nowhere.
entries.content.mission.task.1572.offer_descript: The Warrior's Crest is devoid of its mystical energies. I want you to find Juniper Lee in Nowhere. She is knowledgeable of such things.
entries.content.mission.task.1572.task_descripti: There is a young woman named Juniper Lee in Nowhere. She knows the ways of magic and should be able to help us restore energy to the Warrior's Crest.

entries.content.mission.task.1576.title: Ring Around the Collar
entries.content.mission.task.1577.completion_des: I don't know where the Crazy Brain candy went, but the Fowl Freaks had a dinosaur bone. I think you have to go to the Darklands. Howl!
entries.content.mission.task.1577.mission_comple: I defeated the Moussaka Meanies in the Upper Catacombs and found a piece of Crazy Brain candy. Then I defeated some Fowl Freaks and collected a dinosaur bone.
entries.content.mission.task.1577.mission_summar: Fight Fusion Eggplants in the catacombs.
entries.content.mission.task.1577.objective: Enter the pipe to the Catacombs.
entries.content.mission.task.1577.offer_descript: You'll find the scariest Fusion Eggplants in the Upper Catacombs. Yeesh! Watch out! If you can beat them, maybe you can learn where Fuse is taking the candy.
entries.content.mission.task.1577.task_descripti: The Fusion Eggplants we're looking for are in the Catacombs. You can enter the Caponata Catacombs through the pipe. Then make your way to the Upper Catacombs. Try not to get too scared!
entries.content.mission.task.1577.title: Eggplant Peril
entries.content.mission.task.1578.completion_des: Thanks, kid. I'll let you help out when it's time to bring down Fuse.
entries.content.mission.task.1578.mission_comple: I helped Kevin collect Fusion Monster parts so he can absorb Fusion energy from them.
entries.content.mission.task.1578.mission_summar: Collect Fusion monster parts for Kevin.
entries.content.mission.task.1578.offer_descript: Are you tired of swatting Fuse's flies and never hitting the big boss? Let's take down Fuse together. I can absorb the monsters' powers, but I need some help.
entries.content.mission.task.1578.task_descripti: I can absorb any kind of power, including Fusion power. As soon as I absorb enough energy, I'll be able to beat any minion of Fuse. Maybe even Fuse himself. Collect five bags of Cryptworm Jelly and seven Fowl Freak Pelts to speed up my mastery of Fuse's power. You'll need to go down to the Upper Catacombs.
entries.content.mission.task.1578.title: Kevin Help Us (Part 1 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.1579.completion_des: You have been imbued with the power of the Book of Prophecy. The forces of destiny are at work!  I think you can activate the totems without the book.
entries.content.mission.task.1579.mission_comple: I struck the totem with the Spine of the Book of Prophecy. The totem activated, but the spine vanished. Gwen thinks the Book of Prophecy is now a part of me somehow.
entries.content.mission.task.1579.mission_summar: Activate the totem in the Crystalline Caverns.
entries.content.mission.task.1579.offer_descript: The prophecy says that we must activate a network of ancient totems to protect our planet from Fuse. Can you help?
entries.content.mission.task.1579.task_descripti: The prophecy says that we can protect the Earth by re-activating an ancient network of totems. We just need to find them. I can sense one near here in the Crystalline Caverns. Get in there now.
entries.content.mission.task.1579.title: Head to Totem (Part 1 of 5)

entries.content.mission.task.1580.completion_des: You have done well. The Warrior's Crest contains the spirits of great heroes of the past. With Dexter's Power Level Tracker, we can locate Demongo.
entries.content.mission.task.1580.mission_comple: I went to the Really Twisted Forest and collected the Warrior's Crest, which contains the spirits of great warriors from the ancient Hall of Heroes.
entries.content.mission.task.1580.mission_summar: Collect an artifact from the Really Twisted Forest.
entries.content.mission.task.1580.offer_descript: Are you familiar with Demongo, the Soul Collector? He may be responsible for the heroes' disappearances. We need to track him, and I think I have a way.
entries.content.mission.task.1580.task_descripti: I want you to return to the jungle and go to the Really Twisted Forest. You must recover the Warrior's Crest from the infected zone there. With that, we should be able to find Demongo.

entries.content.mission.task.159.completion_desc: Hey, that was some awesome stuff at Morbucks Towers. I was worried about Fusion Coop's Doomdozers, but you saved the day. Nice work, hero.
entries.content.mission.task.159.mission_complet: I defeated Fusion Coop's Doomdozers at Morbucks Towers.
entries.content.mission.task.159.mission_summary: Stop Fusion Coop's Doomdozers from attacking the space port!
entries.content.mission.task.159.offer_descripti: Fusion Coop is assembling a crew of Doomdozers to level the space port! Now's your chance to show Fuse what you're really made of. You ready?
entries.content.mission.task.159.task_descriptio: You need to get over to Morbucks Towers right away. Fusion Coop is preparing to attack the space port.

entries.content.mission.task.1591.completion_des: You have shown great skill and bravery. Now you must prove your abilities in the dreaded Fireswamps. If you can do this, you may pursue Demongo.
entries.content.mission.task.1591.mission_comple: I defeated the Horrordactyls in Dinosaur Pass.
entries.content.mission.task.1591.mission_summar: Fight the Horrordactyls plaguing the valley.
entries.content.mission.task.1591.offer_descript: The Power Level Tracker indicates that Demongo is deeper in the Darklands. You are not yet prepared for this challenge, but I can help you.
entries.content.mission.task.1591.task_descripti: There are primitive peoples in this area, and Fuse's Horrordactyls plague their lives. If you can purge Dinosaur Pass of some of these foul creatures, I will know you are ready for the next step in your journey.

entries.content.mission.task.1593.task_descripti: There is a girl in the Fireswamps named Peggy Danger. She's in trouble. Please go find her and lend her your aid.

entries.content.mission.task.1715.task_descripti: You see?!? This Mandy thinks she can make a fool of Mojo Jojo, but Mojo Jojo is no fool! Return to Devil's Bluff and make Mandy the fool, instead!
entries.content.mission.task.1715.title: Double Doublecross
entries.content.mission.task.1716.completion_des: Disturbing. The Dark Tree's roots spread all the way down to the edge of the wilderness. That's a lot of reach. Very interesting, indeed.
entries.content.mission.task.1716.mission_comple: I went to Dark Tree South and defeated a number of Wooly Behemoths. Mandy and I determined that the roots of the Dark Tree go even deeper than we thought.
entries.content.mission.task.1716.mission_summar: Investigate the roots of the Dark Tree.
entries.content.mission.task.1716.offer_descript: Have you heard of the Dark Tree? It's in the Darklands, and it's spreading Fuse's infection far and wide. I want to know more about this thing.
entries.content.mission.task.1716.task_descripti: I want to know more about the Dark Tree. I've given you a Fusion Divining Rod to take some measurements. Head into the Darklands and go to Huntor's Crest, an ancient village lying due south of the Dark Tree.

entries.content.mission.task.172.completion_desc: Planet Anurphaetos and Planet Fusion have a connection. This is troublesome. Anyway, good job reinforcing security at the space port.
entries.content.mission.task.172.mission_complet: I delivered an image to Ben that proves Planet Fusion's connection with Ghostfreak. Then I helped Ben reinforce the security around the space port.
entries.content.mission.task.172.mission_summary: Deliver an image from Plumber files to Ben.
entries.content.mission.task.172.offer_descripti: It seems that Ghostfreak's homeworld and Planet Fusion indeed have a history. I have a disturbing image from the Plumber files that you need to take to Ben.
entries.content.mission.task.172.task_descriptio: Good work. Go back to Ben and he'll have a reward for you.
entries.content.mission.task.172.title: Do Not Enter
entries.content.mission.task.1720.completion_des: I guess Dexter figured out my plot. I knew it was too good to be true. That kid really is smart. But I'll come up with another plan, just you wait.
entries.content.mission.task.1720.mission_comple: Mandy gave me a Signal Smasher to put into the Dark Tree, but Dexter told me that it was really a Signal Augmentor! He told me to throw it into the Firepits, instead.
entries.content.mission.task.1720.mission_summar: Place a Signal Smasher in the Dark Glade.
entries.content.mission.task.1720.offer_descript: I've got a weird piece of tech that I found in the Ruins. It's called a Signal Smasher. I think we can use it to stop the Dark Tree's roots from spreading its infection.
entries.content.mission.task.1720.task_descripti: Go to the Dark Glade and defeat the Skull Crushers. Then you should be able to place the Signal Smaher inside the Dark Tree.

entries.content.mission.task.1723.completion_des: If we don't find that Hypnotic Charm soon, Fuse is going to use it to hypnotize the entire planet. I hate it when my enemies steal my best ideas.
entries.content.mission.task.1723.mission_comple: I went to Hero's Hollow to try to find the Hypnotic Charm, but I came up empty-handed.
entries.content.mission.task.1723.offer_descript: Er…remember the Hypnotic Charm that you left on Monkey Mountain? Well, Fuse found it and took it away. I think we may be in a bit of trouble.
entries.content.mission.task.1723.task_descripti: Are you ready for the challenge of your career? Go to Hero's Hollow, the gateway to Fuse's inner sanctum, Fuse's Lair.  Fight Fuse's flunkies to see if you can find the Hypnotic Charm. Defeat nine Eyebulbs.

entries.content.mission.task.1725.completion_des: Even though we haven't found the Hypnotic Charm, Dexter thinks he's been able to track it to the Green Maw. So that's where you have to go.
entries.content.mission.task.1725.mission_comple: I went to the Precipice and defeated a number of Jurassic Centurions, but I still could not find the Hypnotic Charm.
entries.content.mission.task.1725.mission_summar: Continue search for the Hypnotic Charm.
entries.content.mission.task.1725.offer_descript: You will need to go deeper into Fuse's Lair to look for the Hypnotic Charm. Try going to the Precipice.

entries.content.mission.task.1776.mission_comple: I installed a Putrid Spawn Rebreather into a Fusion Compressor from an Oil Ogre and formed a Fusion Diverger. I used that to get past a secret portal to Fusion Hoss Delgado.

entries.content.mission.task.1776.offer_descript: I have determined why the Fusion Compressors and the Rebreathers that you recovered do not work. I will allow you to redeem yourself.
entries.content.mission.task.1776.task_descripti: The monster called Fusion Hoss Delgado is an infernal nuisance and interfering with my plans. Get rid of him and recover the device that he took from me.

entries.content.mission.task.1792.completion_des: That was weird that Coco's egg let you through the Fusion Portal. I didn't know she could do that! Even though you beat Fusion Mac, he might be back.
entries.content.mission.task.1792.mission_comple: After saving Coco, I used one of her eggs to get through a Fusion Portal to fight Fusion Mac. I don't know how one of her eggs opened the portal. Gwen thinks it could have been one of Fusion Coco's eggs, but why would she help us?
entries.content.mission.task.1792.offer_descript: Hey, I'm so glad you're here. Monsters from the Twisted Forest are gonna come here to kidnap Coco! Think you can help?
entries.content.mission.task.1792.task_descripti: Why is Fuse picking on Coco? That's not fair! Fusion Mac has been sending waves of Creeper Kings to attack Coco. And the Freakish Frogs have been eating her eggs! Can you go to the Twisted Forest and protect her?

entries.content.mission.task.1800.completion_des: Fuse now has the scans of Fuzzy Lumkins. That should mess up his research. Defeating Fusion Hex was a nice bonus. But he'll be back, no doubt.
entries.content.mission.task.1800.mission_comple: I got a scan of Fuzzy Lumkins and uploaded it into Fuse's system. Hopefully that will mess up Fuse's research. And I defeated Fusion Hex for good measure.
entries.content.mission.task.1800.mission_summar: Trick Fuse with scans of Fuzzy Lumpkins.
entries.content.mission.task.1800.offer_descript: I've managed to decode some of the information contained in that Gooby Trap. If you want to mess with Fuse, I've got a mission for you.
entries.content.mission.task.1800.task_descripti: The decoded goo revealed that Fuse is obsessed with the Imaginary Friends. There's only one possible explanation. Fuse is stupid. He knows about science and magic and superpowers. But Imaginary Friends are none of those. So he's going crazy researching something that is just imaginary. What a moron. We're gonna trick him into thinking that Fuzzy Lumkins is an Imaginary Friend. First we need a Fusion Scanner that the Dagger Mantises at the Ruins are bringing to Fusion Hex.

entries.content.mission.task.1907.completion_des: Coco must have eaten the data banks that contained the plans. What luck! So Fusion Max got nothing but a bunch of useless data. Now that's a lucky break.
entries.content.mission.task.1907.mission_comple: Coco left an egg for me with Bloo. Inside the egg was a piece of Dexter's data banks -- the part that contained Dexter's missing plans. So Fusion Max stole nothing but useless data! By eating Dexter's wiring, she protected the plans from Fusion Max. Dexter thinks it was pure luck, but I'm not so sure…

entries.content.mission.task.1907.offer_descript: Thanks for your help trying to recover those plans. Listen, Bloo just called to say that he has something for you. Might as well go see what he wants.
entries.content.mission.task.1907.task_descripti: It's unfortunate that Fusion Max was able to escape with those plans. We'll deal with it in due time. Anyway, Bloo said he had something important to show you.

entries.content.mission.task.1909.completion_des: Thank you for recovering the wrench. I must analyze it carefully to learn its secrets. I mean...the secrets of the evil Dexter clone, of course!
entries.content.mission.task.1909.mission_comple: Mandark says Dexter is a clone. He needs Dexter's power wrench to stop the clone and save the real Dexter. It's tough to know who to believe. I got the wrench, but is Mandark being truthful?
entries.content.mission.task.1909.mission_summar: Help Mandark find the real Dexter.
entries.content.mission.task.1909.offer_descript: You need to be very quiet about this. I've discovered that Dexter is merely a clone of his former self. We need to rescue the real Dexter without alarming anyone.
entries.content.mission.task.1909.task_descripti: I have bad news. Dexter is not Dexter. Well, Dexter is Dexter, but not THE Dexter. He's a clone of himself. Must be a plot by Fuse. Or one of Dexter's experiments gone awry. In any case, the only way to prove it and rescue the real Dexter is to get Dexter's power wrench.

entries.content.mission.task.1917.task_descripti: I invented a new kind of Spybot to keep an eye on Fuse’s minions. But my loyal Mandroids were ambushed and one of my inventions was lost. It must have been Fuse's minions. I'm picking up readings from the monsters in Tech Square.
entries.content.mission.task.1917.title: Stealing Secrets (Part 1 of 5)
entries.content.mission.task.1918.completion_des: Yuck. There were traces of monkey hair on each Spybot fragment. My genius tells me that Mojo’s army stole the Spybot but got ambushed by Fuse's monsters.
entries.content.mission.task.1918.mission_comple: I recovered the fragments of Mandark's Spybot. But now Mandark suspects that Mojo tried to steal it, not Fuse.
entries.content.mission.task.1918.offer_descript: I recently sent a Spybot on an important recon mission, but it has just fallen off the grid. Can you help me find it?
entries.content.mission.task.1918.task_descripti: Good job recovering all those Spybot parts. I wonder if Fuse's minions were not to blame after all? Perhaps Mojo's monkey soldiers took my Spybot, and Fuse's monsters stole it from THEM. Bring me those parts for analysis.
entries.content.mission.task.1918.title: Stealing Secrets (Part 1 of 5)
entries.content.mission.task.1919.completion_des: Now I'll monitor Mojo's Volcano. If we catch him helping Fuse, I'll share the credit with you. Well, some of the credit. I mean, they are MY Spybots, after all.
entries.content.mission.task.1919.mission_comple: I planted Mandark's Spybot Monitors in Mojo's Volcano, but I almost got caught.
entries.content.mission.task.1919.offer_descript: After that incident with the Spybot, I suspect that Mojo and Fuse might be working together. Can you help me get proof?

entries.content.mission.task.192.completion_desc: That was nice work at Mandark's house. You helped Dexter and the Professor. With more kids like you, Fuse won't stand a chance against us.

entries.content.mission.task.1936.completion_des: Since you have completed this assignment without serious incident, I will provide you with a second.
entries.content.mission.task.1936.mission_comple: I brought Vilgax the Fusion Compressors. He wouldn't tell me about them, and complained about their condition. But he took them. What's he afraid of telling me?

entries.content.mission.task.1936.offer_descript: You are operating around Offworld Plaza without my permission. If you want to be effective here, you will undertake the missions I dispense.
entries.content.mission.task.1936.task_descripti: Defeat five Oil Ogres in Steam Alley and collect each one's Fusion Compressor. Do not ask me to divulge the secrets of the Oil Ogres or why I need such things. For the likes of you, service to Vilgax should be sufficient.

entries.content.mission.task.1940.completion_des: Hey, nice work on those creeps. You bought us some more time to work on these space ships. With any luck, the space port will be ours again soon.
entries.content.mission.task.1940.mission_comple: I stopped some of the Thuggards and Clawbreakers from damaging our space program. We need to build spaceships to take the fight directly to Planet Fusion.
entries.content.mission.task.1940.offer_descript: I'm so glad you're here. Fuse's monsters are everywhere and my Omnitrix is still acting up. Can you help us protect the Space Port?
entries.content.mission.task.1940.task_descripti: We need to stop some of these Thuggards and Clawbreakers to keep them from trashing our rockets. The space ships we're building are the only way we're gonna be able to take the fight to Planet Fusion. Start by taking out six Thuggards.

entries.content.mission.task.1947.task_descripti: You collected the mini-Terrafusers inside the space port and stopped the infection from getting worse. But here's the bad news: I think the concentrated Fusion Matter has started to pollute our atmosphere.
entries.content.mission.task.1947.title: Bet on Ben (Part 2 of 5)
entries.content.mission.task.1948.completion_des: Had you not assisted me, the consequences would have been dire. Now leave my presence.
entries.content.mission.task.1948.mission_comple: I used Vilgax's Fusion Condenser to keep the concentrated Fusion Matter from spreading through the atmosphere. But Mandark and Mojo are convinced that Vilgax is behind the spread of the concentrated Fusion Matter in the first place. Could they be right? Was it a mistake to help Vilgax?

entries.content.mission.task.1956.completion_des: Thank you for your laudable efforts. If only more youngsters were responsible like you, we might be free of this unseemly situation.
entries.content.mission.task.1956.mission_comple: I defeated some Lazy Metal Boy Scouts that were menacing Foster's Home. So why was one of them carrying a roll of Toilet Paper?
entries.content.mission.task.1956.mission_summar: Defeat twelve Lazy Metal Boy Scouts.
entries.content.mission.task.1956.offer_descript: I hate to trouble you, but some terrifying creatures have been creeping here from Prickly Pines. Will you defend us?
entries.content.mission.task.1956.task_descripti: We've spotted terrifying Lazy Metal Boy Scouts lurking about the house. They've been creeping out of Prickly Pines and paying undue attention to our quiet little home. Could you go sweep up the nearest, say, dozen or so? That should keep them away from here.

entries.content.mission.task.1958.completion_des: Bravo! I daresay that Toiletnator fellow is a bit of a ne'er-do-well. It's disturbing to think that Fusion Bloo is lurking somewhere here in Foster's Home.
entries.content.mission.task.1958.mission_comple: I tracked Toiletnator to the outhouse where he was supposed to meet some of Fuse's cronies. He promised to give me the Plunger of Doom to use on Fusion Bloo.
entries.content.mission.task.1958.mission_summar: Find the traitor in Camp Kidney.
entries.content.mission.task.1958.offer_descript: Would you believe that the toilet paper you recovered from the monsters contained a clue? Can you investigate it for us? Much appreciated!
entries.content.mission.task.1958.task_descripti: We found a hidden message on the roll of toilet paper. Invisible ink, apparently, revealed only when we treated the roll with lemon bathroom cleanser. The message says, "Meet me at the outhouse in Camp Kidney. Come alone." And it's signed by someone named Lou!

entries.content.mission.task.2097.title: Junior Hijinks (Part 1 of 2)
entries.content.mission.task.2098.completion_des: I am in yer debt. Thanks for protecting me vessel!
entries.content.mission.task.2098.mission_comple: I stopped the invasion of the Sweet Revenge.
entries.content.mission.task.2098.mission_summar: Stop the invasion of the Sweet Revenge.
entries.content.mission.task.2098.offer_descript: Yarr! Me ship is being terrorized by Candy Buccaneers! You there! Stop them!
entries.content.mission.task.2098.task_descripti: Thank ye for protectin' me ship. Return to the Candy Pirate village and I'll reward ye!
entries.content.mission.task.2098.title: Avenge the Sweet Revenge (Part 1 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.2099.mission_comple: I defeated five Tech Wings and protected Dee Dee from danger.
entries.content.mission.task.2099.offer_descript: These weird bat-thingies are driving me batty, flapping around all the time. And they're huge! Can you please get rid of the five closest to the house?
entries.content.mission.task.2099.task_descripti: You got those spooky bat things. Yay! Come back to me and I'll see if I have something to give you.
entries.content.mission.task.2099.title: Laboratory Safety (Part 1 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.21.completion_descr: Hey, great job finding those enemy encampments! We won't have any more trouble with those losers, I hope. You're a superstar.
entries.content.mission.task.21.mission_complete: I found three spawn camps in the Suburbs.
entries.content.mission.task.21.mission_summary: Help Numbuh Two find three spawn camps.
entries.content.mission.task.21.offer_descriptio: With the LOCATOR's triangulation nodes in place, I've found three different enemy encampments in Peach Creek Commons that need your special attention.
entries.content.mission.task.21.task_description: Keep your trigger finger itchy! You need to go to the first enemy camp in Peach Creek Commons and do a clean sweep of any monsters that you encounter.
entries.content.mission.task.21.title: Hide and Go Eek
entries.content.mission.task.210.completion_desc: Fuse's forces are gathering all across the suburbs. You did a great job at the graveyard and did even better at the nuclear plant. I'm impressed!
entries.content.mission.task.210.mission_complet: I stopped a leak at the nuclear plant in Endsville.
entries.content.mission.task.210.mission_summary: Stop a leak at the nuclear power plant.
entries.content.mission.task.210.objective: Go to Nuclear Plant infected zone.
entries.content.mission.task.210.offer_descripti: Fuse's forces at the cemetery have now refocused their efforts on the nuclear power plant. I want you to go out there and try to take care of the problem.
entries.content.mission.task.210.task_descriptio: Good job with the Jerk-O-Lanterns. But the Nuclear Plant is reporting a leak. You need to get over to the infected zone immediately.
entries.content.mission.task.210.title: Bad Nukes
entries.content.mission.task.2100.completion_des: You're the best! Thanks for stopping that mean ol' Fuse from stealing my house.
entries.content.mission.task.2100.mission_comple: I stopped the Tech Tunnelers and Doom Drones from stealing Dee Dee's house.
entries.content.mission.task.2100.offer_descript: First bats, now moles! Giant mole creatures digging and digging! They've been popping up in my garden. Can you please flush them out?
entries.content.mission.task.2100.task_descripti: You did a great job against those Tech Tunnelers and Doom Drones. Come back to me and I'll give you something cool.
entries.content.mission.task.2100.title: Laboratory Safety (Part 2 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.2101.completion_des: Yay! You did it! The only thing better than pre-chewed gum chewed by someone else is pre-chewed gum chewed by me!
entries.content.mission.task.2101.mission_comple: I defused a Gooby Trap at the Nuclear Plant. And found Billy's pre-chewed gum.
entries.content.mission.task.2101.offer_descript: I forgot to tell you to get my chewing gum when you were at the Nuclear Plant. Do you mind? It should still have some flavor left in it.
entries.content.mission.task.2101.task_descripti: Now that you gots my pre-chewed gum, can you brings me back that pre-chewed gum?
entries.content.mission.task.2101.title: Billy's Baloney (Part 2 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.2102.completion_des: Those Extremospawns were just a diversion. Fusion Numbuh Five is planning to attack! Talk to Mr. Herriman. He saw it all.
entries.content.mission.task.2102.mission_comple: I defeated five Extremospawns for Frankie.
entries.content.mission.task.2102.offer_descript: Some Extremospawns are terrorizing Foster's Home! Can you stop the five that are closest to the house?
entries.content.mission.task.2102.task_descripti: Thanks for taking care of those Extremospawns. But you'd better come back here. I think we've got trouble.
entries.content.mission.task.2102.title: Imaginary Reinforcements (Part 1 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.2103.completion_des: Thanks for your help. The world is a happy place once again! Except that it’s still covered in disgusting goo…
entries.content.mission.task.2103.mission_comple: I removed a Re:Fuse poster, but a new one appeared in its place. And why did Billy tell me that monsters were putting them up? That seems weird. Those posters are anti-Fuse!
entries.content.mission.task.2103.offer_descript: Motorillas are running amok! Amok I tell you! And they're putting up Re:Fuse posters! What could this mean? Can you p-p-please help?
entries.content.mission.task.2103.task_descripti: You got the Re:Fuse poster! Bring it to me!
entries.content.mission.task.2103.title: Beautification Mutation (Part 1 of 6)
entries.content.mission.task.2104.completion_des: I fought eight Cylomanders and protected Charles Darwin.
entries.content.mission.task.2104.mission_comple: Charles Darwin Middle School is in trouble! Can you drop whatever you are doing and rush back down there?
entries.content.mission.task.2104.task_descripti: Good work against those Cylomanders. I wonder why they have become so much more hostile. Well, please come back to me in Genius Grove.
entries.content.mission.task.2104.title: Beautification Mutation (Part 3 of 6)
entries.content.mission.task.2105.completion_des: Great job getting those Fire Hydras. Now there won't be a fire. Hey, I think Dexter needs you. Hold that thought while I go get some fried dough.
entries.content.mission.task.2105.mission_comple: I stopped Fusion Ace's plan to burn down the Dizzy World Amusement Park.
entries.content.mission.task.2105.mission_summar: Defeat four Fire Hydras at Dizzy World.
entries.content.mission.task.2105.offer_descript: Uh…whoops. Fusion Ace was trying to burn up the whole Dizzy World Amusement Park. Will you help stop the fire?
entries.content.mission.task.2105.task_descripti: Good job taking down those Fire Hydras. You used all the moves that I totally would have used. Come on back and see me.
entries.content.mission.task.2105.title: Getting Dizzy With It (Part 3 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.2106.completion_des: Hey, Dexter was real pleased with how we handled those Asphalt Thief monsters. I told him that I couldn't take all the credit, though.
entries.content.mission.task.2106.mission_comple: I defeated Asphalt Thief monsters to protect the city's water supply.
entries.content.mission.task.2106.offer_descript: I want to go get some fried dough. But Dexter just called and said there's a problem with the water supply or something? Can you help? Maybe check your email.
entries.content.mission.task.2106.task_descripti: I'm so totally on my way to City Station! You go on ahead, though. Look for Dexbot Q-12. I'm right behind you.
entries.content.mission.task.2106.title: What Makes a Monster (Part 1 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.2107.completion_des: The walls of the auditorium took a pounding, but you saved the place before they could tear it down. I could use more kids like you in the KND!
entries.content.mission.task.2107.mission_comple: The Hydro Slammers had no chance to tear down the auditorium with me on the job.
entries.content.mission.task.2107.offer_descript: We've got an emergency. I don't have any operatives in the area and Hydro Slammers are wrecking the auditorium. Can you get over there pronto?
entries.content.mission.task.2107.task_descripti: Great work against those Hydro Slammers. Return to me in Townsville Park for a reward.
entries.content.mission.task.2107.title: How to Date a Fusion (Part 1 of 5)
entries.content.mission.task.2108.completion_des: You did an excellent job. Kids can shop a little safer now. I think the candy store is going to have a big sale in your honor.
entries.content.mission.task.2108.mission_comple: I defeated five Heavy Hunters at Townsville Mall.
entries.content.mission.task.2108.offer_descript: I just received an urgent message. Heavy Hunters are going to attack the shoppers at Townsville Mall! Can you hurry to the mall and stop them?
entries.content.mission.task.2108.task_descripti: Townsville Center should be safe from those Heavy Hunters now. Please come back to the park.
entries.content.mission.task.2108.title: Fusion from Another Planet (Part 1 of 5)
entries.content.mission.task.2109.completion_des: Hope you find a good use for that Fusion Prism. I think it might help you find hidden Fusion Portals. Thing is, you can only use it once. Then it shatters.
entries.content.mission.task.2109.mission_comple: I defeated Shady Streetlights in Townsville Park to find a Fusion Prism. Princess says it can reveal hidden Fusion Portals.
entries.content.mission.task.2109.mission_summar: Defeat Shady Streetlights to find a Fusion Prism.
entries.content.mission.task.2109.offer_descript: Don't be mad at me. I was wrong to try to trick you. I'll make it up to you, okay?
entries.content.mission.task.2109.task_descripti: Well, you got the Fusion Prism. Happy now? Come back to Townsville Center and see me, okay?
entries.content.mission.task.2109.title: Fusion from Another Planet (Part 3 of 5)

entries.content.mission.task.211.objective: Repair the leak inside the Nuclear Plant infected zone.
entries.content.mission.task.211.offer_descripti: Fuse's forces at the cemetery have now refocused their efforts on the nuclear power plant. I want you to go out there and try to take care of the problem.
entries.content.mission.task.211.task_descriptio: You need to find the controls that will repair the leak inside the plant's core. You've got to seal this up, or there will be dire consequences. Hurry!
entries.content.mission.task.211.title: Bad Nukes
entries.content.mission.task.2110.completion_des: You've got what it takes to be here. But be on your guard. The Fissure is unpredictable and dangerous.
entries.content.mission.task.2110.mission_comple: I proved I am ready for the Fissure by defeating Dire Raptors.
entries.content.mission.task.2110.offer_descript: Townsville Park was once beautiful, but now it is a very dangerous place. You need to prove you are ready for the fight here. Are you prepared?
entries.content.mission.task.2110.task_descripti: Good work facing down those Dire Raptors. Come back to me and I'll give you your reward.
entries.content.mission.task.2110.title: Fusion from Another Planet (Part 4 of 5)
entries.content.mission.task.2111.completion_des: Good work with those nasty Asphalt Freaks. But can you master the floating islands of the Fissure to stop the Terrafusers?
entries.content.mission.task.2111.mission_comple: I stopped the Asphalt Freaks in Townsville Park.
entries.content.mission.task.2111.mission_summar: Stop the Asphalt Freaks in the park.
entries.content.mission.task.2111.offer_descript: Asphalt Freaks are tearing up the terrain faster than we can repair it. Can you help out at the Park Drop Zone?
entries.content.mission.task.2111.task_descripti: Nice work taking down those freaky Asphalt Freaks. Come see me for a reward.
entries.content.mission.task.2111.title: Numbuh One Fan (Part 1 of 2)
entries.content.mission.task.2112.completion_des: Thanks for getting those decorations back! I don't see how Mayor is going to have an awards ceremony with all these monsters roaming around.

entries.content.mission.task.2112.offer_descript: The Mayor wants to have an awards ceremony for the bravest kids in town. Unfortunately, the monsters stole all our decorations. Think you can get them back?
entries.content.mission.task.2112.task_descripti: We need to get back all the decorations that Fuse's monsters stole. First, you need to look for the Asphalt Creeps that took our bunting.

entries.content.mission.task.2133.completion_des: Thanks for your help with investigating my theory about Ghostfreak's homeworld. I hope Grandpa Max has a plan that will help us.
entries.content.mission.task.2133.mission_comple: I asked Vilgax about Anurphaetos, but he wouldn't talk unless I brought him some Alien DNA. Ben used his Omnitrix to make it inert, and Vilgax confirmed Ben's theory about Anurphaetos being loyal to Fuse. I told Grandpa Max what we learned.

entries.content.mission.task.2171.completion_des: Mojo Jojo can again spy on Planet Fusion. What’s that? A planetoid just broke off the planet and is now hurtling towards our planet! Curses!
entries.content.mission.task.2171.mission_comple: I installed Mojo Jojo's lens in his telescope. When he looked through the repaired telescope, he saw part of Planet Fusion break off and fall toward Earth. Are we all doomed?
entries.content.mission.task.2171.offer_descript: Curses! Mojo Jojo is too important for unimportant tasks like installing the lens into Mojo's important telescope. You do it!
entries.content.mission.task.2171.task_descripti: Install the Telescope Lens, which belongs to Mojo, in the telescope, which also belongs to Mojo. Go up to the top of the telescope and find the installation beacon, which indicates where the lens can be installed.

entries.content.mission.task.2207.completion_des: You ruined my goo living room set by using it to catch Fusion Mandy! Now Runty has nowhere to watch TV. I should put stinky cheese up your nose!
entries.content.mission.task.2207.mission_comple: Billy hijacked the mission that Grim hijacked from Numbuh One. But it all worked out in the end, when Grim helped me stop Fusion Mandy. Looks like Grim is not a traitor after all. He only met Fusion Mandy when she tried to take control of him.
entries.content.mission.task.2207.offer_descript: I'm so glad you're here! My little alien pal, Runty, needs some new goo for his cage! It's super-duper important. Can you get me some?
entries.content.mission.task.2207.task_descripti: Sigh…go back and talk to Grim. Even though I don't get my gooey living room set for Runty, at least you done did a good job.
entries.content.mission.task.2207.title: A Fusion In Our Midst (Part 4 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.2208.completion_des: I commend your performance by recognizing that you did a good job. Clearly, Fuse knows that Mojo Jojo's technology is the best technology of all technology!
entries.content.mission.task.2208.mission_comple: I defeated six Wild Wings and six Doom Diggers that were trying to steal Mojo Jojo's technology for Fuse.
entries.content.mission.task.2208.mission_summar: Defeat six Wild Wings and six Doom Diggers.
entries.content.mission.task.2208.offer_descript: Curses! Wild Wings and Doom Diggers are plaguing me, Mojo Jojo! Mojo Jojo does not like to be plagued. Why are you not stopping them?
entries.content.mission.task.2208.task_descripti: Now that you have taken care of those Wild Wings and Doom Diggers, return to me at the volcano and I will reward you for taking care of those Wild Wings and Doom Diggers.
entries.content.mission.task.2208.title: Making Friends with Mojo (Part 1 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.2209.completion_des: Be careful around the Dark Engine. If you go on Vilgax’s missions, watch your back. He's helping us now, but can that alien really be loyal to our cause?

entries.content.mission.task.2209.mission_summar: Fight the Gear Goliaths in Steam Alley.
entries.content.mission.task.2209.offer_descript: Fuse's Dark Engine is spewing more Fusion Matter than we can handle. Are you ready for a real challenge in the fight against Fuse?
entries.content.mission.task.2209.task_descripti: The defeat of the Gear Goliaths will slow Fuse's development of the Dark Engine in Steam Alley. Well done. Return to me at Tech Square for a reward.
entries.content.mission.task.2209.title: Dark Engine Days (Part 1 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.2210.completion_des: Hey, nice work on those creeps. You bought us some more time to work on these space ships. With any luck, the space port will be ours again soon.
entries.content.mission.task.2210.mission_comple: I stopped some of the Thuggards and Clawbreakers from damaging our space program. We need to build spaceships to take the fight directly to Planet Fusion.
entries.content.mission.task.2210.offer_descript: I'm so glad you're here. Fuse's monsters are everywhere and my Omnitrix is still acting up. Can you help us protect the Space Port?
entries.content.mission.task.2210.task_descripti: Good work taking out those Thuggards and Clawbreakers. The Space Port should be a little safer now, but we still have a long way to go before we get it functional again. Well, come back and see me.

entries.content.mission.task.2260.mission_comple: I found Samurai Jack and got him to give me his sandal.
entries.content.mission.task.2260.offer_descript: Have you heard of the warrior called Samurai Jack? We are trying to improve his Nano. Please go track him down.
entries.content.mission.task.2260.task_descripti: You got Samurai Jack's sandal? What does it smell like? Nevermind. Come on back to the Jungle Outpost.
entries.content.mission.task.2260.title: Completing the Project (Part 1 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.2261.completion_des: Demongo is a pretty unusual creature. I don't think I'd want to mess with him. Thanks for getting that skull.
entries.content.mission.task.2261.mission_comple: I found Demongo and got him to give me a skull.
entries.content.mission.task.2261.offer_descript: I've got one more for you. We gotta find some scary guy called Demongo. The eggplants are working on improving the Demongo Nano.
entries.content.mission.task.2261.task_descripti: We must find the creature called Demongo. If you can requisition a skull from him, our researchers may be able to improve his Nano! But beware! Demongo collects the souls of those he defeats, and almost stole the soul of Samurai Jack. He works for the mighty shape-shifting wizard, Aku. You will find him in the ancient village of Huntor's Crest.

entries.content.mission.task.2267.completion_des: Tetrax is one of our most loyal allies and very knowledgable about intergalactic affairs. I'm sure you'll be able to learn a lot from him. Go get Fuse!
entries.content.mission.task.2267.mission_comple: Ben asked me to contact Tetrax in the Forsaken Valley.
entries.content.mission.task.2267.objective: Go to the Kumari Serpent in Monkey Foothills.
entries.content.mission.task.2267.offer_descript: Thanks for helping out Max. I want you to contact Tetrax in the Darklands. Fuse's infection is most severe there. I'm sure there's a lot to be done.
entries.content.mission.task.2267.task_descripti: Tetrax is stationed at the gateway to the Darklands in Forsaken Valley. To get there, you will need to take the Kumari Serpent from the Monkey Foothills, way out in the jungle.

entries.content.mission.task.2289.completion_des: Yeah, kid! You've got the stuff. Now you need to find the Wishing Skull right here in Devil's Canyon. I'm told they'll make your wishes come true.
entries.content.mission.task.2289.mission_comple: I ventured into Devil's Canyon and picked up the claw of a Pneumatic Bear. I brought it to Agent Duffey, who told me where I could find a Wishing Skull.
entries.content.mission.task.2289.mission_summar: Get a Pneumatic Bearclaw for Agent Duffey.
entries.content.mission.task.2289.offer_descript: I'll let you in on a little secret, but you have to do something for me in return. Bring me the claw of a Pneumatic Bear, and then maybe I'll talk.

entries.content.mission.task.229.completion_desc: Me Grim's Gardens store is a target for Fuse. Because you showed dose monsters we mean business, I have stayed in business!
entries.content.mission.task.229.mission_complet: I defeated the Oil Ogres in Steam Alley and prevented them from attacking Grim's Gardens.
entries.content.mission.task.229.offer_descripti: Before you leave, can you help me wit one last ting? I heard dat de Oil Ogres in Steam Alley are planning to attack me store, Grim's Gardens. Please stop dem!

entries.content.mission.task.2361.completion_des: How will we transform these strange weapons into a Master Weapon? With all of us studying the weapons you bring back, someone is bound to figure it out.
entries.content.mission.task.2361.mission_comple: I made the long trek to Samurai Jack, where I learned about the Master Weapon. Some of my enemies are transformed into weapons after I defeat them. All I have to do is figure out how to transform those weapons into one Master Weapon to use against Fuse. Easier said than done…
entries.content.mission.task.2361.offer_descript: I think I know why you keep finding weapons after defeating Fuse's monsters. Are you ready for a long journey? You must find Samurai Jack in the Darklands.
entries.content.mission.task.2361.task_descripti: I found an ancient scroll that talks about defeated enemies turning into weapons. But only one person understands this phenomenon: Samurai Jack. You need to seek him out. It's a long journey into dangerous territory. Do not stray from the path. The monsters there are too dangerous for you. You can enter the Darklands from a transport at Monkey Mountain.

entries.content.mission.task.2393.completion_des: Are you wondering where the Master Weapon is? It is you. The greatest weapon is not outside of us. It is our inner spirits that guide us to victory.
entries.content.mission.task.2393.mission_comple: I destroyed the entire arsenal of Master Weapons. Samurai Jack says that by destroying all those weapons, I gave up physical power for power of the spirit. It looks like the real Master Weapon is…me.
entries.content.mission.task.2393.offer_descript: It is true. To create the Master Weapon, we must destroy the Master Weapon arsenal. Are you ready?
entries.content.mission.task.2393.task_descripti: Take the Master Weapon arsenal to the Dark Glade infected zone. Plunge the weapons into the poisonous roots. It will destroy the weapons. Only then will the Master Weapon be created.

entries.content.mission.task.2415.mission_comple: I fought Graveworms in the Upper Catacombs while searching for Fusion Juniper Lee. I recovered the alien artifact she stole.
entries.content.mission.task.2415.offer_descript: Thanks for coming! I just saw Fusion Juniper Lee escape into the Caponata Catacombs. Yikes! I need help!
entries.content.mission.task.2415.task_descripti: Thanks for taking care of the Graveworms in the Upper Catacombs. Can you bring back that alien artifact?
entries.content.mission.task.2415.title: Tracking a Fusion (Part 3 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.2416.completion_des: We both failed! We both struck Planet Fusion instead of the smaller Planetoid Fusion. Vilgax must have sabotaged us! I need you to go back and see Courage.
entries.content.mission.task.2416.mission_comple: Looks like Vilgax sabotaged our efforts to destroy Planetoid Fusion. Does he want the Earth to be destroyed? His recalculations were designed to hit Planet Fusion, instead. Now the planetoid is still a threat.
entries.content.mission.task.2416.offer_descript: We are ready to shoot down Planetoid Fusion with the Ion Cannon. The device needs protection. Return to Nowhere.
entries.content.mission.task.2416.task_descripti: I need you to go to Nowhere and keep any monsters away from my Ion Cannon. Fuse must know that we are trying to shoot down Planetoid Fusion. So I would be very surprised if he didn't attack my defenseless Ion Cannon.

entries.content.mission.task.2418.completion_des: We're safe from Planetoid Fusion. But a piece of the planetoid has crashed down in the Really Twisted Forest. Can you go see Coco at the Jungle Outpost?
entries.content.mission.task.2418.mission_comple: I reversed the polarity of the UFO Magnet, and Planetoid Fusion went squish!
entries.content.mission.task.2418.objective: Take the Remote Control to the UFO Magnet.
entries.content.mission.task.2418.offer_descript: I think I know how to stop Planetoid Fusion! But I'm too scared to do it on my own. Wanna help?
entries.content.mission.task.2418.task_descripti: All the aliens that have crash-landed in Nowhere were PULLED HERE by an alien artifact buried far below Nowhere -- a UFO Magnet. It must have pulled off a chunk of Planet Fusion. The alien device you recovered earlier is a remote control for the UFO Magnet. Take the remote control to the location I send you. If you reverse the polarity of the UFO Magnet, Planetoid Fusion will go squish!

entries.content.mission.task.2427.completion_des: Wait, do not leave me for Tetrax! Where are you going? We have many more missions to complete before Monkey Mountain is mine and no longer not mine!
entries.content.mission.task.2427.mission_comple: I helped Mojo Jojo assault Monkey Mountain, but I uncovered a plot by Fuse to make stronger monsters.
entries.content.mission.task.2427.offer_descript: Monkey Mountain must belong to me: Mojo Jojo! But Fuse's monkey monsters have run my monkey minions off the mountain! We must stop him.
entries.content.mission.task.2427.task_descripti: Curses! There is only one thing worse than Mojo Jojo not having control of Monkey Mountain, and that is SOMONE ELSE having control of Monkey Mountain! You must teach the interlopers a lesson! Defeat twelve Scythe Simians!

entries.content.mission.task.2428.task_descripti: Now that the Scythe Simians are defeated, you may return to my headquarters where we can discuss the next thing we must do to return Monkey Mountain to its rightful ruler: me, Mojo Jojo!
entries.content.mission.task.2428.title: Building a Better Monster (Part 1 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.2429.completion_des: Thank you. I must study this Fusion Matter sample. It should help us to discover what Fuse is up to.
entries.content.mission.task.2429.mission_comple: I worked with Tetrax to investigate the altered Fusion monsters by defeating Fossil Crawlers in Forsaken Valley.
entries.content.mission.task.2429.offer_descript: The Scythe Simians you fought at Monkey Mountain had a slightly different energy signature than a standard monster. Help my investigation into this matter.
entries.content.mission.task.2429.task_descripti: When you defeated the Scythe Simians at Monkey Mountain, I detected that they had a slightly different energy signature than a standard monster. They have been exposed to a new form of Fusion Matter that we have not seen before, and it's making them stronger. I'm getting the same reading from some Fossil Crawlers here in Forsaken Valley. Intercept a few so we can examine them.
entries.content.mission.task.2429.title: Building a Better Monster (Part 2 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.243.completion_desc: Hoo boy. De Desk Lamp of Hades is intact, but it needs a new light bulb. And I got me some other problems, too! Let's talk about dem.
entries.content.mission.task.243.mission_complet: I recovered Grim's Desk Lamp of Hades.
entries.content.mission.task.243.mission_summary: Recover Grim's Desk Lamp of Hades.
entries.content.mission.task.243.offer_descripti: Okay, child. Now that I have me shrunken Zuni heads back, I can help you wit dat problem of missing heroes. Help me find de Desk Lamp of Hades.
entries.content.mission.task.243.task_descriptio: De Desk Lamp of Hades sheds light on de world of de dead, so we can see if de missing heroes are gone. But you will need to get it back from Fuse's goons at Morbucks Towers.

entries.content.mission.task.2430.task_descripti: The Fossil Crawlers that you defeated were altered, just like the Scythe Simians at Monkey Mountain. Bring me the Fusion Matter samples that they dropped.
entries.content.mission.task.2430.title: Building a Better Monster (Part 2 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.2431.completion_des: Thank you for recovering the Fusion Matter Spanner. It should be able to tell us more details about this mysterious machine that Fuse is building.
entries.content.mission.task.2431.mission_comple: The Fusion Matter sample that I found proved that Fuse is attempting to enhance his monsters. And now the creatures in the Darklands are carrying supplies for some kind of machine. That doesn't sound good.
entries.content.mission.task.2431.offer_descript: I've completed my tests of the Fusion Matter sample you recovered. Fuse is trying to make his minions faster and stronger…and it gets even worse.
entries.content.mission.task.2431.task_descripti: The Fusion Matter you collected has a much faster rate of mutation. And it appears that Fuse is building a machine right here in the Darklands to mass-produce these creatures. We have to intercept the monsters carrying supplies for the machine. You must go to the Fireswamps to take out the Creeposaurus Rexes that are transporting a Fusion Matter Spanner.

entries.content.mission.task.2433.completion_des: I don't like the looks of this. Come back and see me after I have had the chance to examine this equipment.
entries.content.mission.task.2433.mission_comple: I found a Fusion Matter Extractor on the Freakosaurus Rexes. But I don't know what it does.
entries.content.mission.task.2433.offer_descript: The Freakosaurus Rexes in the Firepits are also carrying a Fuse device. Can you go there and get it from them while I continue my work on the spanner?

entries.content.mission.task.2434.title: Building a Better Monster (Part 4 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.2435.completion_des: Your interference has slowed Fuse down. I'll let you know when I find the next monsters working on the assembly line. Good work.
entries.content.mission.task.2435.mission_comple: I fought the Skull Bashers in Huntor's Crest to stop them from building an assembly line for Fusions.
entries.content.mission.task.2435.offer_descript: My research indicates that Fuse is not simply trying to strengthen his weaker minions. He is trying to mass-produce Fusions! We can't let this continue.
entries.content.mission.task.2435.task_descripti: Fuse is limited in the number of Fusions he can make at one time. But this enhanced Fusion Matter may allow him to produce Fusions on an assembly line right here on our planet! Instead of a few evil copies of us, he'll have an army. We must foil this plot, or we are doomed. The Skull Bashers in Huntor's Crest are building parts of the assembly line. Stop them.

entries.content.mission.task.2437.completion_des: Well done. But Fuse is likely building his machine somewhere else in the Daklands. We must remain vigilant.
entries.content.mission.task.2437.mission_comple: The Skull Crushers were working on an assembly line for Fusions, but I stopped them.

entries.content.mission.task.2441.completion_des: There is a Fusion behind this. Once I study the readings from the Fusion Sensor, all will be revealed.

entries.content.mission.task.2441.offer_descript: I need you to take an energy reading in dangerous territory. If you are successful, we will reveal the engineer of this entire enterprise. Are you up for it?

entries.content.mission.task.2443.completion_des: Your work must be commended. Fuse's plan to mass-produce a Fusion army has been crushed. Had he succeeded, this entire planet would have paid the price.
