entries.content.mission.task.2447.completion_des: Nice work, mate. Them Ghoulish Growths and Rabid Arachnids are pretty tough. But you did some nice work.
entries.content.mission.task.2447.mission_comple: I fought Ghoulish Growths and Rabid Arachnids and helped protect the Jungle Outpost.
entries.content.mission.task.2447.offer_descript: Hey, I heard how you helped that Ed kid. This jungle is a dangerous place, and Fuse's nitwits make it even more dangerous. Can you help, mate?
entries.content.mission.task.2447.task_descripti: Nice work against the Ghoulish Growths and Rabid Arachnids, mate! You gotta come around here more often. Come see me for a reward.
entries.content.mission.task.2447.title: Treetop Troubles (Part 2 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.2448.completion_des: Oh, thank you so much for getting rid of those evil clown monsters. Don't let them get me! They will destroy us all! Destroy us all! Destroy us all!
entries.content.mission.task.2448.mission_comple: I defeated the Destroyusalls at Dizzy World for Billy, then delivered their noses to Bloo.
entries.content.mission.task.2448.offer_descript: Horrible clown monsters haunt my dreams! They lie in the shadows, preparing to strike! And they're real…real, I tell you! Go to Dizzy World if you don't believe me!
entries.content.mission.task.2448.task_descripti: There are monsters in my dreams, yet they are horribly real! You will find them at the Dizzy World amusement park. Destroy them before they can destroy us! Collect their noses to prove that they have been vanquished.
entries.content.mission.task.2448.title: Destroy Them All
entries.content.mission.task.2449.completion_des: Oh, thank you so much for getting rid of those evil clown monsters. Don't let them get me! They will destroy us all! Destroy us all! Destroy us all!
entries.content.mission.task.2449.mission_comple: I defeated the Destroyusalls at Dizzy World for Billy, then delivered their noses to Bloo.
entries.content.mission.task.2449.offer_descript: Horrible clown monsters haunt my dreams! They lie in the shadows, preparing to strike! And they're real…real, I tell you! Go to Dizzy World if you don't believe me!
entries.content.mission.task.2449.task_descripti: You collected three Destroyusall noses. But even their noses are scary! I don't want 'em! Bring them to Bloo at the entrance to the infected zone. He'll know what to do!
entries.content.mission.task.2449.title: Destroy Them All
entries.content.mission.task.245.completion_desc: Hoo boy. De Desk Lamp of Hades is intact, but it needs a new light bulb. And I got me some other problems, too! Let's talk about dem.
entries.content.mission.task.245.mission_complet: I recovered Grim's Desk Lamp of Hades.
entries.content.mission.task.245.mission_summary: Recover Grim's Desk Lamp of Hades.
entries.content.mission.task.245.objective: Deliver the Desk Lamp of Hades.
entries.content.mission.task.245.offer_descripti: Okay, child. Now that I have me shrunken Zuni heads back, I can help you wit dat problem of missing heroes. Help me find de Desk Lamp of Hades.
entries.content.mission.task.245.task_descriptio: You should bring the Desk Lamp of Hades back to Grim for a reward.
entries.content.mission.task.245.title: Love and Hades
entries.content.mission.task.2450.completion_des: Good work. Dexbot Q-12 has all the information you need to assist with this soopuh important project!
entries.content.mission.task.2450.mission_comple: I reported to Dexbot Q-12 at City Station.
entries.content.mission.task.2450.offer_descript: Did you hear about the Nano improvement study? Kid scientists are collecting Nano creation items to make Nanos better. Talk to Dexbot Q-12 at City Station.
entries.content.mission.task.2450.task_descripti: If you head south of here, you'll enter City Station. Look for Dexbot Q-12. He's coordinating the Nano improvement project for Dexlabs.
entries.content.mission.task.2450.title: Nano Support
entries.content.mission.task.2451.completion_des: Thanks for bringing my photo to Grandpa Max! I'm sure he'll pass it along to his cute grandson, Ben! And if he doesn't…then I'll blast him with laser beams!
entries.content.mission.task.2451.mission_comple: I brought a glamour photo of Princess to Grandpa Max, but he was a little unsure about what to do with it.
entries.content.mission.task.2451.offer_descript: Have you met Ben Tennyson? He's, like, so dreamy! His Grandpa Max is nearby in Townsville Park. Can you bring my glossy 8 x 10 headshot to him?
entries.content.mission.task.2451.task_descripti: Bring my glossy 8 x 10 glamour headshot to Grandpa Max at the Fissure. I'm sure he'll pass it along to his grandson, Ben, once he takes a good look at it.
entries.content.mission.task.2451.title: Teen Dream
entries.content.mission.task.2452.completion_des: Hmmmph! Did Grim refuse? I'm going to tell my daddy what that dumb skeleton said, and then he'll be sorry! I always get what I want, you'll see.
entries.content.mission.task.2452.mission_comple: I brought a buyout contract to Grim from Princess. She wants to buy his chain of day spas. But Grim wasn't interested.
entries.content.mission.task.2452.offer_descript: Have you tried Grim's Gardens' beauty products? They're delightful! I told my daddy to buy out the company. Will you bring this acquisition contract to Grim?
entries.content.mission.task.2452.task_descripti: My daddy promised to buy all the Grim's Gardens stores. Bring this buyout contract to Grim and make him sign it!
entries.content.mission.task.2452.title: Hostile Takeover
entries.content.mission.task.2453.completion_des: Ha ha ha! I hope that Mandark has learned his lesson! There is no one smarter on this planet than my master, Mojo Jojo!
entries.content.mission.task.2453.mission_comple: I brought what I thought was an important secret message from Mojo to Mandark. But all the message said was, "I'm smarter than you!"
entries.content.mission.task.2453.offer_descript: Master Mojo has a very important message to send to Mandark. Will you deliver it for me? I know you can do it. You're pretty smart, for a human.
entries.content.mission.task.2453.task_descripti: Bring this very important note to Mandark in Tech Square. You will find him at Mandark Industries.
entries.content.mission.task.2453.title: Smarty Pants
entries.content.mission.task.2454.completion_des: Fusion Eddy could not resist my bubble gum. Yay! Im a hero! I guess you are, too. I'll be a hero Monday to Thursday. You can be a hero Friday to Sunday.
entries.content.mission.task.2454.mission_comple: I did some bizarre tasks for Billy, but his "plan" worked. I found and defeated Fusion Eddy.
entries.content.mission.task.2454.mission_summar: Stop the bad guys in Eternal Vistas.
entries.content.mission.task.2454.offer_descript: Goo is falling from the sky! Mummy Monsters lurch through the streets! Even worse, my pre-chewed gum tastes awful! But I have a very clever plan. Oh, yes.
entries.content.mission.task.2454.task_descripti: See, I toldja you could beat up that guy if you followed my instructions. All goes according to my plan! Come back to me and I'll give you something even better than that old gum.
entries.content.mission.task.2454.title: Billy's Baloney (Part 3 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.2455.completion_des: My emotions clouded my judgment. I'm glad Father helped you. Perhaps he really is on our side after all. I just hope Fusion Bubbles does not return.
entries.content.mission.task.2455.mission_comple: Professor Utonium thought Fusion Bubbles was the real Bubbles, and he couldn't fight her. Fortunately, Father helped me. Perhaps he's being honest about helping in the fight against Fuse.
entries.content.mission.task.2455.mission_summar: Defeat the Fusion who attacked Pokey Oaks.
entries.content.mission.task.2455.objective: Exit and talk to the Prof.
entries.content.mission.task.2455.offer_descript: I've found the Fusion who is trying to Terrafuse Pokey Oaks! Are you ready for a real fight?
entries.content.mission.task.2455.task_descripti: The foe you defeated was indeed Fusion Bubbles. I don't know how I could have become so confused. Well, please exit the lair and return to me in Genius Grove for your reward.
entries.content.mission.task.2455.title: Of Fathers and Fusions (Part 3 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.2456.completion_des: Tetrax is one of our most loyal allies and very knowledgable about intergalactic affairs. I'm sure you'll be able to learn a lot from him. Go get Fuse!
entries.content.mission.task.2456.mission_comple: Ben asked me to contact Tetrax in the Forsaken Valley.
entries.content.mission.task.2456.objective: Talk to Tetrax in the Darklands.
entries.content.mission.task.2456.offer_descript: Thanks for helping out Max. I want you to contact Tetrax in the Darklands. Fuse's infection is most severe there. I'm sure there's a lot to be done.
entries.content.mission.task.2456.task_descripti: The Kumari Admiral will take you to the Forsaken Valley. There is a remote research facility there that was built by Mandark Industries. Contact Tetrax and see what you can do to help out.
entries.content.mission.task.2456.title: A History of Planet Fusion (Part 4 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.2457.completion_des: Dat's the end of Fusion Grim…for now. I hope everyone will learn dat I am not working wit Fuse, but simply trying to get  away from dem two annoying children.
entries.content.mission.task.2457.mission_comple: I brought the Fusion Matter Declarifier to Grim, and he used it to get through a portal to Fusion Grim. Looks like once again, Grim is no traitor.
entries.content.mission.task.2457.offer_descript: Fusion Mandy tried to control me, and now she is working with Fusion Grim. We can stop him wit de Fusion Matter Declarifier. Are you ready for such a task?
entries.content.mission.task.2457.task_descripti: Find the mine cart inside the Crystalline Caverns infected zone. Den we can find Fusion Grim and beat him silly.
entries.content.mission.task.2457.title: Don't Fear the Reaper (Part 4 of 4)

entries.content.mission.task.2458.task_descripti: Dat was some amazing display of pure gusto. Come and see me before you go, and I can give you someting nice.
entries.content.mission.task.2458.title: Don't Fear the Reaper (Part 4 of 4)
entries.content.mission.task.2459.completion_des: Though Runty's Imagination Energy allowed you to weaken Fuse's shield, the battle is not over. Fuse has not yet fully manifested inside his lair.
entries.content.mission.task.2459.mission_comple: I entered the very heart of Fuse's Lair, where I defeated Stalactitans. Then I weakened Fuse's shield using the Imaginary Energy contained inside Billy's pet Fusion Spawn, Runty.
entries.content.mission.task.2459.mission_summar: Find a way past Fuse's Shield.
entries.content.mission.task.2459.offer_descript: Though you defeated Fusion Kevin, Fuse has appeared inside his lair. He is guarded by Stalactitans and protected by a shield. I fear doom is at hand.
entries.content.mission.task.2459.task_descripti: Fuse himself is attempting to manifest inside his lair. This is our darkest hour. We no longer have the means to transmit Imaginary Energy into the lair. You must try to get past Fuse's shield. Go to Fuse's Lair.
entries.content.mission.task.2459.title: Fuse No More (Part 2 of 4)

But Fuse has not fully materialized, and I am not sure how we can damage him until he does. You'd best return to me.

entries.content.mission.task.2465.completion_des: Incredible. You used your own imagination against Fuse. But I fear that there is one more battle to fight. This time, Fuse himself is waiting for you on his throne.
entries.content.mission.task.2465.mission_comple: Coco left an egg inside Fuse's Lair. It contained nothing -- but Mac reminded me to simply use my imagination. With that, I was able to destroy Fuse's shield once and for all.
entries.content.mission.task.2465.mission_summar: Stop Fuse from appearing on our planet!
entries.content.mission.task.2465.offer_descript: We cannot harm Fuse until he has fully manifested, but we can still weaken his defenses. Unfortuantely, we have no Imagination Energy left . Are you ready?
entries.content.mission.task.2465.task_descripti: Fuse is still manifesting inside his Lair, but his shield is weak. We may be able to destroy his defenses by entering Fuse's Labyrinth. entries.content.mission.task.2472.completion_des: Fuse's defeat signals a major shift in this war. Though his infection and his monsters still poison our world, Fuse has suffered a mighty blow. We are in your debt.

I need you to thin out their ranks a bit and then use the Core Sampling Tool to gather Samples of their makeup.  I want to confirm my hypothesis.

entries.content.mission.task.2692.offer_descript: The Dark Tree is under attack from within. We must find a way to let the Tree's natural defense mechanisms drive off the invaders.
entries.content.mission.task.2692.task_descripti: So the Dark Fusionflies are making it harder for the Tree to protect itself? That would explain why the Ghastly Growths are so firmly entrenched underground. The Dark Fusionflies are creating holes in the roots that are the perfect route for the Fusion Matter to enter the System. As soon as a hole appears, Fusion Matter flows into it and another Ghastly Growth is spawned, weakening the tree even more.  We must put a stop to this!

entries.content.mission.task.2701.completion_des: You've just obtained the first real proof of the existence of the Townsville Blowfish. Just think of the ratings! I'll be famous! Erm--I mean, YOU'LL be famous, of course.
entries.content.mission.task.2701.mission_comple: I used a camera to take a picture of the Townsville Blowfish for Argost. I'm not sure that I trust him, but he does make compelling television!
entries.content.mission.task.2701.mission_summar: Investigate Pokey Oaks for signs of a new Cryptid.
entries.content.mission.task.2701.objective: Find the Cryptid in Pokey Oaks.
entries.content.mission.task.2701.offer_descript: Greetings and bienvenue! I trust that you are a faithful viewer of Weird World? If so, you know that we have identifed over 8,527 different cryptids on live television. Today, you have the unique opportunity to help us identify yet another.  You'll be the envy of millions of viewers if you can help us identify the cryptid. Do you wish to help?
entries.content.mission.task.2701.task_descripti: There have been reports of cryptid activity in the Pokey Oaks area. Rumor has it that the legendary Townsville Blowfish has been spotted roaming around Pokey Oaks South. Were I you, I would concentrate my search near bodies of water. My sources say that the beast spawns near water before venturing onto land. Take this remote camera with you and we will document your search for the show!

entries.content.mission.task.5049.offer_descript: How do you feel about doing some espionage for yer ol’ pal Stickybeard? In exchange, I won’t make ye walk the plank! The SKWID Squad, the aquatic division of those meddlesome Kids Next Door, are up to something nefarious near me camp! There be a strange blue whale swimming nearby, just south of here. Me candy pirate scouts tell me that the SKWID Squad are intending to weaponize the creature, and that the whale’s friend was tricked by the SKWIDs into helping them. We need to undermine their plans by getting a message out to the boy who was tricked!

entries.content.mission.task.5087.task_descripti: Albedo is a Galvan who created his own bootleg Omnitrix. Due to a mishap, he’s now stuck as corrupted version of Ben Tennyson. The guy seems pretty vengeful about it. We’re not really sure how, but he seems to have gotten ahold of the Ultimatrix, a device similar to Ben’s Omnitrix, although reports say that it’s currently not functional thanks to Fuse’s interference. You’ll find this guy in The Precipice.

entries.content.mission.task.5101.completion_des: We made quite a team, Sparky! Although, I guess this is the end of our partnership. entries.content.mission.task.5132.completion_des: I created my own copy of the coordinate data your nanocom scanned earlier. I had intended to keep it for myself, but for reasons far too complicated for you to understand, I must be rid of it. I am trusting you with my copy of the data. Do NOT get rid of this item, you will need it to enact the next part of my plan.
entries.content.mission.task.5132.mission_comple: Albedo taught me how to get Null Void coordinate data from Mini Fusion Echo Echoes.
entries.content.mission.task.5132.mission_summar: Learn about Mini Fusion Echo Echoes from Albedo.
entries.content.mission.task.5132.objective: Find and defeat a Mini Fusion Echo Echo somewhere in the Darklands
entries.content.mission.task.5132.offer_descript: Are you aware that this “Lord Fuse” has created a Mega Fusion Echo Echo? These Plumbers are pretty good at keeping the monster trapped in an uncharted area of the Null Void, but for some reason they refuse to trust me, Ben Tennyson, with the exact coordinates.
entries.content.mission.task.5132.task_descripti:
Every now and then, a Mini Fusion Echo Echo will escape from the Null Void and find its way here to the Darklands. You’ll generally find them roaming between The Precipice and Hero’s Hollow.

If you can manage to defeat one, your Nanocom should be able to scan it and extract the coordinates of the Mega Fusion Echo Echo being held in the Null Void. The coordinate data takes up a lot of storage, so I’d recommend having at least one free space in your inventory. 

If you’re currently not strong enough to beat a Mini Fusion Echo Echo on your own, it’s probably wise to return to this task when you are capable of doing so. Do NOT waste my time.
entries.content.mission.task.5132.title: Mega Fusion Education (Part 1 of 2)

entries.content.mission.task.5133.task_descripti: You managed to defeat a Mini Fusion Echo Echo and, assuming you didn’t completely screw everything up, obtained some coordinate data for the Null Void. It is important to remember that if you ever want to re-obtain this coordinate data, you must defeat another Mini Fusion Echo Echo.
entries.content.mission.task.5133.title: Mega Fusion Education (Part 1 of 2)
entries.content.mission.task.5134.completion_des: There you have it, you are now properly educated on Mega Fusion Echo Echo. More importantly, however, is that I am now very much aware of the exact coordinates where he’s being held in the Null Void. As an acknowledgement of your assistance, I will bestow upon you another duplicate of the coordinate data, but if you ever require more you’ll have to collect them from Mini Fusion Echo Echos yourself.
entries.content.mission.task.5134.mission_comple: Albedo taught me how to use the Null Void coordinate data I obtained from the Mini Fusion Echo Echoes, and I encountered Mega Fusion Echo Echo up close!
entries.content.mission.task.5134.mission_summar: Learn how to use Null Void coordinate data from Albedo.
entries.content.mission.task.5134.objective: Travel to the Mega Fusion Echo Echo Containment Area
entries.content.mission.task.5134.offer_descript: Are you ready to take down Mega Fusion Echo Echo? You can use the coordinate data I had you collect earlier to transport yourself to the Null Void. Speak with the Projector Technician over there, and have him scan the coordinates. Since traveling to the Null Void will completely destroy the coordinate data, you can only use it once. You better still have that copy I entrusted you with!
entries.content.mission.task.5134.task_descripti:
Do you still have the coordinate data in your inventory? If so, proceed to the Projector Technician and travel to the Null Void to face Mega Fusion Echo Echo. If not, ensure that you have it with you before you talk with them. You should also make sure that the coordinate data in your inventory is not encrypted. You can use your nanocom can decrypt the data the same way you open a CRATE.

If you somehow lost the coordinate data completely, you will have to track down another Mini Fusion Echo Echo and defeat it, ensuring that you COLLECT the data and that it REMAINS in your inventory before we can proceed. 

If this is too much for you to wrap your head around, I suggest you give up completely instead of wasting my time any further.
entries.content.mission.task.5134.title: Mega Fusion Education (Part 2 of 2)

entries.content.mission.task.5164.completion_des:
Here’s your reward! I WAS going to give you a whole bunch of taros, but then I realized I need money to buy the comic when Lenny gets back. BUT, I have something even BETTER than money to give you! Presenting… a mint condition, new in-box, first print Blossom Talks-Alot figurine with an articulated hairbow and an ice breath standee! Lenny gave it to me from his PRIVATE COLLECTION. He mentioned something about figurine collecting not being as fulfilling as he thought it would be. Here ya go! Oh, you can also take this green stuff I scraped off the ground. I think it’s moss or something.

I saw this really interesting program last night about moss. Did you know there are over 50 different types of moss native to the Townsville region alone? The ecosystem’s biodiversity is amazing around here because of the proximity to so many different and varied biomes. The leaking nuclear plant is also probably partially to blame.

Oh oh, did you know that nuclear energy is the way of the future? According to top researchers in the field, alternatives like Dextronium and Imaginary Energy just aren’t viable renewable resources. I’m not even sure I believe in that Imaginary Energy hoo-ha anyway. If it WERE real then I would definitely have my own imaginary friend exactly like my good friend Johnny Bravo, but nicer. He’d be really into my favorite multimedia franchise, “Space Wars.”

Speaking of my favorite multimedia franchise, “Space Wars,” what’s your stance on the latest film release, “The Final Starwizard?” It’s a VERY divisive film. Honestly I think it was a fun movie all on its own, but in terms of keeping with continuity I’d rank it below the holiday special. However, I value and respect those with different opinions to my own and if you enjoyed the movie I am very happy for you.

On the topic of holiday specials, did you know that Johnny Bravo met THE Santa Claus? He says so anyway. I personally celebrate Knishmas, myself. I find the personality of Knish Kringle to be way more exciting than a jolly old man. Plus, he could totally beat Santa in hand-to-hand combat. Have you seen how many limbs he has?


Speaking of limbs, you should see the articulation on this REALLY cool mint condition, new in-box, first print Blossom Talks-Alot figurine with an articulated hairbow and an ice breath standee! Lenny gave it to me from his PRIVATE COLLECTION. He mentioned something about figurine collecting not being as fulfilling as he thought it would be. As we established earlier, I’m gonna give this to you along with the green stuff I found on the ground as a reward for helping me out.
entries.content.mission.task.5164.mission_comple: I tried to help Carl get an autograph from one of his favorite celebrities.
entries.content.mission.task.5164.mission_summar: Help Carl get an autograph from one of his favorite celebrities.
entries.content.mission.task.5164.objective: Find the source of the voice Carl heard
entries.content.mission.task.5164.offer_descript:
OH. MY. GOSH. Have you heard? The lead actor from the famous multimedia franchise “Space Wars” is in town! Or, at least, I think he’s in town. I heard his voice the other day when I was walking home from the Game Hive over in Peach Creek. Did you know he’s also a very talented voice actor? Anyway, can you track him down for me and get his autograph? I’ve gotta wait here for Lenny so I can be first in line to buy the latest issue of “Justice Friends versus The Powerpuff Girls: Revenge of the Glorft.” 

Apparently in this next issue they’re going to reveal that there’s actually a secret fourth Powerpuff Girl. Well, they’re advertising it as a fourth, but there were actually two previous fourth Powerpuff Girls in earlier issues, for a total of five so far. BUT they obviously retconned those two since reception of the characters was really mixed. Ooh ooh! What do you think their primary color will be? Well, using data based on the way previous characters have been introduced, and my long history of making headcanons, I theorise the next Powerpuff will be purple! ...Again.

Speaking of which, the alternate universe Krunk from Universe 32-B that fell into Universe 25-C, which is the universe this comic takes place in (that’s actually up for debate, by the way) is actually Supercow in disguise! You see, Krunk doesn’t normally have udders, but if you’re a seasoned comic book veteran like myself you can easily pick out small details like that.

Which reminds me, I really need to go grocery shopping soon. I’m always running out of milk. You know, I saw my very good friend Johnny Bravo’s picture on a carton the other day. That must mean he’s really famous now! Come to think of it, I haven’t seen Johnny in weeks. You see, I tried calling him to tell him the good news, but he didn’t pick up the phone! Maybe he finally figured out how to block my number. I’ll have to get another burner phone so we can keep in touch.

Oh, also! Pops mentioned something about some sort of alien invasion. Man, if aliens were really invading that would be SO COOL. Pops was probably just trying to pull a fast one on me, though. A nerd can dream!

Y’know, the topic of aliens makes me think of my all time favorite multimedia franchise, “Space Wars.” Say, did you hear that the lead actor is in town? Or, at least, I think he’s in town. I heard his voice the other day when I was walking home from the Game Hive over in Peach Creek. Did you know he’s also a very talented voice actor? Anyway, can you track him down for me and get his autograph?
entries.content.mission.task.5164.task_descripti:
I think I heard the voice of the lead actor for my favorite multimedia franchise “Space Wars” when I was in Peach Creek the other day. Can you find him and get me his autograph? I’d mark the location on your map but I don’t know where he is. You should try searching the areas around Peach Creek, though.

I heard him doing one of his character voices, but I can’t remember if it was the sassy robot or the pirate captain.

I heard his voice the other day when I was walking home from the Game Hive over in Peach Creek. Did you know he’s also a very talented voice actor? Anyway, can you track him down for me and get his autograph? I’ve gotta wait here for Lenny so I can be first in line to buy the latest issue of “Justice Friends versus The Powerpuff Girls: Revenge of the Glorft.” 

Apparently in this next issue they’re going to reveal that there’s actually a secret fourth Powerpuff Girl. Well, they’re advertising it as a fourth, but there were actually two previous fourth Powerpuff Girls in earlier issues, for a total of five so far. BUT they obviously retconned those two since reception of the characters was really mixed. Ooh ooh! What do you think their primary color will be? Well, using data based on the way previous characters have been introduced, and my long history of making headcanons, I theorise the next Powerpuff will be purple! ...Again.

Speaking of which, the alternate universe Krunk from Universe 32-B that fell into Universe 25-C, which is the universe this comic takes place in (that’s actually up for debate, by the way) is actually Supercow in disguise! You see, Krunk doesn’t normally have udders, but if you’re a seasoned comic book veteran like myself you can easily pick out small details like that.

Which reminds me, I really need to go grocery shopping soon. I’m always running out of milk. You know, I saw my very good friend Johnny Bravo’s picture on a carton the other day. That must mean he’s really famous now! Come to think of it, I haven’t seen Johnny in weeks. You see, I tried calling him to tell him the good news, but he didn’t pick up the phone! Maybe he finally figured out how to block my number. I’ll have to get another burner phone so we can keep in touch.

Oh, also! Pops mentioned something about some sort of alien invasion. Man, if aliens were really invading that would be SO COOL. Pops was probably just trying to pull a fast one on me, though. A nerd can dream!

Y’know, the topic of aliens makes me think of my all time favorite multimedia franchise, “Space Wars.” Say, did you hear that the lead actor is in town? Or, at least, I think he’s in town. I heard his voice the other day when I was walking home from the Game Hive over in Peach Creek. Did you know he’s also a very talented voice actor? Anyway, can you track him down for me and get his autograph?
entries.content.mission.task.5166.task_descripti: Cool, you’re back! Your mind is going to be BLOWN when you see what I’m about to give you.
entries.content.mission.task.5166.title: The Mark of a True Nerd

entries.content.mission.task.5167.offer_descript: Oh thank goodness, another one of the locals! My name is Larry 3000 and I’m with the Time Squad. We’re a task force dedicated to making sure important events in History happen as they should. What was SUPPOSED to be a fairly standard mission to repair a historical inaccuracy in this time period has turned into one big mess! Would you be willing to help me reestablish contact with Officer Buck Tudrussel?
entries.content.mission.task.5167.task_descripti: You need to locate my time pod, it’s the vehicle I used to get to this time period. It should be somewhere in that disgusting landfill. I’d do it myself, but I’ll have you know landfills don’t exist in the future I’m from, and I’m not risking getting rubbish in my motivator!

entries.content.mission.task.5171.offer_descript: Coop has informed me there’s an alien invasion in progress, but my limited records indicate that Earth wasn’t conquered by an alien planet until 56,897 AD. I’ll see if their energy signature matches up with anything in the Time Squad database.

entries.content.mission.task.5197.completion_des:
Thanks for pounding some sense into those bullies! Why, if I didn’t have a brave soul like you to help me out in these times of trouble, I don’t know what I’d do! Speaking of, I’ve got a list here of all the chores and junk I need done.

entries.content.mission.task.5197.offer_descript: Heya, new neighbor! What’s shakin’? I’m the one and only Ice King. See, I’ve got this cool crown that gives me ice powers and- whatever, that’s not the point. Can ya do me a solid? My penguins are up on that massive ice structure that I totally made, because I’m a super cool dude, and I need someone to babysit them. They can’t really do anything by themselves— I don’t know what they’d do without me! Anyhoo, I’m busy, so you look after ‘em for me.

Dear Diary (you still haven’t written me back, by the way), 
Today I held a great Welcome Ice King To The Neighborhood Barbeque as a way to welcome myself to the neighborhood! But then a bunch of nasty evil penguins showed up and started trashing the place. I wonder if the kid I asked to help me out will be able to get them to stop being annoying. I’m not sharing this sweet new pad I moved into with them OR their giant ice monster friends!
Wait, this isn’t my diary. What the biscuits is a ‘journal’?

Unfortunately, one of my memory chips containing confidential data regarding that particular location has been found to be corrupted, and I suspect this to be the next step in Fuse’s plan to steal our technology. 

Dexter has been unable to diagnose the problem, and I fear we may have to turn to Mandark for help. He may be willing to cooperate in exchange for our silence on the embarrassing Fusion Dee Dee incident.
entries.content.mission.task.5236.task_descripti: It appears that Mandark used his digitizer machine to inject his own malware into the chip alongside your own data. Please destroy his viruses before going after the original source of the corruption.
entries.content.mission.task.5236.title: Nostalgia Chip
entries.content.mission.task.5237.mission_comple: I helped recover one of Computress’ corrupted memory chips.

entries.content.mission.task.5239.task_descripti: This revelation that Fuse’s Lair is filled with Fusion Spawns makes absolutely zero sense! The sense it makes is less than one, on a scale from one to ten. Lord Fuse was the leader of the Fusions, as I am the leader of my Monkey Minion Army, and without my leadership, my army would fall! For I am a great leader, who my army relies on. If I were to be defeated (which I would not be) they would most certainly surrender! Uh, er, I mean, they are STRONG and FEARLESS and would continue without me! So do not attempt to foil any future world-conquering attempts that I will attempt in the future by taking me out to make my army give up, for it will not work. To the point, I am very confused as to why Fuse’s army still functions.

entries.content.mission.task.5257.completion_des: Ооооо, спасибо-спасибо. Я его прям щас и съем… После… после пары писем. «Дорогой Джим, ты всегда умел хорошо шутить.». Это же правда! Я всегда умел хорошо шутить!
entries.content.mission.task.5257.mission_comple: Мне удалось доставить сэндвич с сыром Санитару Джиму, который уж слишком наслаждается своей перепиской с будущим собой. Может, следовало сказать, что это будущий он?
entries.content.mission.task.5257.mission_summar: Помочь Санитару Джиму не потерять сознание от голода.
entries.content.mission.task.5257.offer_descript: Привет, слушай. Эта червоточина – нечто! Из неё постоянно идут сообщения! И постоянно мне! Как будто это я точно знаю, что скажу в будущем, чтобы сказать это себе в прошлом! И какие сообщения! Что я молодец, что у меня всё получится! Я уже так давно не отходил от этой червоточины, что… проголодался. Ты можешь принести мне чего-нибудь перекусить? Буду очень благодарен.
entries.content.mission.task.5257.task_descripti: Эх… Сэндвич с сыром. Как же я буду его вкусно есть. А? Что? Новое сообщение? «Дорогой Джим. Сэнди была дурой, что не захотела с тобой встречаться». А я ведь говорил! Говорил!

entries.content.mission.task.5260.mission_comple: Мне удалось доставить сэндвич с сыром Санитару Джиму, который уж слишком наслаждается своей перепиской с будущим собой. Может, следовало сказать, что это будущий он?
entries.content.mission.task.5260.mission_summar: Помочь Санитару Джиму не потерять сознание от голода.
entries.content.mission.task.5260.offer_descript: Привет, слушай. Эта червоточина – нечто! Из неё постоянно идут сообщения! И постоянно мне! Как будто это я точно знаю, что скажу в будущем, чтобы сказать это себе в прошлом! И какие сообщения! Что я молодец, что у меня всё получится! Я уже так давно не отходил от этой червоточины, что… проголодался. Ты можешь принести мне чего-нибудь перекусить? Буду очень благодарен.
entries.content.mission.task.5260.task_descripti: Эх… Сэндвич с сыром. Как же я буду его вкусно есть. А? Что? Новое сообщение? «Дорогой Джим. Сэнди была дурой, что не захотела с тобой встречаться». А я ведь говорил! Говорил!
entries.content.mission.task.5260.title: Oh, Brother (Part 1 of 3)
entries.content.mission.task.5261.completion_des: Ладно. Хорошо. Я создала страничку своего братишки в «Омнидруг». Написала «Любит чревоточины, путешествия во время и людей, похожих на себя…» - вернее – «с похожими интересами». Будем ждать… и надеяться. Понадейся за меня, ибо я уже всё.
entries.content.mission.task.5261.mission_comple: Попытки найти пару Санитару Джиму… окончились ничем. И, честно говоря, меня это не особо удивляет.
entries.content.mission.task.5261.mission_summar: Попытаться найти пару Санитару Джиму из девочек в Секторе В
entries.content.mission.task.5261.offer_descript: Эй. Это с тобой болтал мой горе-братишка Джим? С этими письмами из червоточены он вообще с ума сошёл. Целыми днями только и делает, что читает и читает о том, какой он классный, какой он молодец. И ладно бы это его мотивировало – но нет, он просто стоит без дела и считает себя лучше остальных. Ему нужна пара. Ты можешь поговорить с девочками Сектора В? Может, он кому-нибудь нравится…
entries.content.mission.task.5261.task_descripti: В Секторе В есть аж шесть девочек! Это шесть шансов! Вероятность неудачи – 16 процентов… Или 14? Неважно! Важно то, что мы найдём моему братишке пару! Поговори с Номер 750.

Могу исправить ошибки, дать правильный совет. Но вот только... Я не знаю правильные советы. Я уверен, что где-нибудь есть руководство о том, как правильно себя вести и достигать успеха. Можешь спросить у Эдди, продаёт ли он что-нибудь подобное?
entries.content.mission.task.5273.task_descripti: Я в тебя верю!.. Я же правильно сказал? Я не слишком на тебя давлю? Потому что я не давлю. Ты справишься!.. Это же не слишком завышенные ожидания?.. Я... Я помолчу.
entries.content.mission.task.5273.title: Me, Myself and I
entries.content.mission.task.5274.completion_des: Огромное тебе спасибо! Я буду слушать эти подкасты и отправлять то, что усвою, себе в прошлое! Меня все будут любить. Так... Что? «Подкаст 413 - Почему надо время от времени говорить «Приятного Аппетита»»? Я заинтригован.
entries.content.mission.task.5274.mission_comple: Теперь у Санитара Джима есть коллекция подкастов «Я - Лучшая» Принцессы Дай-Денег. Надеюсь, это поднимет его самооценку.

entries.content.mission.task.728.task_descriptio: You recovered all of Numbuh Five's candy, but those no-good creeps turned my treats into radioactive junk. Go into the infected zone on Stickybeard's old ship, the Sweet Revenge. Then leave that candy where the monsters will find it.

entries.content.mission.task.797.completion_desc: Now Max has the positive node for the energy cell. Pretty soon he will be able to launch his surveillance satellite so we can study Planet Fusion more closely.
entries.content.mission.task.797.mission_complet: I recovered the positive node of the energy cell for Max.
entries.content.mission.task.797.mission_summary: Recover the other half of the Plumber energy cell for Max.
entries.content.mission.task.797.offer_descripti: Grandpa Max just told me that he's located the other half of the energy cell that he needs for the surveillance satellite. It's inside the space port. Gear up and go.
entries.content.mission.task.797.task_descriptio: Max just told me that he received a message from Kevin. You need to meet up with Hoss Delgado, a real tough hombre and a Spectral Exterminator, to boot. He might know a thing or two about ghostly aliens. He's out in Devil's Bluff, near where the message from Kevin originated.
entries.content.mission.task.797.title: Tough Cell
entries.content.mission.task.798.completion_desc: That Princess Morbucks knows a thing or two about advanced equipment. Good work obtaining that jetpack from the space port for me, Mojo Jojo!
entries.content.mission.task.798.mission_complet: I collected a jetpack from the space port for Mojo.
entries.content.mission.task.798.mission_summary: Talk to Princess about equipment for Mojo's monkey troops.
entries.content.mission.task.798.offer_descripti: Once my new Super Monkeys are ready, I will want to outfit them with the best equipment, not the worst. Please go ask Princess for some advice.
entries.content.mission.task.798.task_descriptio: It is now time to begin recruiting new monkey minions. Then we will use the tributaries and waterways of the wilds to distribute my new Chemical X formula. And then I will have super monkey minions! Go and find Fuzzy Lumkins, who lives near Leakey Lake. He will help me with this plan, or my name is not Mojo Jojo!

entries.content.mission.task.842.mission_complet: I defeated some Power Painsaws and learned that Fuse is trying to dig into Dexter's old lab! Then I defeated some Doom Drones and Fusion Dee Dee. I collected a Pony Puff Princess doll to make a Dee Dee Nano.

entries.content.mission.task.842.offer_descripti: I hear weird noises coming from the basement! And there's lots of monsters around! Can you check it out for me? I'm a little scared.
entries.content.mission.task.842.task_descriptio: My Pony Puff Princess doll has been beheaded! Who would do such a horrible thing? Oh, no, it's none other than Fusion Dee Dee! Defeat her and get my doll's head back.

entries.content.mission.task.913.completion_desc: Hey, I just got a message from Blossom! She wants to say "thanks" for your work in Pokey Oaks. Way to show Fuse a thing or two or three!
entries.content.mission.task.913.mission_complet: I defused a Gooby Trap at Pokey Oaks Junior High.
entries.content.mission.task.913.offer_descripti: Monsters are in Pokey Oaks terrorizing the junior high school, and Blossom has asked the KND to help out. I think you're the perfect choice for the task.
entries.content.mission.task.913.task_descriptio: Come back to me at home base and I'll give you a reward.
entries.content.mission.task.913.title: Pokey Punch-Out
entries.content.mission.task.914.completion_desc: Wow, that info from the Plumber data miner was interesting. Seems like Planet Fusion has been terrorizing the galaxy for almost a thousand years!
entries.content.mission.task.914.mission_complet: I downloaded some info about Fuse from a remote data miner.
entries.content.mission.task.914.mission_summary: Get Plumber data miner back online and recover data.
entries.content.mission.task.914.offer_descripti: Ben wants us to access some info from a remote data miner. You'll need to synchronize both Plumber access ports and download the data to your NanoCom.
entries.content.mission.task.914.task_descriptio: While Ben sends the data to Grandpa Max for analysis, you can go back to Peach Creek to collect a reward. Aw yeah!
entries.content.mission.task.914.title: Major Miner
entries.content.mission.task.915.completion_desc: Awesome! You got the radioactive isotope that our operatives need down at the space port. When you're ready, I'll send you to deliver it.
entries.content.mission.task.915.mission_complet: I recovered a radioactive isotope from the nuclear plant.
entries.content.mission.task.915.mission_summary: Recover a radioactive isotope from the nuclear power plant.
entries.content.mission.task.915.offer_descripti: The operatives stationed with Ben at the space port need a radioactive isotope to power some special equipment. Can you get one from the nuclear power plant?
entries.content.mission.task.915.task_descriptio: Be careful with that isotope, and bring it back to me. Ben sent a reward for you, by the way.
entries.content.mission.task.915.title: Nuclear Haste
entries.content.mission.task.916.completion_desc: Hey, thanks for recovering the Power Level Tracker. I think this will really help us in our search for the missing heroes. Keep up the great work.
entries.content.mission.task.916.mission_complet: I collected the Power Level Tracker from Edd.
entries.content.mission.task.916.mission_summary: Contact Edd to collect a special piece of alien hardware.
entries.content.mission.task.916.offer_descripti: Edd found an alien device called a Power Level Tracker. I've got a picture. Dexter thinks we might be able to use it to locate the world's missing super heroes.
entries.content.mission.task.916.task_descriptio: Too bad that device is broken. Well, bring it back here to me and let me have it. I've got a cool weapon for you, too.
entries.content.mission.task.916.title: Hardware Help

entries.content.mission.task.917.offer_descripti: Fuse has been stealing our tech. It's time we returned the favor. I need you to recover some more samples from the junk yard.
entries.content.mission.task.917.task_descriptio: Fuse has been stealing and corrupting our gear. It's time we returned the favor and stole his tech. His Fusions are stealing the junk in the salvage yard. Bring me five samples of his Scrap Tyrants.

entries.content.nano_tune.3.description: Buttercup intimidates friend and foe alike to get you even more Fusion Matter!
entries.content.nano_tune.3.name: BUTTERCUP BURST
entries.content.nano_tune.30.description: Megas performs an epic ground slam to KO monsters and exposes their weak spots.
entries.content.nano_tune.30.name: GARDEN STATE SLAM
entries.content.nano_tune.31.description: Billy can’t comprehend enemies’ stupefying effects, so they don’t work!
entries.content.nano_tune.31.name: UNSTOPPABLE STUPID
entries.content.nano_tune.32.description: Billy channels his Inner Frat Boy to paddle monsters into a weakening, deep sleep.
entries.content.nano_tune.32.name: INNER FRAT BOY
entries.content.nano_tune.33.description: Billy’s schnozz is full of boogers, and can be used as deadly projectiles!
entries.content.nano_tune.33.name: SNOT ROCKET
entries.content.nano_tune.34.description: Swampfire unleashes a heatwave that saps energy from an enemy.
entries.content.nano_tune.34.name: HEAT STROKE
entries.content.nano_tune.35.description: Using his Powerprof Rocket Pack, Utonium gives your group a jump boost!
entries.content.nano_tune.35.name: ROCKET PACK
entries.content.nano_tune.36.description: Using the power of science, the Professor will propel you upward, even in midair!
entries.content.nano_tune.36.name: UTONIUM ZOOM
entries.content.nano_tune.37.description: Him's terrifying guffaw damages all monsters in the area.
entries.content.nano_tune.37.name: EVIL LAUGH
entries.content.nano_tune.38.description: Him’s chortle gives a health boost to you and your allies nearby.
entries.content.nano_tune.38.name: MWA-HA-HA
entries.content.nano_tune.39.description: A burst of demonic power will protect you from enemy debuffs!
entries.content.nano_tune.39.name: DEMONIC POSSESSION
entries.content.nano_tune.4.description: Fully Amped Shoes Travel Far, Exceeding Estimated Tempo. Simply put: you run faster!
entries.content.nano_tune.4.name: F.A.S.T. F.E.E.T.
entries.content.nano_tune.40.description: Whipsmart McCoy shows treasures on your mini-map! You can be his butler, Wimpy.
entries.content.nano_tune.40.name: FINDERS KEEPERS
entries.content.nano_tune.41.description: Bloo ensnares your enemies with some glue taken from Herriman’s office.
entries.content.nano_tune.41.name: BLOO GLUE
entries.content.nano_tune.42.description: Bloo annoys nearby monsters with a juicebox fueled burp. How rude!
entries.content.nano_tune.42.name: JUICEBOX BELCH
entries.content.nano_tune.43.description: Bubbles uses super breath to slow down your enemies with a tornado.
entries.content.nano_tune.43.name: TORNADO TRAP
entries.content.nano_tune.44.description: Bubbles uses her Harmony Bunny Pogo Stick to give you a jump boost!
entries.content.nano_tune.44.name: BUNNY HOP
entries.content.nano_tune.45.description: Bubbles’ laser vision blasts your target for hardcore damage!
entries.content.nano_tune.45.name: LASER VISION
entries.content.nano_tune.46.description: Demongo's blazing attack will damage all foes in the area.
entries.content.nano_tune.46.name: DEMON'S FIRE
entries.content.nano_tune.47.description: Demongo slows all monsters nearby with one of his enchanted skulls.
entries.content.nano_tune.47.name: HERO'S STRENGTH
entries.content.nano_tune.48.description: Demongo imbues you with a warrior’s essence to revive you in battle.
entries.content.nano_tune.48.name: WARRIOR'S RESOLVE
entries.content.nano_tune.49.description: Four Arms gives monsters in the area a good bonk, leaving them open to a critical attack.
entries.content.nano_tune.49.name: SEEING RED
entries.content.nano_tune.5.description: Hoagie uses S.C.A.M.P.E.R. technology to propel you forward and dodge attacks!
entries.content.nano_tune.5.name: NONSTOP FLIGHT
entries.content.nano_tune.50.description: Four Arms grabs even more Fusion Matter rewards with his extra arms!
entries.content.nano_tune.50.name: FOUR HAND GRAB
entries.content.nano_tune.51.description: Four Arm’s sheer power weakens your enemies and strengthens you!
entries.content.nano_tune.51.name: OVERPOWER
entries.content.nano_tune.52.description: Send a wide blast of spitballs at your foes for big damage.
entries.content.nano_tune.52.name: SPITWAD VOLLEY
entries.content.nano_tune.53.description: Nigel uses his First Aid training to patch you up, restoring health.
entries.content.nano_tune.53.name: FIRST AID
entries.content.nano_tune.54.description: Numbuh One uses a C.H.A.N.G.E.M.A.K.E.R. to grant extra Taro rewards.
entries.content.nano_tune.54.name: BIG BUCKS
entries.content.nano_tune.55.description: You’re unstoppable! No special attacks will harm you thanks to Mojo’s protection!
entries.content.nano_tune.55.name: JOJO JUGGERNAUT
entries.content.nano_tune.56.description: Mojo drains an enemy of its energy. That is to say, it will have less energy than it did before!
entries.content.nano_tune.56.name: FREEZE RAY
entries.content.nano_tune.57.description: Mojo uses his immaculate brain to formulate a plan to protect you from enemy attacks.
entries.content.nano_tune.57.name: BRAIN POWER
entries.content.nano_tune.58.description: Mandark’s hi-tech Bio-Dome shields you from all toxic materials, including Fusion Matter!
entries.content.nano_tune.58.name: BIO DOME
entries.content.nano_tune.59.description: Stun monsters with the dark forces Mandark uses to power his inventions! Ha ha ha!
entries.content.nano_tune.59.name: MANDARKNESS
entries.content.nano_tune.6.description: Numbuh Two uses his “skills” from yipper card trading to earn more taros.
entries.content.nano_tune.6.name: LUNCH MONEY
entries.content.nano_tune.60.description: Mandark sets off powerful thrusters, giving your group boosted jump power!
entries.content.nano_tune.60.name: RETRO-THRUSTERS
entries.content.nano_tune.61.description: Some Heebie Jeebie Juice gives a health boost to everyone in your group.
entries.content.nano_tune.61.name: HEEBIE JEEBIE JOLT
entries.content.nano_tune.62.description: Grim grants your group a speed bonus that lets you run like bats out of heck!
entries.content.nano_tune.62.name: BAT OUT OF HECK
entries.content.nano_tune.63.description: It’s against his job description, but Grim can revive your group members if they’re KO’d.
entries.content.nano_tune.63.name: SCYTHE OF RELIEF
entries.content.nano_tune.64.description: Dexter provides Dexlabs gliding technology to extend your jumps.
entries.content.nano_tune.64.name: GLIDE
entries.content.nano_tune.65.description: The patented Dexlabs Inviso-Ray grants stealth to your entire group.
entries.content.nano_tune.65.name: INVISO-RAY
entries.content.nano_tune.66.description: Use Dexter's Teleporter to return to a safe area, or calibrate it to a recall point.
entries.content.nano_tune.66.name: TELEPORTER
entries.content.nano_tune.67.description: Vilgax’s highly advanced sensors can detect monsters and display them on your mini-map.
entries.content.nano_tune.67.name: SECURE PERIMETER
entries.content.nano_tune.68.description: Vilgax lets you run at light speed via the tech he uses to travel the galaxy.
entries.content.nano_tune.68.name: LIGHT SPEED
entries.content.nano_tune.69.description: Vilgax's knowledge of the Null Void Frontier phases you through dimensions to avoid foes.
entries.content.nano_tune.69.name: NULL VOID PASSAGE
entries.content.nano_tune.7.description: Eddy reluctantly shares a jawbreaker with you for a quick burst of health.
entries.content.nano_tune.7.name: JAWBREAKER BREAK
entries.content.nano_tune.70.description: The Prof.'s parental instincts kick in as he hits a monster to set up a critical strike.
entries.content.nano_tune.70.name: PROF. PROTECTION
entries.content.nano_tune.71.description: Swampfire produces a noxious methane gas to make enemies helpless to a powered-up attack.
entries.content.nano_tune.71.name: SWAMP GAS
entries.content.nano_tune.72.description: Swampfire lets you sneak past your foes like a slowly creeping vine.
entries.content.nano_tune.72.name: CREEPING VINE
entries.content.nano_tune.73.description: Mandy slaps your group on the behind for a speed boost for all.
entries.content.nano_tune.73.name: SEISMIC SLAP
entries.content.nano_tune.74.description: Treasures will appear on your mini-map if they know what’s good for them.
entries.content.nano_tune.74.name: MORE FOR ME
entries.content.nano_tune.75.description: Mandy uses an artifact stolen from Grim to warp you to a recall point or Resurrect 'Em.
entries.content.nano_tune.75.name: DIMENSIONAL RIFT
entries.content.nano_tune.76.description: Coco lays a powerful egg shell to encase you in battle and protect you from harm.
entries.content.nano_tune.76.name: POWER SHELL
entries.content.nano_tune.77.description: Coco goes loco and protects your group from special attacks.
entries.content.nano_tune.77.name: BIRD BRAIN UNBOUND
entries.content.nano_tune.78.description: Coco lays an exploding egg that stuns all monsters in the area!
entries.content.nano_tune.78.name: EGG BOMB
entries.content.nano_tune.79.description: Mac goes hyperactive after downing Fizzy Rox Candy and launches you into the air.
entries.content.nano_tune.79.name: FIZZY ROCKET
entries.content.nano_tune.8.description: Jig’s up! Eddy knows how to move quickly when a scam’s gone wrong!
entries.content.nano_tune.8.name: SPEEDY GEDAWAY
entries.content.nano_tune.80.description: Mac uses stealth learned from avoiding surprise parties to sneak past monsters!
entries.content.nano_tune.80.name: HIDE AND SNEAK
entries.content.nano_tune.81.description: Mac bores enemies into a defenseless sleep with his complicated homework problems.
entries.content.nano_tune.81.name: AFTER SCHOOL SPECIAL
entries.content.nano_tune.82.description: Numbuh Three shares a sweet health boost with everyone in your group.
entries.content.nano_tune.82.name: SHARE THE LOVE
entries.content.nano_tune.83.description: Everybody QUIET!!! Kuki’s trying to help your group sneak!
entries.content.nano_tune.83.name: SANBAN SNEAK
entries.content.nano_tune.84.description: Anything can be made better by hugging a Rainbow Monkey!
entries.content.nano_tune.84.name: RAINBOW REVIVAL
entries.content.nano_tune.85.description: Hex uses a powerful charm to make monsters in the area fall into a weakening slumber.
entries.content.nano_tune.85.name: SLEEP CHARM
entries.content.nano_tune.86.description: Hex summons wind at your back that accelerates your movement.
entries.content.nano_tune.86.name: SUMMON WIND
entries.content.nano_tune.87.description: Hex uses the Charm of Telekinesis to push you and dodge past enemies.
entries.content.nano_tune.87.name: VANISHING ACT
entries.content.nano_tune.88.description: Using her superhuman abilities, Juniper Lee gives you a jump boost.
entries.content.nano_tune.88.name: MYSTICAL BOOST
entries.content.nano_tune.89.description: Using a mystical spell, June steals an enemy’s energy and gives it to you!
entries.content.nano_tune.89.name: TE-XUAN-ZAP
entries.content.nano_tune.9.description: Eddy's Protektion Servizes don't come cheap, but he'll spot you for some enemy damage.
entries.content.nano_tune.9.name: ENERGY SAVER
entries.content.nano_tune.90.description: June gets the drop on monsters in your area and ensnares them all with mystical energy.
entries.content.nano_tune.90.name: MONSTER AMBUSH
entries.content.nano_tune.91.description: Numbuh Four inspires you to return to the fight if you get knocked out.
entries.content.nano_tune.91.name: DON'T GIVE UP!
entries.content.nano_tune.92.description: Never say Wally’s not one to lend a hand - he’ll heal you up, along with allies nearby.
entries.content.nano_tune.92.name: BATTLE BOOSTER
entries.content.nano_tune.93.description: Numbuh Four uses his combat skills to knock some pain into all monsters in the area.
entries.content.nano_tune.93.name: SABOTAGE STRIKE
entries.content.nano_tune.94.description: Dr. Ed prescribes sleeping pills to nearby monsters, leaving them open. Nighty-night!
entries.content.nano_tune.94.name: PAGING DR. ED
entries.content.nano_tune.95.description: Ed knows a lot about monsters, and can show you where they are on your mini-map!
entries.content.nano_tune.95.name: MONSTER TRACKER
entries.content.nano_tune.96.description: Big Ed ensnares nearby monsters in a lung-crushing group hug! Aww!
entries.content.nano_tune.96.name: GROUP HUG
entries.content.nano_tune.97.description: Megas unleashes a familiar energy blast, burning your target with extra damage.
entries.content.nano_tune.97.name: EIGHTBALL FIREBALL
entries.content.nano_tune.98.description: Courage does a cute little dance that heals you emotionally and physically.
entries.content.nano_tune.98.name: SOFTSHOE SHIMMY
entries.content.nano_tune.99.description: Cowardice can pay off! Courage cautiously collects additional Fusion Matter rewards.
entries.content.nano_tune.99.name: COWER POWER

entries.content.tabledata.first_use.first_use_st: Your Nano is running low on stamina. When a Nano's stamina runs out, it will need to rest before you can summon it again.
Gumballs make your Nanos more powerful for a limited time. Feed a gumball to your Nano by clicking on the Nano you want to give it to.
Your guide will send you messages via email. To check your mail, hit the "Enter" key and select "E-Mail" from the main menu. You can also hit the "P" key.
Badly infected areas are surrounded by force fields to prevent Fuse's infection from spreading. Use warp gates to enter and exit the infected zones.
Your NanoCom is low on energy. You will collect less Fusion Matter and fewer Taros until your NanoCom recharges. Take a break from playing to recharge.
Some Nanos have passive powers, which means you do not have to do anything to activate the power. Simply summon the Nano.
Your NanoCom comes with a map to help you get around. To open the map, hit the "Enter" key and select "Map" from the main menu. You can also hit the "M" key.
Nanos and monsters are one of three types: Adaptium, Blastons or Cosmix. A beats B, B beats C, and C beats A. Do more damage with a more powerful Nano.
Monsters may attack your Nano directly with a Corruption Attack. These attacks are one of three types: A, B or C. Block the attack with a more powerful Nano.
Some monsters cause the ground at your feet to erupt with an explosion of Fusion Matter. Get out of the target zone to avoid taking damage.
Nano Potions restore your Nano's stamina. To give a potion to your Nano, hit the "C" key.
A new item has been added to your pack. To open your inventory, press the "Enter" key and select "My Stuff" from the main menu. You can also hit the "I" key.
Weapon Boosts automatically make your weapons deal more damage. You do not need to do anything to activate them.
Nano Stations are used to manage your Nano collection. Visit a Nano Station to swap out your equipped Nanos or to activate new powers.
To change your Nano's active power, visit a Nano Station. You will need the correct amounts of Fusion Matter and power items to make the change.
When you create a new Nano, you will have to select one of three powers. If you don't like your selection, you can use a Nano Station to change it later.
Shopkeepers buy and sell items. To buy an item, click on the item you want and select "Buy". To sell an item from your pack, click on it and select "Sell".
Coco has laid eggs all over the world. Open an egg to get a temporary power boost. Simply touch an egg or run over it to open it.
You defeated a Spawn and found some Taros. Taros are the world's money. Use them to buy items from shopkeepers.
For a fee, you can use the KND's S.C.A.M.P.E.R. to fly from one place to another. You must register first at both ends of the route before you can use it.
Mojo Jojo's monkey minions will fly you to nearby locations for a fee. You must register at both ends of the route before you can use it.
Grim's Resurrect 'Em will revive you in a nearby safe area if you get knocked out in battle.
All of your items, including weapons and clothing, are stored in your pack. To learn about an item, simply click on it.
You can store extra items at Morbucks Savings and Loan. To transfer an item, click on it and select "Move to Bank".
Humans may express themselves with emotes. Select the emotion you want from the menu, and you and your active Nano will behave accordingly.
Use menu chat to chat with your friends without having to type. Simply select the phrase you want to say from the menu.
Use your NanoCom to warp directly to your buddies when they are logged on. Just select the buddy you want to join and click "Warp".
Place items you want to trade in the upper window. When your partner places acceptable items in the lower window, click "Trade" to complete the transaction.
You can trade items and Taros with other players. The trade window will automatically open if the other player accepts your offer to trade.
It is possible to form a group of up to four players. Other players will be automatically added your group after accepting your offer to join.
If another player accepts your offer to be your buddy, that player will be added to your buddy list. You can warp directly to all players in your buddy list.
When you ignore another player, that player will not be able to send you emails or chat with you.
You can collect over 36 different Nanos, but you may only have three equipped at one time. To swap out your equipped Nanos, use a Nano Station.
Shirts, pants and shoes will protect you from Fuse's monsters. To wear an item, click on it and select "Equip".
Your Nano Book displays all the Nanos in your collection. You can check on their powers here, or see how much Fusion Matter you need to get your next Nano.
Shatterguns can hit multiple enemies at long range. But they don't do as much damage as a rifle.
Rockets fire projectiles that fly straight until they hit something. They explode on impact, and all nearby targets are damaged.
Thrown weapons sail over nearby objects and explode where they land, damaging all nearby targets.
To change your guide, select the character you want and click "Confirm". If you have enough Fusion Matter, the change will be made.
Change to your second weapon by using the Tab key. Use long range weapons on targets far away and the switch to melee weapons when they get close.
I am glad to see you made it out of Tech Sqaure. Please come speak to me right away. We must rebuild the time machine to get you back to the past.
Use a Fusion Portal to warp into a Fusion's lair. Fusions are dark versions of our heroes and some of Fuse's most powerful minions.
Some spawns will help their friends when you attack them. If facing these foes, use a weapon that hits multiple targets, such as a melee weapon or shattergun.
If you make a mistake inside an infected zone, Edd's Recall power allows you to warp back to a safe spot, marked by a floating energy sphere.
Use weapons to fight Fuse's minions. To equip a weapon, click on it and select "Equip Weapon 1" or "Equip Weapon 2".
Billy's Freedom power allows you to avoid the enemy's special attacks, like sleep and stun.
Numbuh Five's Revive power will put you right back on your feet after getting knocked out, as long as she is your active Nano when it happens.
Eddy's Guard power prevents monsters from draining your potions and boosts.
Blossom's Antidote power reduces the damage you take from infected ground and pools of Fusion Matter.
Rifles are reliable long-range weapons that do major damage, but they can only hit a single enemy at one time.
Pistols are short-range weapons that can do significant damage, but they can only hit one target at a time.
Melee weapons can strike multiple targets at very short range, but they are not as damaging as pistols.
You will take damage from infected patches on the ground, so steer clear.
Recall Markers allow you to warp back to safety if you have a Nano with the Recall power. Register at the Recall Marker first to use it.
Some monsters will stun you. To avoid these attacks, use a Nano with the Freedom power.
Accessories are worn on your head, face and back. They are worn for fun, not for protection. To wear an accessory, click on it and select "Equip".
Some monsters will drain your Nano Potions and Weapon Boosts. To avoid these attacks, use a Nano with the Guard power.
Some monsters will drain your Nano Potions and Weapon Boosts. To avoid these attacks, use a Nano with the Guard power.
Select "My Stuff" from the Main Menu to equip two weapons at once. To switch between weapons while adventuring, hit the "Tab" key.
You now have more than one mission. To change your current mission, go to your Journal. Then select the mission checkbox and click "Make Current Mission".
If your target is above you, the red marker on your mini-map will display a "+". If it is below you, the red marker will display a "-".
Vehicles allow you to travel around the world faster. They are available in various speeds and styles.
This Egg Generating Gizmo Ejects Rewards! Buy an E.G.G. for a chance to obtain some special or Ultra Rare items.
Combining items allows you to apply stats from one item to the look of another item.
You found a Mystery E.G.G.! These very special E.G.G.s often contain the best and rarest items.
You can equip a vehicle the same way you equip other gear. Select "Get On" to mount your vehicle, or press the "V" key.
Power items are used to change your Nano's active power. Each power type requires a different kind of power item.
You cannot attack monsters or interact with other players and NPCs when riding a vehicle. If you do so, you will automatically dismount.
Vehicles are available for rent only. Your vehicle's rental period has expired and has been automatically removed from your inventory.
Control your vehicle with the same commands that you use when on foot. To dismount, press the "V" key.
C.R.A.T.E.S. Contain Really Awesome Things for Everyone. To see what is inside the C.R.A.T.E., click "Open".
The Special Alien Capture Team hosts races inside the infected zones. Collect as many pods as you can and deliver them to the finish quickly for a top score.
