Defeat six Slizzards.
Yippee! Fusion Toiletnator won't find Coco now!
Nice job. Fusion Toiletnator is looking all over Forgotten Falls for Coco. He'll never suspect that she's actually here with us. Come on back to the Jungle Outpost, and give Numbuh Three that egg.
Return to Numbuh Three.
I've heard great things about you.
Thanks! Poor Fusion Toiletnator! He's so lost and confused! Hee hee hee.
Fusion on the Mountain (Part 1 of 3)
Recover Coco's Eggs.
Fusion Coco has been spotted up on Monkey Mountain. I need you to go out there and check things out.
I recovered thirteen of Coco's Eggs, but she didn't want them back. I wonder why? Hex told me she wanted them to be stolen!
I couldn't have done it better myself. We didn't get all the stolen eggs back, but we got a lot. Why didn't Coco want them?

Coco's eggs have been stolen! Fusion Coco led the Scythe Simians and Volcano Toads on a raid into the Twisted Forest to steal Coco's eggs. Get to Monkey Mountain and recover those eggs. We don't want Fuse to utilize the eggs' special powers.
Go to Monkey Mountain.
You fool. Coco wanted her eggs to be stolen.
You need to get Coco's eggs back from the monsters in the Monkey Mountain infected zone. Defeat the Scythe Simians to get some of the eggs back.
The tree house sure is big!
Defeat the Scythe Simians.
She could have stopped them from stealing her eggs. But she didn't.
Good! You got six eggs from the Scythe Simians.
You got six of Coco's eggs from the Scythe Simians. Now you need to get more from the Volcano Toads.
Defeat the Volcano Toads.
Now go after the Volcano Toads.
Cool! Can you bring those eggs back to Coco?
You recovered 13 eggs from the Scythe Simians and the Volcano Toads. Now you need to bring them to Coco.
Deliver eggs to Coco.
Coco!
I wish I was super like Blossom.
Coco cocococo…
You recovered 13 Coco eggs from the monsters at Monkey Mountain, but Coco didn't want them back. I wonder why? Well, bring them to me at the Jungle Outpost, Mate.
Bring eggs to Numbuh Four.
Coco doesn't want the eggs? Dunno why. Well, bring 'em here.
Nice work, Mate. I'll stash these for safe-keeping.
Why didn't Coco want her eggs back? Strange.
Fusion on the Mountain (Part 2 of 3)
Stop the Fusion Missile Launchers.
Crikey, you've got the monsters riled up on Monkey Mountain. Fusion Mojo Jojo is launching Fusion Missiles at the Twisted Forest. He's trying to get Coco's eggs!
I stopped Fusion Mojo's missile launchers by destroying his Missile Command. He won't be able to attack Coco's eggs now.
Lab Assistance
Good thing I had those eggs, or Fusion Mojo would have blasted 'em. But how did Coco know the attack was coming? Hopefully Dexter will have some ideas.

Fusion Mojo Jojo is launching Fusion Missiles into the Twisted Forest. Three guesses who he's aiming for. Head for Monkey Mountain, find the underground missile sites, and use this Fusion Nullifier on them. There are a lot of sites, so get going.
Go to Launch Site 1.
Good! The Fusion Nullifier took out that missile launcher.
You need to use the Fusion Nullifier on all the missile sites to prevent the Fusion Missiles from tracking Coco! You already got one launch site, now find the next one.
Go to Launch Site 2.
Hurry, those missiles are locked on to Coco's eggs!
Egg-cellent. Now we need to find the Missile Command and take 'er down.
You took out two Fusion Missile Launchers on Monkey Mountain, but now you have to find the Missile Command. If you don't, Fusion Mojo Jojo will never stop his assault.
Go to Missile Command.
Collect unique Fusion Matter samples from Mandark's yard.
Good work, Mate! You got all the launchers, and the Missile Command, too.
Fusion Mojo Jojo's missile attacks have stopped! But Dexter has detected some strange energy on the top of Monkey Mountain. Better go check it out, yeah?
Go to mountain peak.
Dexter here. I'm detecting a strange energy signature on the mountaintop.
What's that? It's an egg with a turban on it!
You collected some kind of weird Turban Egg from the top of Monkey Mountain. Better take it to Dexter so he can check it out.
Bring Turban Egg to Dexter.
Well, now I've seen everything.
Thanks for coming. Fusion Coco laid this egg. And I think she is trying to help us, strange as that sounds. You should be able to use this egg to find Fusion Mojo Jojo.
Critical Mission (Part 1 of 2)
Professor Utonium is conducting experiments on an unusual strain of Fusion Matter. Dexter wants us to collect some samples for him at Mandark's house.
Help Tetrax with his plan to defeat Fuse.
Fuse is getting desperate. His monster armies are dwindling and the infection is not spreading as fast as he would like. Now is the time to strike. You ready?
I collected a Lizard Queen's skin for Tetrax, and he told me that we must hunt down one of Fuse's most dangerous Fusions.
You performed admirably in the Fireswamps. With the Lizard Queen's skin, we can begin the next phase of my plan. You must confront a most diabolical Fusion.

Fuse is irate that so many of his monsters have been defeated and so many of his Fusion Matter infestations have been weakened. He is falling behind schedule, which is unthinkable. He has already redoubled the efforts of his Fusion lieutenants. Now is the time to strike. First, go to the Fireswamps.
Go to the Fireswamps.
You must engage with the Lizard Queens. Recover one of their skins.
It is time to fight Fuse's top Fusion lieutenants, while he is on the defensive. You need to collect a Lizard Queen's skin before we proceed with the next part of the plan.
Collect Lizard Queen skin.
I will explain once you have succeeded.
I collected Fusion Matter samples from Mandark's yard.
Good work. Bring that Lizard Queen skin back to me.
Now that you have obtained a Lizard Queen's skin, you will be able to infiltrate the lair of a very dangerous Fusion. Come back to me in Forsaken Valley.
Bring skin to Tetrax.
The Lizard Queen's skin will enable you to slip into the lair of a most dangerous Fusion adversary. Are you prepared?
Looking for Big Ed (Part 2 of 2)
Track Ed in the wilderness.
That dumb Ed disappeared to investigate weird aliens and now I have no one around here to do the heavy lifting. Maybe you should go out to Camp Kidney.
I went to Camp Kidney looking for Ed, and I found May Kanker. She told me some monsters had some of Ed's comic books, and I recovered them.
You still didn't find Ed? If May Kanker thinks he went deeper into the jungle, then maybe you should keep looking. I hope he didn't get eaten by a gorilla.
You should go out to Camp Kidney and start looking for Ed. If you see May Kanker, ask her if she knows anything.
That was nice work at Mandark's house. You helped Dexter and the Professor. With more kids like you, Fuse won't stand a chance against us.
Go to Camp Kidney.
Now that you're at Camp Kidney, see if you can follow Ed's trail.
You should go out to Camp Kidney and start looking for Ed. If you see May Kanker, ask her if she knows anything.
Find May Kanker.
The Kankers said May went looking for him. Maybe she's around, too.
My widdle Ed disappeared and I can't find him! But I saw some monsters that had some of his comic books. I hope he's not hurt!
Defeat the Tiger Wolves and see if they have Ed's comic books.
Defeat five Tiger Wolves.
Maybe you could beat up those monsters and try to get them back. You need to find the Tiger Wolves. Yeccch!
Nope…those monsters didn't have Ed's comic books.
You need to head out to the Sweet Revenge to see if you can find the monsters that stole my battery. If you find some candy, bring it back, 'kay?
Dexter wants me to send you to the infected zone near Mandark's house in Genius Grove. You need to collect some stuff for the Professor.
Defeat the Lazy Metal Boy Scouts to see if they have Ed's comic books.
Defeat the Lazy Metal Boy Scouts.
Maybe try the Lazy Metal Boy Scouts.
You got them! Wow! Bring them back here to me.
You found Ed's comic books, but no Ed? What a moron. Bring 'em to May and see if that goof can tell you anything.
Deliver comic books to May.
Look at these comics. Jungle Joe, Adam the Ape Boy, Monkey King Curly…I'll bet Ed was going deeper into the jungle! Oh, I hope he's okay!
A Grave Mission
Place a special flower on a grave.
Here Lies: A. Kwest. Sought by Many. Found by Few.
Go to Mandark's house.
I plucked a special flower from the Fireswamps and returned it to a grave.
A voice calls from the Great Beyond: "Thank you for the Flaming Rose. I can now rest in peace. Unless you are going to the store…I could use a soda."

I was once a great explorer. I fell in love with a woman from the Darklands. We sealed our love with the petals of a Flaming Rose. This flower is only found in the Fireswamps. Please bring one to me and place it on my grave.
Find a Flaming Rose in the Fireswamps.

I was once a great explorer. I fell in love with a woman from the Darklands. We sealed our love with the petals of a Flaming Rose. This flower is only found in the Fireswamps. Please bring one to me and place it on my grave.
Deliver the Flaming Rose.
Oh, the Flaming Rose. My soul can now join my True Love…
You're helping dead people? Weird.
There is peace in the cemetery now.
If you're talking to ghosts, I'm leaving.

I need you to collect some Fusion Matter samples for Professor Utoinum. He is conducting a critical study, so please bring them to him right away. By the way, you did a great job for Blossom earlier. Keep up the good work! -Dexter
You helped someone in the Great Beyond!
Scotsman's Best Friend (Part 2 of 3)
Investigate the Runic Charm.
'Tis an odd thing that you found, this Runic Charm. Bring it to Max. He's a man of stature, with a mind much sharper than me own. He may know what it is.
I brought the Runic Charm to Gwen way out in the Pimpleback Mountains. She seems to think it is some kind of magical "alarm clock" that raises monsters from deep slumber.
Do ye think that Fuse wants to use that Runic Charm to raise a monster from deep in the ground? That could spell trouble for us all, my brave friend.
I don't like the idea that those beasts had a Runic Charm. If Fuse has truly mastered the magical arts, this planet may be doomed!
Talk to Grandpa Max.
I've never seen anything like this before. You say that Fuse's monsters had it? That's not good.
Max wants ye to bring the charm to his granddaughter Gwen in the Pimpleback Mountains.
The Fusion Matter samples are located inside the infected area nearby.
Bring Runic Charm to Gwen.
You should bring this to my granddaughter, Gwen. She's very knowledgeable when it comes to magic. You'll find her in the Pimpleback Mountains.
You say you found this on Fuse's monsters? Let me see...I think this is a stone of awakening. The symbols are very old. Roughly translated, this rune says, "alarm clock."
I don't like the idea that those beasts had a Runic Charm. If Fuse has truly mastered the magical arts, this planet may be doomed!
Go to Leakey Lake infected zone.
Fuse may be trying to awaken a creature deep inside the earth. That's not good. You should take this thing and drop it into the deepest part of Leakey Lake.
Enter the infected area here and drop the Runic Charm into the lake.
I don't like the idea that those beasts had a Runic Charm. If Fuse has truly mastered the magical arts, this planet may be doomed!
Drop Runic Charm in Leakey Lake.
Very good. Now that Runic Charm will stay out of Fuse's hands.
Dexter sent me to coordinates of the first sample that you need to collect. He may contact you while you work. Good luck.
Jungle Delivery
Deliver a message to the KND outpost.
Did you know that Numbuh Three and Numbuh Four are stationed at the Jungle Outpost in the wilderness? I have a sooper secret message for them!
I brought a message to Numbuh Three at the Jungle Outpost.
Thanks for bringing that message. I hope Numbuh Three wasn't too mad to learn that Townsville Mall is all sold out of Rainbow Monkeys!
Can you please bring a sooper secret message to Numbuh Three at the KND Jungle Outpost on Mt. Blackhead?
Deliver message to Numbuh Three.
A sooper secret message for me? Oh, no! This is terrible! Townsville Mall is all sold out of Rainbow Monkeys! What am I going to do? Thanks for bringing this important news to me.
A Wee Wish
Get bagpipes for Scotsman.
Find the first Fusion Matter sample.
How I long for the sounds of me homeland. If you can get for me a set of bagpipes from the auditorium, I'll tell ye about a magic skull that grants wishes!
I got a set of pipes for Scotsman from the auditorium, but the instrument was missing some reeds. I collected them from various monsters in Townsville Park.
Thank ye kindly for the pipes. To find the Wishing Skull, look somewhere behind City Hall. Do what the skull tells you, and perhaps your wish will be granted.
Please collect a set o' bagpipes for me at the auditorium in Marquee Row. In return, I pledge to tell ye about the location of a Wishing Skull.
Collect bagpipes.
Make yer way through the Auditorium to collect the bagpipes.
I canna believe you found 'em! Come back to me, now!
Now that ye have the bagpipes, please return them to me. I will play you one of me favorite battle hymns.
Deliver bagpipes to Scotsman.
'Tis a tragedy. These bagpipes are missing some reeds, and I canna play without them. See if you can collect three reeds from the monsters here in the park.
This type of Fusion Matter expresses interesting properties at high temperatures.
I canna play the bagpipes unless you collect three reeds from the monsters in the area. If ye are successful, I'll divulge the location of the Wishing Skull.
Get a reed from Shady Streetlights.
I be startin' with the Shady Streetlights, if I were ye.
Me spirits are lifting! Ye found one of the missing reeds.
I canna play the bagpipes unless you collect three reeds from the monsters in the area. If ye are successful, I'll divulge the location of the Wishing Skull.
Get next reed from Dire Raptors.
Now go after them Dire Raptors.
Huzzah. Now target the Asphalt Freaks.
I canna play the bagpipes unless you collect three reeds from the monsters in the area. If ye are successful, I'll divulge the location of the Wishing Skull.
Get final reed from Asphalt Freaks.
We have the coordinates for the second batch of samples. I'll send it to you. Good work out there.
Fantastic. Bring those reeds to me and I'll play ye a tune.
Ye got the reeds! Come back and I'll tell ye about the Wishing Skull!
Deliver reeds to Scotsman.
Allow me to sing for ye. "In days of old, a story's told of a skull with eyes o' fire. Run through the mall to City Hall and you'll get what you desire." Ah ha ha ha!
Mag-Ick
Investigate magic readings for Mandark.
I've detected some strange magical readings from the Steam Alley area. I hate magic! It has no place in the world of science. Will you investigate?
I investigated magical disturbances in Steam Alley. Putrid Spawns were interfering with the readings. I discovered a Thromnambular Wishing Skull and reported back to Mandark.
I have no interest in experimenting with Wishing Skulls or any other kind of hocus pocus mumbo jumbo. Have fun with your magic tricks. Ha! Ha ha ha!
My laboratory sensors are picking up bizarre energy readings from the Steam Alley area. It looks like magic. I hate magic! Go check it out.
Find the second Fusion Matter sample.
Head to Steam Alley.
The readings appear to originate with the Putrid Spawns in the area.
The strange energy readings that I've detected appear to be coming from the Putrid Spawns. Eliminate them and report what you discover.
Defeat nine Putrid Spawns.
Eliminate some of them and let's see what happens. Ha ha ha!
Curious…the Putrid Spawns were not the source of the energy.
The Putrid Spawns were not the source of the magical energy. It is coming from somewhere else. The monsters were simply interfering with the signal. I'll send you the coordinates.
Find energy source.
They were interfering with the signal. You need to locate the source.
I am Thromnambular, the Wishing Skull. I find science rather dull. Magic is totally where it's at. And you can tell Mandark to chew on that.
Great. Only one more sample to collect. Keep up the good work.
The source of the magical energy is a talking skull that likes to talk in dumb rhymes. Why am I not impressed? Please come back to Mandark Industries.
Return to Mandark.
Oh, it's a wisecracking skull thing? How idiotic. Come back and see me.
Talking magic skulls are a waste of time. That thing seems harmless, at the very least. Stick with science and avoid magic at all costs. It's for losers!
The Thromnambular Saga (Part 4 of 9)
Complete a mission for Thromnambular.
I am Wishing Skull number four. I need something from the store. If you can bring it to me fast, then this mission you will have passed.
I collected a festive party hat for Thromnambular in record time. I only have to find five more Wishing Skulls to get my wish.
Festive hats make me feel so alive! Now go find Wishing Skull number five.
Proceed to the Townsville Mall. When you get there, I'll give you a call.
Deliver TRACKAMABOB to Max.
Here is the location of the last sample. When you're done, Dexter wants you to take everything you've collected to the Professor.
Go to Townsville Center.
I need a festive party hat. You give me this, I'll give you that.
I need a hat for a big soiree. Go get one now, and don't delay.
Pick up a hat for Thromnambular.
Go get one from the store. Do it quick, do nothing more.
I'm sorry, but you're out of time. Don't you love to speak in rhyme?
Go back to the store.
You're not moving fast enough! Go back and get me some more stuff.
Just stay calm, you're doing great. Now hurry up and don't be late.
Now that you have my hat, get back to me in seconds flat.
Find the third Fusion Matter sample.
Return to Thromnambular in time.
That's the hat that I need! Return to me with great speed.
Oh, this hat brings me such delight. It's sure to be the hit of the night! If a wish is what you want to find, you must speak to all the skulls that number nine.

Samurai Jack once mentioned a powerful demon by the name of Demongo, the Soul Collector. I know little about things that do not relate to science! But Jack seems to think that Demongo might have something to do with our missing heroes. Go speak with him about it. Remember, he is at Mandark's research station in the Forsaken Valley. -Dexter
Jack knows someone who can help us with that artifact that you recovered from the Really Twisted Forest. Go speak to him when you can. Good luck! -Dexter

With the mystical energy restored to the Warrior's Crest, I think we might be able to transfer the crest's power signatures to the Power Level Tracker. But I am not sure how to do it. Samurai Jack may know a way. -Dexter

Now that the Power Level Tracker has been upgraded with the energies from the Warrior's Crest, you can use it to find Demongo. But Samurai Jack says that you are not yet ready to confront that wily demon. I trust Jack. So go speak with him and get ready for your trip deeper into the Darklands. -Dexter
Urgent! A girl named Peggy Danger needs your help in the Fireswamps. I've sent all the details to Samurai Jack. Please go to see him right away. -Dexter
Before you confront Demongo, I suggest you arm yourself with the great weapon of Puppet Pal Mitch and Puppet Pal Clem: the Bonkstick! Go see Samurai Jack for instructions. -Dexter
Jack tells me that your skills have improved! You are now ready to find Demongo. He lies deep in the Darklands. Don't give up until we figure out what happened to the missing heroes! -Dexter
Well done. Take the specimens to Professor Utonium near my old house.
So Demongo claims that the souls of the world's heroes were stolen by Fusion Demongo? I believe it. Samurai Jack knows how we can reclaim the heroic souls. Go see him. -Dexter
Samurai Jack says that you can reclaim the heroic souls with the Sacred Vessel that you recovered. All this magic hocus-pocus gives me indigestion. Talk to Jack. Good luck! -Dexter
Samurai Jack knows how we can return the missing heroes to the world! Go talk to him immediately! -Dexter

Congratulations. The heroes of the world have been revived, thanks to you. I cannot wait to see Major Glory! But there is some concern. One of the souls you recovered has Samurai Jack very worried. Can you come to see me at Dexlabs? -Dexter
Go speak to Samurai Jack. His greatest enemy, Aku, is attempting to strike at our world. I do not like the sound of that! -Dexter
Hoss Delgado says he'll help us track down Kevin. But you've got to show him what you're made of. That dude is pretty tough. Report to him in Devil's Canyon North. -Ben
Hoss Delgado says he knows where Kevin is. Go talk to him. He may ask you to do some weird stuff, but don't worry, he's one of the good guys. I'll check in with you soon. -Ben

Fuse is going to use a Satellite Interceptor to sabotage Grandpa Max's surveillance satellite. We gotta stop him! There's a Plumber base in the jungle that may be able to help. Come see me and I'll explain everything. -Ben
Nice work getting that Shield Fragmentation Device. You're gonna need to use it to destroy Fuse's Satellite Interceptor. Go back and talk to Hoss Delgado. He'll help us. -Ben
Kevin says he's uncovered some kind of terrible Fuse plot. I've sent the details to Hoss Delgado. Report to him right away. I'll be in touch. -Ben
Take the Fusion Matter samples to Professor Utonium near Dexter's old house. He'll have some fantastic Dexlabs equipment for you!
Hoss Delgado is willing to give you a really cool buttkicking weapon. Go see him and find out what it's gonna take to get your hands on that bad boy! -Ben

From the sound of it, Fuse is planning to create an army of Fusion Kevins! Those Fusions are really powerful. Fuse would be nearly unstoppable! Hoss says he has a plan. Go talk to him as soon as you can. -Ben
You're going to use a Skull Basher's brain to do…what? Well, go check in with Hoss and find out what he wants to do. I'll be interested to hear the results. -Ben

Good news. Grandpa Max is ready to launch his surveillance satellite. The plan is to scan the surface of Planet Fusion. Max also wants to study Fuse's Lair. Be careful; it's incredibly dangerous. You need to go speak to Hoss. -Ben
Fuse is trying to recreate the surface of Planet Fusion right here on our world! But we have more immediate concerns: that Fusion Kevin army. Hoss thinks he knows how we can locate it. Hurry! -Ben
Tetrax has confirmed that Fuse is using some kind of modified Terrafuser device to create multiple Fusion Kevins. Hoss can help us put a stop to this immediately. -Ben
Hoss may have some strange methods, but they certainly get the job done. Go speak to him. He knows how to destroy Fuse's machine. Then we can kiss those Fusion Kevins goodbye. -Ben
Did you meet that little pink dog named Courage when you were out in Nowhere? Go back and talk to him. I'll bet he can help us locate the next stash of Crazy Brain Candy! -Edd
Mutant eggplants? That sounds horrifying! Talk to Courage. I think he's had a few run-ins with those eggplants. I'm outta here. -Edd
Courage needs some help with a dangerous mission. Go help him out, then get back on the Crazy Brain Candy trail! -Edd
Deliver samples to Professor Utonium.

Courage says that our search for the Crazy Brain Candy leads out into the Darklands. It's really frightening out there. I hope you're ready! Go talk to Courage. We're all rooting for you here in the Cul-de-Sac. -Edd
The search for the Crazy Brain Candy has got me worried. It would appear that Fuse may already have snatched it! Courage has some thoughts on the matter. Go see him right away. -Edd

Oh, dear! Fuse has commandeered the Crazy Brain Candy and has stashed it deep inside his lair! This is not good at all. Not one bit! I hope Courage has some good suggestions! Frankly, I'm stymied. -Edd

Courage has a Special Alien Capture Team scanner, which he uses to monitor alien activity. It appears that Fuse is using a tree in the Darklands to infect the whole planet! Go talk to Courage about it. Then we must find the candy! -Edd
Hurry, you need to speak to Courage right away! I'll check in with you soon. I need a snack! -Edd
Courage said he figured out a way to locate the stolen haul of Crazy Brain Candy. If we don't find it, Fuse will use the candy to scramble everybody's brains! Go talk to Courage! -Edd
Courage says that Samurai Jack can help us destroy the Crazy Brain Candy. Jack is in Forsaken Valley West. Go find him. He's a real hero!
Fuse has stashed the Crazy Brain Candy deep underground? Samurai Jack knows how we can destroy it! Go talk to him, please. It is of utmost importance. -Edd

It is now time to meet your destiny. For if you do not meet your destiny now, your destiny will likely go home and watch TV. Go talk to Samurai Jack, and go destroy the horrible Crazy Brain Candy. You can do it! -Edd

So, Fuzzy Lumkins refuses to help me with my plan for distributing my new Chemical X formula to the monkeys of the jungle? It is quite an ingenious plan, if I do say so myself. For I am a genius! Well, if Fuzzy does not want to help me, perhaps he knows someone who will! Go back to his cabin near Leakey Lake and ask him yourself! -Mojo Jojo
Hey, I know you're helping Dexter, but when you're done, come see me. We've got another problem. Oh, and tell the Professor I say "hi" okay? -Blossom

If this child called Mandy will help us with my plan to send my Chemical X formula directly to Monkey Mountain, then please go right ahead and speak to this child called Mandy. She is located in Devil's Canyon. Now I must stop typing, for I smell something burning in my kitchen, and I do not want my kitchen to catch fire as a result of my inattention! -Mojo Jojo
My plans are nearly in place. Talk to Mandy once again to make sure and confirm that my plans are nearly in place. -Mojo Jojo

This is what I am going to do. I am going to load a transport ship with my special Chemical X formula and dump it into Forgotten Falls. Then, using the Current Diverter, I will divert the current of the river so that the Chemical X flows directly into Monkey Mountain! And then I will have all the monkey minions an evil monkey genius could ever want! Ha ha ha! Go talk to Mandy. -Mojo Jojo
I am now ready to launch the transport ship that is loaded with Chemical X. Report to Mandy in Devil's Canyon and let us get this party started! -Mojo Jojo

Curses! So this child called Mandy thinks she can toy with the likes of me, Mojo Jojo? She will quickly discover that toying with me, Mojo Jojo, will result in her regretting that she ever toyed with me, Mojo Jojo. For I will make her pay dearly. Perhaps I will also make you pay dearly, since you seem to have been at least tangentially involved with these events. Come see me at my volcano. -Mojo Jojo
I have been depressed about the loss of my special Chemical X. So I will be here in my volcano, sulking. You should go talk to Mandy. Curse her! -Mojo Jojo

Mandy has another mission for you. I hope you manage to trick her, for I do not like her. Remember when she tricked me? I do not like to think about such things. Now I am going to eat a pint of banana ice cream to make myself feel better. -Mojo Jojo

Ha ha ha! Mandy has learned her lesson! Now she knows what it feels like to be betrayed, which is exactly how I felt when she betrayed me! This makes me happy, because I like it when those that betray me suddenly feel betrayed! But it turns out we have bigger problems. Fuse is going to attempt to hypnotize the world. Under other circumstances, this is actually not a bad idea. Anyway, go speak to Mandy in Devil's Canyon! -Mojo Jojo
Return to Mandy and see if you can find the missing Hypnotic Charm. I am very busy plotting and scheming. -Mojo Jojo

I grow tired of writing emails to you. These emails do not help us defeat Fuse. Furthermore, they do not help me destroy Townsville and the Powerpuff Girls! So I will stop writing this email, and you will go talk to Mandy. -Mojo Jojo
Thanks for these samples! They will really help me in my research. Blossom has told me great things about you, and she wasn't kidding. Here's some gear Dexter wanted you to have.

I heard that you recovered the Hypnotic Charm from Fuse, but now it must be destroyed. Very well. If you ever find another Hypnotic Charm, please do keep me on your list for I would certainly be interested in obtaining a Hypnotic Charm. In the meantime, the Hypnotic Charm you recovered must be destroyed, so talk to Mandy about it. Until next time, I remain: -Mojo Jojo
Hey, look out! Defeat those monsters and find stupid May!
Well done.  Return to me.
Return to Jack.
You have returned the heroes to the world.  Well done.
Fusion Pirate's Pillage (Part 2 of 5)
Get a Gooby Trap from Devil's Canyon.
Fuse's cronies have planted a Gooby Trap in Devil's Canyon. You'll need to get it before time runs out, or the place goes kablooey.
I collected a Gooby Trap from Devil's Canyon. But Hoss Delgado still seems to think I'm not tough enough.
Well. You made it after all. But can you handle the really important missions? You should go see Juniper Lee in Nowhere. That chick is tough.
What makes Dexter so smart, anyway?
It's gonna be tough to collect that Gooby Trap from Devil's Canyon. Maybe you won't even make it back. Let's see how tough you are.
Go to Devil's Canyon.
Okay, partner. Find that Gooby Trap.
You need to get the Gooby Trap before time runs out. If that thing goes off, Fusion crud will explode every which way.
Collect the Gooby Trap.
You gotta collect the trap before time expires.
I'll be darned. Nice job.
Time's up. You gotta go back to the beginning and try again. Get that Gooby Trap. Just keep your eye on the prize.
Return to start.
Yeah, well, time's up. Start over.
I think you're a Fusion Matter expert.
You need to do a little better this time, kid.
I'm glad to see you got that trap. Maybe you're not as weak as you look. Come back and see me.

Stop the Skull Crushers in the Dark Glade.
The Skull Crushers have picked up where the Skull Bashers left off. You need to stop them from working on the Fusion assembly line.
The Skull Crushers were working on an assembly line for Fusions, but I stopped them.
Well done. But Fuse is likely building his machine somewhere else in the Daklands. We must remain vigilant.
The Skull Crushers in the Dark Glade are also building part of Fuse's assembly line. Get them.
Defeat  eleven Skull Crushers.
Good. Their work is at a standstill now.
You're helping out. Nice job.
With the Skull Crushers defeated, you may return to me.
Return to Tetrax.

Fusion Assembly Line (Part 3 of 5)
Stop the machine preparation in Hero's Hollow.
The Eyebulbs in Hero's Hollow are prepping the site for Fuse's machine. If you take some of them out, you may stall the construction.
I stopped the construction of Fuse's machine to mass-produce Fusions.
We must now strike at the center of Fuse's operation, or he will start building the assembly line anew. We will not be able to withstand an entire army of Fusions!
The Eyebulbs in Hero's Hollow are preparing the site for Fuse's machine. You must stop them.
Defeat ten Eyebulbs.
I wanna rock!
Good. Fuse's construction cannot continue now.
Fuse's construction has been halted, but we have to make sure that he does not just start the building anew. Come back to me so we can discuss this.
Return to Tetrax.
We must discuss final steps. Come back and see me at once.
Excellent. Fuse may not be able to mass-produce Fusions now, but we have to make sure that he can't simply start up again.
Fusion Assembly Line (Part 4 of 5)
Use Tetrax's Fusion Sensor.
I need you to take an energy reading in dangerous territory. If you are successful, we will reveal the engineer of this entire enterprise. Are you up for it?
I defeated the Great Shellworms that were interfering with Tetrax's Fusion Sensor.
There is a Fusion behind this. Once I study the readings from the Fusion Sensor, all will be revealed.
Tell Grim I say hi, okay?

I think I can locate the mastermind of the Fusion assembly line. Take this Fusion Sensor into the Precipice and conduct readings. First, you must defeat some Great Shellworms. Their massive bodies will interfere with the equipment.
Defeat eight Great Shellworms.
The Fusion Sensor's scan is complete. Return to Forsaken Valley.
You successfully collected energy readings from Hero's Hollow. Return to me.
Return to Tetrax.

Fusion Assembly Line (Part 5 of 5)
Defeat Fusion Coop.
I found the enemy who has been trying to mass-produce Fusions. It is Fusion Coop, and he's in the Green Maw infected zone. Ready for a fight?
I defeated Fusion Coop and stopped Fuse's attempt to mass-produce Fusions.
Don't Lose Your Head II
Your work must be commended. Fuse's plan to mass-produce a Fusion army has been crushed. Had he succeeded, this entire planet would have paid the price.
Fusion Coop is behind the attempt to mass-produce Fusions. I've tracked him to the infected zone in the Green Maw. Can you take him down?
Find the Fusion Portal.
Fusion Coop is behind the attempt to mass-produce Fusions. I've tracked him to the infected zone in the Green Maw. Can you take him down?

Fusion Coop is behind the attempt to mass-produce Fusions. I've tracked him to the infected zone in the Green Maw. Can you take him down?
Defeat Fusion Coop.
Excellent. This threat has been eliminated.
Fusion Coop has been defeated. Your skills rival those of any bounty hunter that I have encountered. Come to me for a much-deserved reward.
Return to Tetrax.
Collect the next shrunken head.
Thanks to you, Fuse will not be able to mass-produce Fusions. This entire world is now in your debt. Well done.
Wow, you saved the world. Again.
You stopped a plan to mass-produce Fusions. You're a hero!
What was it like when you beat Fusion Coop?
That fight when you beat Fusion Coop in Fuse's Lair? Amazing!
Quickly, free my other brother.
I tried to send some info to Ben, with no luck. You need to recover the launch key from the Fowl Freaks in the Lower Catacombs.
Nice work against the Ghoulish Growths and Rabid Arachnids, mate! You gotta come around here more often. Come see me for a reward.
Return to Numbuh Four.
I think I'll put you on retainer. But I don't know what that means!
You need to defeat Fusion Coop. I think he took something from Megas, so we gotta stop him! Maybe you'll be able to make a cool new Nano if you defeat him.
Find Fusion Numbuh One's lair.
Enter Fusion Numbuh One's lair.
Go get him! Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha!
Fun and Games, Part Two
Destroy Them All
Destroy the Destroyusalls.
Horrible clown monsters haunt my dreams! They lie in the shadows, preparing to strike! And they're real…real, I tell you! Go to Dizzy World if you don't believe me!
I defeated the Destroyusalls at Dizzy World for Billy, then delivered their noses to Bloo.
Oh, thank you so much for getting rid of those evil clown monsters. Don't let them get me! They will destroy us all! Destroy us all! Destroy us all!
Recover another shrunken Zuni head for Grim.

There are monsters in my dreams, yet they are horribly real! You will find them at the Dizzy World amusement park. Destroy them before they can destroy us! Collect their noses to prove that they have been vanquished.
Collect three Destroyusall noses.
You gots them! Three noses from the clown monsters.
You collected three Destroyusall noses. But even their noses are scary! I don't want 'em! Bring them to Bloo at the entrance to the infected zone. He'll know what to do!
Deliver noses to Bloo.
But even their noses are too scary! Bring them to Bloo.

Nano Support
Assist Nano improvement study.
Did you hear about the Nano improvement study? Kid scientists are collecting Nano creation items to make Nanos better. Talk to Dexbot Q-12 at City Station.
I'm still looking for my other shrunken Zuni heads. Dese are very collectible on the decapitation market, by de way. Can you find another one for me?
I reported to Dexbot Q-12 at City Station.
Good work. Dexbot Q-12 has all the information you need to assist with this soopuh important project!
If you head south of here, you'll enter City Station. Look for Dexbot Q-12. He's coordinating the Nano improvement project for Dexlabs.
Talk to Dexbot Q-12.
Greetings, human. Are you here to assist with the Nano improvement project? Excellent.
Teen Dream
Bring Princess' headshot to Max.
Have you met Ben Tennyson? He's, like, so dreamy! His Grandpa Max is nearby in Townsville Park. Can you bring my glossy 8 x 10 headshot to him?
I brought a glamour photo of Princess to Grandpa Max, but he was a little unsure about what to do with it.
Thanks for bringing my photo to Grandpa Max! I'm sure he'll pass it along to his cute grandson, Ben! And if he doesn't…then I'll blast him with laser beams!
Fantastic. I'm sending you the coordinates of the next enemy camp.
I found another one of Grim's shrunken Zuni heads in the Fissure.
Bring my glossy 8 x 10 glamour headshot to Grandpa Max at the Fissure. I'm sure he'll pass it along to his grandson, Ben, once he takes a good look at it.
Deliver photo to Max.
Er…thanks. What am I supposed to do with this, exactly? But I'm glad you're here. We've got trouble!
Hostile Takeover
Deliver contract to Grim.
Have you tried Grim's Gardens' beauty products? They're delightful! I told my daddy to buy out the company. Will you bring this acquisition contract to Grim?
I brought a buyout contract to Grim from Princess. She wants to buy his chain of day spas. But Grim wasn't interested.
Hmmmph! Did Grim refuse? I'm going to tell my daddy what that dumb skeleton said, and then he'll be sorry! I always get what I want, you'll see.
My daddy promised to buy all the Grim's Gardens stores. Bring this buyout contract to Grim and make him sign it!
Deliver contract to Grim.
I gave you dem Bone Wings so you can remember de fun we have had together. Tanks for getting me de shrunken Zuni head from de Townsville Park.
What am I supposed to do wit dis? Some brat wants to buy me stores? What is wrong wit de children of today? Forget it!
Smarty Pants
Deliver a note to Mandark.
Master Mojo has a very important message to send to Mandark. Will you deliver it for me? I know you can do it. You're pretty smart, for a human.
I brought what I thought was an important secret message from Mojo to Mandark. But all the message said was, "I'm smarter than you!"
Ha ha ha! I hope that Mandark has learned his lesson! There is no one smarter on this planet than my master, Mojo Jojo!
Bring this very important note to Mandark in Tech Square. You will find him at Mandark Industries.
Deliver message to Mandark.
What's this? "I am much smarter than you, and you are dumber than me! Signed, Mojo Jojo." He dares mock my genius?
See, I toldja you could beat up that guy if you followed my instructions. All goes according to my plan! Come back to me and I'll give you something even better than that old gum.
Me next shrunken Zuni head is lost deep in de Fissure in Townsville Park. It's very infected in dere. Can you get it for me?
Return to Billy.
Hee hee! You wonned a prize. Come back and get it.
We're heroes! Thanks for beating Fusion Eddy and making this place safer for chewing gum.
Affirmative. Return to this unit with the glove.
I found my baseball cap, I think. Some creepy green guy has it! Can you find the Fusion Portal and come help me?
Enter the Fusion Portal.
Go to the jump pad.
Jump onto the jump pad to launch yourself onto the tree house platform.
The foe you defeated was indeed Fusion Bubbles. I don't know how I could have become so confused. Well, please exit the lair and return to me in Genius Grove for your reward.
Exit and talk to the Prof.
Go to Fissure infected zone.
Professor Utonium's weakness is his sentimental heart.
I am still so troubled by Buttercup's disappearance, I suppose my emotions got away with me. It was obvious that the creature was a Fusion. Good work.
Numbuh One wants to send Robobradley to Dexlabs for some tests. But Fusion Numbuh One is here! Think you can take him on?
Was Dee Dee there? Did she see you? How did she look? Was she radiant?

Subject: Corruption Attacks. Occasionally, monsters will launch a Corruption Attack, targeting your active Nano. However, if your active Nano is of the correct type, you can cancel or even repel the monster's attack. Just remember that Adaptium Nanos beat Blastons attacks, Blastons Nanos beat Cosmix attacks, and Cosmix Nanos beat Adaptium attacks. Or to put it more simply: A beats B, B beats C, and C beats A. -Computress
You need to defeat the Motor Raptors. They are causing the most trouble.
I didn't mean to trick you. It just comes natural! I wonder what happened to the soda. I guess that Fusion bugger drank it all.
Well, you made excellent time. Return to Mandroid M-99 for a reward.
Good work. The Fissure is a dangerous place, but if we keep at it, I think we'll be able to clean it up and retake the area. Numbuh One, out!
Tetrax is stationed at the gateway to the Darklands in Forsaken Valley. To get there, you will need to take the Kumari Serpent from the Monkey Foothills, way out in the jungle.
You need to go into de gooey infected zone to get me Zuni head!
The Kumari Serpent will take you to Forsaken Valley. Good luck!
Go to the Kumari Serpent in Monkey Foothills.
Find the mine cart inside the Crystalline Caverns infected zone. Den we can find Fusion Grim and beat him silly.
Enter the infected zone.
Go into de infected zone in de caverns and find de Fusion Portal.
Dat was some amazing display of pure gusto. Come and see me before you go, and I can give you someting nice.
Talk to Grim before leaving.
Traitor, indeed! That was excellent work. Now I need to get back to vacationing.
The prophecy says that we can protect the Earth by re-activating an ancient network of totems. We just need to find them. I can sense one near here in the Crystalline Caverns. Get in there now.
Head into the Crystalline Caverns.
Make your way through de scary infected Fissure to find me shrunken Zuni head!
Look for the totem inside these Caverns. Watch out for the infection.
Busted! I'll give 'em their Jawbreakers, but you gotta get the lollipops yerself.
Grandpa Max needs an energy cell to power his surveillance satellite. I think there's a Plumber base downtown that might have just what he needs. Go talk to him about it, okay? -Ben
Fuse No More (Part 2 of 4)
Find a way past Fuse's Shield.
Though you defeated Fusion Kevin, Fuse has appeared inside his lair. He is guarded by Stalactitans and protected by a shield. I fear doom is at hand.
I entered the very heart of Fuse's Lair, where I defeated Stalactitans. Then I weakened Fuse's shield using the Imaginary Energy contained inside Billy's pet Fusion Spawn, Runty.
Though Runty's Imagination Energy allowed you to weaken Fuse's shield, the battle is not over. Fuse has not yet fully manifested inside his lair.

Fuse himself is attempting to manifest inside his lair. This is our darkest hour. We no longer have the means to transmit Imaginary Energy into the lair. You must try to get past Fuse's shield. Go to Fuse's Lair.
Go to Fuse's Lair.
Splendid! You found another shrunken Zuni head. Bring it to me.
Find the Fusion Portal that leads to Fuse's Hall.

You must now enter the very heart of Fuse's Lair, starting with Fuse's Hall. Once inside, we will try to determine how to get past Fuse's shield. If we cannot, Fuse will appear on the planet, and all hope is lost.
Enter Fuse's Hall.
You are deep inside Fuse's Lair. We must not allow him to manifest on the planet. First, you will have to remove his guardians, the Stalactitans.
Defeat eight Stalactitans.
Beware! Stalactitans are Fuse's personal bodyguards.
Hey, that was sweet! Come here and I'll shows ya something.

Good, you have defeated the Stalactitans. I can sense Fuse's form coalescing nearby. You need to figure out what is powering his shield. First, talk to that gadfly, Billy. We don't want him to derail our plans any further.
Talk to Billy.
Sigh…please talk to Billy before you proceed any further.
Bring de shrunken Zuni head back. I have something very cool for you to wear on your back.
Hey, I feel bad about messin' you up before. So I want you to have my pet Fusion Spawn, Runty. He's a sweet li'l guy. I loves him, but I don't want you to be mad at me.

Dexter reports that Billy's pet, Runty, is infused with Imaginary Energy. It must have derived from Billy. Quickly, use Runty on the alien control mechanism that is powering Fuse's shield. There is no time to lose!
Use Runty on shield controls.
I'm detecting high quantities of Imaginary Energy inside Billy's "pet".
The shield has been severely weakened, but it is not gone! We must regroup. Use the Fusion Portal to get back to me.

Good work. Billy's alien pet contained enough Imaginary Energy to critically weaken Fuse's shield. I think we will soon break through. But Fuse has not fully materialized, and I am not sure how we can damage him until he does. You'd best return to me.
Talk to Jack.
Poor Runty! Your sacrifice will never be forgotten! So…what's for lunch?
We must strike twice in succession. Dexter reports that Fuse's shield is weak. You must now proceed to Fuse's Labyrinth, where you will be able to weaken Fuse's shield further.
Fuse No More (Part 3 of 4)
Return shrunken Zuni head to Grim.
Stop Fuse from appearing on our planet!
We cannot harm Fuse until he has fully manifested, but we can still weaken his defenses. Unfortuantely, we have no Imagination Energy left . Are you ready?
Coco left an egg inside Fuse's Lair. It contained nothing -- but Mac reminded me to simply use my imagination. With that, I was able to destroy Fuse's shield once and for all.
Incredible. You used your own imagination against Fuse. But I fear that there is one more battle to fight. This time, Fuse himself is waiting for you on his throne.

Fuse is still manifesting inside his Lair, but his shield is weak. We may be able to destroy his defenses by entering Fuse's Labyrinth. The other heroes and I will meet you inside. Though without enough Imaginary Energy, I don't know what we will do.
Go to Fuse's Labyrinth.

Fuse is still manifesting inside his Lair, but his shield is weak. We may be able to destroy his defenses by entering Fuse's Labyrinth. The other heroes and I will meet you inside. Though without enough Imaginary Energy, I don't know what we will do.
Enter Fuse's Labyrinth.

Fuse is trying to remain protected while his form fully materializes, and we cannot harm him until he does. I am afraid that the other heroes remain trapped outside the lair. You're on your own. Beware! Fusion Demongo guards the area!
Defeat Fusion Demongo.
Oh, tank you so much for this shrunken Zuni! I tink I am only missing one more. I want you to have dese beautiful Bone Wings. You will love wearing dem, I promise.
Alert! We are trapped outside the lair. You must continue on your own!
Excellent. Fusion Demongo dropped something.
Coco left you a mysterious-looking egg. Qucikly, show it to Mac. Somehow, he managed to sneak inside Fuse's Lair!
Deliver egg to Mac.
It's one of Coco's special eggs! Bring it here to me! Quick!
The outside of this egg says "Use Your Imagination." But inside, there's nothing! I wonder what it could mean?

Coco's egg contained NOTHING at all. But she told you to "Use Your Imagination" -- so that is what you should do. Go to the alien mechanism powering Fuse's shield and try using NOTHING on it. Remember, just use your imagination…
Use NOTHING on the controls.
Coco wants you to use your imagination on the alien control mechanism.
Cool, it worked! Fuse's shield is busted.
My LOCATOR is working perfectly. You need to find the next spawn camp and take out Fuse's monsters. Look for the Newspaper Ninjas.
Can I borrow your skull mask?

Using your imagination on Fuse's protective shield destroyed it, and I don't think it will be coming back online. But Fuse has not yet fully materialized. And Terra Claws are guarding him, threatening to tear you to shreds.
Defeat ten Terra Claws.
Watch out! Terra Claws are gonna attack!
Fuse is sufficiently weakened, but once he takes his full physical form, we must be ready to strike. The final confrontation is at hand. Come back and see me right away.
Imaginary Energy is Fuse's weakness. Well done. Come back to me now.
Talk to Jack.
Fuse has fully materialized. And he is more powerful than even I imagined!
It is time. Fuse has arrived. Together, you and I must enter the lair to destroy this menace once and for all.
Fuse No More (Part 4 of 4)
Defeat Fuse once and for all.
You did amazing work at the Fissure for Grim.
Fuse has manifested in his physical form. Only small groups can get inside his lair. I will help you. Meet me inside Fuse's Throne in Fuse's Lair.

I returned to Fuse's Lair with Samurai Jack. He was weakened in a battle with Fuse's Doom Striders. I saved Jack, then battled Fuse until he was seemingly destroyed. Fuse's energies returned to Planet Fusion. We're safe, at least for the moment.
Fuse's defeat signals a major shift in this war. Though his infection and his monsters still poison our world, Fuse has suffered a mighty blow. We are in your debt.
The final battle nears. Return to Fuse's Lair. I will meet you inside his inner sanctum, called Fuse's Throne. Together, we will extinguish this Fuse once and for all!
Go to Fuse's Throne.
If Fuse manifests on our world, all hope is lost. But you are the one who must change the course of our future. You can do this. Everyone is counting on you! -Dexter
The final battle nears. Return to Fuse's Lair. I will meet you inside his inner sanctum, called Fuse's Throne. Together, we will extinguish this Fuse once and for all!
Enter Fuse's Throne.
Doom Striders are swarming outside Fuse's Throne Room, guarding the monster himself. Help me defeat them!
Defeat twelve Doom Striders.
Swim, fishie! Swim!
You're here! Quickly, the Doom Striders have overtaken me!
The battle with the Doom Striders has weakened me. Please, come to speak with me right away. I have escaped immediate danger and lie on the other side of the Fusion Matter moat.
Talk to Jack.
The battle…with the Doom Striders…was fierce. I cannot go on. Fuse lies ahead. You must destroy him on your own.

I cannot go on. It is up to you to defeat Fuse. There is no shield protecting him now. You can do it. Summon all your strength, all your courage, and put an end to this villain. He lies just over the wall.
Defeat Fuse.
It is done. Victory is ours. Leave the lair, and I will meet you back in the Forsaken Valley.
You've done it. Fuse has been defeated and his energies have been forced back to Planet Fusion. He may not be gone forever, but he will not be able to set foot on this planet for a long, long time.
Talk to Jack.
Good news. Fuse's form is gone. His energies have returned to Planet Fusion.
Thanks for helping Grim at the Fissure.
Thanks to you, Fuse has suffered a great defeat. His infection remains and his minions still roam the land. But his energies are weakened. You are a great hero, indeed.
Well, you defeated Fuse. Nice job.
Excellent work! Fuse's form has returned to Planet Fusion.
Wow, you beat Fuse! Can I have your autograph?
Thanks to you, Fuse is weakened and we are safe! Safe-ish.
The Fusion Eggplants we're looking for are in the Catacombs. You can enter the Caponata Catacombs through the pipe. Then make your way to the Upper Catacombs. Try not to get too scared!
Enter the pipe to the Catacombs.
Your first targets are…the Moussaka Meanies!!

Juniper says that you need to proceed to the Caponata Catacombs. You can enter the Catacombs using the pipe. Then proceed to the Lower Catacombs to look for the Cryptworms that are causing the mystical interference. Be on your guard!
Enter the Catacombs entrance.
Spa Daze
The monsters here have powers of their own and are interfering with the magical forces in this area. If you can defeat the Cryptworms in the Lower Catacombs, I will be able to help you.
Arrrmed Forces (Part 2 of 6)
Contact Sugarnose on Bravo Beach.
We be needin' to find the Shortbread Radio's transistor. Talk to me mate, Sugarnose. That Candy Pirate always be knowin' the lowdown!
I went down to Bravo Beach and met Sugarnose, who told me that the Turbo Jetskills stole the Shortbread Radio's transistor. But they didn't have it.
Arrr! Fuse be tryin' to throw us off the trail. But we'll find that transistor yet! I'll send me spies out to get to the bottom o' this mystery.
If we want to reinstall the Shortbread Radio in the lighthouse, we be needin' to find the transistor! Talk to me lieutenant, Sugarnose. He be down on Bravo Beach.
Talk to Sugarnose.
Aye! The Turbo Jetskills took the Shortbread Radio's transistor. I seen 'em! But I not be strong enough to take 'em on meself. Can ye help?
The Turbo Jetskills on Bravo Beach stole our Shortbread Radio's transistor! See if you can get it back, me hearty!
Protect the Grim's Gardens store.
Defeat seven Turbo Jetskills.
Arrr! They don't have the transistor! Come back to me, landlubber!
The Turbo Jetskills didn't have the transistor! Arrr! Where be Sugarnose gettin' his information? Well, go back and find out!
Return to Sugarnose.
If we don't be findin' that transistor soon, we won't be able to signal me mates on the sea. Arrr!
Helping Candy Pirates. Swell.
Candy Pirate reinforcements will certainly help the war effort.
Oooh, did the Candy Pirates give you some candy booty?
The Candy Pirates told me that you're sweet!
Arrrmed Forces (Part 1 of 6)
Before you leave, can you help me wit one last ting? I heard dat de Oil Ogres in Steam Alley are planning to attack me store, Grim's Gardens. Please stop dem!
Investigate the Orchid Bay container maze.
Arrr! We be usin' Orchid Bay's lighthouse to send a signal to Candy Pirate reinforcements on the open sea. But Fuse's jerks have stolen our Shortbread Radio!
I recovered the Candy Pirates' Shortbread Radio from the container maze in Orchid Bay, but its transistor was missing.
Good work, matey! But this radio won't be of no use to us without a transistor. Arrr! You need to talk to me best mate, Sugarnose.

Them crafty Spawns stole our Shortbread Radio from the lighthouse and are guarding it inside the container maze nearby. Careful, it be swarmin' with Boardwalk Bullies! Ye need to go to the maze entrance, then wait for instructions.
Go to maze entrance.
The Shortbread Radio is hidden in the center of the maze. Arrr!
Go into the maze and find me that Shortbread Radio. Ye can enter the maze on the southern side, or go around to the back. Yer choice, Matey!
Retrieve radio from maze.
Good work, kiddo! Come back to me!
I defeated the Oil Ogres in Steam Alley and prevented them from attacking Grim's Gardens.
Good work, Matey! Ye got the Shortbread Radio. Bring it back to me so we can signal me mates on the open sea.
Return to Captain Caramelanie.
Avast! Ye got the Shortbread Radio, but the transistor is gone. Arrr! This gadget be useless without a transistor.
The container maze in Orchid Bay is confusing.
You're doing a great job helping out the Candy Pirates.
Can I have a lollipop?
Arrrmed Forces (Part 3 of 6)
Find the Shortbread Radio's transistor.
Okay, me hearty. This time, I be sure that the Shortbread Radio's transistor be stashed inside the Cutts and Bruises Skate Park. Fancy a run over there? Arrr!
I navigated the infected skate park and collected the Shortbread Radio's transistor. But we need to boost power to the signal.
Me Grim's Gardens store is a target for Fuse. Because you showed dose monsters we mean business, I have stayed in business!
Avast! The Shortbread Radio be back in place at the lighthouse, but the signal be needin' a boost! I have an idea, if ye be game.
Talk to me mate, Mario Superior. He be near the entrance to the Cutts and Bruises Skate Park. He be havin' valuable information regardin' the location of our lost transistor. Arrr!
Talk to Mario Superior.
Hi! I've got some good information for Captain Caramelanie. I saw some of Fuse's monsters stashing a transistor at the top of the halfpipe in the infected zone!
Ah, so the Shortbread Radio's transistor be atop the halfpipe inside the Cutts and Bruises Skate Park. Can ye make it up to the top to grab it, matey?
Collect the transistor.
Ye gots it! Arrr! Quick, bring it back to me.
Bring the Shortbread Radio's transistor to me. Once we have the radio fixed, ye can install it back inside the lighthouse.
Bring transistor to Sugarnose.
Good work, landlubber! I've fixed the Shortbread Radio. All ye have to do is put it back inside the lighthouse, and it will do what it does best. Arrr!
Have you heard of me spa, Grim's Gardens? Our motto is, "Come rest your weary soul, so I don't have to reap it!" Please stop de Oil Ogres in Steam Alley from attacking me store.
The Shortbread Radio is fixed. Bring it to the lighthouse in Orchid Bay, and we will make sure it's seaworthy. Arrr!
Bring radio to lighthouse.
Good. Now we be makin' sure that the radio be workin' right.
Arrr! The Shortbread Radio's signal ain't strong enough! We need to boost the signal. Come back to me, Matey.
Return to Sugarnose.
Avast! We be…signal…who be…cannot hear ye! Arrr ye there? Arrr ye there?
Arrr! We need to boost the Shortbread Radio's signal if we hope to attract the attention of me fellow Candy Pirates. But I have a plan!
Arrrmed Forces (Part 4 of 6)
Boost the Shortbread Radio's signal.
I got me a Multi-Grain signal booster. If ye take this to a high point inside the infected Sand Castle, we will be able to boost the Shortbread Radio's signal. Arrr!
Dee Dee is really happy that you helped her out.
Defeat five Newspaper Ninjas.
Go to Steam Alley.
I boosted the Shortbread Radio's signal using a Multi-Grain signal booster.
Excellent work, me hearty! Have ye considered freelance pirate work? We need to send word to me mates in the area. Fancy one more mission?
Take the Multi-Grain signal booster to the infected zone at Bravo Beach. We can be usin' it to make the Shortbread Radio more powerful.
Enter infected Sand Castle.
Ye need to climb up to the highest point on the Sand Castle. Watch out for the Fusion Matter, me hearty! Get to the top and set up the booster.
Place the signal booster.
Arrr ye a good jumper? Go to the castle's highest point to place the booster.
That should do it! Let's test the Shortbread Radio again.
The Shortbread Radio is working! Ye have done well. Return to me on the beach and I will give ye a much-deserved reward.
Return to Sugarnose.
It seems that our missing heroes are still alive. This is very good news. Come back to Dexlabs when you are finished with Grim. -Dexter
I be hearing ye loud and clear! What can I do fer ye? Arrr!
Good work, Matey! The Shortbread Radio be workin' and Toothy Jim be receivin' us. Let's send word to me fellow Candy Pirates.
Shortbread Radio? Sounds delicious.
Nice work fixing the Shortbread Radio.
When is "Talk Like a Pirate" Day? Arrr!
I hope more Candy Pirates come to help us out!

Send word to the Candy Pirates.

Reduce the Fusion threat in Haunted Ridge.

Go to the Monkey Line.

Good. Use the jump pad to reach the platform. Take the line pointing north.
Use the Monkey Line to get across the ridge to the old mining camp. You could run across, if you want. When you get there, I'll tell you what to do with the meteoric ore.
See Dexter at Dexlabs.
Go to old mining camp.

Now you need to apply the meteoric ore to three of the cabins in the camp.

We can't let Fuse turn the mining camp into an infected zone. Use the meteoric ore on three different cabins to limit the spread of Fuse's infection.

We can't let Fuse turn the mining camp into an infected zone. Use the meteoric ore on three different cabins to limit the spread of Fuse's infection.

Protect the old mining camp.

That Grim guy needs to eat something.

Defeat ten Alpha Arachnids before time expires. If you can keep the monsters at bay for long enough, I am sure we can secure the mining camp.
Defeat ten Alpha Arachnids.

Return to start point.
Listen up! You need to defeat the Alpha Arachnids quickly to secure the area.
Good work. Thanks to you, the meteoric ore has had enough time to work. The mining camp is secure. Come back to me to receive your reward from SACT.
Way to save Grim's Gardens!

Great work. Now we need to find out who that UFO belongs to, and where they obtained that extremely valuable meteor.

Stop Fuse from poisoning the river.

Fusion AmpFibian! So is this a Fusion copy of the original Amperi DNA sample from the Omnitrix, or a Fusion copy of Ben in AmpFibian form?

Looks like you’ve got a Fusion to fry! I’ll try to keep the grid from shorting out again while you take out the bad guy!

Nicely done, sparky! Come and see me for your reward.

You managed to defeat a single unit of a self-regenerating army with the assistance of some rogue Omnitrix DNA. Tell me, how many Ben Tennysons does it take to ward off an alien invasion?

Nicely done, sparky! Come and see me for your reward.
Put a shock in it, squid face! I didn’t see you helping.

Look, I’m not sure if I’m Ben Tennyson or Ra’ad or someone new entirely, but I DO know that Fuse needs to be stopped, and you can be sure that AmpFibian will be there to help save the planet!
1.21 Megawatts
Kevin Levin accidentally released a bunch of Megawatts near the UFO magnet, pulling a spaceship out of orbit and nearly destroying Nowhere. I saved the day at the last second.
Defeat the Overcharged Megawatts.

Hey, sparky! You feel that static in the air? There’s something supercharging the UFO magnet buried under Nowhere, and that’s NOT good. Something that powerful could pull a ship as large as Vilgax’s down to the planet!
Talk To Kevin
There’s something supercharging the UFO magnet buried under Nowhere.
There's definitely more where that came from. Try looking in Pokey Oaks North.
Yo, you here to deal with the Megawatt situation? I may or may not have been trying to use them to jumpstart my car when they got away from me. ...why are you looking at me like that?
Those Megawatts are overcharged with fusion matter! They’re causing the UFO magnet to be nearly ten times as strong!
Pacify 15 Overcharged Megawatts
You need to take care of the Overcharged Megawatts in the Infected Zone before it’s too late! That said, I’m not really sensing a strict time limit, so I guess that’s more of a suggestion.
I tried to warn him, but now we’re all doomed! AAAAAH!
What was I supposed to do, take the pink talking dog seriously? Just take ‘em out before it gets any worse.
That should be enough for now. I trust Kevin will round up the rest, am I correct?
Talk to Kevin
Yeah, yeah. I get the hint, Tennyson. ...or whoever you are. I don’t want to think about it. If you’re all done there, come back and talk to me.
Can you do me a favor and not mention this to Gwen? It’s pretty obvious what I did was stupid, but I need to get my car fixed so I can get out of here. This place is creepy, man!
Much like your previous task, you need to go to Pokey Oaks North to pick up another batch of cardboard.
Max and I just got a report of a large ship of some kind entering our atmosphere at high velocity. It was headed your way until just a few moments ago.
Return to AmpFibian
Whatever it is, it looks like it’s going to be making one heck of a crash landing somewhere in the ocean.
Looks like the two of us saved the day! To think, if we were even a few minutes too late, Nowhere might have been wiped off the face of the planet by a catastrophic spaceship crash!
Simian Snap
Using Mojo Jojo’s primitive camera, I took a picture of Spidermonkey.
Mojo Jojo needs pictures, pictures of Spidermonkey! Use his camera to get the scoop!

I, Mojo Jojo, have uncovered a piece of information that can be classified as “interesting” to someone such as myself. My Monkey Minion scouts are reporting a rare alien creature running around the Monkey Mountain, and I request that you transport yourself to the Monkey Mountain so that you can see if this alien truly exists.
Go to Monkey Mountain
Take this camera device, and use it to take a photograph of this weird alien creature.
Collect second cardboard.
Take a picture of the weird monkey
Now that you have arrived at Monkey Mountain, can you find the odd monkey that my Monkey Minion scouts are describing?
You have found the odd-looking monkey that my Monkey Minion scouts have described to me. You must now take a photograph of it quickly, before it runs away.
EEEEK! You don’t need to put the flash on, genius, it's the middle of the day! Why are you taking my picture anyway, do you work for Jimmy Jones?
What? This ‘Spider Monkey’ can communicate? I, Mojo Jojo, require photographs! Photographs of Spidermonkey!
Return to Mojo Jojo with pictures of Spidermonkey
It seems you have not failed the task I assigned to you, and have gotten the photographs I, Mojo Jojo, had requested. Please return them.

You have succeeded in getting me the photographs of Spidermonkey that I initially requested, however I, Mojo Jojo, imagined that it was a dangerous fusion monster, not an alien hero. If this creature dislikes Fuse just as much as I, Mojo Jojo, happen to dislike Fuse, then I, Mojo Jojo, would recommend you return to Spidermonkey and see what trivial tasks he wants you to accomplish.

This is not a dangerous monster at all, it is simply one of Ben Tennyson’s many alien transformations. Why did you not just relay this information when you initially realized it? The memory card in my camera can only hold a finite quantity of photographs.
Excuse me! What are you doing with that picture, by the way? Is it going on the web? You’ll make sure to tag me, right? Eek!
Collect Dee Dee's tutu.
All right! More cardboard for Edd. There's no bugs on it or anything, right?
Spectacular Spidermonkey
I helped Spidermonkey take down an Alpha Ape, but it didn’t stop Fuse’s monsters from wrecking Monkey Mountain.
Help Spidermonkey fight off Fuse’s forces.
Hey, you! Human! Ook, ook! Want to help take Fuse down, Spidermonkey-Style?
Defeat 7 Volcano Vaulters

This place used to be a sacred sanctuary for monkeys of all kinds, even aliens like me, ook ook! Fuse’s monsters have caused most of the locals to flee the area! Let’s avenge all of the monkeys that were forced to leave, starting with the Volcano Vaulters, eek!
Ook ook! Those Volcano Vaulters are constantly getting in my way. Make sure they know not to mess with your friendly neighborhood Spidermonkey!
That should make swinging around the rocks a lot less dangerous. Now you have to go for those ugly Dire Apes, ook ook!
Defeat 4 Dire Apes
Eeek! The Dire Apes make me sick. These imposters walk around like they own the place, but they aren’t even real monkeys! Thin their numbers and show them that they aren’t so tough, ook ook!
Find the penultimate stash of cardboard near the Powerpuff Girls' house in Pokey Oaks South. You're doing a spectacular job.
Fuse has been using the Dire Apes to kidnap poor innocent monkeys that stayed behind after the invasion. Are we just gonna let them keep doing that!?
Defeat an Alpha Ape

The apes only respond to an alpha, taking the grunts down won’t change a thing. If you can defeat one of the big Alpha Apes and get me one of their fangs, the rest should scatter. Be careful, they didn’t get named the Alpha Ape for no reason!
EEEEEK! You toppled the alpha! I’ll bet he doesn’t feel so good about that. Get one of his fangs and bring it back to me!
Bring the Alpha Ape fang to Spidermonkey

Timber! Eek! The Alpha Ape was no match for you! Now, bring me back one of his fangs. Hopefully, the rest of the Dire Apes will see us as their new alpha, and we can tell them to leave Monkey Mountain forever!

I don’t get it. The monsters here are going about their business as if nothing happened! Ook! I guess as long as Fuse keeps making more Alpha Apes, we’re gonna have to find another way to take back Monkey Mountain, ook!

Eek! Thanks for all your help! In the meantime, I’ll think of another way to clear these monsters out of the Foothills. Don’t worry, you’ll be the first person I call to do all of the hard work, ook ook!
Special Delivery

Collect third cardboard.
Make a special delivery to Monkey Foothills.
Hey, mate! Someone up in the Monkey Foothills radioed in requesting a ton of provisions. Most of our operatives are busy at the moment, think you can make the run?
Go to Monkey Foothills
Get this care package to Monkey Foothills, pronto! Whatever’s in here must be real important.
Whatever it is that you’re delivering, we’ve been given special instructions to make sure it doesn’t get cold.
Talk to Spidermonkey
Wow, thanks! I've been dying for one of these! Quick, come find me!

Mmm, mmm. Pizza time! Two extra large pies on banana bread with ticks, flies, and fleas, just like I ordered! I was going to offer you a slice, but you look like you’re gonna hurl for some reason. Oh well! Since you’re here, want to help me fight off Fuse’s forces in this area? Ook!
Hey wait a second, I ordered a drink with this.
Hold up, we serve pizza? Aw crud, I’ve been eating dry Rainbow Munchies for weeks!
Okay, you can look for more by the Powerpuff's house.
Far From Home
Using some plumber tech Ben gave me, Spidermonkey and I made some sticky web grenade traps.
Get spring-loaded canisters from Ben.

Eek! The monsters up here on the mountain are getting out of control! I think I have a plan to slow them down, quite literally. I can use my webbing to set up traps, but I need something to hide the webbing in! Do you think you could find something for me to use?
Talk to Ben
If you need somewhere to look, try asking me- I mean Ben.  I mean- oh whatever, it’s too complicated to explain. Just go ask Ben if he has any spare Plumber tech lying around.
Oh hey, you found Spidermonkey! I’m sure we have some spare Plumber tech here at the Spaceport if you want it.
Here’s some empty spring-loaded canisters. Spidermonkey filled me in on the details. Just fill these up with his webbing and you should have some totally-awesome sticky traps!
Ben, are you sure about just handing over Plumber tech like that? Just because AmpFibian is on our side doesn’t mean that the rest of your aliens are, too. Don’t be reckless.
Return to Spidermonkey
Sweet! Only one more stash to go.
I knew he would help out, It’s not that hard to convince myself to do something. Bring those canisters back to me and we can get to work!
Don’t worry about it, Grandpa. After all, Spidermonkey is me, kinda, and when have I EVER been reckless?
Ook ook! I’ll start setting up these traps right away! You wanna run around and place these when I’m done? Of course you do!
With Great Power…
I placed the sticky web grenades Spidermonkey and I created around the Monkey Foothills.
Set up the web grenades in Monkey Foothills.
My super special web grenade traps are ready to go! Take these and place them around the Foothills, this should slow these monsters down for good!
Place the first web grenade
We have enough for three spider-traps. Try to place them down in areas with a large amount of monsters, that way we can take out as many as possible!
Place the first web grenade over by the summit, there’s some rock formations that look like the perfect hiding spot.
You need to find one last stash of cardboard to bring back to the Cul-de-Sac. I know I saw some in Peach Creek Commons.
Place the second web grenade

Entanglement set, eek! Only two more to go.
Place the third web grenade

That’s all of them! Head on back to me and we can see what we caught, eek eek!
Return to Spidermonkey
Now that all the super special mega sticky web grenades are set, all we have left to do is wait. Come on back to me and I’ll give you a reward.
I’m detecting a spike of Fusion activity in the Foothills, what exactly are you doing down there?
Collect last cardboard.
Ook! We did it! Now all we have to do is wait for the monsters to set the grenades off! That couldn’t have gone any better, if I do say so myself. And I do!
Into the Spider-Lair
Fuse created a Fusion Spidermonkey using the DNA from the web grenades we left in Monkey Foothills. Whoops! Everything’s cool now, though.
Talk to Tetrax to learn more about Fusion Spidermonkey.
Eeeeek! Heads up, I just got word from Tetrax, he wants to talk to you as soon as possible! Ooooook! You’re in troubleeeee…
Use the Kumari Serpent to travel to the Darklands
Tetrax is in the Darklands. You can ride on that big scary sea monster to get there!
Talk to Tetrax

I got an official-looking email from Tetrax saying he wants to talk to the person responsible for placing those sticky grenades all over the Foothills. Naturally, I gave myself an alibi and told him that you did it. You should go see what he wants, he’s in the Darklands.
What were you thinking!? By leaving Arachnichimp DNA deep within enemy territory, you’ve given Fuse an easy way to create Fusion Spidermonkey! Go clean up your mess.
Stupendous! That's about all we need. Bring it to Edd, post-haste.
Oh riiiiight, I forgot that’s kinda their whole deal. Oops. Fusion Spidermonkey can’t have gotten far!
Find the Fusion Lair in Forsaken Valley

Fuse creates Fusions here in the Darklands, so it’s likely Fusion Spidermonkey is hiding out somewhere near the research station.
Defeat Fusion Spidermonkey
We caused this so we have to fix it, and by we I mean you. I’d join you in the Darklands, but I’m not a very good swimmer! Ook!
There’s the Fusion Arachnichimp. Take the creature down and then report back to me.
Down it goes. Come back to me for a debrief.
Return to Tetrax
Hey, not bad! We make a pretty good team! You should go talk to Tetrax. Ook, ook!
You have all the cardboard Edd needs. Now you just need to bring it back to him at the Cul-de-Sac in Peach Creek Commons. Make sure you say hello from me!
I had the Plumbers remove the rest of the webbing in the area. The two of you were reckless, but you handled the situation well.

Well, you win some and you lose some. How was I supposed to know that leaving super-powered alien DNA unguarded in the middle of a bunch of fusion monsters would turn out disastrous? Ok, now that I say it out loud, it doesn’t seem like my greatest plan ever. Sure, turns out I’m not much of a “plan” person, but if you ever need spider-power on your side, give me a call! Ook ook!
The Fusion Arachnichimp has been eliminated. This Omnitrix alien phenomenon is most curious. I wonder how many more there are out there…
