I, Mojo Jojo, would like to see this creature with my own two eyes. Take this primitive camera and capture a photograph of the creature so that I, Mojo Jojo, may look at it.
Ook! Ook! Awesome, you’re here! Quick, come find me.
Mega Fusion Education (Part 1 of 2)
Albedo taught me how to get Null Void coordinate data from Mini Fusion Echo Echoes.
Learn about Mini Fusion Echo Echoes from Albedo.

Are you aware that this “Lord Fuse” has created a Mega Fusion Echo Echo? These Plumbers are pretty good at keeping the monster trapped in an uncharted area of the Null Void, but for some reason they refuse to trust me, Ben Tennyson, with the exact coordinates.
Find and defeat a Mini Fusion Echo Echo somewhere in the Darklands
Deliver the stashes of cardboard.

Every now and then, a Mini Fusion Echo Echo will escape from the Null Void and find its way here to the Darklands. You’ll generally find them roaming between The Precipice and Hero’s Hollow.

If you can manage to defeat one, your Nanocom should be able to scan it and extract the coordinates of the Mega Fusion Echo Echo being held in the Null Void. The coordinate data takes up a lot of storage, so I’d recommend having at least one free space in your inventory. 

If you’re currently not strong enough to beat a Mini Fusion Echo Echo on your own, it’s probably wise to return to this task when you are capable of doing so. Do NOT waste my time.
The first thing you need to do is locate and defeat a Mini Fusion Echo Echo somewhere in this general area. Read your journal to get the full details.
Return to Albedo

You managed to defeat a Mini Fusion Echo Echo and, assuming you didn’t completely screw everything up, obtained some coordinate data for the Null Void. It is important to remember that if you ever want to re-obtain this coordinate data, you must defeat another Mini Fusion Echo Echo.
You actually managed to defeat one? I’m surprised. Return back to me and I will show you how that data you collected works, hopefully in terms your simplistic human brain can understand.

I created my own copy of the coordinate data your nanocom scanned earlier. I had intended to keep it for myself, but for reasons far too complicated for you to understand, I must be rid of it. I am trusting you with my copy of the data. Do NOT get rid of this item, you will need it to enact the next part of my plan.
Mega Fusion Education (Part 2 of 2)
Albedo taught me how to use the Null Void coordinate data I obtained from the Mini Fusion Echo Echoes, and I encountered Mega Fusion Echo Echo up close!
Learn how to use Null Void coordinate data from Albedo.

Are you ready to take down Mega Fusion Echo Echo? You can use the coordinate data I had you collect earlier to transport yourself to the Null Void. Speak with the Projector Technician over there, and have him scan the coordinates. Since traveling to the Null Void will completely destroy the coordinate data, you can only use it once. You better still have that copy I entrusted you with!
Oh, you found my lucky tutu! But wait…there's a hole in it. Bummer!
I'm sure he'll give you something for your trouble.
Travel to the Mega Fusion Echo Echo Containment Area

Do you still have the coordinate data in your inventory? If so, proceed to the Projector Technician and travel to the Null Void to face Mega Fusion Echo Echo. If not, ensure that you have it with you before you talk with them. You should also make sure that the coordinate data in your inventory is not encrypted. You can use your nanocom can decrypt the data the same way you open a CRATE.

If you somehow lost the coordinate data completely, you will have to track down another Mini Fusion Echo Echo and defeat it, ensuring that you COLLECT the data and that it REMAINS in your inventory before we can proceed. 

If this is too much for you to wrap your head around, I suggest you give up completely instead of wasting my time any further.
The Projector Technician can use the coordinate data you collected to take you to an isolated area of the Null Void. If you somehow LOST the data, check your journal.
Fall back! I’m not sure what you thought you were signing up for, but Mega Fusion Echo Echo is no pushover. Only proceed if you are confident in your abilities!
Return to the Precipice

In reality, it doesn’t matter if you win or lose against this monster. Unlike most encounters, if you get knocked out you will be unable to try again immediately. If you ever want to face Mega Fusion Echo Echo again, you simply need to obtain more coordinate data and travel back to the Null Void like before.
Talk to Albedo
Return to me, we're done here.

There you have it, you are now properly educated on Mega Fusion Echo Echo. More importantly, however, is that I am now very much aware of the exact coordinates where he’s being held in the Null Void. As an acknowledgement of your assistance, I will bestow upon you another duplicate of the coordinate data, but if you ever require more you’ll have to collect them from Mini Fusion Echo Echos yourself.
Echo Echo Echo
Thanks! This cardboard you found has wonderful texture. Firm and sturdy, too. Excellent. You'll like these Urban Ranger pants!
I helped Albedo try to trick the Echo Echoes into thinking that he’s Ben Tennyson, but he’s really bad at lying.
Help Albedo trick the Echo Echoes.
Greetings, fellow inhabitant of Earth! As you’re well aware, I, the great galactic hero and teenage heartthrob Ben Tennyson, need help rounding up all of the aliens who have escaped my Omnitrix.
Talk to Echo Echo 10
These Echo Echo creatures seem to dislike me, Ben Tennyson, for no reason in particular. Talk some sense into them.
These copies of myself in my Sonorosian form refuse to listen to reason. Perhaps you’ll be able to talk some sense into them?

Look, pal. You know just as well as we do that Albedo is obviously up to something evil. Our answer is still “no” to being crammed into his Ultimatrix thingy. If you want to humor him go right ahead, it’s pretty funny to watch “Ben 10” think he’s being clever.
I take it they still won’t listen to reason? Perhaps if we prove how heroic I really am, they’ll see things differently.
Defeat Monsters in The Precipice
Defeat five of every type of monster found The Precipice on my behalf. That should prove to those aliens that I am the galactic hero I say I am.
Peach Creek is full of geniuses.
Defeat five of each of Fuse’s underlings found here in The Precipice on my behalf. I’m sure those simple minded aliens won’t be able to tell the difference.
Meh, we’re not impressed.
Defeat Monsters in The Precipice
You are to defeat ONE HUNDRED of these monsters before the time limit expires! We must prove to these Echo Echoes that I am Ben Tennyson!
Not impressed?! My champion will defeat ONE HUNDRED of every monster in this area within a time limit of sixty seconds!
Return to Albedo
How could you fail such a simple task? Return to me at once.
What was THAT pathetic display?! You are completely useless. Return back to me, there must be some other way to get these Echo Echoes on my side…

I’ll admit I may have overestimated your skills a little back there. You’re clearly not as capable as I thought. If my Ultimatrix was functional, I would have been able to defeat those enemies myself. Seeing as you have no further use to me, I suggest you leave me alone so that I may scheme in peace.
Echo Chamber
Good job helping Edd fix the fortress.
I helped the Echo Echoes trick Albedo with a Holo-Viewer so that they could focus on their plan to overwhelm Fuse by duplicating.
Help the Echo Echoes distract Albedo.
This Albedo guy is clearly up to no good. Even worse, he’s really annoying. Can you find a way to keep him busy so we Echo Echoes can focus on our plan to stop Fuse?
Talk to Plumber Marlon
One of the Plumbers in this area should have some tech we can use to mess with Albedo.
See if you can get ahold of a Holo-Viewer from one of the Plumbers stationed here.
You want to borrow my Holo-Viewer? I dunno, just giving away valuable Plumber tech would make me look bad in front of Ben Tennyson. If you do me a favor, I’ll think about it.
Listen up, I may or may not have been intentionally ignoring my patrol duties.
Talk to Tetrax
Looks like you’ve got to deal with this guy’s problem before you can tackle ours. This must happen to you all the time.
Beep beep! I'm a car!
It’s totally not my fault, though! One of Fuse’s monsters ate my route map! Can you ask Tetrax for a new copy?
A copy of the patrol route map? You’re aware we distribute those digitally, correct? Let me guess, this is another one of Marlon’s half-baked excuses.
Return to Plumber Marlon
Looks like you’ve got to deal with this guy’s problem before you can tackle ours. This must happen to you all the time.
Whoops. I’ll come up with some other story later. Oh well, a deal is a deal. I’ll lend you my Holo-Viewer.
Here’s my Holo-Viewer. Could you keep this between us? I’d feel so embarrassed if Ben found out, especially since he’s hanging out right over there!
About time. We’ve remotely reconfigured the holographic display to cycle through various life size-images of the other alien forms who escaped from the Omnitrix.
Set up the Holo-Viewer
Hey, you finally got it. We’ve reconfigured the device to show life-size holograms of various aliens. If you put it somewhere far away but visible, it should be pretty convincing.
It won’t be very convincing up close, but from a distance it shouldn’t matter.
I think Double D is a cool dude!
That looks like a good spot. Come back here and we can turn it on.
Return to Echo Echo 10
Come back to camp and we can turn it on. Hopefully we Echo Echoes will finally be able to think clearly without Albedo constantly pestering us.
Do my eyes deceive me? That looks to be Spidermonkey off in the distance! Or is it AmpFibian? … or perhaps Swampfire? I may not need these Echo Echoes after all…
Good work out there. This should keep him distracted for a while. Man, for a Galvan, Albedo sure is gullible!
Echo Location
Something capable of creating sound waves on par with Ultimate Echo Echo was wreaking havoc in Hero’s Hollow. Turns out the sound waves were just from Cheese’s annoying screeches.
Investigate sonic waves in Hero’s Hollow.

I’ve been picking up powerful sonic waves emanating from Hero’s Hollow. Could the escaped Omnitrix aliens have the ability to change into their Ultimate forms? Paired with my recent sightings of the other escaped Omnitrix aliens, I’m beginning to reevaluate my plans.
Investigate the source of the sonic waves
Map Quest
Prove your worth and investigate the source of these powerful sonic waves.
We’re picking up those sonic waves too. I’ll send you some coordinates.

This creature is most certainly an Ultimate Sonorosian. Nothing else could create sound waves as powerful as this!

Investigate the source of the sonic waves
The source of these sonic waves is on the move. You must chase after it before it eludes us again!
Hi doggy!
Find the treasure map at Pokey Oaks Junior High.

Talk to Albedo
This “Cheese” lifeform must be one of the most powerful aliens in the Omnitrix. I must gain control! Report back to me and I will reward you for your efforts.
This “Cheese” lifeform must be extremely powerful if it’s capable of taking down an entire army single handedly. I must harness its energy! For galactic hero stuff, obviously.

This “Cheese” is most intriguing. I must add a sample of its DNA to my Ultimatrix so that I may take his form and destroy Ben Tennyson! Er, who is I! I’ve, uh, got very poor self esteem. Let’s go with that.
L’eggo my Echo
I saved a whole bunch of Echo Echoes from the clutches of Fusion Albedo, who was disguising himself as Fusion Ben for some reason.
Find the missing Echo Echoes.

Alright, it’s all been good fun up until now, but this Albedo thing has gone too far. Our scouts have reported multiple sightings of Echo Echoes wandering off with “Ben Tennyson” and not returning. Can you help sort things out?
Talk to Albedo
I'm gonna tell you a secret. I hear that there's a secret treasure map hidden at Pokey Oaks Junior High. And the map leads to a huge haul of candy!
Multiple Echo Echoes have been seen wandering off with “Ben Tennyson” and not returning. We’re pretty sure Albedo is behind this!
You must be joking, I haven’t abducted any Echo Echoes, I’m a galactic hero! Plus, I haven’t moved from this spot since I arrived. Why would I, when I can get fools like you to do all the work?
If there are sightings of another Ben Tennyson besides myself in the area, this can only be the work of my smartest adversary, Albedo!
Investigate the Dark Glade Infected Zone
If it isn’t Albedo abducting Echo Echoes, maybe they were actually seeing the real Ben! Most of the reports mentioned Dark Glade, so you should check there for clues.
He does have a point. We’ve been pretty diligent about keeping an eye on him. Maybe the sightings were actually the real Ben after all? Start by looking for clues in Dark Glade.
I’ll bet Albedo (who I am not) has taken those Echo Echoes hostage and is working with Fuse to repair the Ultimatrix!
Find the Fusion Portal
I’m getting some weird readings coming from the back of the Infected Zone. I’ll bet the missing Echo Echoes are being held there.
Aha! It seems as though my arch nemesis and intellectually superior rival Albedo was working with Fusion Ben all along!
I entered the Pokey Oaks infected zone and collected a treasure map.
Defeat Fusion Ben
Huh, I guess Albedo was innocent after all. Quickly, defeat that Fusion and save those Echo Echoes!
Who does this guy think he’s even fooling? Just go take care of Fusion Ben and rescue those Echo Echoes!
Fusion Ben was actually Fusion Albedo in disguise!
Defeat Fusion Albedo
Huh, I guess Albedo was innocent after all. Quickly, defeat that Fusion and save those Echo Echoes!
Okay, this is just nonsensical at this point.
What a twist! It’s a good thing the real Albedo isn’t cunning enough to fool anyone into thinking he’s me, the real Ben Tennyson!
Return to Echo Echo 10
Nice work, you saved the other Echo Echoes! Come back to The Precipice, we’re almost done!
You are so nice to help Dee Dee!

The Mark of a True Nerd

OH. MY. GOSH. Have you heard? The lead actor from the famous multimedia franchise “Space Wars” is in town! Or, at least, I think he’s in town. Apparently in this next issue they’re going to reveal that there’s actually a secret fourth Powerpuff Girl. Well, they’re advertising it as a fourth, but there were actually two previous fourth Powerpuff Girls in earlier issues, for a total of five so far. BUT they obviously retconned those two since reception of the characters was really mixed. Ooh ooh! What do you think their primary color will be? Well, using data based on the way previous characters have been introduced, and my long history of making headcanons, I theorise the next Powerpuff will be purple! ...Again.

Speaking of which, the alternate universe Krunk from Universe 32-B that fell into Universe 25-C, which is the universe this comic takes place in (that’s actually up for debate, by the way) is actually Supercow in disguise! You see, Krunk doesn’t normally have udders, but if you’re a seasoned comic book veteran like myself you can easily pick out small details like that.

Which reminds me, I really need to go grocery shopping soon. I’m always running out of milk. You know, I saw my very good friend Johnny Bravo’s picture on a carton the other day. That must mean he’s really famous now! Come to think of it, I haven’t seen Johnny in weeks. You see, I tried calling him to tell him the good news, but he didn’t pick up the phone! Maybe he finally figured out how to block my number. I’ll have to get another burner phone so we can keep in touch.

Oh, also! Pops mentioned something about some sort of alien invasion. Man, if aliens were really invading that would be SO COOL. Pops was probably just trying to pull a fast one on me, though. A nerd can dream!

Y’know, the topic of aliens makes me think of my all time favorite multimedia franchise, “Space Wars.” Say, did you hear that the lead actor is in town? Or, at least, I think he’s in town. I saw this really interesting program last night about moss. Did you know there are over 50 different types of moss native to the Townsville region alone? The ecosystem’s biodiversity is amazing around here because of the proximity to so many different and varied biomes. The leaking nuclear plant is also probably partially to blame.

Oh oh, did you know that nuclear energy is the way of the future? According to top researchers in the field, alternatives like Dextronium and Imaginary Energy just aren’t viable renewable resources. I’m not even sure I believe in that Imaginary Energy hoo-ha anyway. If it WERE real then I would definitely have my own imaginary friend exactly like my good friend Johnny Bravo, but nicer. He’d be really into my favorite multimedia franchise, “Space Wars.”

Speaking of my favorite multimedia franchise, “Space Wars,” what’s your stance on the latest film release, “The Final Starwizard?” It’s a VERY divisive film. Honestly I think it was a fun movie all on its own, but in terms of keeping with continuity I’d rank it below the holiday special. However, I value and respect those with different opinions to my own and if you enjoyed the movie I am very happy for you.

On the topic of holiday specials, did you know that Johnny Bravo met THE Santa Claus? He says so anyway. I personally celebrate Knishmas, myself. I find the personality of Knish Kringle to be way more exciting than a jolly old man. Plus, he could totally beat Santa in hand-to-hand combat. Have you seen how many limbs he has?


Speaking of limbs, you should see the articulation on this REALLY cool mint condition, new in-box, first print Blossom Talks-Alot figurine with an articulated hairbow and an ice breath standee! Lenny gave it to me from his PRIVATE COLLECTION. He mentioned something about figurine collecting not being as fulfilling as he thought it would be. As we established earlier, I’m gonna give this to you along with the green stuff I found on the ground as a reward for helping me out.

FWD: FWD: The History of Harada-Bridges Records - Townsville Tribune

The Harada-Bridges Record Company is a Townsville-based record label founded through a joint partnership between former musician/performer Sunny Bridges and Kaz Harada, manager for famous J-Pop/Rock duo Puffy AmiYumi.

Harada-Bridges Records distributes music from many such talents as The Powerpuff Girls, The Trendbenders, Pizza Party, The Gangreen Gang, Puffy AmiYumi, among others.


Alongside these new labels, it also sells redistributions and collections of older albums, including the famous 70's group Shag Carpeting and smaller names like Mr. Universe.
Bridges and Harada founded the company shortly after meeting while Harada was on tour. The band he manages had played at the Westley School for the Performing Arts, at which Bridges teaches music.


Recognizing Bridges from his music career, Harada attempted to persuade him back into the business. Bridges initially turned him down, having been burnt out from performing and having wanted to retire before becoming a teacher.


After thinking it over, however, Bridges eventually pitched Harada the idea of starting up a record label. He has been cited as saying his inspiration was to provide a trustworthy label that up and coming musicians such as his students could sign on to without having the soul sucked out of their music by the industry.


Harada ecstatically agreed, on the condition that he would handle the money. With their ideals combined, the Harada-Bridges Record Company has become the most well-known and well-trusted label out of Townsville.


Their headquarters is based in Marquee Row, the entertainment district of downtown Townsville. The building is furnished with a high-end recording studio, in which much of the music they distribute is recorded.

It appears that Mandark used his digitizer machine to inject his own malware into the chip alongside your own data. Please destroy his viruses before going after the original source of the corruption.
This will not do. Mandark obtaining the secrets is nearly comparable to Fuse obtaining them. Kindly destroy his virus before it completes its work.
I had a feeling something like this would happen. I’ve sent along this virtual avatar of myself to help fend off Mandark’s malware! Let’s get going!
Argh! You idiot! Drat. You win this time, Dexter!

Return to Dee Dee quickly!
Return to Edd with candy.

I did not notice through all the annoying distractions, but it appears that Fusion Computress is the one behind the corruption on the chip. It appears that Fusion Computress is the one behind the corruption. The two of you must defeat her before she escapes with critical data.
Eureka! We may be able to keep our secrets out of Fuse’s hands for good if that data is used as a Nano creation item.

Congratulations, you have created a new Nano, and the secrets of the chip are safe. Feel free to return to the real world when you’re ready.
I wish I could live inside a computer game. I think there was a movie like that once!

I’d let Computress run a diagnostics check on my computer any day of the week.

I’ve received a handwritten sticky note from Computress (Dexter’s robotic assistant, remember? Her handwriting is immaculate, by the way) asking to speak with you about a situation that arose involving a Fusion and one of her old memory chips! -Edd
Don't let Lee eat the candy! Bring it back to me, post-haste!

Greetings. Computress recommended I reach out to you about a (very minor) setback I’ve been experiencing while trying to repair one of her corrupted memory chips. I don’t know how much you can help if even I can’t figure it out, but the only other thing she suggested was asking Mandark, which I definitely refuse to do under ANY circumstances. Talk to Computress here in Tech Square, she’ll fill you in on the details. She said you may be more motivated to come if I mentioned there may be a Nano involved.

-Dexter

Ha! One of Dexter’s machines has malfunctioned! What a fool. Normally I would recommend that you simply idly stand by and laugh at his failures, but I am inclined to believe that you may be able to get an additional Nano out of this situation. Pretend to assist them with their problem so you may increase your own power, which in turn will increase the power of MY army, as you are among its ranks! Muahahahahahahaha!

-Mojo Jojo

Looks like the Omnitrix isn’t the only tech on the fritz right now. I got word that a Fusion Monster corrupted one of Computress’s old memory chips! She requested your assistance specifically, for some reason. You should go over there and see what you can do to help out. Maybe you’ll get a Nano out of it, too! Just a hunch. 

-Ben

I learned that there is no true Lord Fuse, and defeated “Fusion Runty.”
Investigate the recent activity in Fuse’s Lair.

Bet you’re wondering how Runty’s still here after his heroic sacrifice in the depths of Fuse’s Lair, huh? Huh huh huh? Huhhhhhhhhh? Well I’ll tell you! But first, there’s some unfinished business… one last job… one final score... that I need YOU to complete! 

You see, now that Lord Fuse is gone to live on a farm in the sky with my Great Aunt Sally, a power vacuum has opened up in his empire that has already been filled by someone even biggier and baddier! YOU NEED TO DO SOMETHING ABOUT IT!
Return to Fuse’s Lair
Return to Fuse's Lair on behalf of Billy and Runty.
The Lair is swarming with… Fusions and unevolved spawns? They must somehow be regenerating without the presence of Lord Fuse. Curious.
Hmmm…this candy is definitely weird. I'm not eating it. Better keep it away from Eddy, too. While I think about what to do next, you can enjoy your reward!
Progress through Fuse’s Lair

This revelation that Fuse’s Lair is filled with Fusion Spawns makes absolutely zero sense! The sense it makes is less than one, on a scale from one to ten. Lord Fuse was the leader of the Fusions, as I am the leader of my Monkey Minion Army, and without my leadership, my army would fall! For I am a great leader, who my army relies on. If I were to be defeated (which I would not be) they would most certainly surrender! Uh, er, I mean, they are STRONG and FEARLESS and would continue without me! So do not attempt to foil any future world-conquering attempts that I will attempt in the future by taking me out to make my army give up, for it will not work. To the point, I am very confused as to why Fuse’s army still functions.
I’ve seen lots of alien weirdos in my time, but we totally defeated Lord Fuse already! Shouldn’t these guys have given up without their ruler?
The aliens are still stupid and brainless, but they are still functioning identically as they did before, which is to say it seems defeating Lord Fuse has done nothing at all!

This cannot be! Planet Fusion is… a massive hivemind? All monsters acting under one intelligence, all orders sent from the same… It’s all so hard to wrap my head around, truly! But if it’s all a hivemind… what did you fight?
Perhaps Planet Fusion doesn’t have a singular leader! Could it have been some sort of massive hivemind all along? I cringe at the thought!
That… does appear to line up with the data I’ve been collecting. The Lord Fuse you battled was simply a physical manifestation of a fraction of the Planet’s total power.

Based on the data I’ve been collecting, it appears that there is no real Lord Fuse! What you fought was simply a manifestation of the Planet’s power, sent to our world to put a stop to your meddling! I hate to think of the ramifications of this, but at least we have learned something more about our mysterious enemy. We will use this to our advantage, somehow.
So “Lord Fuse” is the planet, and defeating ol’ goobrain did basically nothing? Man, so much for “take me to your leader.”
Maybe so, Ben. But even then, we cannot give up! We now have a greater understanding of Fuse, and this will lead to his defeat, and OUR VICTORY!
Candy treasure? Oh, boy.
Defeat “Fusion Runty”
Papa?
There he is! The new ringleader! The head honcho! The big boss! El Gran Gordo! The Big Cheese! The man upstairs! Big brother! Little brother! Small mother! Oh, bother! GET HIM!
It appears there is much we still have to learn about Planet Fusion. I believe this war has only just begun.
I wish Billy would leave Runty at Foster’s so I could adopt him myself!
Y’know, this whole Planet Fusion hivemind thing would make a great video game! Somebody should get on that.
They gave Runty a Nano? What the heck are the priorities down at the Nano research lab?
Good job defeating Lord Fuse! Too bad it didn’t mean anything in the long run, though.

I’ve got good news and bad news. The good news is, it seems that Billy’s imaginary friend Runty survived the Fuse’s Lair debacle! The bad news is that Fuse’s army doesn’t appear to be behaving any differently than it did before you defeated Lord Fuse. The whole thing is very disturbing. I wonder if the two phenomena are possibly related? Could you please go to Endsville and check up on Billy and Runty?

-Edd

Curiouser and curiouser. Not only has that imaginary spawn that tags alongside that idiot, Billy, persisted through its sacrifice made to help you take down Lord Fuse, but Fuse’s forces have not shown any signs of slowing down, either! Did any of what we accomplished in Fuse’s Lair even ultimately affect anything? Something tells me there’s more to this than any of us realize at the moment. I suppose the best course of action would be to investigate Runty itself. Head over to Endsville (avoid Billy if you can help it) and get a closer look at the foul creature.

-Dexter
Good job keeping Lee Kanker in check.

The pitiful idea to sacrifice Billy’s pet in order to slow down Fuse’s army was a clear waste of time, as Fuse’s army has not faltered in the slightest even after the defeat of their leader. My Monkey Minions stationed at Endsville have reported seeing… ugh… Runty (I despise that name) exactly where it used to be. I would advise you ‘investigate’ the creature. And make sure it stays dead this time!

-Mojo

Soooo you know that freaky Spawn that follows Billy around? Yeah, “FOLLOWS.” Present tense. I was pretty sure it sacrificed itself to help you defeat Lord Fuse, but turns out he’s still around after that whole thing in Fuse’s Lair. Gwen told me she heard Billy mention something about a Fusion Runty? I really don’t get it. Since when do those two talk? Oh, and I don’t get the Fusion Runty thing either. Between Runty still alive and kicking, and Fuse’s army seemingly not slowing down their invasion efforts without their leader, I’ve got a hunch that something is up. Go to Endsville and see what’s up with Runty for yourself, okay?

-Ben

Oh, so Vilgax doesn't quite enjoy this little paradise of ours and wants to escape? What a shame. No worries, I'll keep his ambitions in check and rig his teleporter... Here. Now sender coordinates would always be the same as destination ones. He can play with his toy all he likes.
Human! Did I stutter? I need power coupling now!

You found one bag of tangelos, but there are more bags of tangelos. I like saying "tangelos". Tangelos.

Highbreed Teleportation Drive. Some nosy spoky thief stole it from them after the Los Soledad invasion. Now it can be located on the top of this pathetic human Mandark's house. Get it!

Привет, слушай. Эта червоточина – нечто! Из неё постоянно идут сообщения! И постоянно мне! Как будто это я точно знаю, что скажу в будущем, чтобы сказать это себе в прошлом! И какие сообщения! Что я молодец, что у меня всё получится! Я уже так давно не отходил от этой червоточины, что… проголодался. Ты можешь принести мне чего-нибудь перекусить? Буду очень благодарен.
Эх… Сэндвич с сыром. Как же я буду его вкусно есть. А? Что? Новое сообщение? «Дорогой Джим. Сэнди была дурой, что не захотела с тобой встречаться». А я ведь говорил! Говорил!
Мне удалось доставить сэндвич с сыром Санитару Джиму, который уж слишком наслаждается своей перепиской с будущим собой. Может, следовало сказать, что это будущий он?
Помочь Санитару Джиму не потерять сознание от голода.
Мне бы хотелось сэндвич с сыром.

Ну что? Я уже чувствую этот вкус... А мой друг по переписке говорит, что у меня идеальный вкус в еде, кстати. И я ему верю!

Я... Кажется... Теряю... соз... О, ещё письмо. «Дорогой Джим, приятного аппетита». ОТКУДА ОН ЗНАЕТ?!

Ух, надеюсь, ты рядом, а то я уже… Что-что? «Дорогой Джим, ты – мессия. Остальные тебя не понимают, но только потому что они глупые и не умеют смотреть за горизонд.» Хм… это же я обычно пишу «Горизонд». Видимо, я не один такой!

Хорошо. Я… я больше не уверена в успехе нашей маленькой операции. Но отчаиваться рано!.. Да… Поговори с Шерри Бёрд.

Джим? Джим. Джим! Этот Джим мне весь режим сна испортил, когда практиковался в пении всю ночь! А поёт он, знаешь ли, отвратительно. Как будто кто-то включил петуха на обратную перемотку! Ни за что. Я его видеть не хочу!

Hooray! You got them all. Will you please bring them back here now?
Ладно...Ладно-ладно. Думаем. Номер 255 сразу выпадает. Она слишком СКАМПЕРом занята. О, Номер 1455! Ей Джим даже когда-то нравился. Это обязано сработать. Если это не сработает – я сойду с ума!
Джим?! Джим меня бросил. Я ему с семи лет валентинки отправляла, а он мне недавно выдал: «Ой, я достоин большего». Слизь Псевдо-Отродья он достоин. Нахал.
Поговорить с Номер 901
Я… Я не буду даже объяснять. Мне надоело. Я отказываюсь. Мы оба знаем причину. Мы оба её понимаем. Зачем говорить вслух то, что мы и так знаем? Всё! Поговори с Номер 901.
Я… Я всё. Ладно. Попробуй поговорить с Номер 901.
Джим? Ха. Ха-ха-ха. Хахахахахаха. Хахахахахахаххахахахахахахаахахахахахаха!
Поговорить со Скаутом Мелиссой.
…Это конец. Операция была идеальной. Я… Как? Почему? Неужели он ВСЕМ успел нагадить? Что ж у меня за братишка такой?!
Ладно… Хорошо… Я уже ни на что не надеюсь, но давай поговорим со Скаутом Мелиссой.
А, да, привет? Да, Джим? Нет. Я… Я занята. У меня… Нано-проект. Я… Я потом… когда-нибудь… Ой, какая плитка красивая…
Bring all three bags of tangelos back to me, okay?
Спасибо за помощь. Я... буду думать.
Вернуться к Номеру 404.
Операция провалена полностью. Полностью! Вернись ко мне и я… ну… что-нибудь придумаю, наверное.
Я... эээ... мдямс... а... Вернись ко мне, пожалуйста.
Oh, Brother (Part 3 of 3)
Поговорить со Скаутом Рикки.

Мне пришёл ответ! Мне пришёл ответ!!! Ну как мне… Джиму пришёл. Девочка из Тупичка очень хочет с ним познакомиться. Она тоже обожает червоточины! Я сказала ей, чтобы она написала Джиму бумажное письмо,
Deliver the bags of tangelos to Billy.
Эта девочка в Тупичке. Это к Юго-Востоку от Сектора В. Ну... Вниз и направо, если на карту смотреть, короче. Ты справишься.
Мне удалось свети Санитара Джима со Скаутом Рикки. Джим даже обещал помыться. Счастье-радость!
Свести Санитара Джима и Скаута Рикки.
О, привет, тебя послал Джим? Он прикольный. Тоже червоточины любит. Я написала ему письмо со всеми его шутками, которые мне понравились. И посыпала письмо блёстками! Надеюсь, ему понравится!
Блёстки? Блёстки – это огонь. Я бы не устояла. И братишка мой не устоит. Мы же одной крови, как-никак. Передай ему письмо.
Оооо, блёстки. Это будет наш козырь. Все любят блёстки! Передай письмо моему братишке!

Что? Письмо от девочки? С чего бы МЕНЯ должно заботить письмо от…ч…ч…ч…что? Это… это блёстки? Ладно, я… это же… это же мои шутки! И шутки про червоточину! Какой почерк, какие милые розовые чернила! Я… Я влюблён! И она… Она хочет встретиться… А я не мылся давно. Надо помыться… и… форму поменять. Ты… спасибо, да. За помощь. Пока. Да.
Передать Письмо Санитару Джиму.
Вернуться к Номер 404.
Ура! Наконец-то мы смогли заставить моего братишку отвернуться от этой дыры! Вернись ко мне, я тебя награжу.
Oh, did you think these tangelos were for scaring the monsters? No, only clowns hate tangelos. I was just hungry. Anyway, here's some armor for you to put your body in.
Дыра: 0, манипуляции старшей сестры: 1. Хи-хи. Вернись ко мне, я тебя награжу.
Чувствуешь? Это любовь витает в воздухе... Ну или Цветик опять слишком надушилась. В общем, спасибо за помощь!
Me, Myself and I

Огромное тебе спасибо! Я буду слушать эти подкасты и отправлять то, что усвою, себе в прошлое! Меня все будут любить. Так... Что? «Подкаст 413 - Почему надо время от времени говорить «Приятного Аппетита»»? Я заинтригован.

Но вот только... Я не знаю правильные советы. Я уверен, что где-нибудь есть руководство о том, как правильно себя вести и достигать успеха. Можешь спросить у Эдди, продаёт ли он что-нибудь подобное?
Можешь поговорить с Эдди? У него какого только товара нет. Что-нибудь, да найдётся.
Помочь Санитару Джиму помочь себе же поднять самооценку.
Теперь у Санитара Джима есть коллекция подкастов «Я - Лучшая» Принцессы Дай-Денег. Надеюсь, это поднимет его самооценку.
You're a great tangelo wrangler.

Что-то для поднятия самооценки, значит? Ну был один товар. На самом деле, товара было много - но остался один... за ненадобностью. Набор подкастов Принцессы Дай-Денег «Я - Лучшая». Он годами без дела валялся. А потом его украли Ужасные Гидры. Я никого за ним не посылал - так как... зачем? Но если он тебе нужен - ты знаешь, где его искать.
Да! Это то, что нужно! Я хочу верить, что я лучший! И я... я БУДУ лучшим! И все будут меня любить. Ты можешь найти этих Гидр?
«Я - Лучшая». Ну... для парней же это тоже должно работать, да? Моя сестрёнка мне часто советы давала - и они работали. И это сработает. Оно должно! Но сначала найти этих Гидр.
Найти Ужасных Гидр.
Вот они. Постарайся не поцарапать диски, ладно?
Победить Ужасных Гидр.
Вот они! Диски... Ого... Как их много. Ты дотащишь? Как много у Принцессы есть, что сказать. Наверняка, там скрыто много мудрости...
Я в тебя верю!.. Я же правильно сказал? Я не слишком на тебя давлю? Потому что я не давлю. Ты справишься!.. Это же не слишком завышенные ожидания?.. Я... Я помолчу.
Вернуться к Санитару Джиму.
Быстрее возвращайся! Жду не дождусь узнать, что надо делать, чтобы меня любили... и рассказать об этом себе в прошлом.
Thanks for helping Billy…I think.
231 диск... Это будет долгое развлечение. Но оно того стоит!

You need to find those furious Spawns in Pokey Oaks and take 'em down.

Go give Eduardo his puppy. Big guy deserves a break. It's the kindest ones who got hurt the most here.

Go to the comic shop.
Return puppy to Eduardo.
Hey, I need some help. I sent Sherri Bird to collect a map of Pokey Oaks Junior High, but she never reported back. Can you find out what happened?

I love citrus fruits.

Some stupid creeps stole my favorite candy!! Go down to Candy Cove and talk to Licorice Lips in the Candy Pirate village. Maybe you can find the culprits.
Help Numbuh Five recover her Soopuh Sour Pops.
I've recovered both chocolate dubloons and Soopuh Sour Pops from mosnters. Ain't I a smart cookie?
Man, you're doing great. If all the kids I met were like you, Fuse would be shaking in his green, gooey boots! We gotta fix that time machine!
Licorice Lips wants you to find the Tread Heads that took his Chocolate Doubloons. Then maybe he'll help you find my Soopuh Sour Pops!
Candy Bandits?!? Why didn't I think of that? Now that Licorice Lips has his Chocolate Doubloons back, go after those raggedy Candy Bandits and get my Soopuh Sour Pops back!!
Licorice Lips wants you to find the Tread Heads that took his Chocolate Doubloons. Then maybe he'll help you find my Soopuh Sour Pops!
Find a video game that Coop forgot to return to the rental store.

Bring them Chocolate Doubloons you got from the Tread Heads back to Licorice Lips.
That was sweet, for sure! Bring my Soopuh Sour Pops back to me in Sector V, and I'll most definitely give you something cool in return.
If ye get me dubloons back, perhaps I can help ye find Numbuh Five's loot.
Numbuh Five 'tis not the only victim o' these scoundrels! Me very own Chocolate Dubloons was stolen by Tread Heads!
Deliver candy to Numbuh Five.
You're the best. I'm gonna enjoy these Soopuh Sour Pops. I'll give you some from my next stash...promise!!
Recycle Billy's boogers before they ferment.
In these trying times, it is important to stay environmentally conscious. That is why I have decided to recycle my boogers. Can you bring them to the salvage yard?
I brought Billy's boogers to the junk yard to be recycled.
Man, I liked how you ran really fasy back there! You took those boogers and you recycled them like crazy! Now the world will be a better place and at peace.
You need to get out to the junk yard as fast as you can in order to recycle my boogers. Hurry or they will ferment!
Go to junk yard before time runs out.

Come back here and I'll give you a reward and stuff!

Oh man, if I don't return "Ninja Space Patrol" to the game store, I'm going to pay a crazy fee. I think I left it inside Megas. Will you check for me?
It is a good day. Come back and see me for a prize.
That was an amazing display of running and recycling. You know, you should really think about recycling your boogers, too. Read the literature! Anyway, here's your reward.
Booger recycling. Okaaay.
Um, great work with those boogers.
Can I have some recycled boogers?
Billy is a funny guy.
I am very sad to tell you that the boogers you were going to recycle cannot be recycled. Bring them back to me so I can pick you some new ones.
Return to Billy.
Nooo! The boogers have fermented. Come back to me to get some fresh ones.
Okay, so this time? Go really, really fast and the boogers won't ferment.
I recovered a video game that Coop left inside Megas.

Deliver candy to Foster's.
I have decided that this graveyard candy is gross. You know who likes candy? Those guys at Foster's. If you bring this to them, I'll give you a surprise.
I brought some candy to the Foster's friends.
Did you bring that weirdo candy to Foster's? Those guys love candy! Thanks for the help. Stop by some time and we can watch TV together.
Take the graveyard candy to Foster's. They like them some candy, boy howdy!
Deliver the candy to Edd.
Wait a minute…what is Billy thinking?! Don't bring that candy to Foster's…bring it here. I'll put it somewhere safe. -Edd
You can't take this candy to Foster's -- it's dangerous! Take this box of jawbreakers instead. I'll hide the Crazy Brain Candy where no one will find it.
Bringing Foster's the candy! Bringing Foster's the candy!
Hey, you totally saved me from those nasty rental fees. Let me know if you ever want to get together and play some games!
Bring the candy to Eduardo.
Oh, that's muy nice of you to bring this candy. While you here, can you help with some mucho scary monsters? There's too many!  I promise to give you some candy after!
If you get to Foster's and they want you to do some things for them, then you should. Like defeating four Extremospawns or something.

Cool! You is rocking the casa!
Did you talk to Eduardo, yet? Go talk to him!
Talk to Eduardo.
Come back to me and I will be sharing the candy with you.
Okay, take this candy. Don't break your jaw!
Hey, what happened to my candy? Oh, right. Can you bring me some, please?
Please find that videogame so I don't get charged a late fee. I would do it myself, but I sprained my thumb in a bizarre console-related injury.
Deliver the jawbreaker to Billy.
Hey, you got a jawbreaker! I've got a surprise for you, so how about we trade?
Thanks for the jawbreaker. Ow! Here, you want this armor? Ow, my jaw! Ow! Ow. Ow! My jaw. Ow! I love candy. Ow.
Billy is an idiot.
Great job helping Foster's.
I hear voices.
Edd says you're awesome!
Kibbles 'n' Hits
Get some premium pet food for Billy's alien pet, Runty.
Have you met Runty? He's my new alien green pal. He's nice. I want to get him some new pet food, and the animals at Charles Darwin have the best.
Find video game inside Megas.
I got some pet food for Billy from Charles Darwin.
My slimy little friend named Runty was hungry! Thanks for making it through all that goo at Charles Darwin Middle Schoool to get him some chow.
You need to go to Habitat Homes to get some pet food for Runty. If you beat up the creepy animal monsters, I'll bet you'll find the best treats.
Head to Habitat Homes.
Sweet! Charles Darwin is really gooey inside, so you'll need to watch out.
You need to make your way through the infected school and defeat Fuse's minions to collect the pet food. Runty is hungry! Just the other night, he tried to eat my little toe.
Defeat the Cylomanders.
Great, but do you think that's enough? Runty has a mighty big appetite.
I think you need to defeat a few more monsters to collect some more pet food for Runty.
Defeat the Ramcycles.
Great, you found it! Can you bring it back to me?
Thanks! But I think you still need to collect a little more food. Just a little.
You need to defeat one last group of monsters to get some more pet food. Then you'e done…promise! Runty will be a happy little guy with all this yummy food.
Defeat the Motorillas
Cool, that should do it! Come back to me and I'll give you a treat, too.
You need to bring those bags of pet food to me. I wonder what I should give you in return? You like snot?
Return to Billy.
Hey, looks like you're done with Billy. Listen, I want you to take that map and bring it to one of our suppliers Downtown. I think he can help us find the next stash of Crazy Brain Candy! -Edd
Gee, thanks! Runty is going to love this high quality pet food. I hope he grows big and strong and learns to do tricks that don't involve eating my face.
Billy adopted an alien? Idiot.
You did a nice job for Billy.
Bring that game back to me, okay? I really, super-duper appreciate it.
I want a pet alien!
Billy is so, so silly.
Fun and Games, Part One
Go downtown and find Bloo at the amusement park.
I need you to meet with Bloo, one of our top suppliers downtown. Also, while you're there, see if you can figure out where the next stash of treasure is.
I found Bloo and he asked me to get some stolen supplies.
Thanks for getting Bloo's stolen supplies back from the ruffians in the amusement park! Eddy was glad to get those knickknacks delivered.
You are off to the past! Good luck, and send Dexter my regards. Remind him that he is only half the genius I am. Ha. Ha ha ha. Ha ha ha ha ha!
Meet Number Two inside.
Oh, hey. I have some supplies for Eddy. But some creeps stole them! I'd get them myself, but I threw out my shoulder defending this area from monsters. You get started and I'll be right there.
Help Numbuh Two repair a busted communications dish.
Return video game to Coop.

Recover Bloo's game from the auditorium.
My copy of "Super Mega Blasteroids 10" was stolen! I think those Streetcrushers took it to Marquee Row. Those jerks! Can you go get it? I have a cramp.
I recovered Bloo's copy of "Super Mega Blasteroids 10" but it was broken.
Thanks, you totally rock! Hey, do you know when "Ninja Space Patrol 2" comes out?
Well, that's just great! I went through all that trouble of getting my game back, and it's totally broken. Now what am I supposed to do? I'm bored!
You need to make your way to Marquee Row to see if you can find my game. The fate of the world is at stake!
Go to Marquee Row.
Hey, what's Bloo making you do down there? We need to find that candy treasure. Don't let him get you off track, okay? -Edd
Hi! Fuse's goo monsters are all over this place. So, like, watch out.
Defeat the Streetcrushers.
Oh, yeah! You did it. Bring me the game, okay?
You need to bring that copy of "Super Mega Blasteroids 10" back to me. Must…game…now…
Deliver videogame to Bloo.
Thanks! Heyyy…the disc is totally scratched. Now what am I supposed to do? Well, here's a reward for you. Thanks for nothing!
Hey, kid. Can you pick up my dry cleaning?
Bring the busted videogame back to the store at Townsville Center and exchange it before the sales receipt expires! We NEED to play right away, or this whole world will perish from boredom.
Bring game back to store.

Your gotta bring that new copy of "Super Mega Blasteroids 10" back to me. Hurry. Boredom…sinking…in…
Deliver new game to Bloo.
You're the best. Now the whole world can breathe a big sigh of relief. I am off to conquer this game. In the meantime, you can have these cool skate pants. I think you'll like them.
I hate video games.
Bloo plays too many games, I think.
I wanna play with Bloo!
Did you beat "Super Mega Blasteroids 9"?
I heard you helped Coop! Way to go.
Aw, man! The store is closed. Come back here and maybe we can call and convince them to stay open for a few more minutes.

Argggh! The store closed! Come back here so you can see me sulk.

You need to deliver some batteries to a Dexbot named Q-12 at City Station. I know you can do it.

Bring those rare comic books back to me, and I promise I'll give you a reward or something.

Recover the third stash of candy from the beach.
Fine, I'll take a look at your treasure map. It seems that you need to go to the big sand castle at the beach. I'm expecting my cut when you get back. Deal?
Investigate the giant hamburger in the trailer park.
I dug up the third stash of crazy brain candy.
Glad you made it through the giant sand castle in one piece. Now can I have some candy?
Go down to Bravo Beach and find the giant sand castle. It should look like a giant castle made of sand. With yucky green goo inside.
Go to Bravo Beach.

Great, Bloo is finally helping you with that disgusting candy. We need to make sure Fuse keeps his hands off it! You're doing super. I'll check in with you later, Eddy is yelling at me about something. -Edd
Okay, can you find the sand castle? Go for it, already.
Make your way through the infected area inside the sand caslte and find the stash of candy treasure. Remember that I will need some samples to make sure that it is okay for eating.
Find the buried candy treasure.
Aw, yeah! You found it. Bring it back to me.
Bring the stash of hidden candy back to me. I must conduct analysis immediately.
Hey, some kids told me they saw a giant hamburger near the Park-n-Flush trailer park. I'm busy here, but you should totally go check that out.
Return to Bloo with candy.
Nice work! Tell Bloo to put that candy in a safe place. We gotta protect it at all costs! -Edd
Thanks. Edd wants me to hide the candy? No prob. I know a really, really good hiding spot. Don't worry. Here, take this cool weapon as a reward.
Nice job at the beach, I guess.
You're really helping out!
I have sand in my shorts.
I love giant sand castles!
Bloo is Green
Collect some soda pop for Bloo's upset tummy.
Ugh…I ate that entire bag of candy you brought me. Can you get me a soda pop for my tummy? You'll find some at the top of the construction site. Burp.
Coop asked me to find a giant hamburger at the trailer park.
Bloo wanted some soda for his tummyache.
That candy you dug up at the sand castle was disgusting. Thanks for bringing me some soda. My brain is feeling a little better already.
Make your way to the construction site at Morbucks Towers. I know there's a stash of soda there. I definitely drank some -- burp -- before.
Go to construction site.
You're kidding. Bloo ate ALL of the crazy brain candy?!? This is not good at all. I have a bad feeling about this. -Edd
Hey -- burp -- it's me. Make your way up the infected part of the construction site.
Defeat Fuse's minions and collect the soda pop. You may need to do some -- burp -- butt kicking.
Defeat the Doomdozers.
Look out for Doomdozers. I hear they like soda, so they probably took it.
Great! Bring me that soda. Burp! Pladooey! Bing bang bip!
I can't get in touch with the KND jungle outpost. I think Fuse is tampering with my communications dish. I need someone to go out and check on it.
Thanks for checking out that hamburger in the trailer park. I'm still disappointed that it wasn't real, but I'm drowning my sorrows in a milkshake.
Come meet me with that soda -- burp -- pop. I'm feeling a little…weird. Wired. Word. Whammo. Whee!
Return to Bloo.
Uh-oh! It sounds like the crazy brain candy is having an effect. Be careful!
Hi there, porkchop breath! Slip, slam, boom on the toejam! WHY DID I EAT ALL THAT DUMB CANDY MY BRAIN IS ALL SCRAMBLED UP. Oh, I found another treasure map! And a reward.
I ATE ALL THAT STUPID CANDY AND NOW MY BRAIN IS SCRAMBLED HELP!
Defeat crazy brain Bloo.
Oh dear, you'd better get him to calm down, or we're all in trouble.
Whoah, what happened?!? I ate that entire bag of candy, then I got a weird feeling all over. Did you get my soda? Meet me back at the amusement park with it.
Meet me back at the amusement park with the soda. I need a moment to gather my senses. Come here, senses!
Bring soda to Bloo.
Go find the giant hamburger near the Park-n-Flush trailer park. Save me a piece!
Thanks. I feel better already. Look, I found this treasure map at the bottom of the bag of candy. You can have it. And take this paddle ball, too. Stupid thing's broken.
Crazy brain candy sure is crazy.
Good work helping Bloo's brain.
Soda gives me bubbly tummy!
I'm sorry you had to deal with Bloo!
Spy Games
Talk to Mojo Jojo about using his telescope.
Ugh, my tummy still hurts. Edd wants you to go talk to that monkey dude at the volcano. He said he'd send an email with the details. Want to help?
Edd asked me to talk to Mojo Jojo about using his telescope.
I see you took care of that errand for Edd. That's nice. Anyway, I'm bored. Tell me a story.
Touch the giant hamburger.
Edd wants you to talk to Mojo Jojo at his volcano HQ. I don't know why. My tummy hurts.
Talk to Mojo.
I think the Kankers are up to something. I want you to ask Mojo Jojo if we can use his telescope to spy on the Kankers. Get some photos and send them to me, okay? You rule! -Edd
What?!? You want to use my telescope? You may use my telescope, which I will allow, if you defeat some of the annoying monsters that are annoying me outside my house. They are outside.
The monkey is going to let you use his telescope, but only if you do his chores? Sounds like a lousy deal to me. You need to defeat eight Spawn Simians.
Defeat eight Spawn Simians.
You may use my telescope, but there is a condition. You must defeat the monsters outisde. An adequate number by my count, of course. The use of my telescope is conditional upon this request. -Mojo
Very good! If you want to use my telescope, you may use it now, but not later.
Mojo said you could use his telescope to do some spying. Hey, can you see if Eduardo is eating my chips back at the house?
Use Mojo's telescope.
Hey, what are you doing over there? Get away from our secret weapon!
Cool! Go use the telescope before he changes his mind!
Okay, you have used my telescope, per your request. Now get out of my sight!
Edd says that if you go to City Hall, there should be a terminal there that you can use to send the picture from the telescope.
Go to City Hall to send photo.
Cool! Did you take a picture?
Great! I got it. Listen, go talk to Bloo about your reward, okay?
I guess you can come back here in City Point and I'll give you something, okay?
Talk to Bloo.
Thanks for the photo. Those Kankers are definitely plotting something…wait a minute, is that a giant hamburger? Yum! Go talk to Bloo, he has a reward for you. -Edd
Did you get that job done for Edd? Sweet. What, he wanted me to give you a reward? What do I look like, a reward machine? Okay, here you go.
There are some creepy fright-night monsters haunting the graveyard. We've gotten reports that our old villain Him has been seen controlling the monsters. If that's true, we're really in trouble.
Spying is cool.
You did a good job spying on the Kankers.
I have a loose tooth!
What's Mojo Jojo like? Scary? Hairy?
Tree Treasure
Recover more Crazy Brain Candy from Galaxy Gardens.
That map I found leads to Galaxy Gardens. I'll let you collect the treasure, and I'll do the hard part of making sure it's all there when you bring it back.
I collected more Crazy Brain Candy from Galaxy Gardens.
You did some nice work at Galaxy Gardens. Thanks for bringing back that candy. You may have a future in the sweets acquisition industry.
Go to Galaxy Gardens and see if you can find the spot where the treasure is. I know I could do it.
Defeat the Treadnaughts.
Head to Galaxy Gardens.
Glad you're looking for that candy treasure. Don't let Bloo eat it this time! We'll need to figure out a safe way to trash it. -Edd
That's the place. There's all kinds of creepy critters in there.
You need to make your way through the infected gardens to find the hidden treasure. Let's see if your moves are as good as mine.
Find the candy treasure.
Oh, yeah! You did it. Anyway, bring that back over here, okay?
You gotta bring that candy back to me. I hope it's better than that last batch.
Deliver candy treasure to Bloo.
Remember, don't let that dumb Bloo eat the candy!
Yuck! This is the same candy from before that gave me that awful stomachache. Well, I certainly don't want this. What a waste of time…anyway, here's some armor that I think you will enjoy.
Hey, Fuse's creeps stole a piece of the burger! Go get it!
Ho-hum.
Good job at the arboretum.
You're like a candy magnet!
I don't want a crazy brain, ever!
Candy Crush
Bring the latest stash of Crazy Brain Candy to Dexlabs.
You know, this candy you found is just bad. I think you should take it to that kid named Dexter. He's smart and will probably know what to do with it.
I brought the crazy brain candy to Dexter at Dexlabs.
Did Dexter analyze that candy for you? Man, that kid is smart. He's, like, super smart. I'll bet he can even add and subtract and stuff.
There's a really smart kid named Dexter who will know what's wrong with this candy. You'll find him at Dexlabs.
Hey, what are you doing over there? Get away from our secret weapon!
Deliver candy to Dexter.
Well, Bloo did something smart for a change: he sent you to Dexter. That kid is a genius! He'll know what to do with that crazy brain candy. I'll let him know you're coming. -Edd
Hello. Edd told me to expect you. This candy sounds like it possesses some very unusual properties. I will conduct an analysis right away. In the meantime, I have a mission for you.
Dexter wants you to take care of Fuse's monsters in Tech Square before they can start causing real problems. Better you than me.
Defeat six Sky Drones.
Fuse's minions are amassing around Tech Square. This is very concerning. You should go out there and reduce their numbers before they can cause any serious trouble.
Great work. Come back to Dexlabs. I found something that will be of interest.
Go back to Dexlabs so Dexter can tell you what he discovered about the candy. Save me some!!
Talk to Dexter.
Without question, that candy you found has some curious magical properties that will require further study. I also found a map in the bag. I gave it to Computress. You can pick it up from her.
Good job finding the burger. Bring me a piece -- I need to know it's not for real.
I guess you should go see Dexter's assistant, Computress. She has a map for you.
Talk to Computress.
Greetings. You are here for this map, correct? It appears to indicate that there is something to be found at the space port.
Hey, can I see that map? Please? Pretty please? Bring it over.
Deliver map to Bloo.
Another map? I wanna see. Can you come back here and show it to me?
Map? Nah, not interested. But I have something else I need help with. You want these cool futuristic robot wings? They match your other armor.
You're not as smart as Dexter. Sorry.
Excellent work in Tech Square!
I don't wanna fall down the steps.
Return piece of burger to Coop.
You are an amazing hero!
Fusion Cuisine
Get sandwich ingredients for Bloo.
Hey, I heard about some gourmet food in a place called Nowhere! If you go and get me some, I'll make you a sandwich.
Bloo wanted some exotic ingredients for a sandwich. I brought him some eggplant and chicken from the monsters in Nowhere.
Thank you for getting the eggplant and the chicken. Now I have a bigger problem: do I make eggplant parmigiana or chicken parmigiana? Oh, the choices!
Okay, so you have to go to Nowhere for some very exotic ingredients! Hurrry, because I'm hungry!
Go to Nowhere.
You've got to cease doing this ridiculous stuff for Bloo. As soon as he gets his food, you need to go to the space port to show Ben that map! -Edd
Your first task is to find the delicious eggplantia mutanto.
I helped Numbuh Two repair a busted communications dish.
Are you sure it's not real? Bring a piece over here so I can give it a peek.
Defeat the Aubergine Masters in Nowhere to get me some delicious eggplant!
Defeat the Aubergine Masters.
Yum! I think you got enough eggplant.
Now defeat the Fowl Foes in Nowhere to get some yummy, yummy chicken!
Defeat the Fowl Foes.
Now bring all that deliciousness back to me.
Now that you have all the delicious ingredients, please bring them to me at Dizzy World.
Bring stuff to Bloo.
Wow, I can't wait to make a sandwich. Now where did I put the cheese? Oh, here's a reward or whatever.
You'll need to get through the infected area quickly to collect another chair.
Yep, it's fake, all right. And it tastes terrible! I wonder what those Kanker girls are doing with a giant fake burger? Oh, well. Take this for your trouble, 'kay?
Find another chair for Bloo.
That's more like it. Can you bring it over to me?
Got another chair? Good. I hope I like this one better.
Deliver second chair to Bloo.
Okay, that's better. Now that I can be more comfortable, I should be able to focus on my work. The world thanks you. Here, take this as a gift.
You got a sandwich. Wow.
Please stop helping Bloo with silly stuff.
Stop staring at me!
You're so nice to Bloo!
You're taking too long, and my butt hurts really bad. I mean, this is a significant amount of physical pain I am talking about.
Fake burgers, huh? They come with fake calories?
Start over and try again.
You have run out of time, and I have run out of patience. Go try again.
You have one more chance. My butt is too important to give up now.
Once again, you disappoint me. I'll give you another try, but I won't be happy about doing it.
Start over
Sheesh, you're really not very good at this, are you? Start over.
Try again. My posterior is couting on you.
Spaced Out
Recover the hidden candy loot at the space port.
Hey, so Edd wants you talk to some kid named Ben down in Offworld Plaza about that map you found. Sounds boring.
What are the Kankers are doing with a fake burger?

How did you do at the space port? Edd says you need to look for a dog named Courage in Nowhere. Anyway, can I have a dollar?
Edd wants you to go find Ben at the spaceport in Offworld Plaza and ask him about the treasure map. I will be here resting for the next big battle.
Find Ben at space port.
Great, go down to the space port and talk to Ben. He's really cool and will know what to do about that map. Uh-oh, I think I hear Marie. Gotta go! -Edd
Yeah, I can see exactly where this map leads. It's totally in the worst, most infected part of the space port, though. You'll need to be really careful.
You need to go find the stash of crazy brain candy that's hidden in the spaceport. I promise I won't eat any this time.
Find the next candy treasure.
Hmmm…whatever you're looking for, it's gone! I'll bet the Thuggards took it.
If you want to get the loot back, you'll need to find the monsters that took it. I suppose that's obvious.
Hey, you want fries with that?
Defeat five Thuggards.
Nice work! I really like those moves.

Bring new map to Ben.
Where's the candy? Uh-oh, this isn't good. Better go show that map to Ben.

Find Courage in Nowhere.
Courage? I know that little canine. I wonder what kind of help he can offer.
Aroo! You're looking for buried magic candy? Well, I'll look at this map and ask my computer about it. Your pal Bloo sent you something. It's a Cannon of D-d-doom!
You ate a giant hamburger? Was it yummy?

Prove your worth to Mojo.
Yes indeed, Mojo Jojo is looking for kids who are willing to join the fight against Fuse. If you can prove your worthiness, you will be rewarded. How about it?
I made it through the infected zone in Pokey Oaks and showed Mojo Jojo what I'm really made of.
Mojo Jojo appreciated that impressive display of your skills. You made it to Pokey Oaks and back in record time. Not bad…for a kid.

Go to Pokey Oaks infected zone.

Good, you found Jibba Jabba. And he has found you. I have asked him to task you with a most dangerous mission. If you can accomplish this mission, then I will know that you are someone I can rely upon to do other things that I ask of you in the future. -Mojo
You will need to touch a beacon in the school and return to me in time.
You need to reach the beacon inside the Pokey Oaks infected zone as fast as you can.
Hangin' with the Coopster (Part 3 of 3)
Reach the beacon within time limit.
Yesss! Now go back to Jibba Jabba in Hero Square. Move those human feet!
Get back to me before time runs out. I want to see some speed. Return to me at Hero Square in Sector V.
Return to Jibba Jabba.

You're a real tough kid, aren't you?
Good job in Pokey Oaks.
Father is weird looking.
Father gives me the creeps!
You're not moving fast enough. You'll need to go back to Pokey Oaks Junior High to try again.
Find Coop's queso! He's hungry.
Return to start point.

Let's see if you can do better this time. Get moving.
First Matey

Father says that he knows someone called Stickybeard the pirate, who has a very valuable map of the area. Go see him in the pirate village and get the map.
I went on board the Sweet Revenge and collected a map.
You really went the extra mile by going inside the Sweet Revenge to get that map. Mojo Jojo may think about recognizing you for your efforts.

Talk to Stickybeard.
You hungry? I just nuked some queso that's in dire need of some dipping. Go get it from my secret hiding spot and we'll have ourselves a snack.
Father wants me map of the suburbs? Sadly, the map has been stolen by Fuse. If ye can recover it from me ship, the Sweet Revenge, ye can have it. Be warned: I don't trust that Father fellow.
You need to make your way through the infected area on the Sweet Revenge to get Stickybeard's map back.
Collect the map.
Good. Bring that map to me at once!
Now that you have the map, bring it to Father.
Deliver map to Father.

A pirate's life for you, huh?
Nice job on the Sweet Revenge!
Ahoy!
I recovered Coop's queso!
Can you ask the pirates for some candy?
Me and Him
Do a favor for Him and Mojo Jojo.
According to Stickybeard's map, the monsters in Pokey Oaks North are dangerous. Very dangerous! Do you think you can go there and do a favor for Mojo Jojo?
I defeated the monsters in Pokey Oaks North and recovered Him's moisturizer.
You did exceptional work in Pokey Oaks. Just wait until you see the cemetery! You may want to adopt a permanent position out there. I could help you.
According to Stickybeard's map, Pokey Oaks North is quite dangerous. Mojo Jojo wants you to go there to do a favor for his friend, Him.
Go to Pokey Oaks North.

Him is a weird and strange fellow, but though he is strange he is full of power. And power is what we need to defeat Fuse. Him lost something the last time he was in Pokey Oaks South. Be a good minion and get it for Him, why don't you? -Mojo
Hello there! Are you the one that Mojo found to help me?
Save Dee Dee's herb garden from destruction.
Way to go with that communications dish! We fixed it together. Man, I love teamwork.
Thanks for getting the queso back! I love melted cheese. Especially when it's in my tummy.
Mojo suggests talking to his old partner-in-crime, Him. He should be somewhere near the graveyard.
Talk to Him.
Don't be foolish, young one. The graveyard is much too dangerous for the likes of you. But do me a favor and I will consider helping you.
Mojo wants you to get Him's moisturizer back from the Mean Behemoths in Pokey Oaks North. Perhaps Him will join our cause as a result. Try not to get too hurt, I suppose. Heh.
Defeat the Mean Behemoths.
Get my moisturizer back from those troublesome Neighborhood Ninjas.
That will teach Fuse a lesson. He is a detriment to my villainous enterprises.
Bring moisturizer to Father.
Take this reward. I wonder if Mojo is trying to get his old team, the Beat-Alls, back together?
Get my moisturizer back from those troublesome Mean Behemoths.
Hey, kid, find the queso delicoso! It should be in my secret spot inside the infected zone.
Thanks for returning that stolen gear to the KND.
I don't like Fuse. I hate him!
You're so nice to the KND!
Under Development
Recover Father's blueprints.
I am developing the Peach Creek Estates area, but Newspaper Ninjas have stolen valuable blueprints. Recover them from that smelly trailer park over in Peach Creek Commons.
I recovered blueprints for Father and some stolen KND tech.
Thank you for collecting those blueprints. The Peach Creek Estates development project can now continue unabated.

The construction on my Peach Creek housing development has been stalled due to Fuse's infestation. If you can locate the Newspaper Ninjas sneaking around the trailer park and recover the stolen blueprints, you will help make this area a better place for everyone. Especially me.
Go to Peach Creek Commons.
Find Coop's queso.
Newspaper Ninjas stole the blueprints. Careful, they are dangerous in numbers.

Bring blueprints to Numbuh Two.
Go to City Station and deliver the delivery to my minion, Ramma Jamma!

What are you doing out there? I need those blueprints.
You're ready to continue your adventures Downtown. Take the radioactive isotope that you recovered from the Nuclear Plant and bring it to our operative stationed at Dizzy World, Numbuh 311.
Heyyy…who moved my cheese? I'll best some of Fuse's monsters stole it.
Bring isotope to Numbuh 311.
Did you find those blueprints, yet? Well, bring them over here.
Bring the blueprints to me for your reward. Don't delay, now!
Bring blueprints to Father.
You survived! How…surprising. Well, thank you for the blueprints. I want you to take this armor as a reward.
Gun Run
Recover a power cell for a new weapon.
Mojo Jojo sent me a weapon to give you. But it needs a power cell. If you can go to Genius Grove and recover one, you can have the weapon.
I went to Genius Grove and got a power cell.
Good work in Genius Grove. I hope you will use that Anubis Rifle with care.
Oh, man! Those aliens stole my cheese! You need to head back out of the infected zone to find the queso thieves.
The power cell you need to get is located inside the Genius Grove infected zone, which is a very dangerous zone according to the map. Can you handle it?
Go to Genius Grove infected zone.
Is Father asking you to do not stupid things, or are they all stupid things? You need to do not stupid things so we can defeat Fuse and get back to more important things, not stupid things! -Mojo

You need to find the power cell inside the infected area behind Mandark's house.

Bring the Anubis power cell back to me, and I will furnish you with your reward.

Nice run from Genius Grove!
Woof! Woof! I'm a dog!

Poster Imposter
Check recruitment posters in Sector V for Father.
Mojo is working with someone named Father. He has recruitment signs up near the KND tree house. You need to make sure that they don't come down.
Jibba Jabba asked me to help Father, but Numbuh Two turned the tables on him.
Thank you for reinforcing those posters for Father. Mojo Jojo is very pleased with your performance so far. Together, we will all rule the world!

Father and Mojo Jojo are trying to recruit more kids like you. We need to put our differences aside and get rid of this Fuse character, don't you think? Go around Sector V and reinforce Father's recruitment posters near the tree house.
Okay, the queso is around here somewhere. Start busting heads.
Add tape to first sign.

Reinforce second poster.

Oh, man! Those aliens stole my cheese!  Defeat the Junkasaurus Wrecks to collect the stolen cheese! I know you can do it.

I hope you're on your way back, or someone is going to bed without supper.

Defeat the Junkasaurus Wrecks.

My patience has run out. Come back to Hero Square and speak to me as soon as you are finished with those posters! Don't make Mojo mad!

Since Mojo Jojo and Father seem to trust you, I want you to keep working for them while sending me updates.
Come back to Hero Square and speak with me right away.
Talk to Jibba Jabba.
Hurry up! Come see me!
Thank you for fixing those signs. Working for Mojo and Father is very dangerous! That's why you need this special Morbucks armor.
I'm tired of hearing about you.
Good job helping the KND.
Hey, nice moves. Is the cheese still warm, or is it all crusty and stuff?
My nose itches on the inside.
Don't let Father fool you!
What is taking you so long? I am beginning to lose patience.

No, no. You're not moving fast enough. Get back here and try again.
Oops! You need to start over and fix all of those signs again.

Very good. But I think the Junkasauruses have some more.

There's still more candy to find. Fuse's monsters will wish they stayed home today. Defeat the Junkasauruses to get the last bag of candy.
