Good work. Please bring that candy back to me right away.
Deliver candy to Eduardo.
Well done. That's enough. Bring it back to me right away.
Oh, muchas gracias! I missed this candy so much. It is wonderful to be reunited once again. You are a muy, muy special kid.
Didn't you hear me? I don't like to have to say everything twice. Get back here with that candy!
Talk to Father.
You WHAT?!? You ate all the candy?!? Children simply cannot be trusted to do an adult's job. Well, I hope you have a stomachache now. I'll give you this reward, but I won't be happy about it.
You're my hero! Let's celebrate with some uber delicious chips and cheese. Then we can get back to fighting the enemy and stuff.
Good work. I don't know what you'll tell Father, but I'm sure you can think of something.
I like your style. Not.
Good trick on Father!
Can I have some candy when you're done with it?
You keep getting better and better!
Chemical Xcursion
Go to the nuclear plant to collect irradiated Chemical X.
Mojo has asked me to send you on a special mission. It will be dangerous. Very dangerous. You may not survive. Interested?
I recovered some special Chemical X for Mojo.
Congratulations on making it through the nuclear plant unscathed. Was Mojo pleased that you recovered the irradiated Chemical X?
Wow, you saved the cheese. What's next? Pie?
Mojo would like you to go out to the nuclear power plant. You need to get a sample of some irradiated Chemical X and bring it back to me.
Go to the nuclear plant.

Father is starting to make me irate! When things annoy me, I get irate, and this is what Father is doing. I need some things done for me...Mojo Jojo! Once these things are done, it will soon be time to be done with Father, as well. -Me, Mojo
This is the nuclear plant. It is dark, dangerous and filled with radiation and goo.
The nuclear power plant has been taken over by a Fusion named Professor Plutonium. Make it through and you will find the irradiated Chemical X.
Find the special Chemical X.
I'm surprised you made it. Oh, well. Bring it back so I can send it to the monkey.
Please bring me the strange and irradiated Chemical X.
Return to Father.
Good work. Mojo will be pleased. We wouldn't want him to be unhappy, right? Maybe now he will stop bugging me. Here, take this BRA equipment for your trouble.
Coop told me you've got some smooth moves.
Nukes are great when they go boom.
Good work making it through the power plant.
Hey, can I have a cookie?
You're the bravest and the strongest!
Say Cheese
Place security equipment for Father.
Before you go to meet Mojo, I have one more thing I'd like you to do for me. I have some remote security equipment that needs to be set up.
I helped Numbuh Two steal Father's signal in the wilds.
Father wanted me to put a micro-camera in the wilds to use for surveillance. Numbuh Two gave me a SPLITTR so he could piggyback on the signal.
Many of Fuse's monsters seem to be invading from the wilderness. Talk to Toiletnator at Camp Kidney.
I like my chips con queso caliente, por favor!
Talk to Toiletnator.
This is the last stupid task you do for Father. And by last, I mean final! When you are done, there will be one more mission for you, and then you will come to see me. Me…Mojo Jojo! -Mojo
What? Father wants me to help with something? Oh, goody! I'm ready. So ready! If you want to set up security equipment, you're going to need to take out some of those Lazy Metal Boy Scouts, first.
Before you can set up a security micro-camera so we can keep watch on the area, you will need to defeat the Lazy Metal Boy Scouts nearby.
Defeat four Lazy Metal Boy Scouts.
Wow! Hey, come back here so I can give you the equipment from Father.
Go and talk to Toiletnator to get the surveillance equipment. I guess he's good for something.
Talk to Toiletnator.
Okay, check out these bad boys. I've got a micro-camera and a transmitter that you can set up over there, so we can keep an eye on Fuse's flunkies.
Make sure you place the micro-camera in a strategic spot.
I'm glad you filled Coop's tummy!
Place micro-camera.
Good work. Now Father wants you to find a place for the transmitter.
Before the security camera can come online, you will need to set up the transmitter.
Deliver security transmitter.
Hey, are you still working for Father? Bring that gear to the tree house.
So Father wants to set up a camera and transmitter, huh? Well, we can see what he sees with this SPLITTR. The Signal Produced Locally Is Totally Taken Remotely! Aren't I a smarty?
You need to set up that transmitter. Let's go!
Place the modded transmitter.
By the way, what do you think Mojo wants with irradiated Chemical X? I think you need to keep working with him to figure out what's up. You're braver than me!
Good, did you place the transmitter? Splendid. Come back here, okay?
Marie's Schemes (Part 2 of 2)
You will need to talk to Toiletnator before you come and see me for your reward.
Talk to Toiletnator.
You did so good! Father will be so proud. Make sure you tell him that I helped, okay? I can be really sneaky when I want to, you know. I'm silent but deadly!
You're done at Camp Kidney. Come back and see me right away!
Talk to Father.
Have you completed my work? It's about time. Come back and see me.
Thank you for your help. If there were more kids like you…well, nevermind. Here, take the rest of this BRA outfit. Mojo said he has one more task for you before you leave for the city.
You are a crafty kid.
I like what you did in the wilds for the KND.
I want to be on TV!
Help Marie so she can listen in on the Eds.
You are like a sneaky spy!
Monkey Business
Collect monkey DNA from Charles Darwin.
Mojo wants you to go out to Habitat Homes. Fuse has done a lot of damage out there. I wonder if Mojo knows what he's getting you into?
I collected some monkey DNA from Habitat Homes and brought it to one of Mojo's minions downtown.
I never thought you would make it this far. You are a testament to the stubborn and frustrating tenacity of children.
Mojo needs some monkey DNA from Habitat Homes. Not only is that place a festering cesspool of kid activity, it has also been terribly infected by Fuse.
Head out to Habitat Homes.

Listen and hear me out! I need Motorilla DNA and I need it from Charles Darwin Middle School. Get it and bring it to one of my minions, Ramma Jamma. He is my minion and he works for me downtown. I will now sign my name. -Mojo
That's the place. Well, it's been fun working with you. Try not to get pummeled.
Hey! I have a listening device that I want to use to spy on the Eds. You'll have to place the receiver and the transmitter. It could be dangerous. Want to help?
You will need to defeat the Motorillas in Habitat Homes to collect their DNA for Mojo.
Defeat Fuse's Motorillas.
You have accomplished your mission and completed it.
Well, it's been fun working with you. Now you need to head downtown and find Mojo's minion, Ramma Jamma. He's at City Station.
Talk to Ramma Jamma.
Mojo Jojo will be very pleased to have this irradiated Chemical X and Motorilla DNA. By the way, your friend Toiletnator sent something for you.
A Boy Named Sue
Recover Mandark's stolen lab specimens from Dizzy World.
Master Mojo wants you to contact Mandark. He wants to find humans who will join with us after we beat Fuse. You can find Mandroid M-99 here in City Station.
I recovered Mandark's stolen lab specimens.
Find the communications dish.
I placed a spy receiver and transmitter for Marie Kanker.
Mojo Jojo is most pleased with the work you did for him. Mandroid M-99 would like you to do a favor as well. Go see him!

A boy named Mandark is working on experiments with Fusion Matter. His knowledge, together with Master Mojo's genius, will overthrow Fuse and bring the world to its knees. One of Mandark's robots is nearby. Mandroid M-99. He is expecting you.
Talk to Mandroid M-99.
Acknowledge. Mandark is conducting experiments with Fusion Matter. These experiments are far superior to Dexter's. Fuse's underlings stole our specimens. Engage!
Mandark wants you to go to City Point to recover his stolen lab specimens. Do it!
Go to City Point.
Mandark's orders: proceed to City Point. Be advised: the area is overrun with Fuse's creatures. Succeed and Mandark will consider Mojo's proposal.
The monsters you are looking for are somewhere in the vicinity.
If you defeat Fuse's minions, you can collect Mandark's stolen lab specimens. Then Mojo Jojo can enlist Mandark's knowledge for my own purposes.
Defeat the Fire Hydras.
That's gross! The receiver and transmitter are working, but it sounds like a butt symphony coming over the speakers. You guys are disgusting.
Ha ha ha! You did it. Most excellent. Return those specimens to my Mandroid.
Good work collecting those specimens for Mandark. Deliver them to Mandroid M-99 in City Station.
Deliver specimens to M-99.
Good work, human. The great Mandark bestows this helmet upon you.
You're not exactly a genius.
Those were some smooth moves at the park!
You and me could be a super team!
That Mandark is a sinister fellow.
Not-So-Secret Admirer
Deliver a love letter to Dee Dee from Mandark.
Set up the listening device's recevier near the Castle-de-Sac. Careful, there might be monsters around.
Every great mind has its muse, and Mandark's is called Dee Dee. Mandark orders you to deliver this note to her before time expires. Proceed!
I brought Mandark's love note to Dee Dee in record time.
You successfully delivered love note to the human called Dee Dee. Mandark's inquiry: "Did she ask about me?"
Were it not for Dee Dee, Mandark would not have the drive or sense of conviction to do all the things he does. Humans are weak! Deliver this note before Dee Dee checks her mailbox.
Deliver love note to Dee Dee's house.
What is this?!? Love notes and kissy face? No! This is not a good use of our energy at all. Tell Mandark that Mojo has no use for lovey-dovey! -Mojo
Now that you have completed that task, return to this unit for a reward. Ha. Ha. Ha. Ha. Ha.
Talk to Mandroid M-99.
Mission successful. Yes, you can be Mandark's minion.
Love letters are sooo boring.
Place the receiver.
Mandark is not as smart as he thinks.
Love letters make me gooey inside.
You're a messenger of love!
Error. Time has expired. Dee Dee will see you. Return to this unit.
Return to Mandroid M-99.
You're taking too long! Abort! Go back to Mandroid M-99.
Never send a human to do the work of a robot. Coast is clear. Proceed.
Invention Protection, Part One
Prevent monsters from attacking the Great Machine.
Mandark's greatest invention, the Great Machine, is being threatened by Fuse's monsters. Attack must be prevented to preserve this work of genius.
Watch out! Hydro Hammers are guarding the area. You'll need to defeat them.
I prevented Fuse from attacking the Great Machine.
Mandark could not have done it better himself. Thank you for protecting the Great Machine. But there is more work to be done.
Warning: Fuse's monsters are gathering in City Hall in preparation to strike. Diminish their numbers and make them bow to Mandark's genius.
Go to City Hall.
Target: Heavy Hunters. Initiate butt-kicking.
Reduce the ranks of Heavy Hunters in this area. Do it for the good of the planet, and also for Mandark Industries.
Defeat nine Heavy Hunters.
Warning: Heavy Hunters are not working alone.
Good work with the Heavy Hunters. I have detected Asphalt Freaks in the park that must suffer a similar fate.
Defeat the Asphalt Freaks.
You need to take out those Hydro Hammers so they don't tamper with my stuff.
Those jerks were taking orders from the Asphalt Freaks at the Fissure.
I'm detecting a signal from deep in the Fissure. I think you should investigate.
Make your way through the infected Fissure to take out Fuse's communication device. Go!
Destroy the communicator.
I think this signal is coordianting the enemy forces. Destroy it!
Thanks. The Great Machine is safe for now. Come back and see me.
Good work dispatching the Heavy Hunters. But we must attack their handlers as well. Return to this unit at City Station.
Return to Mandroid M-99.
Mandark offers praise for your success. Next task: find the orchestrators of this fiendish plot. Reward: flight pants. They are quite sporty.
Oops, nevermind. I thought you were someone cool.
Defeat four Hydro Hammers.
Nice job defending the Great Machine.
Who wants a piggyback ride?
You're a hero!
Wharf War
Recover some special Fusion Matter for Mandark and Mojo.
Mandark reports that Mojo Jojo is also working on creating a better Nano. Talk to Ramma Jamma to help us determine if we should coordinate efforts.
I collected Fusion Matter from Orchid Bay for Mandark.
Mandark will configure a special strain of Fusion Matter from samples collected at Orchid Bay. Warning: never tell Dexter about this or you will be incinerated.
Mojo might be able to help Mandark make a better Nano. Result: Mandark makes Dexter look stupider than he already is. Speak to Ramma Jamma.
Return to this unit and report on what you have learned from monkey called Ramma Jamma.
It's about time! Good job. Now you need to set up the transmitter, okay?
Proceed to Orchid Bay to collect the Fusion Matter samples. Then Mandark will decide if he wants to give them to Mojo.
Proceed through infected skate park at wharf to collect Fusion Matter samples.
Deliver Fusion Matter samples obtained in Orchid Bay to this unit for enhancement.
Bring enhanced Fusion Matter samples to Ramma Jamma immediately, and do not deliver them to anyone else.
Bring enhanced Fusion Matter samples to Ramma Jamma immediately, and do not deliver them to anyone else.
Return to this unit immediately to report to Mandark what you have learned, human.
Talk to Ramma Jamma.
Has Mandark sent you to Ramma Jamma? Very good! I am pleased that this has happened. Go to see him and he will tell you secrets that no one knows, because they are secret. -Mojo
This is the secret. Mojo is not working on a Nano, he is working on a new super monkey! Mandark has engineered a special kind of Fusion Matter that Mojo needs.
Talk to Mandroid M-99.
Now that the receiver is in place, you need to head over to Stickybeard's ship.
Remember, this secret must remain secret. So don't tell anyone, or it won't be secret.
Confirmed: Mandark has conducted Fusion Matter experiments to make the substance more stable. If Mojo wants more data, you must collect samples for him.
Go to Orchid Bay.
Acknowledge: the best Fusion Matter material comes from Orchid Bay. Obtain it and this unit will enhance it for Mojo.
The wharf is infected with Fusion Matter. You need to be cautious.
Find the Fusion Matter samples.
Wow, you got two samples at once! Return them to Mandroid M-99.
Deliver samples to M-99.
Fusion Matter has been injected with Mandark's stabilizer. Mandark orders you to take this to Ramma Jamma. Find out whatever you can about Mojo's Nano experiments.
Deliver the samples to Dexbot Q-12!
Go to Stickybeard's ship.
Hey, what are you doing there? Go see Dexbot Q-12 immediately!
Mandark's enhanced Fusion Matter obtained. Dexter reports that Mojo Jojo must be watched carefully. His experiments may be dangerous.
Deliver sample to Ramma Jamma.
Proceed to Ramma Jamma and deliver samples so that no one is the wiser. Dexter expects reports as necessary.
Master Mojo thanks you for the samples. Remember: monkeys are the secret!
Talk to Mandroid M-99.
Are you done? Go back to Mandroid M-99 as soon as you can.
Information required regarding Mojo Jojo's experiments. Later, we must show Dexter the power of Mandark's genius.
A better Nano? Get real.
You're doing a great job in Tech Square!
Just as I thought, that dish has been tampered with.
The best place for the transmitter will be on one of the ship's flags.
Can you make a silly face?
I like how you got through Orchid Bay.
Beach Boom
Recover more Fusion Matter for Mandark at the beach.
Ha. Ha. Ha. Ha. Mojo is a fool. Mandark provided enhanced Fusion Matter from Orchid Bay. However, the best Fusion Matter can be found at Bravo Beach. Ha.
I recovered more Fusion Matter for Mandark at the beach.
Excellent work collecting that Fusion Matter from the beach. If only Dexter could see us. Now please report to Mojo Jojo at his volcano headquarters.
Mandark requires only the best Fusion Matter for his lab. Obtain samples from the beach.
Go to Bravo Beach.

Greetings! I have no use for Mandark anymore, and so I am finished with him. He is too interested in his own genius, whereas he should be interested in MY genius! Come see me when you are done there. -Mojo
You need to navigate through the infected zone on Stickybeard's ship, then set up the transmitter.
The beach is filled with goo. Watch out.
Navigate the infected sand castle and defeat the monsters to obtain the samples that Mandark requires.
Defeat the Squish Scalers.
Good job. Hurry up and bring that stuff to Mandroid M-99!
Return to this unit with the Fusion Matter samples you have obtained at Bravo Beach.
Bring one of the samples to Dexbot Q-12.
Bring one of those samples to Dexbot Q-12 before you give them to Mandark.
Dexter will analyze this Fusion Matter to determine Mandark's objectives. He also suggests that you continue to investigate Mojo's activities.
Return to this unit with the Fusion Matter samples you have obtained at Bravo Beach.
Deliver beach sample to M-99.
Set up transmitter.
Please report. Samples are required.
Your assistance is no longer required. Please go away. Report to Mojo Jojo immediately at his volcano.
Are you Mojo's monkey now?
Good work sneaking stuff to Dexlabs.
I think it's time for a hoedown!
When will the zoo be back to normal?
Guilt Trip
Place a scanner for Mojo in Morbucks Towers.
I have grown to like you, so in a sense, I do not hate you. I have something personal to share, and a favor to ask. It is a personal favor. Can you be trusted?
I went to Morbucks Towers and placed equipment there for Mojo.
Perfect. I'm getting a good signal. Now we can listen to what the Eds are up to!
I am pleased that you delivered the scanner to Morbucks Towers, because now I, Mojo Jojo, can use the scanner that you delivered to Morbucks Towers.

It was not long ago that I fought the Powerpuff Girls recently. It was before Fuse arrived. Buttercup was knocked unconscious and fell into the ocean. I think she is still alive, and I have a scanner here that will help look for her.
Go to Morbucks Towers.
Okay, you are at the correct spot, not the wrong spot. Now place the scanner.

You need to find a good spot to place the scanner. If it is a bad spot, it will not work, so it needs to be a good spot. Otherwise, the scanner won't work. Enter the infected area of the construction site.
Place Mojo's scanner.
Good! The scanner is working!
You need to defeat four Arch Welders and prevent them from jamming the scanner's systems. Yesss!
Defeat four Arch Welders.
Wait, Arch Welders are jamming the scanner's receiver. Stop them!
I know you did a good job of hiding the receiver, right? The Eds will never find it.
Yesss! Now you must enter the infected zone to place the scanner.
With the scanner placed, you can now return to me, Mojo Jojo, for a reward.
Return to Mojo.
You did an excellent job! And not a bad job, either. I want you to have a cool Monkey helmet. You will look like a Space Monkey in it!
You are kinda cool, I suppose.
Are you sure you want to work for Mojo?
How come "wharf" doesn't rhyme with "barf"?
Underneath it all, Mojo has a good heart. I think.
Panicked Attack
Help Mojo determine if someone is spying on him.
Talk to Eddy.
I am beginning to suspect that someone is spying on me. You may call it paranoid, but I will not, because I believe it is true. And paranoia is not rooted in truth.
I went to ask the Mayor if he was spying on Mojo.
I am glad to learn that nobody is spying on me. However, if I were to learn that someone was spying on me, I would be outraged!

Go to the Mayor right away and ask him if he is spying on me. If he is, then I will send my minions to attack City Hall! If he is not…well, I might still send my minions to attack City Hall! For that is what minions do.
Talk to the Mayor.
Spying, you say? On Mojo, you say? I wouldn't know the first thing about it. But it sounds like a smashing idea! You should go talk to that bald fellow, Numbuh One.
What did the Mayor say? If he is spying, he will regret the day that he started spying! If he is not spying, then he better not think about starting to spy on me.
Talk to Numbuh One.
You want to spy on Mojo? I've got just the thing: an EAR! It Eavesdrops Automatically on Rivals. One of Numbuh Two's finest achievements, really.
My minions are standing at the ready. I eagerly await the Mayor's response. Until you return, I shall file my fingernails, for they are getting rather long and unsightly.
Hey, did you put this receiver down here? What's the big idea? Get over here!
Defeat five Doom Diggers.
To place the EAR, you'll have to defeat some of the monsters that are patrolling outside Mojo's HQ.
Good work! Now all you have to do is find a good spot to place the EAR.
Enough! I grow impatient and I am tired of waiting. Return to me and tell me what the Mayor told you to tell me.
Talk to Mojo.
Did you talk to the Mayor? I must know!
The Mayor is not spying on me? Well, that is a relief. I am relieved by the relief. I wonder why my simian sense is tingling, though? Anyway, please take these boots. You may wear them!
You're  a sneaky one, aren't you?
Nice work turning the tables on Mojo!
You're funny. Funny LOOKING!
Okay, wise guy. I've got an idea that'll really get the Kankers' socks in a knot. Take this cruddy receiver and place it in the Park-n-Flush toilets. That'll give them something to listen to. Ha, ha!
I want to give you a great big hug.
My fingernails look much better, now. I hope you are not dawdling, and coming back to see me at this very moment!
Place the EAR.
I'll send the coordinates to your NanoCom.
Sweet! You sure you don't want to join the KND? Great perks.
Arboretum Beat 'Em Up
Help Mojo fend off Fuse's monsters at Galaxy Gardens.
The monsters coming from Galaxy Gardens are ruining my concentration. A genius must concentrate! I need you to take care of this problem.
I helped Mojo take care of the monsters at Galaxy Gardens.
Thanks to your efforts, I am now able to concentrate on the important work in my lab, which is much more important than fighting stupid monsters.
Hey, wait a minute. The signal is cutting in and out. Are you sure you've got the transmitter secured?
I believe I am very close to perfecting a new Super Monkey! But I need to keep Fuse's monsters at bay. If you help me, Mojo Jojo, I will help you, Kid Whatever-Your-Name-Is.
Go to Galaxy Gardens.

Thanks to that EAR you placed, I've learned that Mojo is really trying to make a new kind of Super Monkey.I'm not sure if this is good or bad. I need you to get that irradiated Chemical X and the Motorilla DNA from his lab. -Dexter
Good. Now please go defeat the Horror Kings and tell them to leave me alone!
There are Horror Kings inside Galaxy Gardens that must be defeated. In order to do this, you must defeat them. NOW.
Defeat seven Horror Kings.
That was fantastic. I liked it very much when the monsters fell down! Yesss!
Thank you for your assistance. Return to my volcano and talk to me, and I will perhaps offer you a physical manifestation of my gratitude.
Return to Mojo.
All right, when you go back to Mojo's lab, get the materials I need.
Place receiver in Park-n-Flush toilets.
Are you tired from all the fighting? Fighting can be tiresome. I would like to offer you some cool liquid refreshment. You may get it over there. Go!
Get yourself a beverage, and whatever you do, do not snoop around in my things or take things that don't belong to you.
Grab materials for Dexter.
Now's your chance! Get the irradiated Chemical X and the Motorilla DNA.
Once your thirst has been quenched, I will give you a reward.
It has come to my attention that children take a very long time to drink liquid refreshment. I await your return impatiently.
Deliver material to Dexter quickly!
Very sneaky! Hurry, before Mojo realizes that you're gone. I'll be waiting.
Excellent work. With this material I should be able to reproduce whatever Mojo is working on. Who knows? It might actually help us in our war with Fuse. Nicely done.
That is it! The threshold of my tolerance has been reached. Return to me immediately, or risk losing your reward.
Go fight Fuse's monsters and recover the circuitboard for my communications dish.
It says that the equipment is set up properly. Ewww, what's that noise?
Return to Mojo's lair.
Where have you gone? I ask because I do not know where you are.
I hope you are sufficiently rested, because I have another mission for you that is similar to the last mission you completed. You will once again help me -- Mojo Jojo! And take this reward.
You played both sides. Niiice.
Good work at Galaxy Gardens.
I like chocolate milk!
Can you introduce me to Dexter?
Hey, are you messing around with things that don't belong to you? Those things belong to me, Mojo Jojo!
Return to Mojo's Volcano.
Rats, Mojo realized you were gone. Better go back and try again.
Return to Eddy.
Okay, he sees you. Now bring those materials to me, fast!
Tech Squares
Help Mojo fend off Fuse's monsters at Tech Square.
Once again, my concentration is threatened by Fuse's fools! This time, they are at Tech Square. I cannot tolerate this, so you will help me -- Mojo Jojo!
I helped Mojo take care of the monsters at Tech Square.
Thank you for stopping the monsters at Tech Square. I can now get back to my work. So please leave me alone, and go away!

Still, my super Monkey experiments are thwarted by the interference of Fuse and his freakish flunkies! If you can prove your worth, you shall be rewarded, as I am more willing to reward those of worth.
Go to Tech Square.
You're no genius. I saw you bring that stuff to Dexter. What did you take from Mojo's lab? Bring it to me, or I'll tell Mojo. Ha! Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha! -Mandark
Yesss! This is where those annoying monsters conduct their annoyances.
Oh, no! That's not the Eds! That's…gross!
The monsters in Tech Square must face a similar fate to that of the monsters in Galaxy Gardens. And you must administer that fate.
Defeat ten Cyberuses.
I want you to take care of as many creatures as you can. Do it!
Good! You may one day prove to be a dangerous adversary for someone.
Mojo Jojo congratulates you on a job well done. I will also offer my congratulations in person, when you return to my volcano headquarters.
Talk to Mojo.
Don't forget…when you get back to Mojo's lab, steal those supplies! Ha!
Do you require some more liquid refreshment? I am sure  you are hot and sweaty after all that fighting, and I don't like to be around hot and sweaty children.
Again, I advise you to keep your human paws to yourself while you collect the beverage that I so generously just offered to you a moment ago.
Grab the stuff for Mandark.
What a gas! We really pulled a fast one on those Kankers. Here, take this. It may help you when you're fighting aliens and stuff.
Quick! Get the goods while Mojo is not paying attention.
Hello? If you return to my side, a reward will be yours to have and mine to give.
It is a good thing that I have carefully hidden the Motor Gorilla DNA and the radioactive Chemical X from the prying eyes of children.
Deliver lab materials to Mandark.
You are devilishly clever. Get over here before Mojo comes looking for you!
Radioactive Chemical X and monster DNA? This doesn't sound like a Nano experiment at all. Curse that Mojo Jojo! And curse Dexter as well, just on principle.
It is time to come and see me for your reward. Me -- Mojo Jojo! Yesss!
Talk to Mojo.
Don't you want your reward? Your disappearance implies that you do not.
I am grateful for your assistance, and so I will show my gratitude by bestowing upon you this gift. My Super Monkey experiment is nearly complete. Fuse must beware the wrath of Mojo Jojo!
You are a sneaky kid, and that's a compliment.
You did okay at Tech Square, I guess.
You are an extemely resourceful kid.
The gardens are lovely in spring.
You're a friend to Dexter and Mojo and Mandark!
Keep your human paws off my belongings and get back here! I will now ask a question. What do you think you are doing?
Return to Mojo's Volcano.
You fool! The monkey realized you were gone. Better get back there.
Okay, he sees you now. Bring those lab materials to me immediately!
Princess Pal
Talk to Princess about equipment for Mojo's monkey troops.
I heard you helped play a trick on the Kankers!
Once my new Super Monkeys are ready, I will want to outfit them with the best equipment, not the worst. Please go ask Princess for some advice.
I collected a jetpack from the space port for Mojo.
That Princess Morbucks knows a thing or two about advanced equipment. Good work obtaining that jetpack from the space port for me, Mojo Jojo!
There is a young villainess named Princess who has the most villainous technology, at times, even more villainous than the technology of Mojo Jojo! You should speak with her.
Talk to Princess.

Urgent! I've looked at what Mojo is trying to do with the Motorilla DNA, and it could be disastrous! He might end up making the most dangerous Fusion monster ever. We can't let him do it. And you can tell him I said so! -Dexter
You need some gear? Oh, my daddy makes the best technology. The jetpack he manufactured for the space port is the top-of-the-line. I even read it in a magazine.
If Princess suggests collecting equipment from the space port, then you should collect the equipment from the space port, per her suggestion.
Go to the space port.
By the way, tell Mojo that if he wants to get the group back together, I'll be waiting.
CAN YOU HEAR ME IN ALL-CAPS?
If you go in there, you'll probably find the jetpack. Watch out for Fuse's meanies!
The space port is infected with Fuse's infection. You must avoid the infection and recover the jetpack that she recommends for my beloved space monkey minions.
Collect the jetpack.
Oh ho! A fine selection, indeed! Bring it to me, Mojo Jojo, and do not delay.
Now that you have the jetpack in your possession, please bring it here so it can be placed in my possession instead of in your possession.

Come back and speak to me about Megas. I want to know if there is any hope of freeing him.
Talk to Samurai Jack.

Megas is totally overrated.
Thanks for all your help.
I want to be inside a giant robot!
Robots are cool!

Help Jack fight Fuse in the junk yard.

I helped Samurai Jack defeat Motor Raptors in Goat's junk yard.
Thanks to you, we recovered an Atomizer from Fuse's soldiers. Had he gotten his hands on that, the results could have been disastrous.
I want you to find the Motor Raptors inside the infected junk yard. They are not unlike Aku's robotic servants. I will track some of the other creatures.
Investigate Goat's Junk Yard.
You need to defeat the Motor Raptors. They are causing the most trouble.
You must defeat three Motor Raptors in this area to prevent them from stealing technology from the junk yard. They are not unlike Aku's robotic servants. I will track some of the other creatures.
Defeat three Motor Raptors.
Very good. You have a true warrior's spirit. But there are more.
You must defeat more of the Motor Raptors. They are thick in this area.
Defeat four more Motor Raptors.
Defeat the Heavy Pinchers.
Well done. There is one more group nearby.
Defeat this last group of Motor Raptors and we will rendezvous back outside the junk yard.
Defeat five more Motor Raptors.
What's this? Those creatures dropped something. Bring it to me.
Good work dedeating Fuse's creatures. Bring me the item that they dropped. We cannot let Fuse get his hands on it.
Deliver object to Jack.
An Atomizer. This is a deadly device in the wrong hands. Thank you for recovering it. We must remain ever vigilant around here, or Fuse could gain an even greater advantage.
Into the Vortex
Recover the Timestream Vortex.
You know what, amigo? Samurai Jack has a timestream thingie. Maybe you can be using it to fix el time machine! Go ask him about it!
Bring that hard drive back  so I can reassemble it. I wonder why it's so important?
Samurai Jack gave me the Timestream Vortex, which can be used to rebuild the time machine. He hid the vortex at the Sweet Revenge crash site and I had to use a Temporal Stone to locate it.
Hooray and good job! Jack is going to be sending that Timestream Vortex to Numbuh Two right now. You gotta go back to el past to save the world!
Okay, the first thing you needing to do is talk to Samurai Jack at Goat's Junk Yard. He is having lots of magical things that go through time and stuff!
Talk to Samurai Jack.
The Timestream Vortex possesses magical properties, and I have used it to travel through time. Though it cannot function on its own, it is still very powerful, so I have hidden it safely.
Jack says you can use a Temporal Stone to find the Timestream Vortex. Wow! But the stone was stolen by Verminators in Peach Creek Estates, so you gotta be beating them up, first!
Defeat the Verminators.
You need to use a Temporal Stone to locate the Vortex, but it was stolen by the Verminators in Peach Creek Estates.
You fought bravely. Now you must go down to Candy Cove.
Jack says he hid the Timestream Vortex in Candy Cove. You should go down there and start looking!
Hey, bring both pieces of the stolen hard drive back to me so I can repair it.
Go to Candy Cove.
You must touch three points to triangulate the location of the Vortex.
Hoo-boy. Jack says you gotta touch some temportal points to triangulate the location of the Timestream Vortex. I no know what that means!!
Touch first temporal point.
After touching all three points, you will have limited time to collect it.
Good. Now move to the second point.
Now you gotta be touching the second temporal point to locate the Timestream Vortex. When all three are touched, the Temporal Stone will show you the way. Yipee!
Touch second temporal point.
Well done. One more to go.
You need to touch the last temporal point to triangulate the location of the Timestream Vortex. Then you must collect it muy rapidamente!
Return stolen hard drive components.
Touch third temporal point.
You've done it. The Temporal Stone will lead you to the Timestream Vortex.
You must hurry and collect the hidden Timestream Vortex. If you run out of time, you will need to touch the three temporal points again.
Collect the Timestream Vortex.
Congratulations. You are most skilled. Please come back to me.
You have collected the Timestream Vortex. Bring it to Samurai Jack ahora!
Return to Samurai Jack.

Excellent work. The Timestream Vortex will enable you to rebuild the time machine and return to the past. But I sense that there is still one more item that you need. Seek out Mandark after you have created your next nano.
Ay, caramba! You have run out of time. The Temporal Stone cannot locate the Timestream Vortex. You have to touch the temporal points all over again.
Touch first temporal point.
Thanks. So these guys stole one of Megas' hard drives, huh? Man, I wish I was better with computers. This thing is toast. Still, it's good we got it out of Fuse's hands.
Time has run out. You must touch the temporal points again.
Very good. Proceed to the next temporal point.
Haste Makes Paste
Collect Eddy's Future Paste for the time machine.
If you're gonna fix that broken time machine, you'll need something to hold it together. Try my patented Future Paste! I just need you to get some ingredients.
I collected newsprint, water, and pre-chewed chewing gum to make Eddy's Future Paste. I can use it to rebuild the time machine.
Okay, I'll send this batch of Future Paste to Numbuh Two. But there's gonna be a special handling charge. Computress will let you know what you need next.

If you wanna make Future Paste, the first thing you gotta do is get some newsprint. I think the Newsprint Ninjas will give you some, especially if you knock 'em around a little bit. There's a bunch hanging out in the Park n' Flush Trailer Park.
Go to the Trailer Park.
Beat up some Newsprint Ninjas and collect some newsprint!
Ready for a real fight?
Defeat a whole bunch of Newsprint Ninjas and collect three bundles of newsprint. I'll be waiting.
Defeat the Newsprint Ninjas.
Yeah! Next, you gotta defeat the Dire Hydras and get a few buckets o' water.
Defeat the Dire Hydras and get me some water. I can use the water to turn the newsprint into pulp.
Defeat the Dire Hydras.
Ka-pow! Now bring me the newsprint and the water. Magic's gonna happen.
Bring me the newsprint you got and the buckets o' water. I'll show you how I make my one-of-a-kind Future Paste.
Deliver items to Eddy.
Cool! I'm gonna use the newsprint and the water and turn it all into a pulpy, gooey mess. The secret ingredient is pre-chewed gum! Don't tell anyone.
There's only one more ingredient that I need: chewing gum! You can get some from the mall in Pokey Oaks North.
All right, you're going to need to go back out there and put this back inside the dish. Piece of cake!
Fuse will remember that defeat!
Go to mall in Pokey Oaks north.
While I do this, you need to go to Stickybeard's pirate ship and get some chewing gum.
Arrr you ready? Good luck, it's dangerous in there. Get the gum!
There's only one more ingredient that I need: chewing gum! You can get some from the mall in Pokey Oaks North.
Go to mall in Pokey Oaks north.
That gum is useless to me unless it is chewed. Bring it to Eduardo.
I need you to chew up all that chewing gum so I can use it in my Future Paste. Bring the gum to Eduardo…that guy's got some big choppers.
Bring gum to Eduardo.
That gum is useless to ye unless it is chewed. Shall I chew it for ye?
Oh, si! I love chewing gum! I can chew it and chew it and chew it! Wait…you need it back?
My toes smell like onions!
All right! Bring me that chewed-up chewing gum and I'll finish the Future Paste. Heh heh!
Bring chewed gum to Eddy.
Yuck…now that you have the chewed up gum, bring it back to me!
That's the best batch of Future Paste I ever made! You won't want to make time machines with any other kind of paste once you've tried my Future Paste!
2 x 4 Technology
Collect 2 x 4s scattered in Sector V.
If we're gonna send you back to the past, we gotta get this time machine running! All you gotta do is collect some 2 x 4s, and we'll be on our way.
Numbuh Two sent me to collect some 2 x 4s that were scattered around Sector V to use on the busted time machine. But it still isn't working!

I can use these 2 x 4s to rebuild the time machine for you. But there is something else missing.  After you get your Numbuh Two nano, talk to Numbuh Five.  She might know where you can find another of the missing pieces.
You can use 2 x 4 technology to build lots of cool stuff. Monsters have been stealing 2 x 4s from the tree house and scattering them around. Go collect 'em and I can use them to fix the time machine.
You're so brave and strong.
Go to the Sweet Revenge.
Enter the infected ship and collect the 2 x 4s. I'll be waiting.
You can use 2 x 4 technology to build lots of cool stuff. Monsters have been stealing 2 x 4s from the tree house and scattering them around. Go collect 'em and I can use them to fix the time machine.
Collect stash of 2 x 4s.
Good work. But we need more. Some Shocktanglers stole some!
You got one stash of 2 x 4s, but you'll need to collect some more from the thieving Shocktanglers. I know you can do it!
Defeat the Shocktanglers.
I think you're gonna have to keep climbing higher up on the ship.
Great! I think that's enough. Bring those 2 x 4s back to me and I'll get to work.
If you can go a little bit higher, I think you'll find one more 2 x 4 that we can use.
Hands on a Hard Drive (Part 2 of 2)
Collect one more 2 x 4.
If you can go just a wee bit higher, I think you'll find the last 2 x 4.
Great! I think that's enough. Bring those 2 x 4s back to me and I'll get to work.
You got enough 2 x 4s for me. Bring them back to the tree house so I can start to fix the time machine. Woo hoo!
Deliver 2 x 4s to Numbuh Two.
Congratulations. You are now ready to return to the past to save the world. There is just one more mission for you to complete before you rebuild the time machine. -Computress
This is great, but I'm afraid we're still missing something. The time machine needs more parts.
Bring Me the Head of Larry 3000
Find the robot called Larry 3000.
You must find the time-traveling robot called Larry 3000! I would inquire about his location myself, but that would be a waste of my superior intellect.
Restore the data on Coop's hard drive.
I found Larry 3000, but he had been damaged in battle. All that remained was his head. But I gave him to Numbuh Two, and he was able to fix the time machine.
You found the head of Larry 3000! Now you can repair the time machine. Return to the past and save the world. Remember, you could not have done it without me.
Larry 3000 was a time traveling robot. His circuits should enable you to power the time machine. Start your search in Pokey Oaks.
Go to Pokey Oaks North.
I think I saw Larry near the giant robot. Search carefully.
Numbuh Five might know where Larry 3000 is, so you should probably talk to her. It doesn't take a genius to figure that out!
Talk to Numbuh Five.
Yeah, Numbuh Five remembers that crazy robot. He got all blowed up in the battle of Tech Square. We gave his parts to Eddy, that kid in the Cul-de-Sac. Talk to him.
Eddy likes to collect all kinds of junk, so it makes sense that he would have what remains of Larry 3000. Go find him in the Cul-de-Sac.
Talk to Eddy.
Remember when Fuse tried to steal this hard drive from Megas? I want to know why he was interested. You should bring it Downtown to one of Dexter's Dexbots.
Sure, I remember that junky robot. He was worthless! I threw him into the salvage yard. Maybe you can still find some of his parts. Go ask Samurai Jack.
This is turning into a real adventure. How about you just come back here when you're done? I'm getting bored!
Talk to Samurai Jack.
I do recall seeing the head of a strange robot in the junk yard. But the area is extremely dangerous now. I recommend defeating some Toxic Spawns to ensure the retrieval goes smoothly.
Defeat the Toxic Spawns in the infected area before looking for the robot. Hurry.
Defeat five Toxic Spawns.
If you want to find this Larry 3000, you must first secure the area. The Toxic Spawns and Dread Heads will offer less resistance if you reduce their ranks.
Good. I believe I saw the robot close by.
Once you have found Larry 3000, return to me and I will assess the damage.
Defeat five Dread Heads.
I fixed Coop's hard drive, and Grandpa Max analyzed it.
Good. I believe the robot is in the infected zone inside the junk yard.
Make your way through the infection to the other side of the junk yard. Once you have found Larry 3000, bring him to me.
Find Larry 3000.
You found him. It seems that all that remains is his head. Ha ha ha ha ha.
You found Larry 3000's head? That's all that's left of him? Ha ha ha ha ha! Well, bring him here to me.
Bring Larry to Mandark.
It appears that the circuitry inside Larry 3000's head remains intact. I expect you should be able to use this to power the time machine. Bring it to Numbuh Two.
Bring Larry 3000's head back to me. With his circuits in place, I will be able to repair the time machine.
Bring Larry to Mandark.
Using my genius, I will explain to Numbuh Two how he can use Larry 3000's head to fix the time machine. You should go to his time lab now!
Good job getting that hard drive fixed. So, there was some Glorft stuff on there? I hoped you washed your hands after you touched it.
You are off to the past! Good luck, and send Dexter my regards. Remind him that he is only half the genius I am. Ha. Ha ha ha. Ha ha ha ha ha!
Head to the Time machine.
Will time travel save the world?
Be the hero we know you are.
Do you think they have soda in the future?
I wanna save the world with you!
Dawn of the Spawn
Defeat Fusion Spawns for Numbuh Five.
You know the Fusion Spawns you beat up for Numbuh Two? They're coordinating their attacks with the Fusion Spawns here in Pokey Oaks North. We gotta get 'em!
I defeated Fusion Spawns in Pokey Oaks North to prevent them from coordinating future attacks.
I can't do anything with this hard drive. I think someone at Dexlabs might be able to access the information on it. You should bring this thing to Dexbot Q-12 at City Station.
You got the Spawns! We'll keep our eyes peeled to make sure them little green creeps don't start any more trouble. Is that time machine fixed, yet?
Defeat five Fusion Spawns in Pokey Oaks North. They're trying to team up with other Spawns, and we can't let 'em do it.
Defeat five Fusion Spawns.
Good job. Head on back to me.
Defeat five Noxious Spawns in Pokey Oaks South. They're trying to team up with other Spawns, and we can't let 'em do it.
Defeat five Noxious Spawns.
Good job. Head back to Sector V.
Talk to Licorice Lips.
Talk to Licorice Lips.
Defeat five of 'em, and let's send a serious message!
Deliver hard drive to Dexbot Q-12.
Oh, I'm so glad ye is here. The Serious Spawns near the Sweet Revenge are rallying together for an attack. Can ye take 'em down?
Those little creeps are working together somehow! You gotta keep those Serious Spawns from doing serious damage!
Defeat five Serious Spawns.
These attacks are happening everywhere! Keep it up.
Good job, matey. You sent 'em a real Candy Pirate welcome.
Good job getting those Spawns! Get back to Pokey Oaks North and I'll give you a reward or somethin'.
Return to Numbuh Five.
Hey, nice! Now get back to Sector V. There's more trouble.
Good stuff out there. We gotta stay on our guard and make sure those Spawns don't get all crazy again.
Band of Bandits
Good job. Now just stand by while I synchronize the systems…
Greetings. Allow me to conduct a cursory analysis on  Mr. Kaplowski's hard drive. Analyzing…data is alien in origin.
Recover Samurai Jack's temporal stone.

Hello again, my time-traveling friend. Do you recall the Temporal Stone used to locate the Timestream Vortex? It seems that it has once again been stolen by the monsters in Peach Creek Estates. You will need to fight to retrieve it.
I recovered a Temporal Stone from the Sewer Creepers in Peach Creek Estates.
Excellent work, Young One. You may very well be the saviour of this planet. But there is still much to be done. Remain strong and focused.

To recover the Temporal Stone, you must defat the Sewer Creepers that stole it from my possession. I had intended to pass it on to you as a parting gift. With that artifact in hand, you will discover that time travel is much more tolerable.
Defeat the Sewer Creepers.
You have the stone! Return to me at once.
Blossom needs you to find the Furious Spawns in Pokey Oaks and take 'em down.
Find the Furious Spawns.
I need to stay here to protect the school. You need to head out and find those creatures!
Uh-oh! The hard drive contains alien data, but it's protected by a fail-safe device. Dexbot Q-12 wants you to take it to Grandpa Max at the Fissure before we lose the data.
Okay, be on the lookout for those monsters.
Licorice Lips wants you to find the Tread Heads that took his Chocolate Dubloons. Then maybe he'll help you find my Soopuh Sour Pops!
Defeat the Tread Heads.
Good work, me hearty! Now bring them dubloons to me!
Bring them Chocolate Dubloons you got from the Treadnaughts back to Licorice Lips.
Bring candy to Licorice Lips.
Noxious Spawns are attacking Pokey Oaks South. Can you handle it?
Arrr! Me Chocolate Dubloons are back in me possession! So I will tell ye: the Candy Bandits stole Numbuh Five's Soopuh Sour Pops!!
Candy Bandits?!? Why didn't I think of that? Now that Licorice Lips has his Chocolate Dubloons back, go after those raggedy Candy Bandits and get my Soopuh Sour Pops back!!
Defeat the Candy Bandits.
Bring hard drive to Max ASAP.
Seems pretty obvious, don't it?
You got 'em! Bring them yummy goodies back to Sector V.
Furious Spawns, Noxious Spawns, Toxic Spawns…they're no match for you!
Defeat the Toxic Spawns.
Sounds like the work of Toxic Spawns. I think you know what to do.
Oh, gracias! Please bring my puppy back.
Go give Eduardo his puppy, then come back to Sector V. I wanna congratulate you in person.
Bring the puppy to Eduardo.
Great job. I think we've got all the spawns contained. Thanks.
Oh, I so scared and worried about you, little puppy! Muchas muchas gracias!
Warning: fail-safe device has been triggered. Please deliver this hard drive to Grandpa Max at the Fissure or data will be destroyed.
You are a fierce warrior. Bring the Temporal Stone to me and I will show you how to use it properly.
Bring Temporal Stone to Jack.
Awesome job. Return to Sector V!
The right combination of skill, luck and spirit will lead you to victory.
Resurrect 'Ems
Find the closest Resurrect 'Em.
Even the best operatives are sometimes defeated in battle. But don't worry, Grim's Resurrect 'Em will always bring you back to the fight. Want to learn more?
I learned about the Resurrect 'Em and how to use it if I am defeated in battle.
Now you know what to do if you are defeated in battle. Hey, it happens to the best of us. Remember to thank Grim for the Resurrect 'Em next time you see him!
If you get knocked out during a fight, you can always be revived at the closest Resurrect 'Em. Go to the one near here and check it out. I'll send you an email with all the details.
What? You say you got this from Megas? Hang on, let me see…this looks like a Glorft encryption protocol. There, all set. Now I want to see what Fuse was so interested in here.
Go to the nearest Resurrect 'Em.

Grim was nice enough to set up Resurrect 'Ems throughout the world to revive anyone who falls in battle. If you get knocked out, just press the Resurrect 'Em button and you'll come back with all your health. You can also be revived right away, but there's a penalty. I'll tell you more about that soon. -Numbuh 108
That's one of Grim's Resurrect 'Ems. You'll find them all over the place.
After you get knocked out, you can also choose to be revived on the spot. But there's a penalty for that. Come back and I'll tell you about it.
Return to Numbuh 108.
If you get knocked out, you can always be revived at the closest Resurrect 'Em.
If you get knocked out, you can also be revived on the spot. But you have to wait for a certain amount of health to regenerate, and that takes time. A Resurrect 'Em is always your best bet!
Infected Zones
Explore the infected zone in Sector V.
Fuse has polluted our world with Fusion Matter, and the most dangerous areas have goo everywhere. We call these places infected zones. Want to learn more?
The Glorft? That's just what we need. While Max works on the data, why don't you go see Ben at the spaceport for that cool new equipment?
I navigated the infected zone in Sector V.
You'll find infected zones everywhere. Some of them are pretty dangerous. We've gotta make sure we contain the Fusion Matter explosion, or our planet's toast!

Fuse uses his Terrafusers to infect our world with Fusion Matter. Once he's done, he's gonna absorb our planet! So we have to make sure we do everything we can to contain the infected zones. I'll send you an email with the details.
Go to the Sector V infected zone.

Fuse sends his Terrafusers down to our planet to infect it with Fusion Matter. The worst areas are called infected zones. You'll find tricky pathways, precarious floating platforms and lots of green goo! But don't worry, we've added launch pads, zip lines and other neat stuff to make the areas a little less dangerous and a lot more fun! -Numbuh 108
This used to be a KND training ground, and now it's covered in slime.
In order to enter an infected zone, you need to click on the entrance.
Use the entrance.
To enter the area, you need to click on the entrance.
When you enter an infected area, you'll see lots of dangerous Fusion Matter, but you'll also find jump pads, zip lines and launchers to help you get around. Sometimes, it's even kinda fun!
Head to the spaceport.
Touch the KND flag.
Now that you're in, see if you can go and touch the KND flag.
You did it! Nice work. Come on back.
Wasn't that cool? Infected zones are gross, but they can also be pretty exciting, too. Anyway, you can leave now and come back.
Use the exit.
To leave, just click on the exit. Often, it's the same place you came in.
So now you know what an infected zone looks like. Come on back and I'll give you a little reward.
Return to Numbuh 108.
Those infected zones are pretty dangerous places. Some of them are even filled with monsters. But you can also find some really cool gear. Make sure you explore them all, and let's stop Fuse!
Quest Journal

Megas must have picked up these files from the Glorft. While I run this data through the translator, why don't you go see my grandson, Ben? He's been handing out some new equipment to kids like you, sharp and skilled.
Learn to use your Mission Journal.
You're gonna have to do a lot of missions if you want to save the planet from Fuse. Want to learn more about your Mission Journal?
I learned about my Mission Journal and delivered a medal to Sherri Bird from Blossom.
Thanks for bringing me that medal. Blossom is really cool, huh? Now you know how to get missions and manage them in your Mission Journal.

If you accept a mission from someone you meet, it will appear as an Active Mission in your journal. The first thing I want you to do is talk to Blossom. Look for your Current Objective on your screen. I'll send you more details in an email.
Talk to Blossom.

Access your Mission Journal by pressing the "J" key. When you accept a mission from someone, it will appear as an Active Mission in your Journal. There are three types of missions: World Missions, Guide Missions and Nano Missions. You can have up to nine active missions at a time. If you don't want to complete a mission, you can always drop it from your journal. -Sherri
Oh, did Sherri Bird send you? I've been meaning to give her this medal for her great work defending Pokey Oaks. Will you please bring it to her?
You will be asked to do different tasks while on a mission. You can see the task details for all active missions by checking your journal. Now come back and see me.
Deliver medal to Sherri Bird.
I've decoded some of the data, and I see why Fuse wanted it out of our hands.
Did you notice that your Current Objective updated after you talked to Blossom?
A medal for me? Thanks. Blossom is so awesome. Now that you know more about your Mission Journal, you should have no trouble taking on all kinds of different missions!
Containment Areas
Help clean up the Sector V infected zone.
It is critical that we clean up the infected zones. If we don't, Fusion Matter will destroy our world. The Special Alien Capture Team has a solution. Learn more?
I learned how to clean up the infected zones, starting in Sector V.
SACT has placed fields agents in every infected zone. Those who post very high scores receive "kudos" from their peers. Are you ready to learn about transport?

The Special Alien Capture Team has set up containment areas inside the infected zones. Your job is to collect Fusion Matter Seedlings and place them in SACT containment drums. The Seedlings appear on a predetermined path inside the containment area, and you must pick them up as quickly as you can. Please check your email for more information. Now proceed to the Sector V infected zone.
Go to Sector V infected zone.

Subject: Containment. SACT has set up containment areas in the infected zones for the purpose of collecting Seedlings. Seedlings are toxic Fusion Matter deposits that will eventually grow into Terrafusers, further spreading Fuse's infection. Talk to the SACT agent at the start to begin your run. Your score is determined by how many Seedlings you collect and the time it takes you to reach the containment drum at the finish. -Computress
The Glorft? That's just what we need. Who do ya think is worse, them or Fuse? Anyway, bring that data back to Dexbot Q-12 so he can translate it.
Enter the Sector V infected zone and find the SACT agent.
Speak to the SACT agent to start your run through the containment area. You may practice these runs at any time, but to post a score, you must have a container with you.
Talk to the SACT agent at start.
Greetings. You can run through the containment area any time you like. Select a practice run or go for a high score. Either way, you're helping clean up Fuse's infection.

SACT agents are stationed inside every single infected zone to assist in the cleaning up of Fusion Matter. Now that you know, return at any time for a practice run. If you want to register your score, you need to buy a Fusion Container from a vendor first. You may now exit the infected zone.
Exit the infected zone.
Return here at any time to try a practice run. You may now exit the infected zone.
Hey, that was a pretty good time! Well, come on back.

When cleaning up a containment area, being fast is critical, but it is also important to collect as many Seedlings as possible. Now that you have learned about SACT's containment areas, please return to me at Hero Square.
Talk to Sherri Bird.

I've booted up the system and calibrated the whatsahoosit. Now just protect the dish while it gets syncronized. Fight the Caterplugs and make sure they don't get near the dish. Defeat eight of them before time runs out.
Return data to Dexbot Q-12.
Now that you know about the containment areas, feel free to try them at any time. You are now ready to learn about the transportation system.

Learn how to create a Nano in the Great Machine.
Subject: Mandark. World's Greatest Genius and creator of the Great Machine. The Great Machine is used to make Nanos. Do you require more input?
I used the Great Machine and learned how to make a Nano.

Talk to Mandroid M-80 about the Great Machine and learn how to make a Nano.
Talk to Mandroid M-80.

Use the Great Machine.

Learn how to use Nano Tuning Stations.
Subject: Nano Tuning Stations. Nanos can be granted new powers at Nano Tuning Stations. Do you require more input?
I learned how to use Nano Tuning Stations.
Mission: Complete. Nano Tuning Station used. Request: Leave me alone.
Use the Nano Tuning Station to tune your Nano. Requirements: Nano and appropriate amount of Nano Tuning material. Details will be sent via email.

Data analysis indicates that the Glorft homeworld was once attacked by Fuse, but the Glorft successfully defended themselves against the invasion.
Mission accomplished. Nano Tuning Station used. Sigh of relief.
Going Places

Waaah! You beat me! Boo-hoo! I don't wanna go home. I wanna find my Ed! I'm sorry I got mad at you. Here, take this because I didn't mean it. Waaah!

Return to Dexter's House.

We need you to plug all three Tech Tunneler holes. Fast! Good luck.
Fill the third hole.

Investigate places Father recently visited.
Father says he's on our side, but I have reason to believe that he's has been working with Fuse's monsters. I'd like you to investigate Peach Creek Estates.

I'm concerned that Father has not reformed his villainous ways. He may still be secretly plotting against the Kids Next Door. Defeat him and get it back!

Get Mandark's storage locker.

Head down to Cul-de-Sac.

Maybe Fuse is taking over Peach Creek Estates because none of you heroes are here to keep an eye on the place. Find the three Gooby Traps that Fuse has planted and get rid of them.

Clean up Eternal Meadows.

Hey: What's up? Is everything going well? I'm downtown at the Space Port dealing with Fuse's freaks. Why don't you go check in with Numbuh Two in Sector V and see if he can hook you up with some equipment? I'll be in touch. -Ben
Grandpa Max needs a special piece of equipment from the KND. Speak to Numbuh 311 at Dizzy World. She's got the gear and will send you on your way. -Ben
Come back and see me as soon as that potion is delivered.
Numbuh Two tells me you're doing great work. I think he still needs help with that LOCATOR device. Go check in with him. I'll touch base with you again soon. -Ben
There are some enemy encampments in the suburbs that need immediate attention. Contact Numbuh Two. -Ben
.Hey, there's trouble in Pokey Oaks! Blossom sent all the details to Numbuh Two. Go talk to him about it, okay? -Ben

Did you get the Sonic Earplugs? Max just told me about a secret Plumber base in Peach Creek Estates. I sent its location to Numbuh Two. Go see him right away. I'll upload a special access code to your NanoCom. -Ben
Great job with the Plumber base in Peach Creek. There's another one at the junk yard. I sent the info to Numbuh Two. -Ben
The Plumbers have a hidden data miner in the suburbs that has some useful information on it. Go check in with Numbuh Two. He'll help you figure out how to access it. Thanks. -Ben

I'm down here at the Space Port with some KND operatives. They're pretty cool kids. Anyway, they said they need some special equipment, and Numbuh Two knows where to get it. Can you go talk to him about it? -Ben

A nasty Fusion out at Charles Darwin is preparing an attack on Sector V. I've got too much going on down here, so go see if you can help Numbuh Two. Then maybe you can deliver that radioactive isotope that you recovered from the power plant. -Ben

Blossom told me you impressed her with your fighting skills. That is good! Now I want you to check in with her about the missing heroes. I hear she has a lead regarding my favorite hero of all time, Major Glory! -Dexter

Major Glory, the best superhero ever, seems to have disappeared during a mission to the Darklands. That area is very dangerous, but if you keep working with Blossom, she'll help you get prepared. Go see if she has any missions for you. I'll be in touch soon. -Dexter
Deliver chocolates to Marie.

Professor Utonium has been experimenting with a bizarre strain of Fusion Matter. I would like to get my hands on some samples. Talk to Blossom and see if she can get us in touch with the Professor, okay? Thanks. -Dexter

You need to speak with Blossom right away. There is a lot of Fuse activity happening around her house in Pokey Oaks South. Could be trouble! Oh, and thanks for collecting those Fusion Matter samples for me. -Dexter
I sent Blossom some information about a device that I believe may help us locate the missing superheroes. Go speak with her to get the details. I have to get back to my research. -Dexter
Hey, you're doing a great job out there. The Power Level Tracker will be extremely useful. Why don't you go talk to Blossom and see if there are any missions you can help her with? -Dexter

Has Blossom mentioned the disappearance of her sister, Buttercup? I still wonder if Buttercup's fate is somehow related to the disappearances of the other heroes. You should go ask her about it. Be gentle; she's still very emotional. -Dexter
Apparently, there's trouble brewing at the nuclear plant in Endsville. Better contact Blossom about it. Whoops, I think I left the Bunsen Burner on! -Dexter
Dexlabs just sent Blossom some new communications equipment. Go see if you can help her get it set up, okay? Thanks. -Dexter
That Power Level Tracker that you got from Coop needs repair. I think I have something in my old lab that might do the trick. Talk to Blossom about it. -Dexter
Hey, pal! We need some assistance with an ice cream delivery! Think you can lend a hand? Speak to Urban Ranger Ralphie in Hero Square. -Edd
My cardboard castle is having some structural problems and I need to collect some more cardboard. Maybe you can help. Stop and see Ranger Ralphie when you can. -Edd

Arrr, that was delicious! Oh, I be feeling all tingly in me guts. And now I can only think of one thing: the bonny lass, Marie Kanker. Please bring her these chocolates, along with me kindest regards.
I've got a secret to share. Come down to the Cul-de-Sac and talk to me about it. Ssshhh…it's a surprise! -Edd
Let's use that treasure map to find the treasure! Come and see me so we can formulate a plan. -Edd
You know that weird candy you found? I think I know what we can do with it. Come down to the Cul-de-Sac when you have a free moment. -Edd
Hey, where does that second treasure map lead? I have my suspicions. Meet me in the Cul-de-Sac. -Edd
If you're heading out to Endsville, go talk to that kid Billy and see if he can help us find more candy treasure. We can't let Fuse get his hands on that Crazy Brain candy! -Edd
Go see Billy. I believe he needs help with something. Although I doubt it is very important. -Edd
Billy said he had an idea about what to do with the Crazy Brain candy. Might as well find out what he has to say. -Edd
Once again, Billy requests your assistance. However, I think we need to move on to other ventures. Go see what he wants, but pretty soon I will need you to meet someone Downtown. -Edd

If we are to defeat this creature called Fuse, we must assemble minions in the multitudes! Are you worthy of this assemblage? Proceed to Hero Square in Sector V and speak to my minion, Jibba Jabba. He will have a mission for you, and if you can complete this mission, then it will be clear that you are capable of working for me, Mojo Jojo! -Mojo Jojo

Father says that there is a valuable map that we must obtain. I have sent the details to my minion, Jibba Jabba. Go speak to Jibba Jabba to find out more about this valuable map that we must obtain. -Mojo Jojo
Are these chocolates from my little sockhead? Awww, there's a note. "Dear Fair Marie, Your eyes arrr like the shiniest beans 'o' jelly. Your True Love, Ol' Licorice Lips." Ol' Licorice Lips?!?

So far, Father has proved helpful, and so I will continue to work with him until such time that he becomes unhelpful. Go see him in Peach Creek Estates, and when you see him, tell him you want to defeat Fuse. When Fuse is defeated, I can get back to destroying Townsville and those miserable Powerpuff Girls! -Mojo Jojo
Go see Father. When you see him, he will have a mission to give you. You should accept this mission. Do not decline the mission. Then, complete the mission. Do not fail the mission. -Mojo Jojo

I have delivered a weapon to Father that will help you in your Fuse-fighting activities. Go see Father about it, and make sure you ask him about the weapon that I sent to aid you in your Fuse-fighting activities. -Mojo Jojo

I have contacted a nasty individual called Father. Father says he is also assembling the best kids to fight Fuse. Return to my minion, Jibba Jabba, in Hero Square. He will have a mission for you. This is the end of my email. There is no more email to write. Other than my name, which is: -Mojo Jojo
You may see Father for another mission. That is all. I am very busy at the moment. -Mojo Jojo

I am interested in recovering some special Chemical X from the nuclear plant. Since you are relatively close to the nuclear plant, perhaps you could recover the special Chemical X that I require from the nuclear plant. Please go speak to Father about it. This is the last sentence of my email. -Mojo Jojo

Father has requested your assistance with another mission. Curses! I, Mojo Jojo, would like to request your assistance for another mission as well. This creates a conflict. But I have a solution. Assist Father with his mission, and then you can assist me with my mission. I believe that is a suitable compromise. -Mojo Jojo
