Wow, Fusion Blossom was using the Kankers to help make a Thingamajig! Good thing you figured it out. Well, please rendezvous with me back at the Cul-de-Sac.
Talk to Edd.
You got the scissors! Please get out of there and come see me.
Investigate the attacks on the Chickens From Outer Space.
You were very clever to figure out that the Kankers were working with Fusion Blossom. Thanks for recovering my giant pair of scissors! Now I can use them to complete the Thingamajig.
What the heck is a Thingamajig?
Great job defeating Fusion Blossom in Peach Creek.
You're bold and sassy!
Wow, I heard you beat Fusion Blossom in Peach Creek!
Make a Wish
Get some bubble bath for Him.
Would you like to hear about the Wishing Skulls? Bring me some bubble bath, and I would be happy to tell you all.
I got some bubble bath from Dee Dee and brought it to Him. Him told me that the first wishing skull is in the southeast corner of Eternal Vistas.
Thank you for the bubble bath. Look for Wishing Skulls throughout your journey. There are nine in total. The first is located nearby in Eternal Vistas.
I am General Tso, commanding officer for the Chickens From Outer Space. Can you help me find the eggplants that have been attacking my people? Bock!
If you want to know more about the Wishing Skulls, you need to get me some bubble bath. Ask that lovely young lass, Dee Dee, in Genius Grove.
Talk to Dee Dee.
Oooh, you want some bubble bath? Sure. I have lavender cucumber, chamomile melon, mango marigold…take your pic
Once you have the bubble bath, please bring it back to me in Endsville.
Bring bubble bath to Him.
Oh, just take this one. It's ginseng horseradish!
Thank you. The Wishing Skulls number nine, and the first one is in the southeast corner of Eternal Vistas. Completing all their missions may be quite…rewarding. Good luck.
Wish Upon a Weirdo
Get some garlic for Billy.
Ooo! Do you know about the Wishing Skulls? You make a wish, and then they grant it, and it's awesome. I know about one, but can you do me a favor?
I found the fake eggplants that were attacking the chickens.
I brought Billy some garlic to help ward off vampires, and he told me that there's another Wishing Skull in Genius Grove.
Thanks for bringing me all this yummy garlic! If I eat it all at once, my farts smell like pizza. Wanna smell? Don't forget about the Wishing Skull in Genius Grove!
I need some garlic to scare away the Bloodsuckers. Can you get some from Numbuh Two? If you bring it quick, I'll tell you where a Wishing Skull is.
Talk to Numbuh Two.
Sure, you need some garlic? I've got plenty. I think it adds zest to any dish. Especially pasta, pizza, lo mein, fried chicken, peanut butter…man, I'm hungry!
I need some garlic to scare away the Bloodsuckers. Can you get some from Numbuh Two? If you bring it quick, I'll tell you where a Wishing Skull is.
Deliver garlic to Billy.
Hey, thanks! I loves garlic! If you want to find the Wishing Skull, look in Genius Grove. There's nine all together, and if you find 'em all, you'll get something amazing and stuff.
Pirate's Wish
Bock! Those horrible eggplants were actually Fuse's monsters in disguise! You have been a great help to the Chickens From Outer Space. Bock.
Get a jawbreaker for Stickybeard.
Arrr, would ye like to know about the Wishing Skulls? I know of one near here, and I'll tell ye about it for the price of one jawbreaker.
I got a jawbreaker for Stickybeard and he told me that there's a Wishing Skull hidden somewhere in the junk yard.
'Tis most satisfying to have me a jawbreaker between me gums. Remember, the Wishing Skull is over yonder in the junk yard. Step lively!
Go to the Cul-de-Sac and ask the scrawny scalawag called Double-D for a jawbreaker. If ye bring it here, I'll tell ye about the Wishing Skull.
Talk to Edd.
You want a jawbreaker? Sure, I suppose I can part with this one. It's my least-favorite color.
Go to the Cul-de-Sac and ask the scrawny scalawag called Double-D for a jawbreaker. If ye bring it here, I'll tell ye about the Wishing Skull.
Return jawbreaker to Stickybeard.
The Wishing Skulls will grant ye one wish! There are nine all told, and you must speak with them in the correct order. But a fine prize awaits those who find all nine! Arrr!
I want you to find the eggplants that have been attacking my people. There is a group of Aubergine Meanies in the area. Get them!
The Thromnambular Saga (Part 1 of 9)
Complete a mission for Thromnambular.
If a wish is what you desire, then a Joke-O-Lantern head is what I require.
I brought a bunch of stuff over to Thromnambular, the Wishing Skull in the graveyard. I need to find all nine skulls to get my wish.
Thanks for doing what you had to do. Now you must find Wishing Skull #2.
You heard exactly what I said. Bring me a Joke-O-Lantern's head.
Get a Joke-O-Lantern's head.
You have done extremely well. Now bring that head to where I dwell.
You heard exactly what I said. Bring me a Joke-O-Lantern's head.
Deliver head to Thromnambular.
Find the Aubergine Meanies.
Sorry, but I changed my mind. A Bloodsucker wing is what you must find.
I told you what you need to bring. Get me a Bloodsucker's wing.
Get a Bloodsucker's wing.
The end of your quest is almost near. Bring that wing back over here.
I told you what you need to bring. Get me a Bloodsucker's wing.
Deliver wing to Thromnambular.
Whoops, but on second thought…a Spooka's tail is what you should have brought.
Hurry up and do not fail. Bring me the tip of a Spooka's tail.
Get a Spooka's tail.
You're very good, that much is clear. Now bring that tail back over here.
Oh, thank heavens for a smooth chin.
Halt! This is where most of those mutant eggplant creatures live.
Hurry up and do not fail. Bring me the tip of a Spooka's tail.
Return tail to Thromnambular.
I promise now your work is done. But, c'mon, wasn't that a little fun? If a wish is what you want to find, you must speak to all the skulls that number nine.
The Thromnambular Saga (Part 2 of 9)
Complete a mission for Thromnambular.
If you want to get to wishin', then you must complete this mission. Your destination on this trip is the Sweet Revenge pirate ship.
I made it to the top of the Sweet Revenge in record time, and completed the second of nine Wishing Skull missions.
That is all you will get from me. Now find Wishing Skull #3.
Go to the ship and do not rest. Once there I will describe your test.
Go to the Sweet Revenge.
You need to clear the eggplants out of the Upper Catacombs. Defeat six Aubergine Meanies.
Are you ready for this test? To pass, you must reach the crow's nest.
Oh, this is my favorite part! Give up and go back to start.
Return to start.
Sorry, but your time's expired. I hope you aren't much too tired.
If you want to be my hero, reach the top before the clock says zero.
Reach the crow's nest.
Listen closely and don't make me shout. Reach the top before time runs out.
That was quite a fine display. Come back to me right away.
Return to Thromnambular.
Well, I cannot believe my eyes. Return to me to claim your prize.
Defeat six Aubergine Meanies.
You impressed me with your speed. Here's a little something for your deed. If a wish is what you want to find, you must speak to all the skulls that number nine.
The Thromnambular Saga (Part 3 of 9)
Complete a mission for Thromnambular.
If a wish is what you crave, then I hope you're feeling brave. I need metal scraps for a work of art. In the junk yard is where you'll need to start.
I collected metal scraps for Thromnambular so he could make a sculpture or something. I still have to find six more Wishing Skulls to get my wish.
From me you will get nothing more. Go find Wishing Skull #4.
This will not be very hard. Make your way through the junk yard.
Find the Scrap Scrappers.
Scrap Scrappers are what you need to find.
Get those beasts and watch for traps. When you're done, pick up their scraps.
Thin their ranks and report back to me. Bock, bock, bock. Bock.
Collect metal scraps.
Destroy them and pick up what's left behind.
Those annoying creeps have ceased to be. Bring their remains back to me.
You've done well, this is true. Those metal scraps belong to You-Know-Who.
Deliver scraps to Thromnambular.
Sorry, these scraps aren't big enough. I didn't think this would be so tough!
Scrap Tyrants should be better suited, than the monsters you already looted.
Collect bigger metal scraps.
I'm going to need something a little bigger. You'll have to fight some Scrap Tyrants, I figure.
I really appreciate your work! I hope you don't think I'm a jerk.
Wait just one minute…those aren't eggplants!
Bring me those scraps and don't delay. Then you can get on with your day.
Deliver large metal scraps.
Now I can finish up my sculpture. Don't we all need a little culture? If a wish is what you want to find, you must speak to all the skulls that number nine.
Pirate Love
Get a peppermint heart for Jellybean Jane.
Arrr, I be most upset. I left Stickybeard's crew to be with me true love, Brittle Butter. Yet he don't know me true feelings. Will ye help me express me emotions?
I collected a peppermint heart from the Candy Buccaneers and delivered it to Brittle Butter.
Ye have my thanks. 'Tis hard to be a tough candy pirate on the outside when ye feel so tender on the inside, like a caramel-filled piece of chocolate.
I used to have a peppermint heart, but it was stolen by them Candy Buccaneers. Can ye recover it?
Defeat the Candy Buccaneers.
Those eggplants were actually Fuse's invaders in disguise. Hmmm. Come back to me right away.
Ye have accomplished yer goal. Can ye bring that heart to Brittle Butter?
Now that ye have the peppermint heart, please bring it to Brittle Butter as an expression of me true feelings.
Deliver candy to Brittle Butter.
He be at the top of the ship. Tell him it's from Jellybean Jane.
What's this? A delicious candy heart from Jellybean Jane? Why, I had no idea she felt this way. She never told me she had a fancy fer peppermint!
Did ye give him the peppermint heart? Please come back to me and tell me what he said!
Return to Jellybean Jane.
Oh, he didn't understand me true feelings? Arrr! I suppose if ye want to express yer love, ye need to do it yerself. Thanks for the help. I learned me lesson.
Hairy Chest Test
Get a throwning star from a Newspaper Ninja.
Return to General Tso.
I am trying to get the Urban Ranger Hairy Chest of Resilience. I have to get a throwing star from a Newspaper Ninja, but I'm too scared. Can you do it for me?
I collected a Newspaper Ninja's throwing star for Ranger Joey.
Hey, thanks for getting that throwing star! Though I feel somewhat guilty about chickening out, at least I will have my Hairy Chest of Resilience to comfort me.
I need to get a Newspaper Ninja's throwing star to qualify for the Hairy Chest of Resilience. Will you get one for me?
Collect a Newspaper Ninja's throwing star.
Awesome! Can you bring that over?
Now that you have that Newspaper Ninja's throwing star, please bring it over.
Deliver star to Ranger Joey.
Thanks for doing that. You really deserve the Hairy Chest of Resilience more than I do. You're totally brave! Here, take this reward instead.
Stop helping Urban Rangers.
These creatures are more of those awful goo monsters. Report to me immediately!
Did you help Ranger Joey? When will he learn?
I want a hairy chest!
You should tell Urban Rangers to do their own work.
Well, now you've done it. The hard drive is scrambled. That's the kind of thing I would do. Go back to Dexbot Q-12 at City Station.
Return to Dexbot Q-12.
Time expired. Fail-safe triggered. Come back here to reset the drive.
I have been able to temporarily restore the hard drive's data. Quickly, bring this to Grandpa Max.
Lame Imitation
Find and defeat Fusion Blossom.
Fuse steals items and uses them to create his Fusion monsters. I mean, there's a dark version of me hanging around! We need to put a stop to this immediately.
I believe we have made an unfortunate error. The eggplants are not attcking us at all. Whoops. Please go talk to Mel Anzana, one of the eggplants of Nowhere, and tell him what we have learned.

I recovered Sugar, Spice and Everything Nice from Fuse's monsters. Then I tracked down Fusion Blossom inside the Pokey Oaks infected zone. I defeated her and collected Blossom's hairbow, which I used to make a Blossom Nano!
Thanks for getting my stuff back. Do you think Fuse is responsible for the missing superheroes, too? I'm ready to send that guy back to wherever he came from.

Fuse's monsters raided the Professor's lab. They stole some Sugar, some Spice and Everything Nice! You need to get that stuff back before they can make more Fusions. Look for the Ball-Peen Meanies in Pokey Oaks North.
Find the Ball-Peen Meanies.
The Ball-Peen Meanies stole the Sugar. Get 'em!
Defeat the Ball-Peen Meanies and collect the Sugar that they stole from the Professor's lab.
Defeat the Ball-Peen Meanies.
Maybe you can get the Hydro Slammers that took my microphone.
Great job. Now you need to get the Mean Behemoths who stole the Spice.
You got the Sugar. Now you need to defeat the Mean Behemoths and recover the Spice.
You need to find Mel Anzana, one of the eggplants of Nowhere, so he can learn what’s been going on. He is in the Lower Catacombs.
Defeat the Mean Behemoths.
Maybe you can get the Sonic Scorpions that took my microphone.
Great! Now get the Pesky Ponies who took Everything Nice.
You've done a great job collecting the Sugar and the Spice that the monsters took from the Professor's lab. Now you have to get Everything Nice back from the Pesky Ponies in Pokey Oaks North.
Defeat the Pesky Ponies.
Maybe you can get the Streetcrushers that took my leather jacket.
Sweet. Bring those things back to me in Sector V, okay?
You've collected the stolen Sugar, Spice and Everything Nice! Now Fuse won't be able to make more Fusions with that stuff. Can you bring it all back to me in Sector V?
Deliver items to Blossom.
I'm glad you got this stuff back. Who knows what Fuse would have done with it. But Fuse also took one of my hairbows to make a Fusion Blossom. We gotta stop her.
That was really nice of you to help Lee Kanker.
Talk to Mel Anzana.
You got the Sugar. You got the Spice. You even got Everything Nice. But Fuse took one of my hairbows. And I think he used it to make a Fusion Blossom. Go find her in the Pokey Oaks infected zone.
Find Fusion Blossom's Lair
But Fuse also took my green lipstick. I think that's what he uses to make Fusion Buttercup. You need to track her down.
Fusion Blossom is hiding inside.
You got the Sugar. You got the Spice. You even got Everything Nice. But Fuse took one of my hairbows. And I think he used it to make a Fusion Blossom. Go find her in the Pokey Oaks infected zone.
Enter the Fusion Portal.
You've got the element of surprise. So go surprise her.
You've found Fusion Blossom! Defeat her, get my hairbow, and make a Blossom Nano. You can do it!
Defeat Fusion Blossom.
Fusion Blossom is in the area. Go get her!
What? Fuse's creatures are taking the form of eggplants and attacking the Chickens From Outer Space? Well, that explains a thing or two.
That chick is so totally out of the band.
You got my ribbon back, now get out of there and come see me.
Exit the area.
Grab my lipstick and get out of there!
You got my ribbon back, now get out of there and come see me.
Talk to Blossom.
Thanks for getting rid of her. Now make a Blossom Nano.
Way to go. You beat Fusion Blossom. Yay.
Nice job taking down Fusion Blossom.
I want to be a superhero when I grow up.
Once you've talked to Mel Anzana, come back and tell me what you have learned.
I love that you got rid of Fusion Blossom!
Go, Demongo, Go
Find Fusion Demongo's minion.
Have ye heard talk of the missing heroes? 'Tis true, Fuse is trying to kidnap them. But for what foul purpose? The trail leads to Leakey Lake, my friend.
I went to find a lackey that works for Fusion Demongo, and it turned out to be Fusion Scotsman! I defeated him at Leaky Lake and collected one of Demongo's skulls. I used it to make a Demongo Nano.
It breaks me heart to learn that e'en a Fusion version of me is to be working with that foul creature, Fusion Demongo. Well, at least ye bested him. Ha ha ha!

When warriors go mysteriously missing, 'tis usually the work of Demongo, the Soul Stealer! Yet, Jack bested him not too long ago. I suspect Fusion Demongo 'tis the one responsible. One of his henchmen is told to live at Leakey Lake.
Head out to Leakey Lake.
Crikey! Wild Cogfish are surrounding us! Halllp!

When warriors go mysteriously missing, 'tis usually the work of Demongo, the Soul Stealer! Yet, Jack bested him not too long ago. I suspect Fusion Demongo 'tis the one responsible. One of his henchmen is told to live at Leakey Lake.
Return to General Tso.
Find Numbuh Four at Jungle Outpost.
Crikey! Ghoulish Growths are surrounding us! Halllp!
Glad you're here, mate! Ghoulish Growths are preparing to attack, and we're short-handed. Sure could use an assist!

When warriors go mysteriously missing, 'tis usually the work of Demongo, the Soul Stealer! Yet, Jack bested him not too long ago. I suspect Fusion Demongo 'tis the one responsible. One of his henchmen is told to live at Leakey Lake.
Defeat nine Wild Cogfish.
Great job! Can you come see me at the Jungle Outpost, mate?
Speak with Numbuh Four at the ol' Jungle Outpost upon Mt. Blackhead before ye continue onward. I suspect he knows a thing or two about Fusion Demongo's dastardly henchman.
Talk to Numbuh Four.
Thanks for the assist, mate! The monsters in this area are being controlled by a crazed Fusion in a kilt! If you could track him down, you'd save us all a heap of trouble. He's at Leakey Lake.
Good thing ye helped the KND. Know we know who to look for. Proceed to the Leakey Loch to find our quarry! Tread lightly; Leakey Lake is infected by Fuse beyond measure.
I've said it a thousand times: we eggplants have no problems with the chickens. If anything, tell General Tso that he needs to stop attacking US! What does he want, a chicken and eggplant WAR?
Go to Leakey Lake infected zone.
A monster in a kilt, eh? Could this'n be our boy?
Hmmm. I daresay that Billy is not going to be helping us in our pursuit of the Crazy Brain Candy. When you are done there, we should discuss our next course of action. -Edd
Navigate the infected zone to find the Fusion Portal that shall lead us to the devious creature that works with that Fusion most foul, Fusion Demongo!
Enter the Fusion Portal.
The Fusion's in the infected area, mate. Watch out. I hear he's a real ringer!
'Tis Fusion Scotsman, the vile fellow. I'm not surprised t'find him workin' for Fusion Demongo. Let's send him back from whence he came, lads!
Defeat Fusion Scotsman.
Look! 'Tis the Fusion Scotsman. He's working for Fusion Demongo!
Faith, ye did a bang-up job in there. Best be getting home, now.
Just as I thought. The eggplants claim innocence. But Mel Anzana thinks the Chickens From Outer Space are attacking the eggplants? Most curious. Thank you for the help, human. Bock, bock.

When warriors go mysteriously missing, 'tis usually the work of Demongo, the Soul Stealer! Yet, Jack bested him not too long ago. I suspect Fusion Demongo 'tis the one responsible. One of his henchmen is told to live at Leakey Lake.
Exit the area.
Grab that Demongo skull before ye leave.

When warriors go mysteriously missing, 'tis usually the work of Demongo, the Soul Stealer! Yet, Jack bested him not too long ago. I suspect Fusion Demongo 'tis the one responsible. One of his henchmen is told to live at Leakey Lake.
Talk to Numbuh Four.
Hey, I need to thank you in person before you go.
So that Fusion was a dark version of Samurai Jack's friend, the Scotsman? Yeesh! I don't think I'd want to mess with that guy, even on a good day. Sooper job!
You beat Fusion Scotsman? Pretty impressive.
Great work defeating Fusion Scotsman.
Any monster with a kilt is scary!
What's next? Turkeys From Outer Space?
I'm so proud of you for getting Fusion Scotsman!
Souls for Sale
Investigate an energy surge for Vilgax.
Fuse has the ability to create his own warriors in the form of Fusions. I must learn more. I want you to investigate an energy spike that I detected at Tech Square.

I went to Tech Square after Vilgax detected a strange energy signature. I learned from Ben that it was Fusion Demongo, who had his sights set on Area 51.5 near Nowhere. I went to Nowhere and defeated Fusion Vilgax, who was trying to revive a great alien being for Fusion Demongo to absorb.
Fuse's ability to duplicate the powers of others reminds me of the Omnitrix, a device that continues to elude my grasp. Fuse is a worthy adversary, indeed.

I have detected a strange energy surge in Tech Square. I want you to investigate immediately. Perhaps it has something to do with this Fusion Demongo, a being that can steal the souls of fallen warriors.
Go to Tech Square.
Hey, be careful! Fusion Demongo was just spotted in your area.

I have detected a strange energy surge at the space port. I want you to investigate immediately. Perhaps it has something to do with this Fusion Demongo, a being that can steal the souls of fallen warriors.
Keep up the good work in Nowhere.
Talk to Ben.
You're here for Vilgax? He must have learned about Fusion Demongo. That creature was just here, but we chased him off. Not sure what he wanted, but it can't be good.
Our "friend" Ben Tennyson has confirmed Fusion Demongo's presence in Tech Square. Defeat six Mech Queens to see if you can collect more information.
Defeat six Mech Queens.
Oh, indeed? Defeat the Mech Queens to collect more information.
Nice work taking out Fusion Ben and Fusion Gwen.
The Mech Queens you defeated in Tech Square dropped a Positioning Drive. Perhaps we will discover more information about Fusion Demongo, the one who absorbs the powers of other beings.
Deliver Positioning Drive to Vilgax.
Those creatures dropped a Positioning Drive. Bring it to me immediately.
This Positioning Drive indicates that Fusion Demongo was going to Nowhere. Speak to that ingrate Kevin Levin and see what he knows. He is also in Nowhere.
Bock, bock, bock!
The Positioning Drive you recovered indicates that Fusion Demongo is heading for Nowhere. You must speak to the teenage human called Kevin Levin. He is in Nowhere and will give us more information.
Talk to Kevin in Nowhere.
Fusion Demongo is one of Lord Fuse's most powerful minions. Anything to do with him is bad news. Proceed with caution.
Good thing you're here. Fusion Vilgax has been trying to awaken an alien monster so that Fusion Demongo can absorb its essence. You gotta go to the infected zone right away.
Proceed immediately to Area 51.5, the infected zone north of Nowhere. I want to find Fusion Vilgax and learn how he intends to deliver more power to the creature called Fusion Demongo.
Go to Area 51.5 infected zone.
You defeated Fusion Gwen AND Fusion Ben? Wow.
Please be careful.
Now that you have entered the infected zone inside Area 51.5, you must find the portal that leads to Fusion Vilgax's lair.
Find the Fusion Portal.
Chickens From Outer Space? Cool!
You are doing well. Find the Fusion Portal that leads to Fusion Vilgax's lair.

I remain mystified by the Fusions and even more curious about the soul-stealer, Fusion Demongo. Could it be that these creatures possess power that rivals that of the Omnitrix? Defeat Fusion Vilgax, and let us remind our foe who he is up against.
Defeat Fusion Vilgax.
Astounding. Fuse is even able to create a creature in my image.
Good work! Fusion Vilgax won't trouble us any more.
I remain mystified by the Fusions and even more curious about the soul-stealer, Fusion Demongo. Could it be that these creatures possess power that rivals that of the Omnitrix?
Exit the area.
Grab that fallen Armor Shard and get out of there.
I remain mystified by the Fusions and even more curious about the soul-stealer, Fusion Demongo. Could it be that these creatures possess power that rivals that of the Omnitrix?
Talk to Max.
Not by the hair of my chinny-chin-chin!
Chickens from Outer Space! (Part 2 of 3)
Excellent work out there. Come back and report to me.
You stopped Fusion Vilgax from completing his dark plan. Excellent. Even Vilgax must admit that Fuse is a terrifying foe. Now use that Armor Shard to create a Vilgax Nano.
Fusion Vilgax is no pushover.
Way to go. You defeated Fusion Vilgax!
I don't like people with tentacles on their face.
You defeated Fusion Vilgax! Everyone is talking about it!
Squirrel Squad
Stop the Vile Cabinets in City Station.
Oh, no! Those horrible Vile Cabinets in City Station are eating up harmless squirrels! They chase them and stick them inside their drawers. It's awful.

I rescued Bullet from the Vile Cabinets in City Station. Then I brought her to Numbuh Three at the Jungle Outpost. There, I went into the infected KND training area, where I fought and defeated Fusion Bubbles.
Find the fake Chickens From Outer Space.
Thanks for rescuing Bullet! She's the best squirrel ever. I can't believe Fuse's monsters would harm the peaceful city creatures. You really showed them!
Fuse's monsters are terrorizing harmless furry creatures. The Vile Cabinets in City Station are collecting squirrels and eating them! You need to put a stop to this.
Defeat eight Vile Cabinets.
You ready for a Nano? Go to City Station and save the animals from monsters!
Great job! Now those monsters will stop eating the cute little animals.
Hey, one of those monsters captured Bullet, our favorite super-powered squirrel! Is she okay? Bring her to me, please!
Bring Bullet to Bubbles.
Look! One of those villains captured Bullet! Is she all right?
You need to bring Bullet to Numbuh Three at the KND Jungle Outpost. She rescues woodland creatures. Just let me put on some bandages. You need to be fast!!
You saved Bullet, but she is injured! Bring her to Numbuh Three at the KND Jungle Outpost on Mt. Blackhead. You have to be really fast, or those bandages will come loose!
Why do the eggplants think the Chickens From Outer Space are attacking them? Isn't it obvious? Fuse! Find the monsters that are impersonating the chickens!
Deliver Bullet to the Jungle Outpost.
Get Fusion Max! And look for an item that might let you make a new Nano.
Oh, no! Bullet looks hurt. I'll fix her up. You know, I saw Fusion Bubbles with some Vile Cabinets inside our infected training area just the other day. Can you go check it out? Thanks!
Uh-oh. Bullet's bandages came loose. Come back to me at City Hall so I can tie her bandages again.
Return to Bubbles.
Uh-oh! Bullet's bandages are coming loose. You better come back to me.
Okay, she's all set. Don't waste any more time!
Thanks for bringing Bullet to Numbuh Three. She'll be able to make her better. Now you need to find Fusion Bubbles in the infected KND training area at the Jungle Outpost. I know you can do it.
Go to Outpost infected zone.
Find the Fusion Portal! Careful, it's really icky in there!
I defeated the fake Chickens From Outer Space.
Thanks for bringing Bullet to Numbuh Three. She'll be able to make her better. Now you need to find Fusion Bubbles in the infected KND training area. I know you can do it.
Enter Fusion Portal.
Oh, boy! More Vile Cabinets! Can you take care of them? Then you need to find Fusion Bubbles and tell her to stop hurting cute forest creatures with super powers.
Defeat ten Vile Cabinets.
Fusion Bubbles is here! And she's surrounded by those vile Vile Cabinets!
Great! Now you need to go after Fusion Bubbles.
Get rid of Fusion Bubbles! Maybe you'll even recover my stolen Octi, and you can make a Nano with it!
Defeat Fusion Bubbles.
Nano Time! You must rescue Robobradley from the monsters in Townsville Park!
Now that you defeated Fusion Bubbles, go back and talk to Numbuh Three. I want to make sure that Bullet is okay!
Good work tracking down those fowl impostors. You can't fool the Chickens From Outer Space! Bock, bock!
Exit the area.
Now that you defeated Fusion Bubbles, go back and talk to Numbuh Three. I want to make sure that Bullet is okay!
Talk to Numbuh Three.
You did an amazing job! Can you go check in with Numbuh Three?
Thanks for taking care of Fusion Bubbles. She won't be bothering us for a while. Now you can make a Bubbles Nano! Poor Bullet! She seems fine, now.
Wow, you saved a dumb squirrel.
You saved Bullet and defeated Fusion Bubbles!
I love super-powered squirrels!
Thanks for saving Bullet from nasty Fusion Bubbles!
Skunk Support
I have supplied the location here in the Catacombs where the Fuse chickens are supposedly located. Go find them.
Rescue Robobradley for the KND.
We have a situation! Asphalt Freaks have captured Numbuh Six, the cybernetic skunk known as Robobradley. Are you available to lead a rescue mission?

I tried to rescue Robobradley from the Asphalt Freaks in Townsville Park, but all I found were strange crystals. Turns out that Robobradley was being held in the Crystalline Caverns in the Pimpleback Mountains, and I saved him from Fusion Numbuh One.
Thank you for saving Numbuh Six. I will send Robobradley to Dexlabs to make sure he is no worse for wear. The KND thank you once again.
You need to locate the Asphalt Freaks here in Townsville Park that have captured Numbuh Six. I will send you their coordinates. Track them down and take care of business!
Defeat seven Asphalt Freaks.
Those creatures dropped a bag! Bring it here.
The Asphalt Freaks you defeated did not have Robobradley, but they did have a bag of…something. Bring it here so I may take a look.
Deliver bag to Numbuh One.
What's this? This sack contains nothing but strange crystals. Gads! Robobradley must be being held in the Crystalline Caverns, way out in the Pimpleback Mountains! You must go there!
Find the Fuse chickens.
Go out to the Pimpleback Mountains and look for Robobradley in the infected Crystalline Caverns. No doubt he has been captured by a Fusion! We must save Numbuh Six, AKA Robobradley!
Go into the Crystalline Caverns.
You will need to find the entrance to Fusion Numbuh One's hideout.
The Crystalline Caverns are beautiful to behold, but there is dangerous Fusion Matter about. Look for the lair of the Fusion that took Robobradley. Perhaps it is -- GASP! -- Fusion Numbuh One?!?
Enter the Fusion Portal.

You've rescued Robobradley! Numbuh 445 will make sure he goes straight to Dexlabs for a complete diagnostic. Now it's time to take down that no-good loser, Fusion Numbuh One! Show that imposter what it means to be a real Kid Next Door!
Defeat Fusion Numbuh One.
Can you bring those supplies back to me?
Get Fusion Numbuh One! Maybe you'll even get a new Nano.
You've found the dastardly Fusion's lair. And I've located Robobradley. The monsters have trapped him inside a crate. Poor little guy!
Stay alert. The faux chickens are close by.
Collect Robobradley from crate.
And look. They've trapped Robobradley in that crate. Poor Robobradley!
Good show! One of our operatives is standing by to collect Numbuh Six.
Very good, you've saved Numbuh Six! Please deliver him to our Pimpleback Mountains field operative, Numbuh 445. He will make sure that Robobradley gets home in one piece.
Deliver Robobradley to Numbuh 445.
Hold your nose!
Thanks for rescuing Robobradley from that no-good loser, Fusion Numbuh One! Please bring my glasses back to me.
Talk to Numbuh One.
Thanks for taking care of those Gravel Golems. Come on back to me in Sector V.
Thanks!
Now that you've found the monsters disguised as Chickens From Outer Space, you need to take them down. Defeat seven Fowl Fiends.
Good work in the Crystalline Caverns and all.
Great job rescuing Numbuh Six from Fusion Numbuh One!
I want to be a cyborg skunk when I grow up, don't you?
That was awesome when you rescued Robobradley!
Things Look Grim
Help Grim get a shrink ray.
I saw you collecting dem weird bananas at de skate park. I tink you can help me! I need a shrink ray to make new shrunken heads. Can you get one at Dexlabs?

Grim wanted a shrink ray to make more shrunken heads. I spoke to Dexter, who told me about his tests on Robobradley. Fuse is salvaging some kind of bizarre ancient tech from the infected zone in the Ruins! I went there and defeated Fusion Grim.
Please tell Dexter "tank you" for de shrink ray. It will save me lots of time! And I am most glad dat you were able to defeat Fusion Grim and make de new Nano.
I don't have de time to make more shrunken heads. I tink a shrink ray will be just de ting. Maybe you can get one from Dexlabs. Can you talk to dat brainy kid named Dexter about it?
Defeat seven Fowl Fiends.
Talk to Dexter.
So, you want a new Nano? Den how about getting me a shrink ray from Dexlabs?
Certainly, I would be happy to send a shrink ray to Grim. But I wonder if you can help me in return. After you rescued Robobradley, I conducted some tests.
Oh, I am so glad dat Dexter said he will send me de shrink ray. Now how about it you go to de Hani-Baba Ruins to help Dexter? Dere's a good child.
Go to the Ruins.

I've learned that Fuse has a new kind of Fusion Matter that he's using on animals. This strain of Fusion Matter contains ancient tech salvaged from the Hani-Baba Ruins in the wilderness. Can you investigate?
The monsters in this area will likely have traces of this new Fusion Matter.
You must defeat four Dagger Mantises before entering de Ruins infected zone. See if dey have de Fusion Matter type that Dexter is seeking.
Defeat four Dagger Mantises.
Locate the Dagger Mantises and defeat some to test my theory.
Help! Defeat the monsters behind my house to save my herb garden from destruction.
That Lee Kanker! Bless her heart!
Fuse is going to learn that he can't mess with the Chickens From Outer Space.
Indeed. I am detecting the same Fusion Matter that infected Robobradley.
Good work with dem Dagger Mantises. Now Dexter wants you to defeat six Necromashers. Can you do it?
Defeat six Necromashers.
I wonder if other creatures carry it as well? Defeat some Necromashers.
Just as I thought…well, you need to go to the heart of the matter.
Good work defeating de Dagger Mantises and de Necromashers! Enter de Ruins infected zone to find de Fusion Matter dat Dexter seeks.
Go to Ruins infected zone.
I want you to go into the infected zone. Fuse is salvaging the tech from there.
Be careful inside.
Dexter tinks dat a Fusion boss is running de salvage operation in de Hani-Baba Ruins. Enter de creature's lair to find out!
Not bad for a flightless human. Return to me for your reward.
Enter the Fusion Portal.
I am sure a devious Fusion is running the operation. Stay on your guard.
Defeat Fusion Grim! When you're done, maybe you will be able to make dat new Nano I told you about!!
Defeat Fusion Grim.
Oh, look at dat! It's a Fusion of Yours Truly! Get him!!
Excellent work. That should slow down Fuse's mining operation.
I don't have de time to make more shrunken heads. I tink a shrink ray will be just de ting. Maybe you can get one from Dexlabs. Can you talk to dat brainy kid named Dexter about it?
Exit the area.
Grab the head that the Fusion dropped and escape!
I don't have de time to make more shrunken heads. I tink a shrink ray will be just de ting. Maybe you can get one from Dexlabs. Can you talk to dat brainy kid named Dexter about it?
Well done, human. Come back to me and I will give you a reward.
Return to Dexter.
Come back to Dexlabs. I have something for you.
Excellent work in the mines. Here is a shrink ray that you can give to Grim.
I don't have de time to make more shrunken heads. I tink a shrink ray will be just de ting. Maybe you can get one from Dexlabs. Can you talk to dat brainy kid named Dexter about it?
Bring Shrink Ray to Grim.
Let's keep our eye on Fuse's activities. He's trying all kinds of tricks to make his monsters more powerful than ever!
Tanks for de shrink ray! You can keep dat shrunken head dat you found. I can make me own. Maybe use it to make a Grim Nano!
Wow, crazy animals. I'm so scared.
Good work taking out that Fuse mining operation.
Thanks for getting Fusion Grim for me!
Talk to General Tso.
You were really brave at the Crystalline Caverns.
Plant Problems
Help recover Max's laptop.
I was recently studying the effects of Fusion Matter on plants at Galaxy Gardens. Unfortunately, I was chased out and lost my laptop deep in the Fissure.

I recovered Grandpa Max's laptop from the Fissure. When I tried to deliver it to Dexbot Q-12, however, I discovered that he was sabotaged by Fusion Max! I defeated him and recovered an Alien Barbell, which I can use to make a Fourarms Nano.
Thanks for getting my laptop to Dexter. Maybe you should follow up on his lead and talk to Mojo Jojo about the unusual Fusion Bananas at Galaxy Gardens.

I have been studying the effects of Fusion Matter on plant life. I was taking readings at Galaxy Gardens when I was noticed by a squad of Sky Drones. I barely escaped and took cover inside the Fissure here in the park. Unfortuantely, I lost my laptop!
Recover Max's laptop.
I lost my laptop somewhere inside the Fissure. Please find it.
That's it! I'm so glad you found it. I've got lots of useful data on there.
Thank you. I won't tolerate this type of behavior from Fuse. No one gives the Chickens From Outer Space a bad name! Anyway, here's your prize.
Uh-oh! Fusion Max has captured Dexter! You need to find out where Fusion Max is hiding. Sounds like he's here in Townsville Park.
Go to Dexlabs.
Urgent! Fusion Max has captured me inside Townsville Park!
Deliver map to Bloo.
Fusion Max's lair is inside the Fissure. I should have guessed. Quickly, get moving. You need to rescue Dexter.
Enter the Fusion Gate.
Fusion Max has captured Dexter and is guarding him with Shady Streetlights! You'd better defeat six of them.
Defeat six Shady Streetlights.
You're finally here! These Shady Streetlights have me trapped! Get them!!

I have been studying the effects of Fusion Matter on plant life. I was taking readings at Galaxy Gardens when I was noticed by a squad of Sky Drones. I barely escaped and took cover inside the Fissure here in the park. Unfortuantely, I lost my laptop!
Fight any space chickens lately?
Go to the Fissure.
Been nice playing with you! Now Edd wants you to take this treasure map to Bloo down at Dizzy World in City Point. Good luck! Don't fall in a goo puddle!
Fusion Max is extremely clever, even for a Fusion! Defeat him, and whatever you do, don't let him get his hands on Dexter or that laptop!
Defeat Fusion Max.
Anyhoo, Edd wants you to take this treasure map to Bloo down at Dizzy World! I'll send something cool for you if you do it! Remember to watch out for the Destroyusalls.
Good work defeating those Shady Streetlights. Talk to Dexter and find out what happened. Make sure you give him my laptop.
Talk to Dexter.
Thank you for this laptop. Max's plant research is similar to Mojo Jojo's recent work with Fusion Matter and bananas. But enough of that…you need to take on Fusion Max! I cannot go on.
Great. You defeated Fusion Max and safely delivered my laptop to Dexter. Get on out of there and rendezvous with me outside. And don't forget to use that Alien Barbell to create a new Nano.
Exit the area.
Nowhere is a much safer place, thanks to you.
Did you pick up that Alien Barbell that Fusion Max dropped?
Great. You defeated Fusion Max and safely delivered my laptop to Dexter. Get on out of there and rendezvous with me outside. And don't forget to use that Alien Barbell to create a new Nano.
Talk to Grandpa Max.
Come and see me, please.
You want me to do what? Sure, give me that map and I'll look at it later. I've got more important stuff to deal with! Oh, some kid named Billy sent you a giant sword.
Going Bananas
Recover Mojo's Fusion Bananas.
Yes, I am experimenting with Fusion Bananas that I have recovered from Galaxy Gardens. But someone stole them from me and hid them down in Orchid Bay!

I collected some Fusion Bananas from Orchid Bay. Mojo has been feeding them to his minions. The monkeys that ate them turned into monsters and disappeared inside the infected sand castle at Bravo Beach. I went and defeated them all!
If Fuse thinks he can steal my minions with Fusion Bananas, he will have to think twice, and possibly three or four times! No one messes with me, Mojo Jojo!
Who you calling chicken?

I sent my minions to Galaxy Gardens to collect Fusion Bananas, and when they returned with the Fusion Bananas I let them eat the Fusion Bananas. But now the Fusion Bananas have disappeared, and I want to find those Fusion Bananas. Recover my misplaced Fusion Bananas from the infected skate park in Orchid Bay. Then I will have some more Fusion Bananas and we can study the effects of these Fusion Bananas.
Collect the Fusion Bananas.
It is time for a Nano! If you want this Nano, go to the infected zone in Orchid Bay.
Now that you have the Fusion Bananas, return to me with the Fusion Bananas!

Now that you have recovered those Fusion Bananas, bring those Fusion Bananas back to me, Mojo Jojo! And whatever you do, do not bring them to my minion, the one who is also located here at my volcano, named Boomer Bango!
Deliver the Fusion Bananas.
Hey! Don't bring those bananas to Mojo! Bring them to me, Boomer Bango!
All the monkeys who ate these Fusion Bananas went to find Fusion Mojo at Bravo Beach. They have gone bananas! That's why I hid the Fusion Bananas at the skate park in Orchid Bay.

So, the Fusion Bananas have caused my minions to go bananas and join up with Fusion Mojo Jojo? This will not be tolerated! You must proceed to the infected sand castle at Bravo Beach to teach Fusion Mojo Jojo that he cannot steal my minions. I believe I have been clear about this point!
Go to infected sand castle.
Chickens are so soft and cute and feathery!
You will find them at the infected sand castle!
The Fusion Bananas have turned my own minions against me! You must now find Fusion Mojo Jojo's lair inside the sand caslte, and eliminate this inferior knockoff version of me, Mojo Jojo!
Find the Fusion Portal.
Now you must find the entrance to Fusion Mojo Jojo's lair.

Before you can launch your attack against Fusion Mojo Jojo, you must first defeat 12 angry Spawn Simians. To think that these creatures used to be my faithful minions! And now they are the minions of Fusion Mojo Jojo. This angers me! And makes me mad.
Defeat twelve Spawn Simians.
Look! Mojo's minions have turned into monsters! Attack!
You win! I never want to see those Fusion Bananas again.

Let us review: you recovered the Fusion Bananas that I thought were stolen, but were actually hidden by my faithful minion, Boomer Bango, who learned that the Fusion Bananas were turning my minions into Fusion Mojo Jojo's minions, which is why he hid the Fusion Bananas in the first place. Oh, forget it. Just beat up Fusion Mojo Jojo.
Defeat Fusion Mojo.
Chickens from Outer Space! (Part 3 of 3)
Aw, yeah! Bang! Boom!

Now that you have defeated Fusion Mojo, return to me, Mojo Jojo, the real Mojo Jojo! And don't forget to take the White Glove so that you can make a Nano when you have successfully completed this mission.
Exit the area.
I hate to see minions go to waste. Hurry up and return to me, Mojo Jojo!

Now that you have defeated Fusion Mojo, return to me, Mojo Jojo, the real Mojo Jojo! And don't forget to take the White Glove so that you can make a Nano when you have successfully completed this mission.
Return to Mojo.
Stop all this dawdling and dillydallying. Come back to the volcano!
It would appear that these Fusion Bananas turn ordinary minions into monstrous minions! Get these Fusion Bananas out of my sight! And keep that White Glove, because I do not want that, either!

Now that you have defeated Fusion Mojo, return to me, Mojo Jojo, the real Mojo Jojo! And don't forget to take the White Glove so that you can make a Nano when you have successfully completed this mission.
Deliver bananas to Dexter.
Hamburger Helper
Rescue the Chickens From Outer Space.
Hey, bring those Fusion Bananas to me. I want to study them.
These Fusion Bananas have interesting properties. I think I might be able to reverse engineer them into something that might be quite harmful to Fuse. Good job!
Monkeys and bananas. How hilarious.
Great job defeating Fusion Mojo at Galaxy Gardens!
Hey, I heard about those Fusion Monkeys!
Thanks for defeating Fusion Mojo and teaching him a lesson.
Lab Monkeys
Help Dexter with a key experiment.
The Fusion Bananas Mojo found have interesting properties. I think I might be able to reverse engineer them into something that might be quite harmful to Fuse.

I took Fusion Bananas to the Dark Engine and supersaturated them with Fusion Matter. Though they became dangerous to Fuse's monsters, they were not very appetizing. So I returned to Galaxy Gardens and recovered a Bananaflange from Fusion Dexter and Fusion Computress.
In retaliation for our recent attack, Fuse has taken a number of my people hostage inside the Catacombs. You must save them!
Excellent. I think I have now figured out a way to make toxic Fusion Bananas. If we drop these on Monkey Mountain, we're sure to give Fuse a stomachache.

I want you to help me test a theory. If we supersaturate the Fusion Bananas with Fusion Matter, we may make them toxic to Fuse. I want you to bring these Fusion Bananas back to Galaxy Gardens. To supersaturate the Fusion Bananas, you must place them near a very toxic area of the infected zone. I will send the coordinates to you.
Supersaturate Fusion Bananas.
It is Nano Time. Proceed to the Galaxy Gardens infected zone!
Very good. Let them cook for a while.
While the infected area's natural toxicity supersaturates those Fusion Bananas with Fusion Matter, defeat six Horror Kings in the vicintiy to prevent them from tampering with our plans.
Defeat six Horror Kings.
Take care of those Horror Kings and don't let them tamper with our experiment.
Good work! Now go retrieve the Fusion Bananas.
Recover the Fusion Bananas from where you placed them before. They should now be supersaturated with Fusion Matter.
I helped rescue the chicken hostages inside the catacombs.
Retrieve Fusion Bananas.
Looks good.
Now that we have supersaturated the Fusion Bananas with Fusion Matter, I want you to take them to Boomer Bango at Mojo's Volcano for a quick field test.
Bring bananas to Boomer Bango.
Bring those to Boomer Bango for a quick field test.
Ugh! These things smell awful! I would rather eat rotten fruit soaked in fish oil. Blech! Are you trying to turn me into a Fusion minion?

The supersaturated Fusion Bananas are totally unappetizing. If we want Fuse's monsters to eat them, we need to make them taste better. I know something that will do the trick: a Bananaflange that I used to use on Monkey. Return to the Galaxy Gardens infected zone.
Return to Galaxy Gardens infected zone.
As I feared. I have a solution, though, as always. Go back to Galaxy Gardens.
Thank you, adventurer. I will deliver this Banaflange to Dexter immediately.
My people were kidnapped, and you rescued them. You are most courageous, especially for a human. Now you are dismissed. Bock.

Fusion Dexter is lurking somewhere inside the infected area at Galaxy Gardens. He stole the Bananaflange from my old lab. It is up to you to retrieve it. Look for the Fusion Portal that leads to his lair.
Find Fusion Portal.
Fusion Dexter is here, and he stole the Bananaflange from my old lab.
You have found Fusion Dexter's lair. But watch out! Fusion Computress is there as well. She has the Bananaflange that we need. Get her!
Defeat Fusion Computress.
There's Fusion Computress! Defeat her to collect the Bananaflange.
Excellent work. Find Dexbot Q-101. He will bring the Bananaflange to me.
You have done an amazing job today. Now it is time for the final challenge: defeat Fusion Dexter. If you can best him, you will recover my Power Wrench and be able to make a new Nano in my image!
Defeat Fusion Dexter.
Now you must defeat Fusion Dexter. I know you can do this!
Human! You must go to the Caponata Catacombs and rescue the hostages.
Wow, you beat two Fusions at once. Yawn.

You've defeated Fusion Computress and collected the Bananaflange. Please bring it to Dexbot Q-101. With the Bananaflange, I will be able to make the supersaturated Fusion Bananas more appetitizng to Fuse's monsters.
Deliver Bananaflange to Dexbot Q-101.

You've defeated Fusion Computress and Fusion Dexter. You have the Bananaflange as well as a wrench that you can use to make a Dexter Nano. I'd say that your mission has been accomplished. Return to Dexlabs.
Return to Dexter.
Bring me the Bananaflange and the supersaturated Fusion Bananas. I'm waiting.
Well done. I can use this Banaflange to make the supersaturated Fusion Bananas more appetitizng to Fuse's monsters. Keep my old wrench and make a Nano for yourself.
You did great in Galaxy Gardens. Yippee.
I'm impressed with your combat performance at Galaxy Gardens.
Can I use a Bananaflange on chopped liver?
Proceed to the catacombs.
Way to beat Fusion Computress and Fusion Dexter!
Leaderbored
Find Bloo's stolen juicebox.
Have you played Sumo Slammer Online? Someone just beat my top score! I hate that! I need to practice, practice, practice. But more than that, I need my juice!
I tried to find Bloo's stolen juicebox. I defeated monsters throughout the amusement park, but finally recovered his stolen beverage from Fusion Bloo in the Dizzy World infected zone.
On second thought, what I really need is a snack. Glad you got yourself a new Nano. If you find out who "Omnitrixter" is, let me know right away.
If I'm going to get to the top of the Sumo Slammer Online leaderboards, I need to stay in the zone. Can you find my stolen juicebox? You'll need to beat up some monsters to get it back.
Defeat four Dynamite Mice.
Nope. Those little rodents didn't take my juicebox.
If I'm going to get to the top of the Sumo Slammer Online leaderboards, I need to stay in the zone. Can you find my stolen juicebox? You'll need to beat up some monsters to get it back.
The monsters are about! Get ready to do what you do best.
Defeat five Fire Hydrants.
How about beating up some Fire Hydrants?
Let's see…nope! No juicebox. Hmmm.
If I'm going to get to the top of the Sumo Slammer Online leaderboards, I need to stay in the zone. Can you find my stolen juicebox? You'll need to beat up some monsters to get it back.
Defeat six Destroyusalls.
How about those Destroyusalls? I'll bet they took it!
Nope! Well, I'm fresh out of ideas.
Those stupid monsters didn't have my juicebox. You'd better go into the infected zone and look for it. I'll wait here and send you professional pointers from the sidelines.
Go to Dizzy World infected area.
Wait…maybe you should go to the super dangerous infected area!
Go get those Fowl Fiends again. They have a key that you will need before you start looking for the hostages.
Go inside there and look for somebody really tough and scary.
I'll bet a Fusion monster took my juicebox! Now that you're in the infected area, look for a Fusion Portal. As for me, I'm going to rest in light of my game-related injuries.
Enter the Fusion Portal.
Only a tough and scary Fusion would dare to steal my juicebox.
Well, you've found Fusion Bloo. Clearly, he's the one who stole my juicebox. Have at it, kid! I'm sooo thiiirsty!
Defeat Fusion Bloo.
Agggh! A giant Fusion Bloo! Beat him up. I need to get back to Sumo Slamming.
Thank you for your assistance! Please bring Max's laptop to me.
You defeated Fusion Bloo and got my juicebox back. You're the best. Hurry up, I'm sooooo thiiiiirsty.
Exit the area.
Defeat the Fowl Fiends.
Well, grab my juicebox and get back here.
You defeated Fusion Bloo and got my juicebox back. You're the best. Hurry up, I'm sooooo thiiiiirsty.
Return to Bloo.
What's taking you so long?
You know what? This juicebox is warm. I don't want it. You can have it. I could really go for some pretzels or something. Got any pretzels? Now excuse me while I get back to Sumo Slamming.
Fusion Bloo looks like a cactus.
Excellent work taking down Fusion Bloo.
Next time you're at Dizzy World, go on the ferris wheel!
I'm so proud of you for defeating Fusion Bloo!
Leet Cheats
Take them out and see if you can recover a key to the hostages' prison. Bock.
Help Mandark find his rival.
Someone called "Omnitrixter" has just bested me at Sumo Slammer Online. This will not do! I am the best at this game, bar none. We need to find this cheater!

I helped Mandark activate tracking devices at Morbucks Towers to locate his online rival. But someone was tampering with his equipment, and it was none other than Fusion Mandark. I defeated this villain and collected Mandark's glasses to make a Nano.
I have tracked the "Omnitrixter" signal to the space port in Offworld Plaza. You should go there and find this cretin. Remind him that I am not one to be trifled with!

I refuse to be beated at Sumo Slammer Online by someone called "Omnitrixter". We must find out who this person is! Place three Signal Trackers at Morbucks Towers, and I will be able to trace the source! Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha!
Activate first Signal Tracker.
Do you want a new Nano? Go to the Morbucks Towers infected zone right now!
Good! Now activate the second Signal Tracker. Ha!
Now that you have entered the infected zone at Morbucks Towers, you must activate three signal trackers so I can trace this "Omnitrixter" and his signal! Only two more to go.
Activate the second Signal Tracker.
Clear a path from the Park-n-Flush down to the Ed's fort.
Good. Now you need to head deep into enemy territory to find the hostages.
Ha ha! Now place the third and final Signal Tracker.
Now that you have entered the infected zone at Morbucks Towers, you must activate three signal trackers so I can trace this "Omnitrixter" and his signal! Only one more to go.
Activate final Signal Tracker.
Ha.
Good! Now all I need to do is triangulate the atmospheric parameters…

You have successfully activated all three Signal Trackers. But someone is jamming MY signal from inside Morbucks Towers! Who would have the gall? Find this interloper immediately. I am certain that it is a Fusion.
Find Fusion Portal.
Wait! Someone is inside Morbucks Towers…and they are jamming MY signal!
So, you have entered a Fusion's lair, and you have found…what? My Mandroids? Who would dare steal my Mandroids? Well, they are of no use to me now. Defeat eight of them, please.
Defeat eight Mandroids.
You will need to go deeper into the Catacombs to see if you can find the trapped chickens.
Look! Someone has hijacked my precious Mandroids. Stop them!
My babies! Someone will pay…dearly. Or at the very least: monthly.
So, the one responsible is none other than Fusion Mandark. And I thought Dexter might be to blame. Very well. Destroy him!
Defeat Fusion Mandark.
I should have guessed: Fusion Mandark! Defeat him! Ha ha ha ha ha!
Ha! Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha!
So, Fusion Mandark was tampering with my Signal Tracking system. Too bad for him that you were around. Come out of there and let's see where the signal was coming from.
Exit the area.
Get out of there and return to Mandark Industries.
So, Fusion Mandark was tampering with my Signal Tracking system. Too bad for him that you were around. Come out of there and let's see where the signal was coming from.
Go deeper into the Catacombs
Return to Mandark.
Come back to Mandark Industries and see me. I have located "Omnitrixter".
I have tracked "Omnitrixter" to the space port! He will regret the day he bested me at Sumo Slammer Online. Ha ha ha! Oh, you may keep those glasses and use them to make a Nano.
I hate Sumo Slammer Online.
Way to beat Fusion Mandark at Morbucks Towers.
You've got smooth moves!
I'm going to tell everyone how you defeated Fusion Mandark!
Alien Abductions
Stop Fuse's plans to make alien Fusions.
You found me. I'm none other than "Omnitrixter" -- the best Sumo Slammer Online player ever. But we've got bigger problems. Fusion Gwen is causing trouble.
Good gravy! The hostages are being guarded by those Fowl Freaks!

I helped Ben recover objects that Fusion Gwen stole from his alien alteregos. Then I tracked Fusion Gwen to the infected area of the space port, only to learn that she was working together with Fusion Ben!
Thanks for getting all that stuff back. Keep the Swamp Root to make a Swampfire Nano. Hopefully my Omnitrix will start working properly again soon.

I'd much rather be playing Sumo Slammer Online, but there's more important stuff to do. Every time I manage to get my Omnitrix to work, Fusion Gwen appears out of nowhere to steal something from me. I'm worried she's trying to make Fusions of my alien alteregos. You need to get my stuff back from the monsters in Steam Alley. Defeat the Putrid Spawns to recover what they stole.
Defeat the Putrid Spawns.
Hey, it's time for a new Nano! You need to get to Steam Alley, pronto.
Good work! Now you need to find the Oil Ogres.
Good work defeating those Putrid Spawns. Now you need to go after the Oil Ogres to get back what they stole from me.
Defeat the Oil Ogres.
The last time I managed to become Spidermonkey, they stole some of his fur.
Cool! Now you need to get back a Jetray Talon.
You need to clear out those Fowl Freaks before it is safe to save the chickens. Bock!
Great work defeating the Putrid Spawns and Oil Ogres. Can you take down the Gear Goliaths to recover one more piece of stolen alien property?
Defeat the Gear Goliaths.
Look for the Gear Goliaths that stole it.
Awesome. Can you bring those items to me?
You need to enter the Offworld Plaza infected zone to find Fusion Gwen. She stole a Swamp Root from Swampfire. If you can get it back, you might be able to make a Swampfire Nano!
Go to Offworld Plaza infected zone.
A-ha. Fusion Gwen didn't have Swampfire's Swamp Root. It's Fusion Ben! Looks like you'll need to defeat him as well to get my property back. Then you can make a Swampfire Nano.
You need to find the Fusion Portal that leads to Fusion Gwen. Good luck.
Find the portal inside the Offworld Plaza infected zone that leads to Fusion Gwen.
Enter Fusion Portal.
Defeat eight Fowl Freaks.
You found Fusoin Gwen! Take her down and recover Swampfire's stolen Swamp Root.
Defeat Fusion Gwen.
There she is. Look out!
Great. But where's Swampfire's Swamp Root?
Defeat Fusion Ben.
Oh, man. It's Fusion Ben! Are you ready for him?
Great work. You better get out of there.

Fuse has sent Caterplugs to the area to reinforce the positions around those Terrafusers. You need to defeat six Caterplugs to keep the enemy at bay.
Defeat six Caterplugs.
Hey, is Fuse giving you a hard time out there? Don't worry, Numbuh Two says that you're doing great. Once I hear from Grandpa Max, I'll let you know. Keep it up! -Ben
Nice work! Come back and I'll get you some more gear.
Good job defeating those Caterplugs. Come back to me and I'll hook you up with some more KND gear.
Return to Numbuh Two.
Good work! We need to make sure those Terrafusers don't spread Fuse's infection everywhere. But we've got more to worry about. The enemy is hiding out all over the Suburbs.
Caterplugs are wimps.
Nice job taking down those Caterplugs!
Wow, that info from the Plumber data miner was interesting. Seems like Planet Fusion has been terrorizing the galaxy for almost a thousand years!
One time I ate a Caterplug. It was gross.
Thanks for protecting Sector V!
Bugs and Earplugs
Get special gear from Genius Grove.
Ben wants you to access hidden Plumber bases, but they are equipped with a high-frequency sonic security system. You need special gear to protect yourself!
I collected the Sonic Earplugs from the infected zone in Genius Grove, but there was only one. So I had to defeat some Tech Wings to get the other earplug.
Now that you have the special Sonic Earplugs, you should be ready to access the secret Plumber bases for Ben and Grandpa Max. I love secret spy stuff!

If you access those Plumber bases without protecting your ears, the high-frequency sonic security system will melt your brain! You need to go to the infected zone in Genius Grove to collect a special pair of Sonic Earplugs.
Go to Genius Grove infected zone.
Once you have the Sonic Earplugs, I'll send you special access codes for the hidden Plumber bases. I can upload them directly to your NanoCom. Go see Numbuh Two when you're done in Genius Grove. -Ben
You need to head over to the junkyard and find the access port. Remember where it is? Ben will contact you with further instructions.
Are you ready for some slime?
The Sonic Earplugs that you need can be found inside the Genius Grove infected zone. Do you think Mandark invented them?
Collect Sonic Earplugs.
Enter the infected zone and find those earplugs!
Oops. There's only one earplug. Fuse's monsters must have stolen the other one.
You need to exit the infected area to find the Tech Wings that stole the other earplug.
Defeat Tech Wings.
You need to leave the infected zone to find the Tech Wings that are responsible.
Good! You got the Sonic Earplugs.
Now that you have the Sonic Earplugs, bring them back to me and I'll be sure that you're wearing them properly.
Head to the salvage yard.
Deliver earplugs to Numbuh Two.
Now bring them back to me and I'll make sure you put them in right.
Cool. Now you should be protected when you find those Plumber bases. Ben sent me this cool mask. You can have it. It's not my style!
Galactic Enforcers are silly.
Good work getting the Sonic Earplugs.
I have lots of earwax!
Nice job in Genius Grove!
Blossom Battle
Defeat monsters in Sector V.
Dexter says he wants me to help you out on a special mission. Well, I need to make sure that you know how to handle yourself. Can you show me what you got?

Ready for another mission? This should be fun. Numbuh Two has a thumb drive that Max wants you to use to download the data from the data miner. First, you need to syncronize the access ports, starting with the one in the junkyard. -Ben
I defeated a bunch of Ultramagno Beetles in Sector V, and Blossom told me that I was ready for the challenges ahead.
You made short work of those Ultramagno Beetles. I guess you're pretty tough! Are you ready to crack the case of the missing superheroes?
Dexter wants us to help him with a special assignment. If you're going to work with me, I need to make sure that you know what you're doing. Go to Sector V and take out a squad of Ultramagno Beetles.
Defeat nine Ultramagno Beetles.

Greetings. Blossom has agreed to help me with a special mission. I want you to work with her on it. She's going to test your battle skills, so show her that you have the right stuff! I will contact you again soon. -Dexter
Good. I see you've been through training!
Those Ultramagno Beetles will regret the day they messed with you! Come back and see me for a reward, and we can talk about Dexter's special assignment.
Talk to Blossom.
You're done, so come back and see me.
Good work. Dexter reports that superheroes all over the world have been disappearing. We need to work together to see if we can get to the bottom of the mystery.
Cool. You remember where the access port is, right? Go find it!
I could take down Blossom. Totally.
Good work defeating those Ultramagno Beetles.
I wanna drive a racecar!
Thanks for protecting Sector V from the Ultramagno Beetles.
Spooky Spies
Defeat the spies in Eternal Vistas.
The graveyard is crawling with Fuse's spies. We need to take them out, or they'll start figuring out our secrets. Can you go to Eternal Vistas?
I defeated a bunch of Spookas in Eternal Vistas.
Good work. We cannot allow Fuse to get his hands on any of our top-secret secrets! You did great. Now I have a personal favor to ask.
You need to go to Eternal Vistas to defeat a small squad of Spookas.
Talk to Marie.
For security, the access ports need to be syncronized within a time limit. Get the one in the junkyard, then make a break for Peach Creek.
Defeat seven Spookas.
Blossom really knows what she is doing. Without her, the Suburbs would have fallen to Fuse a long time ago. Keep helping her out and I will send new information as soon as I receive it. -Dexter
Great! Come back to me and I’ll give you some more cool stuff.
Thanks for taking out those Spookas. Come back and see me as soon as you are ready.
Talk to Blossom.
Thanks for clearing out those monsters. You did a fantastic job. Would you like these red Dynamo boots? I don't wear them very often.
Spooky spies in the graveyard? Neat.
You really did well against those Spookas in the cemetery.
I'm scared of graveyards!
Thanks for saving us from the scary spooks!
Touch the first access port.
Ed-vanced Combat
Help Numbuh Two in Sector V.
Numbuh Two is complaining that the ice cream ammo is gone, though I suspect he ate it. And now he's having problems with monsters. Can you help?
I spoke to Numbuh Two and helped him defeat a number of Caterplugs in Sector V.
Sure enough, Numbuh Two ate the ice cream ammo before he could use it. Well, thanks for helping him out. We need to keep the KND in our customer file.
Numbuh Two says he's all out of ice cream ammo again, even though you just brought him some. And now Sector V is overrun with Fuse's creatures. Better go talk to Numbuh Two.
Talk to Numbuh Two.
I'm so glad you're back. I accidentally ran out of the ice cream ammo you brought…BURP! Can you please help me take care of the Caterplugs in the area? Thanks!
You need to help Numbuh Two by defeating eight Caterplugs in Sector V.
Defeat eight Caterplugs.
Head to the other access port in the housing development! Quick!
Did Numbuh Two truly eat all that ice cream? Wow!
Thanks! I knew I could count on you.
Good work defending Sector V from infestation. Please come back to Hero Square now.
Return to Ranger Ralphie.
Please come back to Hero Square and I'll reward you.
Gracious! The KND really use a lot of ice cream ammo, but that's what keeps Eddy in business. Good work!
I'm lactose intolerant.
Thanks for helping the KND.
I want some ice cream!!
You did great helping the guys in Sector V.
The clock is ticking! You need to access the Plumber access port in Peach Creek as fast as you can.
Spex Trek
Find Billy in Endsville.
If Fuse knows about the Crazy Brain Candy, we could be in big trouble. This map leads to Endsville. Talk to Billy. Careful -- his brains are already scrambled.
I went to find Billy in Endsville, and he agreed to look at the map if I brought him his prescription X-Ray Spex from the infected zone in Genius Grove.
Good work. I'm glad that you found Billy. Now you need to persuade him to read that map! Those spectacles make me skeptical…but see what he can do.
The map you pilfered from the Sweet Revenge leads to Endsville. Bring it to Billy, and see if he can tell you where the next treasure lies.
Take map to Billy.
Hi-de-ho, bucko! Sure thing, I'll look at yer treasure map. But I need my prescription X-Ray Spex to read it. Can you go get 'em from Genius Grove?
Sigh…Billy needs his prescription X-Ray Spex to read the map. You need to go to the infected zone in Genius Grove.
Go to Genius Grove infected zone.
Touch the second access port.
I losted 'em somewhere inside the infected zone near that kooky Mandark's house.
If you can go in there and jump around and stuff, you'll find my Spex!
Watch out for the Fusion Matter and the monsters and the other hazardous things. Make your way to the box that houses Billy's X-Ray Spex.
Collect the X-Ray Spex.
Whoo-ee! You got 'em! Please bring them back to me, okay?
Bring Billy his prescription X-Ray Spex so he can read that map.
Bring Spex to Billy.
Thanks, buddy! Now let's see…read the map, read the map. This thing looks pretty funny. But I think you'll find your buried treasure nearby! Want a reward? Sure you do!
Wing and a Prayer
Collect Fusion Matter samples for Mojo.
Great work. Now find the secret data miner. It's inside the trailer park.
Mojo Jojo has a request. Apparently he is working on a very secret experiment. I have no interest in such things. But he would like you to go back to Genius Grove.
I collected Fusion Matter samples from the Tech Wings in Genius Grove.
Thank you for collecting the Fusion Matter samples for Mojo. I will send them to him right away. Now maybe he will leave me alone.
Mojo Jojo wants you to go back to Genius Grove to collect Fusion Matter samples from the Tech Wings. They are the flying creatures buzzing around.
Defeat the Tech Wings.

I am interested in how Fusion Matter works with animals. I will tell you why later, but not now! Now I want Father to make sure that you help me. And if you don't help me, then Father is no help to me. Curse those who don't help me…Mojo Jojo! -Mojo
Good. That should be enough to give to the monkey. Please come back.
Now that you have collected the Fusion Matter samples for Mojo, bring them to me and will send them to him.
Deliver Fusion Matter samples.
Good. I'll send these to Mojo. I'm amazed at how persistent you are. Take this reward.
You have to find the Plumber data miner in the trailer park before time runs out, or the security systems will reset the database.
Who cares about Fusion Matter samples?
Great job defeating the Tech Wings.
I hate flying monsters!
Thanks for making Genius Grove a safer place.
Blood Feud
Defeat monsters in Eternal Vistas.
I'm told that the spooky monsters in Eternal Vistas are more aggressive towards children. I'll admit that my curiousity is piqued. Care to test the theory?
I went to Eternal Vistas and defeated the Bloodsuckers.
Yes, it would appear that the supernatural creatures in the cemetery are no match for children like you. How very…disappointing.
I want to test a theory. Go to Eternal Vistas and fight the Bloodsuckers. I want see if they really are more aggressive towards children.
Find the data miner.
Defeat eight Bloodsuckers.

It has become obvious that Father is intentionally putting you in harm's way. Which means he wants you to get hurt on purpose! But I need more help with my Fusion Matter experiments. You are useful to me, and Father is proving to be the opposite of useful to me. -Mojo
Well, how…interesting. Come back to me and I will reward you.
Now that the Bloodsuckers are dispatched, return to me for something of value.
Return to Father.
Perhaps you will be of more use when you grow up. As such, I will give you this pair of BRA boots. Everyone needs a set of Battle Ready Armor.
I was hoping that Eternal Meadows would get a new resident.
Spooky creeps are no match for a strong kid.
Don't get eaten by a monster!
Please save us from the Bloodsuckers.
Nice. Return to the Plumber base in the housing development to get a reward.
High Jinx
Equip City Station with Descrambler.
Fuse is toying with our communication devices and making it difficult for me to stay in touch with Ben. Can you go to City Station and place this Descrambler?
I went to City Station and jumped my way to one of the tallest buildings Downtown. Then I placed a Descrambler for Grandpa Max to protect our communication devices.
Good job. The Descrambler should prevent Fuse from sabotaging our main systems. But you won't believe this. Now I can't find my satellite phone.

Fuse is trying to scramble our communications signals at City Station. I've given you a Descrambler that you can use to thwart his plan. Head out to City Station. You'll need to get up to one of the tallest buildings to place the Descrambler.
Go to City Station target area.
I'm having a hard time reaching Grandpa Max. I wish I had a NanoCom! See if you can help him fix our communications units at City Station. -Ben
I've sent you to a jump pad that you can use to reach the top of the building.
I've sent you the coordinates. Place the Descrambler at the top of the building. You can use the jump pads to reach it.
While Ben sends the data to Grandpa Max for analysis, you can go back to Peach Creek to collect a reward. Aw yeah!
Place the Descrambler.
Great. Communications are back online.
Thanks for placing the Descrambler. Fuse will have a difficult time getting past it. Come back to me and I'll give you a reward.
Return to Grandpa Max.
Come back to the Fissure. Ben sent you a reward.
You did great out there. The view from the top of City Station is pretty spectacular, no? Well, take this gear that Ben sent. I'm sure you will find it useful.
Stay off of my roof.
Great job placing the Descrambler at City Station.
I fell off a building once!
I heard how you jumped through
You are amazing. The Eds will never know we're coming. Soon we will be inside their fort…and their hearts. Swoon!
Return to Peach Creek.
Nowhere to Go
Investigate a signal in Nowhere.
There's some unusual atmospheric disturbance being generated in Nowhere. We need to figure out what it is, or Max won't be able to launch his satellite.
I fought strange eggplant monsters in Nowhere and discovered a crashed ship from Anurphaetos. I turned off the jamming signal so Max could launch his satellite into orbit.
Nice work out in the middle of Nowhere. Now that we've cleared up that atmospheric disturbance, we need to find the other half of that energy cell for Max.
I need you to go to Nowhere to investigate some strange energy.
Go to Nowhere.

Max cannot launch his satellite until we figure out what's creating this atmospheric disturbance. It seems to be coming from a crashed ship in Nowhere. Go and check it out and report what you find. -Ben
This is Nowhere. A lot of alien activity, not to mention ghosts and monsters.
You need to defeat the Moussaka Masters that are guarding the crashed ship.

Whoah…listen to this. That data you retrieved contained a Plumber file about Fuse. Their research indicates that Planet Fusion is almost a thousand years old! I will send this to Max right away. Nice work. Hey, go back and talk to Two when you're ready, o
Defeat eight Moussaka Masters.
The crashed ship we're looking for is being guarded by Fuse's minions.
Good work. Now find that ship and deactivate the scrambling signal.
Now you have to find the ship that's causing the atmospheric disturbance to deactivate the scrambling signal. I'll send you the coordinates.
Deactivate scrambling signal.
You need to find the ship that's causing this atmospheric disturbance.
Nice job. Max should be able to launch his satellite now. Wait a minute…
Great work out there. Come on back to the space port in Offowrld Plaza for your reward.
Return to Ben.
That ship has an Anurphaetos design. They're definitely working with Fuse.
Take that Galactic Enforcer Cape as a reward. You did an amazing job.
Good work in Nowhere. Man, the last thing we need is a problem with ghostly aliens. As if Fuse wasn't bad enough! Thanks for the help.
Laser Blast
Recover Quad Laser from Orchid Bay.
Hey, dat boy Dexter has a request for you. He needs something from right here in Orchid Bay. He will send you an email about it. So go help him, already!
I went into the infected zone at the wharf and recovered a Quad Laser for Dexter.
Oh, boy! You did it! I'm glad you on our side and not wit dat nasty Fuse. Dexter was glad to get his laser, but I still need to find me last missing Zuni head.
Dexter needs you to go to de infected skate park here in Orchid Bay. You gotta get him a Quad Laser dat he lost.
Go to wharf infected zone.

There was a problem with the Power Level Tracker, but I've almost got it fixed. I need a Quad Laser. I used to have one, but I lost it at Orchid Bay. Do you think you can go over there and try to find it for me? -Dexter
I am sure I lost my Quad Laser in Orchid Bay.
Who wants to wear a cape?
Dexter needs you to go to de infected skate park here in Orchid Bay. You gotta get him a Quad Laser dat he lost.
Collect the Quad Laser.
You must go in there and get it. I need it to fix the Power Level Tracker.
You have done it! Bring the Quad Laser to Grim. He will deliver it for me.
Okay, bring me dat Quad Laser and I'll make sure it goes right to Dexter.
Deliver Quad Laser to Grim.
What do I look like? One of dem errand boys? I'll get dis Quad Laser to Dexter. But we still gotta find me my last shrunken Zuni head! Here, you can take you this reward.
Tracking Jack
Find Samurai Jack in the Darklands.
You are ready to journey out to the Darklands. It is extremely dangerous there, but you are prepared. Find Samurai Jack, and get to the bottom of this mystery.
Fuse is an ancient villain, huh? Interesting.
I was not able to locate Samurai Jack right away, but I used a code that Mandark gave me to access the research station's mainframe. Jack's signal originated from the research station itself!
Good work. Jack will be able to help us find the missing heroes. Remember that we have the Power Level Tracker at our disposal. It may be useful later.

I received a message from Samurai Jack. I think he can help us figure out where the missing heroes are. He is somewhere in the Darklands, but the signal scatters near the research station in Forsaken Valley.
Go to Forsaken Valley.

Jack is somewhere in the Darklands. I've traced the source of his communication to somewhere near the research station in Forsaken Valley. Go there, and take the Power Level Tracker with you. It may prove useful. -Dexter
Greetings! This is the Mandark Industries research facility in Forsaken Valley.

Against my better judgment, I've contacted Mandark. He's going to send you an access code that will allow you to collect data from the research center's mainframe. It should be able to trace Jack's signal.
Use the facility's mainframe.
I've uploaded an access code to your NanoCom. Now stop bothering me!
Good work. The research center can trace the source of Jack's signal.
I wanna be a super hero!
Interesting. Jack's signal didn't scatter at the research station, it actually originates from there! Ascend to Mandark's floating reasearch facility by using one of the transport mechanisms nearby.
Talk to Samurai Jack.
Why, it's coming from the research station itself! Head up there immediately.
So, Dexter sent you to me? I've heard that he is trying to solve the mystery of the world's missing warriors, and I believe I can help. If you are ready and willing, we can do this together.
You and Bloo
Collect stolen supplies for Bloo.
I'll look at that map later. Right now, I gotta get some supplies back from the Dynamite Mice that stole them. I'd do it myself, but I think you'll do it better.
I defeated some Dynamite Mice at Dizzy World and recovered Bloo's stolen supplies.
Some help you are! You got my stolen supplies back, but my copy of "Super Mega Blasteroids 10" is gone! What good are you, anyway?
Take the treasure map to your pal, Edd. He'll tell you what to do!
You're like a cool alien hunter!
Bring treasure map to Edd.
Too bad that Billy could not be more helpful, but I should have suspected as much. Now let's take a look at this map
Thanks for defending the SCAMPER. For a small fee, you can fly just about anywhere. Just talk to the KND attendant to take flight. Now come on back to the tree house for a reward.
Bring map to Bloo.
I think the treasure is buried somewhere Downtown! You should talk to one of our suppliers, Bloo. We need some stuff from him, anyway. He is at the amusement park.
Oh, hey. You want me to do what? Sure, give me that map and I'll look at it later. I've got more important stuff to deal with!
I had some supplies for Eddy. But some creeps stole them! I'd get them myself, but I threw out my shoulder defending this area from monsters. You get started and I'll be right there.
Defeat the Dynamite Mice.
Return to Blossom.
Great work! I was about to come and help, but it seems you did just fine.
Test nano
Good work getting those supplies back. I'll give you something if you bring them back to me.
Deliver supplies to Bloo.
Let's see…paddleballs, fake vomit, false teeth…it's all here. Wait a minute! Where's my copy of "Super Mega Blasteroids 10"? Thanks for nothing. Here, take this reward anyway.
Skate Switcheroo
Collect the next candy treasure.
Oh, right. You wanted me to look at that map or something? Yeah, this thing seems to lead down to Orchid Bay. You should go check that out. Totally.
