Bloo told me that the next stash of candy was buried in Orchid Bay. I collected something, but when I got back I found out that it was Bloo's skateboard!
Sorry, I didn't mean to trick you. Well, yes I did. But I really wanted my skateboard! Anyway, I promise to take a look at your map now. Promise.
The map you gave me seems to lead to the old skate park in Orchid Bay. But that place is really goopy. Wear a helmet!
Go to Orchid Bay infected zone.
Phew, I'm relieved to hear that you are back to finding the Crazy Brain Candy. If Fuse gets that stuff, kids are doomed! -Edd
Go inside the infected area to dig up your treasure.
Find the loot inside the infected skate park. Then bring it back here to me! We'll split it 60/40, right? Isn't that what I said?
Collect the Treasure
Remember, the split is 50/50.
Coolness! Bring the treasure chest back to me, okay?
You did a great job nabbing that treasure! Bring it here and let's see what we got!
Bring treasure to Bloo.
And the treasure is…my skateboard?!? Wow, I've been looking all over for this! Who ever would have left it at the skate park by accident last Tuesday, I wonder? Here's a reward for you!
Invention Protection, Part Two
Talk to numbuh two
Defeat Asphalt Freaks in Townsville Park.
Heavy Hunters at City Hall are under command of Asphalt Freaks in Townsville Park. You must destroy them to protect Mandark's invention, the Great Machine.
I defeated Asphalt Freaks in Townsville Park to ensure that the Great Machine would be safe.
Mission accomplished again. Mandark values your existence, but reminds you that he could exterminate you at any time. Ha. Ha. Ha.
Heavy Hunters at City Hall have been defeated. Proceed to Townsville Park and do same to Asphalt Freaks.
Defeat six Asphalt Freaks.
I'm detecting a signal from deep in the Fissure. I think you should investigate.
Navigate infected zone inside Fissure to destroy Fuse's communication device.
Destroy the communicator.
I think this signal is coordinating the enemy forces. Destroy it!
Can I pay you Tuesday for a hamburger today?
Nuclear Haste
Thanks. The Great Machine is safe for now. Return to Mandroid M-99.
Return to this unit at City Station.
Talk to Mandroid M-99.
Your actions justify this reward. Good day.
Chemical Xpert
Investigate Nowhere for signs of monkeys.
My special Chemical X formula is now complete. I must now recruit new minions into my army! I hear there are monkeys to be found in a place called Nowhere.
Mojo thought he would find monkeys in Nowhere. I fought some creatures there, then ran into Courage the Cowardly Dog, who reminded Mojo that monkeys live on Monkey Mountain.
Monkey Mountain! Of course! Were the answer not so obvious, I would not have remembered that Monkey Mountain is where I can find monkeys! Yesss!

You must go to a place called Nowhere. It is somewhere in the wilderness. Though it might be hard to believe that a place called Nowhere is actually somewhere, I assure you that Nowhere is somewhere in the wilderness.
Recover a radioactive isotope from the nuclear power plant.
Go to Nowhere.
This area is bound to be filled with monkeys.
In order to find out where the monkeys are hiding, defeat Fuse's minions and pry the information from their body parts that store information.
Defeat seven Fowl Foes.
Defeat Fuse's monsters and ask them where the monkeys can be found.
Pssst! Hey, are you looking for monkeys? Come here!
Once you have located the monkeys, report to me immediately, and not a second before.
Talk to Courage.
There are no monkeys here! This place is only filled with scary alien monsters and scary regular monsters!! If Mojo wants to find monkeys, he should go to Monkey Mountain. Whine!

Leave it to a craven canine to remind me of the existence of Monkey Mountain, a mountain in the jungle that is the home of many monkeys and many of my past and future monkey minions. I curse this oversight!
The operatives stationed with Ben at the space port need a radioactive isotope to power some special equipment. Can you get one from the nuclear power plant?
Return to Mojo.
CURSES! Why did I not think of going to Monkey Mountain? Return to me at once!
We must now figure out how to deliver vast quantities of my Chemical X formula to Monkey Mountain. But before we do that, we must obtain some new equipment. And here is a reward!
Here's a hot tip: talk to Belladonna at the auditorium. I'll bet you can make a new Nano! -Edd

Fuse has been stealing items from heroes around the world to create his horrific Fusions. You need to talk to Buttercup. A lot of her stuff was recently stolen! You'll find her at the auditorium. -Dexter

Curses! Buttercup requires assistance at the auditorium. She has been missing for weeks and weeks, only to resurface and immediately torment me with her presence. How I hate the Powerpuff Girls! I can write no more. -Mojo Jojo
Dexter told me that many of the world's superheroes have gone missing! And I just heard that Buttercup may be his latest target. You should go see her at the auditorium. -Ben
Have you ever met the Scottish guy with the big moustache and the machine-gun leg? You should go talk to him! He's a hoot. You'll find him at the Fissure. -Edd
It turns out that Fuse is indeed trying to kidnap the world's superheroes? But why? The Scotsman may know the answer. Go see him down at the Fissure. -Dexter

An annoying Fusion is causing problems at Leakey Lake. I have no interest in going to Leakey Lake, but I know someone who may be able to help you. Talk to the Scotsman at the Fissure. You cannot miss him: he is Scottish. -Mojo Jojo
I recovered a radioactive isotope from the nuclear plant.

One of Fuse's most powerful monsters is Fusion Demongo. I heard that one of Fusion Demongo's flunkies is making trouble at Leakey Lake. Can you go talk to the Scotsman about it? He's at the Fissure with Grandpa Max. -Ben
Scary guy alert! Go talk to Vilgax at the Dark Engine. Just be careful, okay? -Edd

It would appear that Fuse is responsible for the disappearance of the world's superheroes. I am not surprised in the least. The intergalactic conqueror called Vilgax may know where Fuse will strike next. Even though I am wary of Vilgax, you should probably go talk to him at the Dark Engine. -Dexter

The one called Vilgax has tentacles on his face, and I subscribe to the general principle that you cannot trust anyone who has tentacles on their face. Nevertheless, I suspect you may be able to acquire a new Nano if you go to see Vilgax at the Dark Engine. -Mojo Jojo
Vilgax is planning to study the process of creating Fusions. I'm not sure I trust him. You'd better go and see what he's up to. You'll find him at the Dark Engine. -Ben
You wanna help out the Powerpuff Girls? Bubbles needs you down at City Hall. -Edd
Fuse is attacking helpless animals! Go talk to Bubbles at City Hall. -Dexter
Curses! Bubbles requests your presence at City Hall! Those rotten Powerpuff Girls monopolize your time. You should be devoting all your time to me, Mojo Jojo! -Mojo Jojo
Bubbles needs help at City Hall. Can you go find out what she wants? Thanks. -Ben
Hey, Numbuh One needs your help! Sounds important. You'd better go to the Fissure and see him right away. -Edd
Awesome! You got the radioactive isotope that our operatives need down at the space port. When you're ready, I'll send you to deliver it.
Numbuh One needs to see you at the Fissure right away. It seems that one of their top operatives has been captured. -Dexter

I have just received word that a Kids Next Door operative has been kidnapped. Since I do not care about the Kids Next Door or whether or not they are kidnapped, I thought you might like to report to Numbuh One at the Fissure to find out more. -Mojo Jojo
I have an urgent request from the KND. Can you go to the Fissure and report to Numbuh One? -Ben
Go see Grim at Bravo Beach. Maybe you can figure out why Fuse is kidnapping animals. And I'll bet you can get a new Nano, too! -Edd
There appears to be some kind of connection between Bullet's and Numbuh Six's abductions. Believe it or not, Grim may have the answer. Go see him at Brave Beach. -Dexter

Are you interested in making a new Nano? This is a pointless question, because simply everyone is interested in making a new Nano! Except me, Mojo Jojo. I am not interested in making a new Nano because I have no use for new Nanos. Go see Grim at Bravo Beach. -Mojo Jojo
Grandpa Max thinks that Fuse is trying to create fiercer monsters by kidnapping super-powered animals. Can you look into it? Check with Grim at Bravo Beach, he says he has a lead. Thanks. -Ben
Whoah, Grandpa Max says he needs some help! Can you go check in with him at the Fissure? Most appreciated! -Edd
Grandpa Max has been studying the effects of Fusion Matter on plantlife at Galaxy Gardens. Would you mind asking him if I may look at his data? You'll find him at the Fissure. -Dexter

I have been studying the plants at Galaxy Gardens, but more specifically, I have been studying the bananas! Ben Tennyson's grandfather has also been studying the plants at Galaxy Gardens, but he lost all his data. Boo hoo! Maybe you can help him? Go to the Fissure...now! -Mojo Jojo
You need to go down to the nuclear power plant to collect a radioactive isotope, which I will send down to the spaceport.
Hey, Grandpa Max lost his laptop at the amusement park and needs help finding it. Can you go see him at the Fissure? Thanks! -Ben

Did you know that when some kids eat bananas, their faces break out into polka dots? What do you think would happen if a kid like that ate a Fusion Banana? Heavens! Mojo Jojo is messing around with Fusion Bananas, so you better go tell him to stop it. -Edd

Mojo Jojo is causing trouble. He is taking the infected bananas from Galaxy Gardens and feeding them to his minions, which turns them into Fusion monkeys. We cannot let this continue. Please go speak to Mojo about it. -Dexter

I have recovered Fusion Bananas from Galaxy Gardens! They appear to have interesting effects on those who eat them, in particular my monkey minions! Perhaps you would like to hear more about this subject? If that is the case, then come to my volcano immediately! -Mojo Jojo

Grandpa Max says that the infected plants at Galaxy Gardens could cause serious trouble. Don't let Mojo Jojo mess around with that stuff! Go see that crazy monkey as soon as you can, and tell him to cut it out! -Ben
Dexter wants to see you about a super-super secret experiment! Go find him at Dexlabs HQ, downtown. -Edd
I have studied the Fusion Bananas, and I think I have developed a way to use them against Fuse. Come to see me at Dexlabs and I will tell you my plan. -Dexter

So, Dexter believes that the Fusion Bananas might actually be harmful to Fuse, as opposed to helpful? I would like to see how this is so, for it currently appears that Fusion Bananas simply create Fusion Monkeys. And I hate Fusion Monkeys! Go see Dexter at Dexlabs at this very instant! -Mojo Jojo
Dexter says he's developed a way to make toxic Fusion Bananas. That ought to give Fuse some indigestion! Go talk to Dexter as soon as you can, okay? -Ben
Bloo needs some help at the amusement park. Maybe he can help you with getting a new Nano! -Edd
Head to the nuclear power plant.
Bloo would like to see you down at the amusement park. I'm sure it's very important, at least according to Bloo. Good luck! -Dexter

There is a creature called "Bloo" who requests your presence at the amusement park, which is an establishment devoted entirely to the amusement of its customers. I find this hard to believe! What could be more amusing than destroying the Powerpuff Girls? -Mojo Jojo
Hey, Bloo needs some help down at Dizzy World. By the way, have you tried "Sumo Slammer Online"? It's pretty awesome. -Ben
That weirdo named Mandark needs some help! Can you go meet him in Tech Square? Thanks! -Edd
Mandark would like some assistance with placing tracking devices at Morbucks Towers. I am suspicious of Mandark's activity, so do let me know if he is up to something suspicious, okay? -Dexter

Mandark may be a genius, but his genius cannot compare to my own genius, which is without question the greatest genius on this planet! Because Mandark's genius is inferior, he requires assistance. Please see him at Mandark Industries. Goodbye. -Mojo Jojo
Fusion Mandark is making trouble at Morbucks Towers. Can you talk to Mandark and see if he knows anything about this? He's in Tech Square. -Ben

Have you ever seen Ben's Omnitrix? That thing is totally rad. I wonder what would happen if Fuse's monsters could transform into aliens? On second thought, I'd rather not consider it. Maybe you'd better go see Ben at the Space Port to make sure everything is copacetic. -Edd

Fusion Tetrax is stealing items that belong to Ben's alien alter egos. I suspect that Fuse is trying to create new types of alien Fusions. We cannot let him do this! Check in with Ben at the Space Port immediately. -Dexter
Trouble at the Space Port means that you must leap into action! Go talk to Ben Tennyson! He is at the Space Port, and he also likes leaping into action! Ha ha ha! -Mojo Jojo

Hey, nice work before. Listen, the situation down here at the spaceport is getting bad. Fuse realy wants to make sure we don't get off the planet. But I've got some KND guys helping me out. Numbuh Two needs you to get a radioactive isotope for them. You can do it. -Ben
That's right…I'm Omnitrixter, the best Sumo Slammer Online player of all time. Come on down to the Space Port when you're free and I'll teach you how to play. -Ben
Subject: Resurrect 'Ems. Grim has supplied Resurrect 'Ems to revive our allies when they fall in battle. Speak to Numbuh 108 to learn more about this device. -Computress
Subject: Infected Zones. Planet Fusion's infection spreads far and wide. Areas of high concentration are called infected zones. Speak to Numbuh 108 to learn more about them. -Computress
Subject: Mission Journal. Contained in your NanoCom, the mission journal keeps a record of your activities. Speak to Sherri Bird to learn more. -Computress
Subject: Containment Areas. The Special Alien Capture Team requests your assistance in helping to clean up the infected zones. Sherri Bird can explain the entire process. -Computress

Subject: Nano Creation. You must use the Great Machine to build a Nano. There is one located in the Cul-de-Sac. The Great Machine was a joint venture with Dexlabs and Mandark Industries, although Mandark Industries erroneously claims full credit. Litigation is currently underway. Speak to Mandroid M-80 in the Cul-de-Sac to learn more about the Great Machine. -Computress
Subject: Nano Tuning Stations. You can grant one of three powers to each Nano. Speak to Mandroid M-80 in the Cul-de-Sac to learn more about Nano Tuning Stations. -Computress
Subject: Nano Gumballs. Speak to Ranger Joey in the Cul-de-Sac to learn more about the curious candy called Nano Gumballs. -Computress
Subject: Transportation. There are many ways to go "to and fro" in this world. Dexlabs is a world leader in warp technology. To learn more, speak to Ranger Joey in the Cul-de-Sac. -Computress
Subject: Corruption Attacks. Our enemies are numerous and resourceful. To learn more about their Corruption Attacks, talk to Jellybean Jane in the Cul-de-Sac. -Computress
Go inside and work fast -- you could get a bad case of radiation poisoning!
Subject: Eruption Attacks. Jellybean Jane, the Candy Pirate at the Cul-de-Sac, can tell you all about Eruption Attacks. Eruption Attacks are yet another weapon in Fuse's vast arsenal. -Computress

Numbuh Two just sent me an urgent message. Apparently, the ice cream ammo we supplied is already gone, though I have a sneaking suspicion that the problem is tummy-related. Regardless, can you see Ranger Ralphie to address the issue? Thanks! -Edd

Hey, go get that third map from Billy and then come back to the Cul-de-Sac. Eddy wants you to meet Bloo down at the amusement park, and I think he might be able to give us a lead on the next stash of candy. -Edd
So, Stickybeard has stashed Crazy Brain Candy all over the world? It looks like the next map leads to Endsville. Perhaps you should talk to that kid, Billy. Meet me in the Cul-de-Sac, first. -Edd
Billy thinks the next stash of Crazy Brain Candy is buried in Eternal Meadows cemetery. Go talk to him in Endsville, okay? -Edd
I spoke with Bloo and he totally promised that he would help us with that treasure map. Go meet him, okay? -Edd
So, can Bloo help us with the treasure map? Speak with him at Dizzy World and find out! -Edd
Did Bloo look at the treasure map, yet? We have no time for "Super Mega Blasteroids 10" at a time like this! Please stress the importance of our task! -Edd
Bloo said he was going to help Eddy with some deliveries Downtown. Go see if you can give Bloo a hand. But remember: we need him to help us with that treasure map! -Edd
Wait a minute…Bloo made you go and collect his skateboard? We need to find the Crazy Brain Candy before Fuse gets it! Go knock some sense into that little blue buffoon! -Edd
This area is really infected, but you need to be quick and find that isotope. I know you can do it.
Oh, dear. Did Bloo eat that entire bag of candy? This is bad…you better go check on him at Dizzy World right away. -Edd
Hey, since you're downtown, I have a favor to ask. Bloo has all the details. Maybe he'll tell you about it, if he isn't too busy complaining about his stomachache. -Edd
Thanks for your help with Mojo's telescope! But back to the matter at hand...Bloo can help us locate the next stash of candy treasure. Go see him, okay? -Edd
Bloo says he knows what we can do with that strange Crazy Brain Candy. I am highly skeptical, but why not go and see what he's talking about? -Edd
I just heard from Bloo. He has an extremely critical mission for you. Go find out what he wants, okay? Although I suspect that Bloo's definition of "critical" is different than mine. -Edd
Our most recent map leads to the Space Port. Go pick up the map from Bloo at Dizzy World. Then you should probably find Ben Tennyson at the Space Port. -Edd
You are ready to make the journey into the Darklands to find Samurai Jack. Come see me at Dexlabs. We must continue our search for the world's missing heroes. -Dexter

Greetings: I hope this email finds you well and that you are continuing to fight the good fight. Ever since Fuse invaded, many superheroes have disappeared. I want to investigate this strange phenomenon. Speak with Blossom at the Kids Next Door tree house and see if she can help. -Dexter
I have received reports that Fuse is gathering spies in the Eternal Meadows Cemetery. You'd better go talk to Blossom and see if she can help you take care of this. -Dexter

I think I have figured out the problem with the Power Level Tracker. I need a Quad Laser. I recently lost one in Orchid Bay. That's right down near Grim. Maybe he can help us instead of asking you to get his stupid shrunken heads! -Dexter
Did the Kankers get inside the Cul-de-Sac?
Collect the radioactive isotope.
Please contact Dexbot Q-12 at City Station right away. Something is preventing delivery of the Power Level Tracker. I am certain Fuse and his monsters are somehow to blame. -Dexter
I have repaired the Power Level Tracker and sent it to Dexbot Q-12 for testing. Meet him at City Station, and we can test the device by tracking Buttercup. -Dexter

Do you think Grim will be able to help us with our search for the missing heroes? It can't hurt to ask him…although, he's a bit of a strange guy. Well, go check in with him while I work on fine-tuning the Power Level Tracker. You can find him in Orchid Bay. -Dexter

Hey, I heard that Grim is asking you to collect shrunken Zuni heads. What's that all about? Sounds pretty gross. Make sure he helps us with our investigation. If not, you've probably got better things to do. -Dexter

Please keep bugging Grim about helping us with our search for the missing heroes. I am still trying to get the Power Level Tracker working correctly. It is a little more complicated than I thought. Curse this alien technology! -Dexter
Stay on Grim. As soon as I have the Power Level Tracker ready, I'll let you know. -Dexter
Desk Lamp of Hades? Well, if it needs a light bulb, I suppose you can help Grim get a new one. -Dexter
Now Grim needs an extension cord for the Desk Lamp of Hades? This is absurd. Well, please go help him out. I want to know where those missing superheroes are! -Dexter

You have the Desk Lamp of Hades, the Light Bulb of Hades and the Extension Cord of Hades. What's left? I want Grim to look into the World of the Dead once and for all to see if the missing heroes are there. If not, we have better things to do. Go back and talk to Grim. -Dexter

I am relieved to learn that the missing heroes cannot be found in the World of the Dead. Since Grim helped us, it is only appropriate to return the favor. Fuse is planning an attack on one of his stores, Grim's Gardens. (Dee Dee likes their lavender exfoliating wash.) Can you go help him? -Dexter
Wow, you did it! Superbly done. Bring that thing back to me, okay?

I am working on a very secret experiment right now, which I cannot tell you about, for then it would no longer be a secret! However, I require some material from Genius Grove, and you will help me obtain what I require. Speak to Father about this mission right away, and do not dilly or dally. -Mojo Jojo

Father told me that he has another mission for you. However, I am starting to suspect that Father is acting in his own interests, and not in my interests. And my interests belong to me, Mojo Jojo! -Mojo Jojo

Though you managed to protect the Great Machine in a previous mission, it appears that the Great Machine is still in danger. Therefore I would like you to again speak to Mandroid M-99 about defending the Great Machine, so it is no longer in danger. That is all I have to say in this particular email. -Mojo Jojo

I will let you in on a little secret regarding my secret experiment. I am not in fact working on improving Nano technology, I am working on improving minion technology! With my new Chemical X formula, which contains Fusion Matter, I will create the most powerful minions of all time! And I hear that the best minions can be found in Nowhere. So you must go there for me immediately! Well, not immediately...first come see me about this assignment. -Mojo Jojo

Thank you for delivering the alien DNA and irradiated Chemical X to my minion, Ramma Jamma, in City Station. Now I require you to return to City Station to speak to my minion, Ramma Jamma. He will have further instructions for you. But before you can do what Ramma Jamma asks you to do, you must speak to my minion, Ramma Jamma! -Mojo Jojo

Mandark is a formidable evil genius, even though he may not be as formidable as I, Mojo Jojo. In any case, Mandark has a mission for you. Contact Mandroid M-99 at City Station for further information. Goodbye! -Mojo Jojo

I am told that Fuse's forces are threatening the Great Machine. The Great Machine is an important tool in our fight against Fuse, and much too important to be threatened. Speak with Mandroid M-99 at City Station and see what we can do about this. -Mojo Jojo

I would like to work with Mandark on developing better Nano technology. I sent him a message asking him if he would like to work together, but he never responded to my message asking if he would like to work together. Can you please go to City Station and ask Mandroid M-99 about it? -Mojo Jojo

I am pleased that you recovered some of that special Fusion Matter with Mandark's help. Perhaps Mandark can still be of use to me. Go talk to Mandroid M-99 in City Station when you have a moment to talk to him. -Mojo Jojo

I have a personal favor to ask. Please come see me. I am trying to keep this message short. Sometimes my messages get too long, and my fingers begin to feel strain from typing so many words. I have decided that if I type fewer words, my fingers will not hurt. That is why I am trying to keep this message short. Please come see me. -Mojo Jojo
Be careful with that isotope, and bring it back to me. Ben sent a reward for you, by the way.
I am afraid someone is spying on me. And I don't want someone spying on me. Please come talk to me right away at my volcano. -Mojo Jojo
I cannot concentrate! Fuse's monsters are making it impossible to work! And when I cannot work, I get angry! Curses! Please come assist me. -Mojo Jojo
Once again, I cannot concentrate thanks to Fuse's minions! It is even difficult to write this email. That is how significant the distractions are. Help! -Mojo Jojo

With my new, all-powerful monkey minions, I, Mojo Jojo, will rule all! Once Fuse is defeated, of course. Ha! We have no need for Father, or Mandark, or anyone for that matter. But we do have need for jetpacks. And I know someone who can help us. Please come to my volcano immediately. -Mojo Jojo
Numbuh Two is trying to put together a device that will help him find Fuse's hiding spots. Think you can help him with that? -Ben
Max is just about ready to launch his surveillance satellite. But we're picking up some weird atmospheric disturbance. I think I've traced the source. Come see me when you get this. -Ben
I heard Numbuh Two set you up with some gear. Those Terrafusers in the burbs could mean trouble. I'm sure he could use your further assistance. -Ben

Listen up. There are some secret Plumber bases hidden in the suburbs, and we can't let Fuse get access to them. Numbuh Two will help you lock them down. But first, you're gonna need some special gear to get past the security systems. -Ben
Hey, Grandpa Max said he's having trouble getting in touch with me. Can you go see him at the Fissure and find out what's up? Thanks. -Ben

One of the KND operatives at the Space Port said he's leaving to pick up that isotope from Numbuh Two. Why don't you talk to him and see if you can bring it down? Then maybe we can meet up at the Space Port. Cool? -Ben
Return to Numbuh Two.
Good job getting that Descrambler hooked up. But I still haven't heard from Grandpa Max. He usually calls me on his satellite phone to keep Fuse off his back. You'd better go check in with him. -Ben
Grandpa Max said he's trying to learn more about Planet Fusion. He's putting together a surveillance satellite to launch into space. Why don't you see if there's anything you can do to help? -Ben
Ever since Fuse invaded, the Omnitrix has been acting weird. Grandpa Max will know what to do. Go check in with him at the Fissure in the park. -Ben
There's trouble at Morbucks Towers! Fusion Coop is gathering his troops to attack the Space Port. I sent the info I have to Grandpa Max. Go see him as soon as you can. -Ben
There's trouble at Morbucks Towers! Fusion Coop is gathering his troops to attack the Space Port. Can you come down and meet me here? We need to stop him! -Ben

Grandpa Max told me that he collected some pretty strange information from that data miner you found earlier. I'm afraid my suspicions about Ghostfreak may be confirmed. Go see what he's talking about, okay? -Ben
We've got a problem at Galaxy Gardens. Report to Max at the Fissure when you get this. -Ben
I'm worried that Ghostfreak and his cronies may have returned. There's something I want to investigate. See Grandpa Max if you're ready to lend a hand. -Ben
Hey, Grandpa Max located the other half of the energy cell that he needs to fix his satellite. It's right here at the Space Port. Come and see me and I'll give you all the details. -Ben
Hands Off
That was great! Before you can bring this radioactive doohickey to the spaceport, I need you for one more task. Oh, and Ben sent his personal Galactic Enforcer uniform for you. Check it out!
Protect the Great Machine.
Someone in Fuse's army is gathering troops out here to destroy the Great Machine at City Hall. I can't allow this to happen. You need to help me find the culprit.

I stopped Desert Clawdads in Area 51.5 from attacking the Great Machine. I also recovered the Totem of Ectonurite, which I gave to Juniper Lee. Then I went to the infected zone in the Really Twisted Forest, found Fusion Mandy, and defeated her.
Thanks for getting rid of Fusion Mandy. I can't have her messing with the Great Machine. I want my slaves -- I mean, pals -- to be as strong as possible.

If Fuse destroys the Great Machine, kids won't be able to make Nanos. And I want all my slaves -- I mean, allies -- to be as strong as possible. The monsters that are planning to attack are coming from Area 51.5, north of Nowhere.
Go to Area 51.5.
The Desert Clawdads are assembling to attack. You need to defeat eight of them.
Defeat eight Desert Clawdads so they can't assemble into an army and attack the Great Machine down at City Hall.
Defeat eight Desert Clawdads.
Good work. It looks like they dropped something.
Super hero? More like super ZERO.
That girl Juniper Lee wants to see that thing you found. When you're done, come back and see me.
Deliver item to Juniper Lee.
Hey, can you please bring that item to me? I'm down in Nowhere.
This is some strange alien totem. I don't know a lot about these things, but they are very powerful. I've noticed the monsters in the area are collecting them, but I'm not sure why. Can’t be good.
Are you done? I need you to come back and see me at Devil's Bluff. I've discovered who is behind the planned attack on the Great Machine.
Return to Mandy.
Quit stalling. I need to see you right away.
Fusion Mandy is leading the attacks on the Great Machine. That faker. She's hiding out inside the infected zone in the Really Twisted Forest. Do me this favor, and I promise I won't forget you.

Fusion Mandy is the monster responsible for the attacks on the Great Machine. Take her out of the picture, and I promise you'll be my friend when the revolution comes. You need to go to the Really Twisted Forest infected zone.
Go to the Really Twisted Forest infected zone.
Ben tells me great things about you.
She's hiding out inside the infected zone in the Ruins. Do me this favor, and I promise I won't forget you.
You need to make your way through the Really Twisted Forest's infected area, find the Fusion Portal, and enter Fusion Mandy's hideout.
Enter Fusion Portal.
Wouldn't you know it? That annoying Fusion Mandy has bodyguards. You'll need to get rid of those Brackish Beasts before you go after their boss.
Defeat ten Brackish Beasts.
There she is. But she's got some guards. That coward. Take 'em down.
Finally. Now it's Fusion Mandy's turn.
I can't have Fusion Mandy hurting my slaves -- I mean -- friends! That girl needs to go back to where she came from. Right now. Get it done and you'll have a new Nano as a result.
Defeat Fusion Mandy.
Coco? Coco coco!
Can I be your sidekick?
Wow, you did really great against those monsters. Come back and see me for a reward, okay?
Exit the area.
Good work taking out Fusion Mandy. I never liked her at all. What a poseur. I won't forget this.
Return to Mandy.
Nice job. That stupid Fusion Mandy won't be bothering me anymore. Why don't you take that headband and make a Nano? I'd like to see you again when you're really strong.
Good. You got Fusion Mandy.
That battle with Fusion Mandy was intense! Good work.
I don't ever want to fight Fusion Mandy!
Thanks for saving the Great Machine from Fusion Mandy.
Alien Totem Poll
Wow, you look nice in a cape.
Collect the alien totems.
The Totem of Ectonurite that you found is from the planet Anurphaetos. I know little about alien magic, but we must keep their power away from Fuse.

I tracked two more alien totems for Juniper Lee. I collected the Totem of Viktor and the Totem of Loboan from the Fireswamps. Then I fought Fusion Juniper Lee inside the infected zone at Monkey Mountain.
Great work collecting the alien totems. Someone in Fuse's army wants their power, and the trail leads to the Dark Tree in the Darklands. You should check it out.
The Totem of Ectonurite that you found contains massive amounts of alien energy. I've tracked two more in the Fireswamps. You need to go there before Fuse can collect them.
Go to the Fireswamps.
It's time for a new Nano. Go to the Fireswamps for further instructions.

Hey, it's Ben! The Totem of Ectonurite contains the power of my old pal, Ghostfreak. The people of Anurphaetos placed these totems on our planet to channel their alien energies. If Fuse gets those, we're sunk! Help Juniper! Good luck. -Ben
You need to defeat the Magma Hulks in the Fireswamps to collect the Totem of Viktor.
Defeat the Magma Hulks.
He accepted the brownies? Stupendous! You may have just helped avoid a war. Come back to me so I can offer thanks.
Fuse's Magma Hulks have stolen the Totem of Viktor, so prepare for a fight.
Good work! Now you need to get the Totem of Loboan from the Tar Titans.
Excellent work. Now you must defeat the Tar Titans to collect the Totem of Loboan.
Defeat the Tar Titans.
Move swiftly! We must put an end to this Fusion Demongo.
Those monsters are working for a Fusion that's hiding at Monkey Mountain.
Go to the Monkey Mountain infected zone. Once inside, you will need to find the entrance to an evil Fusion's lair.
Go to Monkey Mt. infected zone.
You will need to enter the infected zone to find the creature's lair.
Enter the Fusion's lair inside the Monkey Mountain infected zone.
Shiny! Shiny!
Talk to Mel Anzana.
Find the Fusion's lair.

Hey, it's Ben again. Great job getting those totems. The Viktors are an incredibly strong race of robotic aliens. And the Loboans are dangerous wolf-like creatures. Really vicious and cunning. It's good that Fuse can't harness their power. I wonder how he was going to do that, anyway? -Ben
So, it's Fusion Juniper Lee, is it? Well, It's time to take her down. When you've won, I'm sure you'll have a new Nano for your collection.
Defeat Fusion Juniper.
I should have known…this is the lair of Fusion Juniper Lee! Watch yourself.
I have detected a familiar energy signature: Fusion Tetrax.
Before you take on the Fusion in the lair, you need to deliver the totems you recovered to a SACT agent named Agent Hoffer.
Deliver totems to Agent Hoffer.
Hey, it's Ben! Agent Hoffer is inside the lair waiting to collect those totems.
Bring the alien totems you collected to me. I'll make sure they stay safely out of Fuse's hands.
Great job. Come back and see me now that your job is complete.
Deliver totems to Juniper.
These alien totems are pretty powerful. I'm sensing even greater energy emanating from the Dark Tree in the Darklands. You should investigate...after you make a new Nano, of course.
Alien totems are dumb.
Excellent work keeping those alien totems from Fuse.
I think Juniper Lee is pretty!
You did great at Monkey Mountain when you beat Fusion Juniper!
Demon Attack
Investigate the Dark Tree.
Fuse is attempting to assemble items of power for Fusion Demongo. In my current state, I am too weak to fight him. But he will grow all-powerful if he isn't stopped.

I spoke to Demongo, and he confirmed that Fuse is assembling items of power for Fusion Demongo to absorb. Demongo sent me to Jack, who recently had an item of power stolen. I could not recover the item, but tracked Fusion Demongo to the Dark Glade, where I fought and defeated him.
Nobody can resist a batch of Mel Anzana's famous eggplant brownies. I hope the trouble is over. Here's a token of our gratitude
You performed honorably. Fusion Demongo is an offensive blight that needs to be smothered. Once I regain my full power, Fuse will have nowhere to run.

Yesss…this cretin called Fuse is trying to assemble items of great power, including the alien totems that you recovered. Fusion Demongo is in this area, and he is using the energy for his own gain. I am too weak to fight him. You must talk to my old enemy, Samurai Jack, in the Forsaken Valley.
Talk to Samurai Jack.
Fuse wants to feed Fusion Demongo with powerful energies. I once wore the tooth of Aku on a necklace at my breast. But this item was recently stolen. We must recover it from the Precipice.
You must defeat the Great Shellworms in the Precipice to recover Samurai Jack's necklace.
Defeat the Great Shellworms.
Defeat the Great Shellworms to recover my necklace.
Good. Please bring that back to me now.
Bring the necklace you recovered from the Great Shellworms in the Precipice back to Samurai Jack.
Deliver necklace to Jack.
I didn’t know chickens liked brownies.
As I feared. Aku's tooth is gone. Fuse must already have it in his grasp. We must find this Fusion Demongo. Talk to Demongo…he won't talk to me. Then I shall meet you for the battle.
You recovered Samurai Jack's necklace, but its item of power -- Aku's Tooth -- was gone. Very well…return to me and I shall tell you where the lair of Fusion Demongo lies.
Talk to Demongo.

Hey, it is Dexter. Be warned: Fusion Demongo is incredibly dangerous. Like Demongo, he can absorb the powers of warriors of all kinds. This makes him very strong and a serious threat. I hope you can take him down. -Dexter
You may have already guessed that Fusion Demongo lies in wait inside the Dark Glade. I will give you a taste of ancient power that shall enable you to defeat him. If luck is on your side.

Enter Fusion Demongo's lair inside the Dark Glade's infected zone. I have given you a small amount of my ancient power, which shall help you in the battle ahead. If you can defeat this creature, I shall spare you when I am back to full strength.
Enter Dark Glade infected zone.
Go to the Dark Glade infected zone. I will meet you inside the villain's lair.
Enter Fusion Portal.
You have reached Fusion Demongo's lair. Samurai Jack is there. Best you talk to him before you fight.
You have done some amazing stuff in Nowhere.
Talk to Samurai Jack.
My friend! Come to me, quickly!
My friend…Fusion Demongo tried to steal my soul. It was luck that I was able to escape his clutches. It is all up to you now. Defeat this monster!

If you can defeat Fusion Demongo, you shall have my respect, even though you will save Samurai Jack in the process. I suppose I must accept the good with the bad. Recover Aku's tooth, and make a new Nano.
Defeat Fusion Demongo.
I watch this confrontation with great interest.
Talk to Hoss Delgado.
You may leave Fusion Demongo's lair. And I shall reclaim the power I bestowed upon you. Be thankful that I do not claim interest.
Exit the area.
Now get out of here. My advice is to steer clear of Demongo. He cannot be trusted, and he is a most dangerous enemy. Meet me once again outside of here.
Hey, have you seen my socks?
Very well. You have defeated Fusion Demongo. Now talk to that troublemaker, Jack.
Talk to Jack.
A valiant effort, my friend. The creature is no more. Come see me.
You have reclaimed Aku's tooth. Keep it. I believe you will be able to make a Nano from it. Your power will continue to grow. You have my thanks.
Fusion Demongo is ugly.
You defeated Fusion Demongo and recovered Aku's tooth? Amazing!
Even the name "Demongo" gives me a shiver!
I'm so proud of you for beating Fusion Demongo!
Bird Beast
Protect the Jungle Outpost.
The chickens and eggplants are so proud of you!
Coco! Coco coco coco coco co! Coco!
I explored the Really Twisted Forest and entered the infected zone, where I fought and defeated Fusion Coco.
Coco coco co-coco co.
Coco co-coco coco.
Talk to Mac.
Hey! Coco's really worried about the monsters attacking our little village here in the Jungle Outpost. Are you prepared to head into the Really Twisted Forest? It's scary.
Coco coco co-coco coco. Coco coco coco? Coco!
Defeat seven Grime Serpents.
Coco says that she's really scared of the Grime Serpents. Can you get rid of them?
Coco!
Tree House Trouble
Coco coco coco cocococo co-coco. Coco!
Find the Fusion Portal.
You know, I saw a really scary monster in that infected zone the other day!!
Thanks! But you still need to rescue Baby Monkey!
Cococo coco coco!
Enter the Fusion Portal.
Look for a monster that looks kinda like Mac's weird birdie friend!
Coco!
Defeat Fusion Coco.
Look out! It's Fusion Coco! Go get her.
Reduce the number of Motorillas at Charles Darwin.
Great! Now defeat Fusion Numbuh Three and save poor little Baby Monkey!
Coco coco coco coco co-coco coco coco.
Exit the area.
You should get out of there. Come back and see me at the Jungle Outpost.
Coco coco co-coco.
Talk to Mac at Jungle Outpost.
Thanks for taking down Fusion Coco. You should keep that egg to make a Nano or something. Ed told me that you should go to see him when you're free, okay?
I don't know who is crazier: Coco or Fusion Coco.
Great work defeating Fusion Coco in the Really Twisted Forest.
I never want to go back to the Really Twisted Forest!
Fusion Numbuh Three is amassing an army of Motorillas to attack the tree house. If you can thin out these troops, I know you'll be ready to go to the space port.
Thanks for saving us from Fusion Coco!
Royal Ed-Viser
Recover Ed's comic books.
Welcome to the Kingdom of Ed! I wish to thank you for your righteous defeat of the Fusion Coco monster. Take this comic book! Waitaminute, my comics are gone!

I went out to Huntor's Crest to find Ed's comic books. The monsters didn't have them, but when I entered the infected zone in the Firepits, I found Fusion Ed! He stole the comic books! After I beat him, I kept one to make an Ed Nano.
Thanks for getting my comic books back. I hope you like the one I gave you. "Nuclear Nurse" is one of my favorites. Oh, you made a Nano? Even better!

Hey, the monsters that stole my comic books are out in the Darklands in the nasty Huntor's Crest area. Go find them, I did decree! Please defeat the Fusionflies at Huntor's Crest and get my comic books back.
Defeat six Fusionflies.
Nano Time! Nano Time! Go to Huntor's Crest to get my comic books back!
Gads! The Fusionflies did not have my comic books.
That was nice of you to help Marie Kanker.
I helped reduce the ranks of Motorillas in the suburbs.
The Fusionflies in Huntor's Crest did not have my comic books! Mayhap the Wooly Behemoths have them?
Defeat six Wooly Behemoths.
Mayhap it was the Wooly Behemoths who stole them.
Verily! No comic books herewith, too. I'm getting mad!
Someone named Gwen wants you to go to the scary infected zone in the Firepits to the east. Proceed!
Go to Firepits infected zone.
I'm picking up major Fusion activity in the infected area to the east.
I've been tracking Fuse's activity in the Darklands. He's messing with dino DNA.
The damsel Gwen needeth you to find the nasty Fusion's hideout. She says that Fuse is messing around with dinosaur stuff. Cool! But don't forget to find my comics!
Enter Fusion Portal.
I think you're ready to go downtown to the space port. You did an amazing job taking out those nasty Motorillas at Charles Darwin!
You need to find the Fusion responsible and take them down.
Lo! It is Fusion Ed who lieth inside these walls. Can you give him a nice big bump on the noggin? Better fight those monsters, first.
Defeat eight Freakosaurus Rex.
Watch out! It's Fusion Ed, and he's surrounded by dinosaur monsters!
Fusion Ed must be the one doing the studies of dinosaur DNA.
Defeat Fusion Ed at all costs, my loyal subject person! Then make a new Nano, hencewith!
Defeat Fusion Ed.
We need to take him out. You should go see Tetrax about this.

You will find my old partner in crime, Fuzzy Lumkins, near his cabin by Leakey Lake. He will no doubt help recruit new monkeys for me, Mojo Jojo! Then we will use my special Chemical X formula. Yesss!
Why, thank you for getting my comic books back. Please return to me at the Kingdom of Ed and I will happily give you a reward and stuff.
You need to head out to the area near Charles Darwin Middle School, where Fusion Numbuh Three is gathering an army of Motorillas. Go to Habitat Homes.
Exit the area.
Get out of there and return to the Jungle Outpost.
Why, thank you for getting my comic books back. Please return to me at the Kingdom of Ed and I will happily give you a reward and stuff.
Talk to Ed at Jungle Outpost.
You have done a great deed this day! Please keepeth the comic book "Nuclear Nurse" for your enjoyment. Or go make a Nano! I think that might be better. Then go see Gwen, okay? She's pretty.
You need to stop reading comic books.
Great job defeating Fusion Ed.
I wonder why Fuse is studying dinosaur DNA?
I'm so glad Fusion Ed won't scare us anymore!
Prehistoric Plot
Go to Charles Darwin Middle School.
Enter the heart of Fuse's Lair.
Fuse is preparing to make an army of alien-dinosaur Fusions. We cannot allow this. You must travel to the heart of Fuse's Lair to stop this plot. Are you ready?

I went out to the Darklands to enter Fuse's Lair. First, I had to fight the Meteoric Sentries. Then I fought and defeated Fusion Tetrax. I collected Humongousaur's dinosaur scale, which I used to make a Nano!
Thank you for your assistance. We did significant damage to Fuse today. He will not be able to continue his genetic experiments. Savor the victory.

You must go into the heart of the Darklands, deep into the infected zone in the Green Maw. We must not allow Fuse to build an army of alien dinosaurs. In order to enter the infected zone safely, you will need to defeat a dozen Slag Cephalopods. Good luck.
Defeat twelve Slag Cephalopods.
It is time to obtain another Nano. Proceed to the Green Maw.
Good work. Now you must find the Fusion who is building this army.
Excellent work against the Slag Cephalopods. A Fusion is most certainly behind this plot. You will have to enter the Green Maw's infected zone to find your Fusion adversary.
Enter Green Maw infected zone.
Hey, you're doing some amazing stuff. Numbuh Two will probably send you down to the space port soon. Come find me, okay? But finish up with him, first. -Ben
Proceed to the Green Maw's infected zone.
Find the lair of Fusion Tetrax. He's lurking somewhere deep inside the Green Maw's infected zone.
Enter Fusion Portal.
Defeat Fusion Tetrax. With your victory, you will not only cripple Fuse's strange genetic experiments, you will also gain a new Nano.
Defeat Fusion Tetrax.
There he is. I hope you are ready for this fight.

Max just told me that he received a message from Kevin. You need to meet up with Hoss Delgado, a real tough hombre and a Spectral Exterminator, to boot. He might know a thing or two about ghostly aliens. He's out in Devil's Bluff, near where the message from Kevin originated.
Excellent work defeating Fusion Gwen. I never liked her, anyway. We couldn't let Fuse make an army of dinosaur Fusions. I already have enough trouble! Now get out of that area and return to me.
Exit the area.
I'll bet you can use it to make a Humongosaur Nano. Cool!
Okay, you're in the right area. Look for those nasty gorilla monsters.
Excellent work defeating Fusion Gwen. I never liked her, anyway. We couldn't let Fuse make an army of dinosaur Fusions. I already have enough trouble! Now get out of that area and return to me.
Talk to Gwen.
Cool! Humongosaur is like a tank! I'll bet his Nano is awesome. You did an amazing job out there with Gwen. Tell her I say hello. -Ben
Thanks for your help. We really did some damage to Fuse today. Next time, he'll think twice about messing with dinosaur DNA. Now you can go make a Humongosaur Nano.
"Humongosaur" is a silly name.
Good work stopping Fuse from creating an alien-dino army.
Aliens! Dinosaurs! I like both of those things.
I'm thrilled that you defeated Fusion Tetrax in the Darklands.
Pack Attack
Recover Mac's backpack.
You need to defeat as many of those gorilla monsters as you can, to make sure that they don't attack the tree house.
Creatures in the Really Twisted Forest stole my backpack! I'm too scared to get it. Do you think you can help me?
I got Mac's backpack from the Boarbills in the Really Twisted Forest, but those monsters put a Gooby Trap inside it. I dumped the pack into the Forgotten Falls, then found Fusion Mac's lair.
Thanks for getting my backpack back from Fusion Mac! That guy is pretty scary. I told the Kids Next Door all about how awesome you are.
Go to the Really Twisted Forest. You need to find the Boarbills in the Really Twisted Forest to recover my stolen backpack.
Defeat the Boarbills.
It's Nano Time! Cool. Go to the Really Twisted Forest, okay?
You got it! Thanks!
Uh-oh! Numbuh Four says that the monsters put a Gooby Trap in my backpack. Better get rid of it! Hurry!
Race to Forgotten Falls.
Look out! There's a Gooby Trap in there! Get rid of the pack at Forgotten Falls!
Defeat eight Motorillas.
Phew. That was a close one.
You're out of time. But the Gooby Trap didn't explode. That was lucky. You need to go back to the start to try again.
Return to start.
Yipes. You ran out of time. But you can give it another try.
All right, Mate! You can do this!
Numbuh Four is detecting a Fusion in the area. I'll bet it's that Fusion Mac. That kid scares me.
Find Fusion Mac's hideout.
Careful, Mate! There's a Fusion in your area. See if you can find his hideout.
Numbuh Four is detecting a Fusion in the area. I'll bet it's that Fusion Mac. That kid scares me.
Enter Fusion Mac's hideout.
Oh, no! Those creeps took a stabilizer from the tree house platform.
Fusion Mac is being guarded by Striding Lampreys! You gotta fight 'em!
Defeat six Striding Lampreys.
Fusion Mac is here! But you need to beat those Striding Lampreys, first.
Good show, Mate! Now can you take down that Fusion?
Holy cow! Can you stop Fusion Mac and get my other backpack back?
Defeat Fusion Mac.
Cool! You win!
Thanks for beating up Fusion Mac. I hope he doesn't come back. Quick, get out of there and come back to the Jungle Outpost.
Exit the area.
Thanks for beating up Fusion Mac. I hope he doesn't come back. Quick, get out of there and come back to the Jungle Outpost.
You need to to recover the tree house stabilizer from the infected zone inside Charles Darwin. Without it: CRASH!
Return to Mac.
Awesome stuff. You can keep that backpack. I'll bet you can make a new Nano with it. Numbuh Four was really impressed with you. He said he has a special mission for you, if you're interested.
Fusion Mac is a little runt.
Thanks for beating Fusion Mac at Forgotten Falls.
I don't want a Gooby Trap in my backpack.
You saved us all from Fusion Mac! Whee!
Tree Trouble
Save the Jungle Outpost from infection.
The tree at the Jungle Outpost is starting to get infected, and we can't figure out what's causing it. Fusion Matter is coming in from the Forsaken Valley. How?

Numbuh Four asked me to investigate the Forsaken Valley. I spoke to Samurai Jack, who said the Lizard Kings at the Firepits were digging trenches in the earth to spread infection from the Dark Tree. I stopped them and discovered they were working for Fusion Numbuh Four, who I defeated.
Gear Up
Recover the stabilizer.
Great job, mate! But we need to stop the infection from the Dark Tree! If it spreads to the Jungle Outpost, we're all gonna be in some serious trouble. Talk to Jack!

The tree in the Jungle Outpost is starting to show signs of infection. It seems to be spreading from the roots! Somehow, Fusion Matter is flowing in from the Darklands. You need to speak with Samurai Jack in the Forsaken Valley at the floating research station.
Talk to Samurai Jack.
Yes, I am aware of the infection that is spreading from the Dark Tree. Fusion Matter courses through the earth. You must defeat the Lizard Kings in the Firepits to stop them from digging.
Samurai Jack says that the Lizard Kings in the Firepits are helping to spread the infection into the jungle. You need to defeat them!
Defeat nine Lizard Kings.
Perhaps you can defeat the Triceraclaws in this area to stop them from digging.
Good work. The monsters here are working for Fusion Numbuh Four.
Go back to Samurai Jack. I'll bet he will know what to do next, Mate.
Talk to Samurai Jack.
Awesome, you found it! Come on back, Ben sent something for you.
The infection in the land is coursing through the roots of the Dark Tree. Fuse's influence is spreading far and wide.

Gadzooks! Samurai Jack says that Fusion Numbuh Four is responsible for helping to spread the infection. You gotta find out where that creep is hiding. He's somewhere inside the creepy infected zone in Dinosaur Pass.
Go to Dinosaur Pass infected zone.
His lair is inside the Dinosaur Pass infected zone. You must defeat him in battle.
Now you need to find the portal that leads to Fusion Numbuh Four's lair. You know what you have to do, mate.
Enter Fusion Portal.
Can you do this? Defeat Fusion Numbuh Four! We're all counting on you. Once you recover my football, you can make a Numbuh Four Nano.
Defeat Fusion Numbuh Four.
You found 'im! Now give 'im a pounding he won't forget!
Wha--? I don' wanna help Mojo Jojo. He be mean to me. Now git offa my propity!
Cool, bring that stolen stabilizer back to me at the tree house.
Great work defeating Fusion Numbuh Four. You can leave now and come back to the Jungle Outpost.
Exit the area.
Now get out of there and come back to the Jungle Outpost.
Great work defeating Fusion Numbuh Four. You can leave now and come back to the Jungle Outpost.
Talk to Numbuh Four.
You stopped the spread of the infection, but we need to hit it at the source. You should go back to Samurai Jack and figure out how to attack the monsters at the Dark Tree.
Fusion Numbuh Four is a wimp.
Thank you for slowing Fuse's infection in the Darklands.
You beat Fusion Numbuh Four! You rule.
You beat Fusion Numbuh Four in the Darklands? Great!
Return the stabilizer to Numbuh Two.
Plant a Seed
Place Wisdom Seed in Dark Tree.
To stop the Dark Tree's roots from infecting this planet, we must place a Wisdom Seed inside the tree. You can collect one from the Eyebulbs in Hero's Hollow.

I fought the Eyebulbs in Hero's Hollow to collect a Wisdom Seed. Then I went into the Dark Glade to plant the seed, but I was ambushed by Fusion Jack. I defeated him, collected Jack's sandal and made a Jack Nano.
I am in your debt. The Dark Tree's power is strong, but the Wisdom Seed will help slow the infection. We have certainly struck a powerful blow against Fuse.
You must go to Hero's Hollow, on the edge of Fuse's Lair. Look for the Eyebulb monsters. They possess the Wisdom Seed that will allow us to slow the Dark Tree's infection.
Defeat the Eyebulbs.
To obtain your next Nano, you must go to Hero's Hollow, deep in the Darklands.
You have collected the item you require.
You have obtained the Wisdom Seed. Now go to the Dark Glade infected zone. Once you are there, I will direct you to the heart of the tree itself.
You rule. But the challenges are only going to get tougher. I think you're ready!
Go to Dark Glade infected zone.
Now it is time to proceed to the heart of the Dark Tree.
You want my help, kid? That's fine and dandy, but I don't consort with no wimps. Here's a reward from Max.
Enter the Fusion Portal to find your way to the Dark Tree's heart. Once inside, you can deposit the Wisdom Seed.
Enter Fusion Portal.
Find the Fusion Portal. Steel yourself and be prepared for resistance.

You may have planted the Wisdom Seed, but there is one more obstacle to overcome. Fusion Jack is at the source of this evil, helping to spread the Dark Tree's poison. Defeat him and make your next Nano.
Defeat Fusion Jack.
This battle will test all your skills.
But there's more trouble. I received a garbled message from Kevin in the wilderness. It sounds like he's in danger. I want you to report to Hoss Delgado in Devil's Bluff.
You're good. Too bad I'm better.
You have entered the heart of the Dark Tree. I am certain a Fusion is about. Quickly, plant the Wisdom Seed while there is time.
Plant Wisdom Seed.
It is done. But watch your flank! Fusion Jack approaches.
With Fusion Jack defeated and the Wisdom Seed planted, you can now leave the area and return to me.
Exit the area.
It is safe for you to leave now.
With Fusion Jack defeated and the Wisdom Seed planted, you can now leave the area and return to me.
Talk to Samurai Jack.
Once again, I am in your debt. The Dark Tree's power is strong, but the Wisdom Seed will help slow the infection. Take the sandal you collected to make a Nano. You have done well.
I hope the Dark Tree will stop poisoning the Jungle.
The KND say hello.
The Dark Tree is a horrible thing! Thanks for beating Fusion Jack.
My Monkeys!
Recover Numbuh Three's Rainbow Monkeys.
Do you think it's possible for Rainbow Monkey dolls to come to life? I swear I saw my monkeys march off in the direction of Monkey Mountain. Weird!!

I went to the Monkey Mountain infected zone and recovered Numbuh Three's Rainbow Monkey dolls. The baby doll was guarded by Fusion Numbuh Three! Numbuh Three let me keep one of the dolls to make a Nano.
Oh, thank you so much for getting my family of Rainbow Monkeys back! I wonder how they came to life? Maybe that weird magician guy at Devil's Bluff knows.
I lost an entire family of Rainbow Monkeys in the Monkey Mountain infected zone! Can you find Papa Monkey, Mama Monkey, Brother Monkey, Sister Monkey and itty-bitty Baby Monkey? Thank you!!
Find Papa Monkey.
Whee! It's Nano Time! Go to Monkey Mountain for a rescue operation.
Yay! Now find Mama Monkey!
Beets taste terrible!
I lost an entire family of Rainbow Monkeys in the Monkey Mountain infected zone! Can you find Papa Monkey, Mama Monkey, Brother Monkey, Sister Monkey and itty-bitty Baby Monkey? Thank you!!
Find Mama Monkey.
Whoopee! Now find Brother Monkey!
I lost an entire family of Rainbow Monkeys in the Monkey Mountain infected zone! Can you find Papa Monkey, Mama Monkey, Brother Monkey, Sister Monkey and itty-bitty Baby Monkey? Thank you!!
Find Brother Monkey.
Tee-hee! Where's Sister Monkey?
I lost an entire family of Rainbow Monkeys in the Monkey Mountain infected zone! Can you find Papa Monkey, Mama Monkey, Brother Monkey, Sister Monkey and itty-bitty Baby Monkey? Thank you!!
Find Sister Monkey.
Great! But where's Baby Monkey? She's nowhere to be found!
Oh no! Fusion Numbuh Three took Baby Monkey! Can you find her hideout and save my baby?
I think you're the best!
Find Fusion Portal.
Kuki! I'm detecting Fusion Numbuh Three! I'll bet she stole Baby Monkey.
Oh no! Fusion Numbuh Three took Baby Monkey! Can you find her hideout and save my baby?
Enter Fusion hideout.
It's Nano Time, mate! Go talk to Samurai Jack in the Forsaken Valley.
Fusion Numbuh Three stole my baby Rainbow Monkey doll! But she's being guarded by yucky Sickle Simians. You need to fight them!
Defeat ten Sickle Simians.
Eek! Fusion Numbuh Three has help from Sickle Simians! Look out!
Awesome! Bring the monkeys you rescued to Numbuh 2112. She's nearby.
Defeat Fusion Numbuh Three and get my little itty-bitty baby Rainbow Monkey doll back! If you save her, you can use her to make a new Nano.
Max Marathon
Defeat Fusion Numbuh Three
Find Fusion Numbuh Four's lair and give him a smackdown!
Bring the monkeys that you rescued to our operative Numbuh 2112. Then you need to save Baby Monkey from Fusion Numbuh Three.
Deliver monkeys to Numbuh 2112.
Thanks for getting Fusion Numbuh Three and saving the whole Rainbow Monkey family! You're so sweet!
Return to Numbuh Three.
You! I must speak with you right away!
Thanks for saving the entire Rainbow Monkey family! I want you to keep baby. You can use her to make a Nano. I still don't understand how they got up and started walking around, though!
Rainbow Monkeys? Psssh.
Thanks for defeating Fusion Numbuh Three.
You did it! Hooray! Come back over here, I have something for you.
Pinpoint locations of three Terrafusers in Sector V.
Deliver a TRACKAMABOB to Grandpa Max.
Bring me a Rainbow Monkey! Bring me a Rainbow Monkey!
I'm so glad you stopped Fusion Numbuh Three.
Charmed Life
Help Hex find the Charms of Bezel.
I seek the Charms of Bezel. I believe the Charm of Reincarnation briefly gave life to your friend's toy monkeys. Return to Monkey Mountain and search for me.

I went back to Monkey Mountain, but only found a trace of magic powder, and not the Reincarnation Charm. I then explored Dinosaur Pass, where I invaded the infected zone and fought Fusion Hex to recover the magic powder and make a Nano.
The Fusion's magic powder is good for nothing but parlor tricks. If we are to defeat Fuse, I must recover all of my powers. And you may tell Tetrax to leave me be.

You will go back to Monkey Mountain and search for the Charm of Reincarnation. I believe it is this very charm that caused Numbuh Three's toys to come to life. The Volcano Toads are carrying a magic box. Defeat them and recover the box for me.
Defeat the Volcano Toads.
Congratulations, it is Nano Time. Proceed to Monkey Mountain immediately.
Grandpa Max is waiting for you in Townsville Park. You need to bring him this TRACKAMABOB. But hurry. The batteries are almost dead!
Very good. Please bring that Magic Box to me immediately.
Bring the Magic Box that you recovered from the Volcano Toads. I am back at Devil's Bluff.
Bring Magic Box to Hex.
Warning. Be wary of how you deal with the one called Hex. He cannot be trusted.
Hmmm. There are traces of an arcane powder inside this box. Fuse is meddling with powers he cannot understand. I've seen the monsters in Dinosaur Pass toying with such energies
We must keep these magical items out of our enemy's hands. Go to the infected zone in Dinosaur Pass, which is out in the Darklands. You may travel there from Monkey Mountain.
Go to Dinosaur Pass infected zone.
I've seen the monsters in this area toying with such energies. Proceed to the infected zone in the Ruins. Defeat those you encounter and bring whatever you find back to me.
Now you gotta find -- GULP! -- Fusion Courage! Shiver!
You must make your way through the treacherous infected zone in Dinosaur Pass to find the entrance to Fusion Hex's lair.
I delivered a KND TRACKAMABOB to Grandpa Max.
Enter Fusion Portal.
Find Fusion Hex. He commands the monsters in this area.
You've found Fusion Hex's lair. It's time to show him what it means to interfere with powerful magics. Recover more of that laughable magic powder, and I am certain you will be able to create a Nano.
Defeat Fusion Hex.
Fusion Hex is here. You will defeat him if you know what is good for you.
You must talk to Samurai Jack, human child, if you hope to obtain a Nano.
You have defeated Fusion Hex. Collect the Magic Powder and return to me at once.
Exit the area.
You may leave now and return to me.
You have defeated Fusion Hex. Collect the Magic Powder and return to me at once.
Good work. I hope Grandpa Max makes use of that TRACKAMABOB. Meanwhile, I gotta help the operatives in Offworld Plaza. I hope we're back in space soon!
Bring Magic Powder to Hex.
Please come and see me in the Forsaken Valley as soon as you can.
Bah! This Magic Powder is a child's toy! I must find the Charms of Bezel to fully restore my abilities. Keep this trifle for yourself. Perhaps you can use it to make a Nano.
I don't care about you or Fusion Hex.
Anyone who enters Dinosaur Pass and defeats Fusion Hex is a hero.
Fusion Hex is spookier than the real Hex!
Thanks for beating Fusion Hex.
Ring Around the Collar
Protect the research station.
Hex is scary, but he was right. Fuse is playing around with dark magic in the Darklands. How dark can you get? We need some help!
You need to bring the unstable radioactive isotope to the KND operative waiting for it down at the amusement park. He will deliver it to the kids at the spaceport.

Fuse is trying to use Dark Magic to make the creatures in the Darklands more powerful. I fought Ghastly Growths and Bully Behemoths in the Dark Glade. Then I found Fusion Courage in the Firepits and defeated him!
You did great! Fuse is getting stronger all the time, but you showed him a thing or two. And you got a cute little Courage Nano, too!

Fuse is taking the power of the Dark Tree in the Dark Glade and making his monsters more powerful. You have to go to the Dark Glade infected zone to take care of four Ghastly Growths to prevent them from absorbing the powerful energies of the Dark Tree. Yikes!
Defeat four Ghastly Growths.
It's Nano Time! You need to go to the Dark Glade infected zone. Whimper!
Talk to Fuzzy Lumkins.
Your next target are the bizarre Bully Behemoths. These creatures are incredibly strong, and Fuse hopes to make them even more so.
Defeat five Bully Behemoths.
Defeat five Bully Behemoths and don't let them become even more dangerous.
Now you must proceed to the heart of Fuse's network: Fuse's Lair.
Deliver the isotope to Numbuh 311.
Good job with the spooky Ghastly Growths. The weirdo Bully Behemoths are next. These creatures are really strong, and Fuse hopes to make them even stronger, so watch out.
Defeat five Bully Behemoths.
Yipe! Now defeat five Bully Behemoths.

It is now time to begin recruiting new monkey minions. Then we will use the tributaries and waterways of the wilds to distribute my new Chemical X formula. And then I will have super monkey minions! Go and find Fuzzy Lumkins, who lives near Leakey Lake. He will help me with this plan, or my name is not Mojo Jojo!
You did really great against those monsters. Fuse is weaker already. You gotta go now to the Firepits infected zone. One more monster to get.
Go to Firepits infected zone.
Hooray. Now you need to go to the Firepits infected zone.
Now you have to find Fusion Courage inside the Firepits infected zone. He's the scary creature that's helping to make all the other scary creatures even stronger.
Enter Fusion Portal.
Fusion Courage leads all the creatures in the Darklands. He's more powerful than an entire herd of Doom Striders! Once you get him, maybe you'll get a Nano!
You're doing an awesome job. You're definitely ready for the next leg of your journey. Once you get done with this mission, go see my Grandpa Max. He's down in the Fissure at the park. -Ben
Defeat Fusion Courage.
Get Fusion Courage! We're not afraid of you, Fuse!
Good. I'm very impressed with your skill.
You have defeated Fusion Courage. Collect the dog tag and return to me in Forsaken Valley.
Exit the area.
Yikes, you found my dog tag! Can you bring it back to me?
You have defeated Fusion Courage. Collect the dog tag and return to me in Forsaken Valley.
Return to Tetrax.
Congratulations on your victory. Please come back to Forsaken Valley.
Well done. If I am not mistaken, you may be able to use this dog tag to create a Courage Nano. But the item by itself is useless. You should speak to Courage in Nowhere.
Good work. Numbuh 311 got the radioactive isotope and will bring it to the other KND agents at the space port. I hope we're back in space soon!
Go speak to Courage in Nowhere. The Dog Tag is not useful to you unless you collect Courage's collar as well.
Bring dog tag to Courage.
Yeah, bring me that dog tag and I'll give you a collar to go with it.
Yeesh, Fusion Courage is scary. I'm glad you got rid of him. I put my dog tag on this collar. Now you can use it to make a Courage Nano. Whimper!
Fusion Courage needs to learn new tricks.
With Fusion Courage out of the way, the monsters in the Darklands are weaker.
I had a dog like Fusion Courage once. I hated him!
Thanks for saving the Darklands from Fusion Courage!
Hey, the Jungle Outpost is under attack! Can you go see Mandy at the Ruins? And if you see Ed, tell him to come home already! -Edd
Fuse's minions are preparing to attack the Great Machine at the Jungle Outpost. Please go speak to Mandy at the Ruins and see if she knows more. -Dexter
TRACKAMABOB? Gimme a break.

You must go speak to Mandy at the Ruins. She knows something about an imminent Fuse attack, which means that Fuse will be attacking something in the near future. I hate Fuse, and I don't like him, either. -Mojo Jojo
There's a problem in the jungle! Fuse and his monsters are planning an attack on the Great Machine at the Jungle Outpost. You need to meet up with a girl named Mandy at the Ruins. Good luck! -Ben
I want you to go find Juniper Lee in Nowhere. She may be able to help you get a new Nano. Also, she's purty! -Edd
Fuse is trying to collect totems of alien power. Speak to Juniper Lee in Nowhere. She may know a little more about what is going on. -Dexter

Fuse is attempting to collect powerful alien totems, which we cannot allow for a few reasons. However, I will not outline all the reasons for you in this email, for there are too many reasons and I am not interested in writing a very long email. Just understand that we cannot allow Fuse to collect the powerful alien totems. Speak to the girl called Juniper Lee in Nowhere. She may be interested in giving you all the reasons that I am reluctant to give you. -Mojo Jojo

Fuse is up to his old tricks again. This time, he's trying to collect powerful alien totems from the planet Anurphaetos. That's where Ghostfreak is from. That's not a good sign. Go find Juniper Lee in Nowhere. She may know where the hidden alien totems are. -Ben
Yeesh, there's something about Fusion Demongo, and alien totems, and warrior souls…I can't even follow it! You need to find Demongo at the Dark Tree and ask him to explain all this stuff to you. -Edd

So it would seem that Fuse is trying to collect the alien totems to give to Fusion Demongo. Fusion Demongo is very dangerous, since it appears he is also responsible for absorbing the energies of the world's missing heroes. I suggest talking to Demongo himself. But be warned: Demongo is some kind of demon and not to be trusted. -Dexter

If Fuse assembles items of great power, he will become very powerful! And if Fuse becomes more powerful, he will be more powerful than us! And then we will be defeated, and our planet will turn into green goo! Which is my way of saying: go see Demongo at the Dark Tree! -Mojo Jojo

Fuse is trying to collect the totems from Anurphaetos to give to one of his henchmen, Fusion Demongo. Apparently, Fusion Demongo can absorb the powers of great warriors. You need to find Demongo at the Dark Tree and see if he can shed some light on this. -Ben
You're an incredibly fast delivery guy.
Hey, I just heard from Ed somewhere deep in the jungle! He says you need to find Coco in the Twisted Forest! And something about a scary Fusion monster! Yikes! -Edd
Fusion Coco is constantly attacking our allies at the Jungle Outpost. Find Coco in the Twisted Forest and see if she can help you locate Fusion Coco. -Dexter

I am about to tell you how you might be able to make a new Nano. Are you ready to hear about it? No? How about now? Now? Okay, now! Speak to Coco in the Twisted Forest! Coco is an Imaginary Friend who looks like a bird. No, a plane! No, a palm tree! Whatever she is, she can help you make a new Nano. Now stop reading this email! -Mojo Jojo

A Fusion bird-thing has attacked the Jungle Outpost on more than one occasion. You need to track down Coco, who is an imaginary bird-thing hanging out in the Twisted Forest. She can probably help us. -Ben
Ed wants to thank you for protecting his kingdom from the scary Fusion Coco. You can find him at the Jungle Outpost. How did Ed get a kingdom, anyway? -Edd
Excellent work protecting the Jungle Outpost. You can return there and report to Ed. He would like to thank you for your efforts. -Dexter

The boy called Ed fancies himself a jungle king, but he is not a king at all, except perhaps a king of the nincompoops! He wants to thank you for defeating Fusion Coco and protecting the Jungle Outpost, so why don't you go see him? Surely, you would prefer a reward to sitting here reading email? I know I would prefer a reward to sitting here reading email. But that's just me. Me, -Mojo Jojo
Hey, nice work taking down Fusion Coco! Why don't you go see Ed at the Jungle Outpost? -Ben

Everyone knows that dinosaurs are cool. But not when they are turned into nasty alien goo monsters! You should talk to that girl Gwen down at the Crystalline Caverns. She knows a thing or two about Fuse's plans in the Darklands. -Edd

Gwen just reported some disturbing news. Apparently, Fuse is using dinosaur DNA collected from the Darklands to create powerful prehistoric Fusions. Can you check with Gwen at the Crystalline Caverns to learn more? -Dexter
Looking for some new gear, huh? Well, I've got some stuff that I think will do the trick, but I need some help pinpointing the locations of Terrafusers in Sector V.
I wanna ride the roller coaster.
I command you to speak to Gwen at the Crystalline Caverns! Her hair is red! -Mojo Jojo

Hey, you need to talk to my cousin, Gwen. She says Fuse is up to some dirty business in the Darklands. Do you know where Gwen is? She should be hanging out near the Crystalline Caverns. Tell her I say hi! -Ben
Do you know Mac? Fuse's monsters stole his backpack. How about helping a friend in need? Go find Mac at the Jungle Outpost. Send Ed my regards. -Edd
Hey, our friend Mac had his backpack stolen. Can you go help him out? He is at the Jungle Outpost. -Dexter

Young boys and girls and their activities do not interest me in the least, unless those young boys and girls happen to be of the annoying super-powered variety, such as the Powerpuff Girls! In this case, a young boy named Mac requests your assistance at the Jungle Outpost. Go! -Mojo Jojo
Mac just had his backpack stolen. Go check with him at the Jungle Outpost and see if you can lend him a hand. -Ben

Ed says that the trees near the Jungle Outpost are showing signs of alien infection. Do you think Fuse's goo is spreading through the roots of the trees? It seems like a strong possibility! Can you talk to Ed at the Jungle Outpost? -Edd
Fuse is somehow spreading his infection from the Darklands into the jungle. It's already affecting the Jungle Outpost. Report to Numbuh Four. See if you can get to the bottom of this. -Dexter

You must proceed to the Jungle Outpost to speak with Numbuh Four. Do not speak to Numbuh One. Or to Numbuh Three. Or to Numbuh Two or Numbuh Five. Just speak to Numbuh Four. Four is the numbuh that you must remember. -Mojo Jojo
The KND request immediate assistance at the Jungle Outpost. Report to Numbuh Four. -Ben
If Ben likes you, then I like you!
Oooh…Samurai Jack wants to speak with you right away. He's in the Forsaken Valley. I hope you're not in trouble! -Edd

Fuse is using the Dark Tree in the Darklands to spread his infection through the earth. A genius plan, and a terrible one! Please go speak to Samurai Jack in the Forsaken Valley. Tell him I sent you. -Dexter

The ancient samurai lived by a strict code of honor and possessed intense loyalty for their masters. I wish my minions had this kind of loyalty, but sadly, they do not. I can't even get them to show up for our monthly minion review meetings! Go speak to Samurai Jack in the Forsaken Valley. Maybe he knows how to improve my minions' behavior. -Mojo Jojo

Our enemy, Fuse, is using more and more clever ways to spread his infection throughout the planet. Apparently, he is using the roots of the Dark Tree to infect the jungle. Can you check in with Samurai Jack in Forsaken Valley? Maybe he knows how we can keep the infection from spreading further. -Ben
Awww, Numbuh Three lost her Rainbow Monkey dolls! Can you go to the Jungle Outpost and help her? Thanks! -Edd

Okay, this is very strange, indeed. Numbuh Three says that her Rainbow Monkey dolls came to life and disappeared into the jungle! Can you please go see what she is talking about? You will find her at the Jungle Outpost. -Dexter

Curses! Numbuh Three's Rainbow Monkey dolls have gone missing! Did I ever tell you that I have a cousin, by marriage, who is a Rainbow Monkey? Very pleasant to be with at family functions, as long as you don't have to spend more than two hours with him. After two hours, he is not pleasant to be with at all! In fact, I can't stand him! -Mojo Jojo
Numbuh Three reports that her Rainbow Monkey dolls have gone missing. Can you go check in with her at the Jungle Outpost to see if you can help? -Ben
Hey, you should go see that spooky guy named Hex in the Ruins. I think it's about a new Nano! -Edd
The magician called Hex claims to know what caused Numbuh Three's Rainbow Monkey dolls to come to life. You'll find him at the Ruins. -Dexter
You Make the Call

Sometimes, my internal monologue is so loud that it interferes with my external monologue! That is why I have resorted to writing emails, as emails are virtually invulnerable to both internal and external monologues! You must speak with the dark magician called Hex at the Ruins. And please pick up my dry-cleaning. Wait...nevermind the dry-cleaning. That was my internal monologue! -Mojo Jojo

My old friend, Hex, thinks he knows why Numbuh Three's dolls came to life. But I'm just kidding about Hex being a friend…he's a scheming magician and potentially quite dangerous! Go talk to him at the Ruins…but stay on your guard. -Ben
Fuse is trying to use magic to make the monsters in the Darklands much more powerful! Don't let him do it! Go see the alien guy called Tetrax in the Forsaken Valley. I know he can help! -Edd

Fuse is tampering with powerful magic forces. I know very little about magical energies. You should talk to Tetrax in the Forsaken Valley. He is near the research station. Perhaps he can help. -Dexter
Writing this email is preventing me from watching my favorite television program! Go see Tetrax in the Forsaken Valley! I must return to my favorite television program! -Mojo Jojo

Tetrax wants to see you right away. He's reporting bizarre energy signatures from the Darklands, indicating that Fuse is toying with powers of unknown origin. You'll find Tetrax in Forsaken Valley. -Ben
Warrior's Welcome
Collect an artifact from the Really Twisted Forest.
Are you familiar with Demongo, the Soul Collector? He may be responsible for the heroes' disappearances. We need to track him, and I think I have a way.
I went to the Really Twisted Forest and collected the Warrior's Crest, which contains the spirits of great warriors from the ancient Hall of Heroes.
Recover Max's satellite phone from the Fissure.
You have done well. The Warrior's Crest contains the spirits of great heroes of the past. With Dexter's Power Level Tracker, we can locate Demongo.
I want you to return to the jungle and go to the Really Twisted Forest. You must recover the Warrior's Crest from the infected zone there. With that, we should be able to find Demongo.
Go to Really Twisted Forest.

So, Jack believes that Demongo is responsible for the missing heroes? I have heard of him. He is some kind of demon that can absorb warrior spirits. Sounds powerful. Keep me updated. Good work. -Dexter
The Warrior's Crest was stolen from the Hall of Heroes at the Hani-Baba Ruins.
The infected area in the Really Twisted Forest is most hazardous. You must try to locate the Warrior's Crest, hidden somewhere amidst Fuse's dangerous infestation.
Find the Warrior's Crest.
Enter the infected zone to find it. We will need it to proceed.
Well done! Return to me with the crest and I will explain what we need to do.
The Warrior's Crest contains the spirits of warriors past. Bring it back to me. We can utilize it to locate Demongo and find Dexter's missing heroes.
I need to contact Ben at the space port, but Fuse's minions stole my satellite phone and escaped into the infected zone deep inside the Fissure. Can you help?
Bring crest to Jack.
You have great skill! The Warrior's Crest will allow us to locate Demongo. I am certain he is somewhere in the Darklands. Dexter sent a reward for you.
An ancient artifact of power? Yawn.
I'm amazed that you were able to recover the Warrior's Crest.
What's a Warrior's Chest?
Oooh! The Warrior's Crest is old and powerful and stuff.
Magical Aid
Restore power to the Warrior's Crest.
The Warrior's Crest is devoid of its mystical energies. I want you to find Juniper Lee in Nowhere. She is knowledgeable of such things.
I brought the Warrior's Crest to Juniper Lee. She was able to restore its mystical energies after I defeated the Cryptworms.
I navigated the fissure and recovered Max's satellite phone.
