You are proving to be a most resourceful ally. Now that the energy has been restored to the Warrior's Crest, I believe I know how we must continue our quest.
There is a young woman named Juniper Lee in Nowhere. She knows the ways of magic and should be able to help us restore energy to the Warrior's Crest.
Talk to Juniper Lee in Nowhere.

Juniper Lee is a trusted friend. She possesses great skill. As the world's Te-Xuan-Ze, she helps maintain balance between the world of man and magic. I'm highly skeptical of magic, but she's definitely a good person to talk to. -Dexter
This Warrior's Crest is a very interesting artifact! I'm sure I can help you restore its energies. There's just one problem…
Juniper Lee wants you to defeat eight Cryptworms in the Lower Catacombs so she can focus her magical powers.
Defeat eight Cryptworms.
You must go to the Lower Catacombs to find the Cryptworms. Be careful!
Nice work! Come back here and I'll be able to help you now.
Bring the Warrior's Crest to Juniper Lee so that she can restore its power.
Good work recovering my satellite phone. Now I should be able to reestablish my contact with Ben. Fuse keeps tampering with our equipment!
Talk to Juniper Lee.
Okay, the power of the Warrior's Crest is restored. I hope you can find the missing heroes. Dexter told me all about it.
Now that Juniper Lee has restored the Warrior's Crest, please bring it back to me. We must figure out how to best utilize this artifact.
Bring Warrior's Crest to Jack.
Very good. Return to me with the Warrior's Crest.
With the power of the Warrior's Crest restored, we will be able to track Demongo. But I think we will also need to use Dexter's Power Level Tracker. Here, Dexter sent a reward for you.
Tech Meets Magic
Upgrade the Power Level Tracker.
Dexter believes we can transfer the spirits in the Warrior's Crest into the Power Level Tracker. That should allow us to locate Demongo, the Soul Collector.
I placed the Warrior's Crest atop Monkey Mountain, which allowed me to transfer the power signatures contained inside it into the Power Level Tracker.
Proceed to the Fissure in Townsville Park and wait for further instructions.
Excellent. Now you have the power signatures from the Warrior's Crest inside the Power Level Tracker. We must now find Demongo.

In ancient times, there was a Hall of Heroes inside Monkey Mountain. This location will amplify the power signatures contained in the Warrior's Crest. Once that is done, we can transfer them to the Power Level Tracker.
Head to Monkey Mountain.
Theoretically, you should be able to transfer the energies from the Warrior's Crest into the Power Level Tracker. But I am not sure how to do it. Samurai Jack seems to have a way. Good luck! -Dexter
Before you climb the peak, you must take out some of our enemies.
Defeat six Scythe Simians before proceeding up the mountain. They cannot give you any trouble if they are out of the way.
Defeat six Scythe Simians.
The Scythe Simians will give you trouble if you are not careful.
Good work. Now proceed up the mountain to the correct location.
Navigate the most dangerous parts of the infected mountainside. Once you find the correct location, the Warrior's Crest will be amplified.
Go to the Fissure infected zone.
Climb Monkey Mountain.
You are at a critical junction point of ancient energies.
When you amplified the energies inside the Warrior's Crest, you transferred their power to the Power Level Tracker. You may now return to me.
Return to Samurai Jack.
The Power Level Tracker has received the energies from the Crest.
We have utilized a combination of science and magic. The Power Level Tracker now contains the information we need to locate Demongo. Here is your reward from Dexter.
Horrordactyl Hunt
Fight the Horrordactyls plaguing the valley.
The Power Level Tracker indicates that Demongo is deeper in the Darklands. You are not yet prepared for this challenge, but I can help you.
I defeated the Horrordactyls in Dinosaur Pass.
Hey, I've been having trouble raising Max on his satellite phone. Can you find out what's going on? -Ben
You have shown great skill and bravery. Now you must prove your abilities in the dreaded Fireswamps. If you can do this, you may pursue Demongo.

There are primitive peoples in this area, and Fuse's Horrordactyls plague their lives. If you can purge Dinosaur Pass of some of these foul creatures, I will know you are ready for the next step in your journey.
Defeat twelve Horrordactyls.

I see you have upgraded the Power Level Tracker with ancient energies. Find Demongo, but please do not put yourself in unnecessary peril. If Jack thinks you still need preparation, listen to him. -Dexter
Your skills are improving with each passing day.
You have done well. Return to me to receive your reward from Dexter.
Return to Jack.
Dexter has sent you a reward. Return to me.
You are most skilled, but Demongo is no ordinary adversary. You must pass a few more trials before I can be sure you are ready to confront him.
Friend in Need
I helped Numbuh Two locate three Terrafusers in Sector V.
Proceed with caution. The park is badly infected, and the surface is treacherous.
I helped Peggy Danger in the Fireswamps.
Always remember to help your allies. A fellow Fusion Fighter named Peggy Danger is in the Fireswamps, and she needs your help. Go to her.
I found Peggy Danger in the Fireswamps, and recovered her Bonkstick from the Magma Hulks.
Very good. Now please return to me. I have one final test of your skills before we pursue Demongo.
There is a girl in the Fireswamps named Peggy Danger. She's in trouble. Please go find her and lend her your aid.
Talk to Peggy Danger.
Oh, I'm so glad you're here! I was just in a fierce battle with Fuse's forces and lost my Bonkstick. I'm defenseless! Can you get it back from the Magma Hulks?
You must defeat the Magma Hulks to recover Peggy Danger's lost weapon.
Defeat the Magma Hulks.
That's it! Thanks! Can you bring it back to me?
You have to defeat the Dire Raptors that stole my phone so that I can contact Ben.
You have succeeded. Bring the weapon to Peggy Danger so she will not remain defenseless. And always remember that a true ally would do the same for you.
Deliver bonkstick to Peggy.
You're the best! Thanks. Fuse's army is really strong in the Darklands, but I know that we can beat him. It's only a matter of time.
Peggy Danger? Is that her real name?
Thanks for helping Peggy Danger in the Fireswamps.
I went to school with Peggy Danger!
That was so nice of you to help Peggy Danger.
The Power of Bonk
Forge a bonkstick of power.
Defeat the Dire Raptors.
Would you like to forge your own…bonkstick? I doubt the value of this weapon, but Dexter claims it is quite powerful. You must go back to the Fireswamps.
I forged a bonkstick in the fires of the Firepits. I am now ready to find Demongo.
The great power of the…bonkstick…has been forged in the flames of the Firepits. Now you are ready to pursue Demongo and find the missing heroes.
Take the bonkstone to the Firepits, on the far side of the Fireswamps. Before you can forge your weapon in the flames, you must defeat seven Stone Drakes.
Defeat seven Stone Drakes.

The great heroes Puppet Pal Mitch and Puppet Pal Clem once wielded bonksticks on the field of battle. Now, you too can share in their glory. Then we can find the missing heroes and solve the mystery! -Dexter
Good. Now take the bonkstone and place it in the fires of the Firepits.
Now that you have defeated the Stone Drakes, take the bonkstone and place it in the fires of the Firepits. You will forge a bonkstick of great power.
Forge the bonkstick.
It is done. Your weapon is in hand. Now let us find Demongo.
Thanks. Make your way back here. I need to talk to my grandson right away.
Beware the power of bonk.
Good job making your own bonkstick.
Bonk!
Some day I'll have my very own bonkstick.
Demongone
Locate Demongo in the Darklands.
The Power Level Tracker indicates that Demongo is near the Dark Tree. Follow the signal, but you must be swift. You will not be able to target him for long.
I located Demongo near the Dark Tree in the Darklands. He claims that all the souls he stole were taken by Fusion Demongo!
Though Demongo is somewhat to blame, our true enemy is Fusion Demongo. We need to form a plan to return the warrior souls to their proper homes.
Proceed to Huntor's Crest and find Demongo. Be careful. I have faced him before, and he is a terrible adversary. Who knows what he might be up to?
Please bring the satellite phone back to me so I can call Ben.
Find Demongo before time expires.
With the Power Level Tracker upgraded with the information from the Warrior's Crest, you have been able to locate Demongo near the Dark Tree. Well done. Be careful. -Dexter
Yesss, I am Demongo. However, I do not possess the souls you seek! The one called Fuse created a Fusion Demongo, and he has pilfered the souls from me. Revenge will be mine!
Unfortunately, the Power Level Tracker has lost the signal. Return to me so I can reset the device. We will find Demongo yet.
Return to Jack.
I'm afraid you've lost the signal. Return to me so I can recalibrate the device.
You can do it this time. Hurry to Huntor's Crest and speak with Demongo. We must get to the bottom of this mystery.
Now that you have spoken with Demongo, return to me so we can plot our next move. It appears that a Fusion is the one to blame.
Talk to Jack.
Very well. Demongo speaks the truth. We seek Fusion Demongo after all.
Return Max's phone.
Fusion Demongo patrols the Darklands. We must obtain a Sacred Vessel to steal the warrior souls back. Then we can restore them to the world. Please, take this reward.
Soul Collecting is an impressive feat.
I am very pleased that you were able to find Demongo.
Ain't you scared of Demongo?
Wow, you found Demongo near the Dark Tree! You must be brave!
Bully the Bullies
Recover a Sacred Vessel.
To steal back the souls from Fusion Demongo, we must first collect a Sacred Vessel from the Dark Glade. Are you up to the task?
I went to the Dark Tree and recovered a Sacred Vessel that was guarded by Bully Behemoths.
Very well. With Demongo's charm, you will simply need to be in Fusion Demongo's vicinity to recover the souls that he stole.
Good job. Your skills are impressive. Ben was right about you! These ought to go nicely with those Heatblast boots.
You must go to the Dark Glade, deep in the Darklands. There you will find the Sacred Vessel we need. No doubt it will be guarded by Fuse's monsters.
Go to the Dark Glade.
First Warrior Crests, now Sacred Vessels? All respect for Jack, I have no patience for this kind of magical nonsense. Let me know when you are back to tackling scientific endeavors! -Dexter
Avoid Demongo for now. We must find the Sacred Vessel.
Find the creatures called the Bully Behemoths. They are guarding the Sacred Vessel that we require.
Defeat the Bully Behemoths.
You will need to fight the Bully Behemoths.
Well done. Now comes the tricky part.
In order for this Sacred Vessel to be of use to us, Demongo will need to charm it. With his charm, the vessel will be able to steal back all the souls that Fusion Demongo stole from the real Demongo.
Talk to Demongo.
What kind of signal does Max get with his phone?
You must bring the Sacred Vessel to Demongo and ask him to place a charm on it.
I am too weak to recover the stolen souls from Fusion Demongo. If you can do it, I will be most impressed, yes. Allow me to lay my charm upon this Sacred Vessel.
Good work. Now bring the Sacred Vessel to me, and I will explain what we have to do.
Bring Sacred Vessel to Jack.
Good work. Return to me with the Sacred Vessel.
Now that the Sacred Vessel has been charmed by Demongo, you will able to recover the stolen warrior souls just by being in Fusion Demongo's proximity. This reward is yours.
Soul Recovery
Recover the stolen warrior souls.
We must recover the heroes' souls from Fusion Demongo and place them in the Sacred Vessel. I have a plan to distract Fusion Demongo, and I need your help.
I fought legions of monsters near Fuse's Lair and was able to seal the warrior souls from Fusion Demongo inside the Sacred Vessel.
You journeyed into the fissure? You must be brave.
Congratulations. The warrior souls are secure inside the Sacred Vessel. Now all we must do is restore them to their rightful place in the universe.

Proceed from this location to the hostile areas of Hero's Hollow. You must fight Fuse's minions in order to distract Fusion Demongo. With the Sacred Vessel in hand, the stolen warrior souls will be returned.
Go to Hero's Hollow.
I hope Samurai Jack's plan works. If you can recover the stolen warrior souls, soon the world's missing heroes will return. I cannot wait to see Major Glory once again! -Dexter
This area is crawling with Fuse's most dangerous minions.

Engage with the monsters in Hero's Hollow. This will distract Fusion Demongo, who is somewhere nearby. With each fight, I predict that the Sacred Vessel will recover the souls that Fusion Demongo stole.
Defeat four Shellworms.
Your first task is to defeat four Shellworms.
It is working! The stolen souls are returning to the Sacred Vessel.

Engage with the monsters in Hero's Hollow. This will distract Fusion Demongo, who is somewhere nearby. With each fight, I predict that the Sacred Vessel will recover the souls that Fusion Demongo stole.
Liar, liar! Pants on fire!
Defeat five Meteoric Sentries.
Now you must defeat five Meteoric Sentries.
Very good. You have almost reached your goal.

Engage with the monsters in Hero's Hollow. This will distract Fusion Demongo, who is somewhere nearby. With each fight, I predict that the Sacred Vessel will recover the souls that Fusion Demongo stole.
Defeat six Eyebulbs.
Defeat six Eyebulbs, and it will be done.
Excellent. The Sacred Vessel has recovered the warriors' souls.
The Sacred Vessel is full. You have successfully recovered all the souls that Fusion Demongo stole. Now we must return them to the world.
Return to Jack.
You have acted with skill and honor. Please return to me.
Thanks for helping me find those Terrafusers. Ben says you're doing great. How do you like that gear I gave you? Pretty sweet!
Grandpa Max is such a nice grandpa.
I am most impressed with your skill. Fusion Demongo is still a threat, but he is severely weakened now that we have recovered the souls. I want you to have this reward.
Your combat skills in the Darklands are to be commended.
That was amazing work in Fuse's Lair!
Warriors Reborn
Return the warrior souls to the world.
With the warriors' souls safely housed in the Sacred Vessel, we can now proceed to return them to the world. You must do this from the top of Monkey Mountain.
I climbed to the top of Monkey Mountain and opened the Sacred Vessel, returning all the missing heroes to the world.
You have done a great deed today. I am extremely proud of you, and I know Dexter is, too. Perhaps you should go see him at Dexlabs.
If we hope to free the warriors' souls, the Sacred Vessel must be opened atop the highest peak in the land, Monkey Mountain.
Go to Monkey Mountain.
Free Launch
I can't believe you were able to recover the souls of the missing heroes! Jack was right. Do whatever he says, and I am sure we will achieve victory. Come see me when you are done! -Dexter
You have reached the base of the mountain. Remember: it is infected.
If we hope to free the warriors' souls, the Sacred Vessel must be opened atop the highest peak in the land, Monkey Mountain.
Climb Monkey Mountain.
Ascend to the tallest peak and open the Sacred Vessel.
You've done it! The missing heroes have returned to the world.
You saved the missing heroes! Congratulations.
Major Glory is back! Yay!
I'm so happy that you were able to find the missing heroes.
The Dark Wizard
Get launch trajectory coordinates from Mojo Jojo.
Go to the Hall of Heroes.
I am thrilled that you found the missing heroes. I want to see Major Glory! However, I'm concerned about one of the souls you recovered. Can you investigate?
I went back to the Hani-Baba Ruins and recovered a shadow fragment from the Hall of Heroes. Could this be a piece of Aku?
Samurai Jack will not take this lightly. If indeed you have recovered a piece of Aku's shadow, we may be in serious trouble, indeed.
I am concerned about one of the souls that you recovered from Fusion Demongo. Its power level is off the charts. It seems to have returned to the Ruins, near the entrance to the Hall of Heroes.
Go to Hani-Baba Ruins.
This warrior's soul came back to the Hall of Heroes.
Enter the infected zone at the Ruins. I think that is where you will find the source of the power.
Find the source of power.
You will find it within the infected area of the Ruins.
The infection at the space port is designed to prevent us from getting off-planet. I want to know more about this Planet Fusion. I believe Mojo Jojo can help us.
Very strange. The soul seems to have reverted to a shadow fragment.

One of the souls that you recovered from Fusion Demongo returned to the world in the form of a shadow fragment. I have no idea what this means. Samurai Jack may have the answer. You'll find him in the Forsaken Valley.
Show fragment to Jack.
You'd better show it to Jack.
If this is what I think it is, we are in grave danger. I recognize this shadow fragment as a piece of the Dark Wizard himself, Aku! The last I saw something like this, I was in Fuse's Lair.
Shadows of Aku
Destroy the shadows of Aku.
Somehow, Fusion Demongo possessed a shred of Aku's shadow. I've encountered this before, in Fuse's Lair. You must destroy these pieces of shadow!
I recovered three shadow fragments from Fuse's Lair and destroyed them in the Dark Tree.
You are truly a great warrior. I fear that Aku may be lurking somewhere in the shadows. But with your help, we will be ready to meet any challenge. I thank you.
I got some important information from Mojo Jojo.

All along, I thought Demongo was working alone. But if Fusion Demongo collected a shred of Aku's shadow from him, Demongo may yet again be working with my greatest enemy. If that is the case, and Aku is here, we could all be in grave danger. Go to Fuse's Lair and wait for further instructions.
Go to Fuse's Lair.

I know little of shape-shifting wizards, but everything I hear about Aku makes me glad that he's not around. Complete your tasks for Jack, and then I'll add your name to my list of favorite heroes. -Dexter
This is Fuse's Lair! The heart of his infection, and a dangerous place, indeed.

I have seen shadow fragments in Fuse's Lair before. We must recover these and destroy them so Aku cannot return to our timeline. You will have to fight Fuse's minions to get the shadow fragments back.
Defeat the Great Shellslugs.
You must recover a fragment of Aku's shadow from the Great Shellslugs.
Good. Now you must find and defeat the Meteoric Guardians.

I have seen shadow fragments in Fuse's Lair before. We must recover these and destroy them so Aku cannot return to our timeline. You will have to fight Fuse's minions to get the shadow fragments back.
Defeat the Meteoric Guardians.
I am working on a surveillance satellite to learn more about Planet Fusion. Mojo Jojo's launch trajectory coordinates should help me in my research. Thanks!
Excellent. Finally, you must take on the Scoria Cephalopods.

I have seen shadow fragments in Fuse's Lair before. We must recover these and destroy them so Aku cannot return to our timeline. You will have to fight Fuse's minions to get the shadow fragments back.
Defeat the Scoria Cephalopods.
Defeat them and you will have all the shadow fragments.
Very good. With shadow fragments in hand, you must proceed to the Dark Tree.
Now that you have four shadow fragments, you must go to the Dark Tree. This is the only thing that can destroy those shadow fragments. We must not let Aku gain a foothold in our timeline.
Destroy shadow fragments.
Throw them into the tree, and they will be destroyed.
Good. The shadow fragments are no more.
Talk to Demongo.

I want to contact Mojo Jojo. On the day of the invasion, Mojo was in space investigating Planet Fusion. I want to get his launch coordinates. Find Ramma Jamma, one of Mojo's minions. He's in City Station.
Talk to Demongo.
Now please talk to Demongo. Is that demon conspiring with Aku?
I cannot say if Aku has employed my assistance. All I will tell you is this: Aku is not here, but he is close. And he is watching.
That Demongo is not a demon to toy with. Leave him be and return to me at once.
Talk to Jack.
Very well. Leave Demongo and return to me.
You have performed admirably. We must keep a watchful eye at all times. If Aku is near, then Fuse may be the least of our problems. Take this weapon to aid you in your future quests.
Into the Wild
Prove your worth to Hoss Delgado.
Sure, I'll help you find your buddy. But I don't hang with no crybabies. Bring me the tongue of a Grime Serpent, and I'll know you're Hoss material.
Go to City Station.
I found Hoss Delgado in Devil's Bluff. He asked me to get a Grime Serpent's tongue to prove myself.
Nice work getting that Grime Serpent's tongue. Them beasts is a nasty breed. Now let's settle in and talk about this friend of yours.
The readings of the Fusion Matter Receptor can mean only one thing. Fusion Numbuh One is hiding somewhere in Steam Alley. Go find the entrance to his lair!
Talk to Hoss Delgado.

I received a message from Kevin that there's dangerous Fuse activity out in the wilderness. It sounds like he's in trouble. See if you can find Kevin. In the meantime, I'll check in with Max to see how he's doing with his surveillance satellite. -Ben
You want my help? That's fine and dandy, kid. But I don't consort with wimps. Bring me the tongue of a Grime Serpent, and I'll know you're Hoss material.
Collect a tongue from a Grime Serpent to prove to me that you're the real deal. It's easy! Just go to the Really Twisted Forest and find a Grime Serpent. Then forcibly remove its tongue.
Get a Grime Serpent's tongue.

Max got a message from Kevin that there's dangerous Fuse activity out in the wilderness. It sounds like he's in trouble. See if you can find Kevin. In the meantime, I'll check in with Max to see how he's doing with his surveillance satellite. -Ben
You got it. Bring it here.
So Max wants you to contact that weirdo, Mojo Jojo? Probably because he was the only guy who ever got into space to check out Planet Fusion. Well, we all know how that ended. Be careful! -Ben
Bring the Grime Serpent's tongue to me. Then maybe I'll help you find your friend, Kevin.
Bring tongue to Hoss.
You done good, kid. Looks like you know how to handle yourself. So what can Hoss do for you? How about some sweet gear?
Chicken Scrap
Find Kevin in Nowhere.
You're looking for a kid named Kevin, huh? I think I know that guy. You'll probably find him in Nowhere. Watch out for the mutant eggplants.
I located Kevin in Nowhere. He told me about Fuse's plans to sabotage Max's satellite. I collected a launch key from the Fowl Freaks in the Caponata Catacombs and brought it to Ben right away.
You found Kevin! That kid is pretty tough. I like his leather jacket. If Ben needs you for more missions, so be it. See me if you want to kick more butt.
Proceed to the Caponata Catacombs to find the Fowl Freaks that have the Satellite Interceptor launch key. Don't go soft on me, now!
Go to the Catacombs.
Look for Mojo's monkey minion, Ramma Jamma. He can help us.
This is the entrance to the Caponata Catacombs.
To get that launch key, you need to defeat the Fowl Freaks that are guarding the Lower Catacombs. They are twisted versions of the dreaded Chickens From Outer Space.
Defeat seven Fowl Fiends.
Defeat the Fowl Freaks in the Lower Catacombs to collect the launch key.
That launch key will tell us where Fuse is going to set up his Satellite Interceptor.
You'll find your pal Kevin in Nowhere. That area will tear your head off! Look for the weird farmhouse.
Talk to Kevin.
Hey, you're a friend of Ben's? Cool. Listen, I heard about Max's satellite. Fuse and his creeps are going to try to shoot it out of the sky!
Kevin is a cool dude. Take that launch key to Ben at the space port. Tell him I say hello.
Bring launch key to Ben.
Ben said I should get you hooked up with some new equipment. First, you need to locate three Terrafusers in Sector V and relay the information back.
You need to talk to Ramma Jamma and ask him for Mojo's launch coordinates. With that info, we may be able to better study Planet Fusion.
You need to get that to Ben right away.
I'm glad Kevin's okay. We need to stop Fuse from destroying Max's satellite. Hopefully this launch key will have the info we need. Here, Hoss sent this gear for you!
Caponata Catacombs is a dumb name.
Good job in the Catacombs.
Will you save the satellite? Please?
I hope you can stop Fuse from making trouble in the Wilds!
Mountain Madness
Find the Plumber Base.
Fuse's Satellite Interceptor is protected by a shield. If we want to get past it, you'll need a device from a hidden Plumber base on Monkey Mountain.
I went to Monkey Mountain and found a hidden Plumber base. I collected a Shield Fragmentation Device (SFD) and got more Spectral Exterminator gear from Hoss.
Talk to Ramma Jamma.
Good work. The Shield Fragmentation Device will allow you to get past the Satellite Interceptor's shield. Go see Hoss. He'll tell you what to do next.

With this launch key, I should be able to determine the location of Fuse's Satellite Interceptor. In the meantime, you need to head back into the wilderness to locate a hidden Plumber base on Monkey Mountain.
Go to Monkey Mountain.
This is Monkey Mountain, and it's totally infected with Fuse's goo.
You need to make your way through the infected zone on the mountain. Look for the hidden Plumber access port. The equipment we need is inside.
Find Plumber access port.
The hidden Plumber base is inside the infected zone. I'll send the location.
Take the Shield Fragmentation Device. Bring it back to Hoss.
Take the Shield Fragmentation Device back to Hoss. I'll bet he has some new gear for you, too.
Bring SFD to Hoss.
Mojo Jojo says that you may have the launch coordinates that you have asked for…if you can find our remote storage unit! Ha ha ha! It's very high up. Ha ha ha ha ha!
I'll hold onto this doohickey for you. Nice work, pal. Now take this sweet pair of pants.
Nice work protecting the surveillance satellite.
I hope the surveillance satellite teaches us about Planet Fusion!
Dark Times
Find the Satellite Interceptor.
Ben wants you to enter the Darklands. He says that's where the Satellite Interceptor is. That place will chew you up and spit you out like an overripe banana!
I went to the Forsaken Valley and used the Shield Fragmentation Device on Fuse's Satellite Incerceptor. The machine is sabotaged, and Max's satellite is safe!
Nice work, sport. You're one tough hombre. But we've got bigger problems. I think you're gonna need to go back to Nowhere and see our pal, Kevin.

Ben's figured out that Fuse's Satellite Interceptor is somewhere in the Forsaken Valley. That place is dangerous. But your middle name is danger, right? To get to the Darklands, use the Kumari Serpent in the Monkey Foothills.
Go to Forsaken Valley.

In order to get the launch coordiantes, Ramma Jamma said you can get them from the remote storage computer. Don't give him the chance to change his mind. I think the unit is on the top of one of the nearby buildings.

Hey, I used the launch key from Kevin and figured out that Fuse's Satellite Interceptor is in Forsaken Valley, near the research station built by Mandark Industries. You need to go sabotage that thing so Fuse can't destroy Max's surveillance satellite! -Ben
The Forsaken Valley is your gateway to the Darklands.
You'll need to get rid of the Fossil Crawler guards before you find the Satellite Interceptor mainframe.
Defeat seven Fossil Crawlers.
First, defeat the Fossil Crawlers guarding the Satellite Interceptor mainframe.
Great! Now use the Shield Fragmentation Device on Fuse's mainframe.
Ben says to use the Shield Fragmentation Device on the Satellite Interceptor mainframe to destroy it. That sounds pretty complicated.
Destroy the mainframe.
Good work! Here's a reward. Now get back here. Kevin needs to see ya.
Thanks for sabotaging Fuse's satellite interceptor.
Find remote storage unit.
You saved Max's satellite! Yay!
Sinister Plans
Head to the Fireswamps.
Kevin says that he needs to see you right now. Sounds urgent. I'd help out, but I've got an appointment with a bunch of busted Fuse monsters. So you're up!
I went out to the Fireswamps to investigate Fuse's plans for making an army of Fusion Kevins. I defeated a group of Lizard Queens and returned to Hoss.
This plot makes me uneasy, and I hate being uneasy! You need to move deeper into Fuse's network. I don't think his plans end in the Fireswamps.
Kevin wants to see you right away. You'll find him in Nowhere, remember? Get to it.
Talk to Kevin.
Kevin says that he's uncovered a dangerous Fuse plot. You've done an amazing job so far, so don't stop now! Get an update from Kevin and then go teach Fuse a lesson. -Ben
Get this. Fuse stole my keys and used them to create a Fusion Kevin. But have you seen this dude? It's a giant version of my monstrous alien self. Not good.
You need to find the remote computer terminal on a skyscraper nearby.
Kevin wants you to head back out to the Darklands. The Fireswamps ain't for wimps. But I know you can take it.
Go to the Fireswamps.
Now I've learned that Fuse has a base of operations in the Fireswamps. He wants to create an army of Fusion Kevins. We can't let that happen! That Fusion is way too powerful.
You need to explore the Fireswamps and look for clues.
I once wrestled a Lizard Queen with both legs tied behind my back. You gotta take those monsters down if you want to investigate further.
Defeat six Lizard Queens.
But there's too many Lizard Queens around. Take them down.
You there. Please come to the research station and see me immediately.
Way to destroy those Lizard Queens. It seems that someone else was watching. Better go talk to him.
Talk to Tetrax.
Arrgh! I never thought you would find it!
I am Tetrax. This area is locked down and secure. Fuse is not using the Fireswamps. If Kevin wants you to continue this investigation, you will need to proceed deeper into the Darklands.
You ain't ready to go deeper into the Darklands! Even really tough kids end up frying in the Fireswamps, swallowed up by the Dark Tree, or worse! Come back to me and I'll prepare you.
Return to Hoss.
You ain't ready to go deep into the Darklands. Come back and see me.
I'll tell you how to stop this Fuse plot. First, you gotta take this Spectral Exterminator gear. Don't worry. We won't let Fuse make a Fusion Kevin army.
Pit Stop
Make a run through the Firepits.
I'm prepared to give you the awesomest weapon in my arsenal. But I want to see your speed. Make it through the Firepits in time, and I'll know you're worthy.
I ran through the Firepits in record time. Now I hope Hoss will help me investigate Fuse's sinister plot.
I gotta admit, you've got liquid steel in your veins. That was a good run through the Firepits. With more kids like you around, Fuse won't stand a chance.
Did you get the information? Bring it back here so I can take a look.
If you want to get to the bottom of Fuse's dark plans, you need to show me your speed. If you can run to the edge of the Firepits before time runs out, I'll know you're ready.
Move fast to the Firepits.
Hey. You're gonna need to be careful in the Darklands. Fuse has infected that area really badly. Watch your back and be prepared for anything. -Ben
You're not fast enough! If you can't make it through the Firepits quickly, you're not gonna survive. Come back to me and give it another go.
Good job. You're tough AND fast.
Return to Hoss.
Time's up. You failed, kid. Come back to me and try again.
I know you can do this. Envision victory. Be nothing but legs and muscle and heart. And feet. Don't forget feet. Now move!
That was a good run through the Firepits. Come back to me and I'll give you a totally buttkicking weapon.
Return to Hoss.
Deliver coordinates to Grandpa Max.
Come back to me.
Well done. You get good marks for toughness and speed. Are you ready to take the pain to Fuse's front door? Good. Here's the RRRBG.
First to the Firepits, first to burn.
You really proved yourself to Hoss.
What does RRBG stand for?
I think you're tougher than Hoss Delgado!
Bash Your Brains
Collect the brains of a Skull Basher.
You've seen the Fireswamps, but it's time to go further. Bring me the brain of a Skull Basher from Huntor's Crest, and we'll use it to find the answers we seek.
I went to Huntor's Crest and collected the brains of a Skull Basher for Hoss.
Great. These coordinates should give us a better idea of Planet Fusion's location in our orbit. I need you to send this information to Ben. Use the communications relay that I've set up at City Hall.
Good work, bucko! I don't know why Fuse thinks he can toy with us, but if that's what he's gonna do, he'll pay dearly in the end. Let's put the brakes on him.
We will use the dark powers of the unknown to uncover Fuse's plot. Bring me the brain of a Skull Basher. Go to Huntor's Crest.
Go to Huntor's Crest.
I don't know much about magic, but my cousin Gwen does. Get the Skull Basher's brain for Hoss and see if you can get to the bottom of this. We do not need an army of Fusion Kevins! -Ben
You'll find all kinds o' crazy creeps around these parts.
Find Fuse's Skull Basher monsters and collect one of their brains.
Collect a Skull Basher's brain.
But you need to find the Skull Bashers. Bring me one of their brains!
That's what I like to see. Now bring me that brain.
Good job taking down those Skull Bashers. Bring me the monster's brain so I can get down to business.
Locate the first Terrafuser.
You can find a communications relay at City Hall. Use it to send Ben the launch coordinates.
Bring brain to Hoss.
Stick with me, kid. There's powerful forces at work here that only the bravest can understand. Here's a little something for your trouble. Some Plumber gear that Ben sent.
Wow, you collected a Skull Basher's brains!
You must be brave to take on the Skull Bashers.
Welcome to Braintree
Plant monster brains in Dark Tree.
Hmmm. We can read Fuse's mind if we place the Skull Basher's brain into the Dark Tree. Go to the Dark Glade and find a good spot to plant this brain.
I went to the Dark Glade, defeated some Dark Fusionflies, and placed the Skull Basher brain inside the Dark Tree. What we learned is…questionable.
Reading minds is such a trip. Sounds like Fuse is gonna build a Fusion Kevin army deep in the Darklands, probably in his lair. Who woulda thought?!?

This is the plan. You gotta take these Skull Basher brains and plant 'em inside the Dark Tree. Then we'll be able to read Fuse's thoughts and learn what's up. But first you gotta beat up the Dark Fusionflies that are buzzing around.
Use the communications relay.
Defeat twelve Dark Fusionflies.
Nice. Now plant that brain inside the Dark Tree.
Hmmm. The answers will flow from the brains to the roots of the tree once you plant it inside. I love that dark magic stuff.
Plant the brain.
Good. But I can't read the brainwaves just yet. Come on back for some gear.
The brain is inside the Dark Tree now. We should be able to read the monster's thoughts through the roots. So come back to me and we'll figure out what to do next.
Return to Hoss.

Good news. Max has his satellite in orbit, and he's getting some pretty useful readings. Stick with Hoss and I'll fill you in soon. And what's the deal with planting brains inside trees? I hope you know what you're doing! -Ben
I think I've got it. Fuse is gonna breed the army of Fusion Kevins right in the heart of his network: Fuse's Lair. Are you ready to steamroll him? Let's do this thing! Here's some armor for ya.
Brains in trees? That's my style.
Message received! I sent Grandpa Max something that I think you'll like.
Good work at Dark Glade.
What did you learn from planting brains?
Please save us from the Fusion Kevin army.
Satellite Mission
Recover soil samples from Hero's Hollow.
Hey, Ben says he needs ya to go out to Hero's Hollow. Perfecto. I like me some multitasking. Let's take this goon downtown. You ready?
I went to Hero's Hollow and collected some soil samples for Ben and Tetrax. Grandpa Max says Fuse is trying to recreate the surface of Planet Fusion right here in our world!
Poop on a stick! So Fuse thinks he can make a home for himself on our planet? He's gonna learn the hard way that he can't do that. Let's get him, partner.
Ben wants you to go to Hero's Hollow. He said he'll send you some more information in an email. Remember, stay on the trail of the Fusion Kevin army!
Go to Hero's Hollow.
Come back to Townsville Park. I'll give you a reward for your hard work.

Grandpa Max's satellite has done an analysis of Planet Fusion's surface. He's getting similar readings from the heart of the Darklands. Fuse is trying to recreate Planet Fusion right near his lair. We can't let this happen. -Ben
Grandpa Max wants you to get some soil samples from Hero's Hollow.
Ben wants you to collect soil samples. Soil samples? That's boring. But beating up Shellworms ain't boring. Can you defeat them?
Defeat the Shellworms.
You'll need to defeat some Shellworms to collect the infected soil.
Good work. Bring those samples to Tetrax.
Bring those soil samples to that Tetrax guy in the Forsaken Valley, and then come back and see me. I've got a plan formulating in my head.
Deliver samples to Tetrax.
He's near the research facility in Forsaken Valley.
Ben told me you would be coming. I will send these soil samples to him right away. Here's some Plumber gear that Max wanted you to have.
Talk to Max.
Fuse is just a dumb alien.
I'm fascinated with Grandpa Max's spy satellite.
If I eat a planet, I'll get a tummyache.
Oooh, I don't want Fuse to eat our planet!
Captain's Log
Collect Fuse's command log.
We need to find out where Fuse is building the Fusion Kevin army. You gotta go to the Precipice and get the command log from a Jurassic Centurion.
I went to the Precipice and defeated the Jurassic Centurions. I collected a command log, and we learned that the Fusion Kevin army is being developed underground!
Yep, Fuse is building some kinda army in an underground lair. Time to introduce him to the business end of our fists, whadda you say? Who's with me?
Go to the Precipice and defeat the Jurassic Centurions. One of them is bound to have the information we need.
Also, can you tell him that my Omnitrix is acting up again?
Defeat the Jurassic Centurions.
Grandpa's satellite is collecting tons of data about Planet Fusion. We couldn't have done it without you. Now you've gotta put a stop to this Fusion Kevin army thing. I know you can do it! -Ben
That's right. Show 'em the business end of yer boot.
Bring the captain's log to me. Let's see if we can't figure out where all the nastiness is going down.
Deliver captain's log to Hoss.
Now bring me that captain's log and we'll see what's what.
Well, hmmm. Yes. Let's see. Okay. It seems that this scum called Fuse is building his Fusion army underground. But I've got a trick that will trip him up. Here, take this reward.
Eyebore Easily
Collect the eye of an Eyebore.
Fuse is using a modified Terrafuser to create a Fusion Kevin army. We can destroy this device with the Eyebore's Eye. You must go to Green Maw.
Good work. Those launch coordinates should help me complete my surveillance satellite. Take this with my thanks.
I went to Green Maw and collected the eye of an Eyebore.
Heh. You have the Eyebore's Eye. Now you must enter the depths of Fuse's Lair. Place the eye inside Fuse's machine and put the brakes on his plan.
Eyebores can only be found in the southwest area of Fuse's Lair, called the Green Maw. You must defeat the Eyebores and collect one of their evil eyes.
Collect an Eyebore's Eye.
Fuse has modified a Terrafuser to mass-produce Fusion Kevins. If he can do this, he will create an unstoppable Fusion army. Hoss can help you put an end to this before it begins. -Ben
This is it… Careful, they're feisty buggers.
Congratulations. Now you must go into the depths of Fuse's inner sanctum.
Now that you have the Eyebore's Eye, return to me so I can give you some armor for the last leg of your journey.
Return to Hoss.
But first, come back to me for some more Plumber armor!
What could you learn about Planet Fusion?
Here's the Plumber armor that I promised. You must now take the Eyebore's Eye to Fuse's Lair. Remember: your muscles can cut diamonds. Move out.
Eyebores are dumb monsters.
Excellent work collecting the Eyebore's Eye.
Can you bring me an Eyebore's big toe?
You defeated the Eyebores! You're brave!
Fusion Finale
Stop Fuse's evil plot.
Take the Eyebore's Eye and enter Fuse's Lair. Place the eye inside Fuse's machine, and the Fusion Kevins will be no more. Onward to victory. Grrr.
I went to Fuse's Lair and placed the Eyebore's Eye in Fuse's machine to stop him from making a Fusion Kevin army. I went back to the space port, and Ben thanked me in person!
You're one of the toughest kids I've ever seen. I'd be proud to go into battle with you. Don't let Fuse push us around. We're gonna send him packing!
You're doing great work for Max and Ben.
You must go to Fuse's Lair. I hope you're not gonna be a wuss. Find the Fusion Kevin machine and put the Eyebore's Eye inside it.
Go to Fuse's Lair.
Good luck out there. I know you can do this. Once it is done, come back and see me at the space port for a special reward. -Ben
Fuse's Lair…the darkest, scariest, creepiest alien fortress ever.
Before you find Fuse's machine, you gotta take out them Meteoric Guardians. Nine should do it.
Defeat nine Meteoric Guardians.
Take out the Meteoric Guardians in the area before you look for the machine.
Good. Now put the Eyebore's Eye inside Fuse's machine.
Place the eye of the Eyebore inside the machine and Fuse will not be able to make a Fusion Kevin army. Sweet.
Place eye inside machine.
Who wants to play spaceman?
Good. That machine won't work now. The Fusion Kevins are useless.
Our time together is done. Until the next adventure. Meanwhile, go see Ben down at the space port.
Go to Ben at space port.
That was awesome! Come down to the space port and see me.
You've done an amazing job. Plumber bases, Max's satellite, Anurphaetos, Fusion Kevins. You're a real hero now! Take this Plumber weapon with my thanks.
Great job in Fuse's Lair. You saved us from a Fusion Kevin army.
Thank you for putting an end to Fuse's evil plot!
Nowhere Dog
Explore the Really Twisted Forest for candy.
Oh, dear…this ain't a map of Nowhere. You have a map of the Really Twisted Forest! The Really Twisted Forest is really scary. Run! Then tell me what you find.

Grandpa Max told me something that's got me worried. He says there's a bunch of secret Plumber bases in the suburbs, and Fuse may have discovered them. Work with Numbuh Two and get some gear while I collect more info. -Ben
I would be scared to talk to Mojo!
I explored the infected area in the Really Twisted Forest. I didn't find any more Crazy Brain Candy, but I did find an eggplant?!?
An eggplant means trouble! Mutant Eggplants live in the Caponata Catacombs. Fuse is making his own Fusion Eggplants! Yipes! You need to find them.
The map that you have leads to the Really Twisted Forest. Yeek! You should go out there and see what you can dig up.
Go to the Really Twisted Forest.
Hey, the next stash of Crazy Brain Candy must be in the Really Twisted Forest. We gotta get to it before Fuse does. I have a bad feeling about this! -Edd
This is the frightening Really Twisted Forest!
Navigate the Really Twisted Forest to find the buried treasure on your map.
Find next candy stash.
It's really infected. Don't say I didn’t warn you!
Oh, no! There's no candy in the chest. But what's this?
Omnitrix Fix
What did you find? Bring it here so I can see it.
Show eggplant to Courage.
You found a pirate bandana and…an eggplant?!? Better show that to Courage.
Eggplant Peril
Fight Fusion Eggplants in the catacombs.
You'll find the scariest Fusion Eggplants in the Upper Catacombs. Yeesh! Watch out! If you can beat them, maybe you can learn where Fuse is taking the candy.
I defeated the Moussaka Meanies in the Upper Catacombs and found a piece of Crazy Brain candy. Then I defeated some Fowl Freaks and collected a dinosaur bone.
I don't know where the Crazy Brain candy went, but the Fowl Freaks had a dinosaur bone. I think you have to go to the Darklands. Howl!
Defeat four Moussaka Meanies in the Upper Catacombs and see if you can find any clues to where the Crazy Brain Candy lies.
Defeat four Moussaka Meanies.
Find a capacitor that should stabilize Ben's Omnitrix.
This is most unfortunate. It seems that Fusion Eggplants are hoarding the Crazy Brain Candy for Fuse. We need to figure out where he's hiding it! -Edd
Wow! They dropped a piece of Crazy Brain Candy! But where's the rest of it?
Now you need to defeat five Fowl Freaks and see if you can learn anything from them. Yipes!
Defeat five Fowl Freaks.
Oh, cripes. Now you need to fight the Fowl Freaks.
Those Fowl Freaks dropped a dinosaur bone.
Bring the Crazy Brain Candy and the dinosaur bone back here to me.
Deliver stuff to Courage.
Show that stuff to Courage!
My computer says this Crazy Brain Candy makes your brain all crazy. Eeek! The dinosaur bone is definitely from the Darklands. Is that where the candy is? Oh, no! Here, take this reward.
Ben's just told me that his Omnitrix is not working properly. Dexlabs has a capacitor that did the trick last time. Can you please go get one from Dexter?
Slippery Foes
Recover Muriel's slippers.
You're not ready for the Darklands! That place is terrifying! First, I need you to help me get Muriel's slippers back from scary Fuse monsters!
I defeated the Dire Apes in the Monkey Foothills and recovered Muriel's slippers.
Thanks for getting Muriel's slippers back. Even in these dark times, no one likes to have cold toes.
Please go to the Monkey Foothills and get Muriel's slippers back from the Dire Apes!
Get Muriel's slippers back.
I understand the need to help Courage, but we really must get back on the trail of the Crazy Brain Candy! Your pal, Edd
Oh, good! Can you bring those back to me?
Now that you have Muriel's slippers, can you please bring them back here to me?
I got a capacitor from Dexter to stabilize Ben's Omnitrix.
Return Muriel's slippers.
Thanks! I'm much too scared to fight monsters on my own. Do you want these Candy Pirate pants?
I don't even want to think about Muriel's feet.
Thanks for getting Muriel's slippers back.
You're nice to help old ladies.
Muriel is so happy to have her slippers back.
Valley Ghouls
Fight the monsters in the Forsaken Valley.
The trail to the candy leads to the Darklands. Whimper! I hate the Darklands! Your first stop is the Forsaken Valley. Are you ready?
I thinnned the ranks of Triceraclops and Fossil Crawlers in my search for the Crazy Brain Candy.
Ben's Omnitrix has been acting strangely ever since Fuse invaded. Thanks for going to Dexlabs to get that capacitor. We need to keep this problem under control.
You're not the only one looking for this weird candy. Fuse wants it, and the Candy Pirates want it back! You'll need to go deeper into the Darklands. Eek!

I don't recommend going out to the Darklands. You'll get eaten by a dinosaur monster, fry in the Fireswamps, or worse! The entrance to the Darklands is the Forsaken Valley. You need to take a transport from Monkey Mountain.
Go to the Forsaken Valley.
It seems that Fuse used Fusion Eggplants and Chickens to haul the Crazy Brain Candy into the Caponata Catacombs. But I guess it's not there anymore. Let's find it before it's too late. -Edd
Yikes, it's pretty scary around here.
Before you go deeper into the Darklands, you need to defeat six Triceraclops and six Fossil Crawlers. They may give us a clue to the location of the candy.
Defeat six Triceraclops.
You need to defeat six Triceraclops. Giant dinosaur monsters!
Now you need to defeat six Fossil Crawlers.
Before you go deeper into the Darklands, you need to defeat six Triceraclops and six Fossil Crawlers. They may give us a clue to the location of the candy.
I want you to go back to City Station and talk to Dexbot Q-12. See if he will contact Dexter to help us with the Omnitrix.
Defeat six Fossil Crawlers.
Good! Now get out of there before they eat you alive!
Before you go further, come back and see me. I'll give you something to help you go further into the Darklands.
Return to Courage.
Come back and I'll give you more of the Candy Pirate stuff that I found.
You did great. Now you're ready for the next step. Take this Candy Pirate booty bag to store all the candy when you find it.
Candy Scare
Journey to the Fireswamps.
I think you're ready to go to the Fireswamps. I'm sure you'll find the weird candy. Don't let anyone eat you! And don't burn up! Or fall in the lava!
I went to the Fireswamps, where I fought Creeposaurus Rexes and Tar Titans. But I didn't find the Crazy Brain Candy. I talked to Samurai Jack, who said Fuse's minions moved the candy to Fuse's Lair.
Talk to Dexbot Q-12.
Oh, dear me. The Crazy Brain Candy is in Fuse's Lair? You don't want to go there. It's the scariest place you can imagine.
You're ready to go to the Fireswamps. I'd never go there! I hope you find the Crazy Brain Candy.
Go to the Fireswamps.
If Fuse has all the Crazy Brain Candy, he could give it out to kids and scramble their brains! We need to get it back, and you're the kid to do it. Good luck! -Edd
Aggh! Look out! Creeposauruses!
Look out! Defeat seven Creeposaurus Rexes before they can eat you!
Defeat seven Creeposaurus Rexes.
There are Tar Titans nearby, too. You'd better get them.
Now you'd better defeat seven Tar Titans, just to be on the safe side.
Defeat seven Tar Titans.
My grandpa's right, the Omnitrix is really acting crazy. Sometimes it works, and sometimes it doesn't! Dexter will know what to do, though. He's a genius! -Ben
You are a valiant warrior. We must speak.
Oh, it's Samurai Jack! He's really brave. Better go talk to him and see what he wants. He's in the Forsaken Valley, at the remote research station.
Talk to Samurai Jack.
I am in the Forsaken Valley, at the research facility.
If the strange magical candy is what you seek, Fuse moved it through this area not that long ago. The monsters took it to his lair. The journey ahead is fraught with danger.
Uh-oh!  Fuse's Lair is about as scary as it gets. You'd better come back to Nowhere. Whine!
Talk to Courage.
Fuse's Lair?!? You don't want to fo there. Come back and see me.
I don't recommend going to Fuse's Lair. But if you must, here's some Candy Pirate gear to help.
I don't care about Crazy Brain Candy.
Dexlabs is happy to provide a capacitor for Benjamin Tennyson's Omnitrix. Be advised that capacitor must be set to proper frequency.
Good work exploring the Fireswamps.
I want to get Crazy Brain Candy for my brain!
You're really brave to fight Creeposaurus Rexes.
Monster Mash
Get Courage's bone from the Firepits.
You'd better get some practice before you go to Fuse's Lair. The scary Miasma Hulks in the Firepits stole my bone! Howl! Can you get it back?
I defeated Miasma Hulks in the Firepits to recover Courage's bone, but it was covered in Fusion goo. So I went into the infected zone to dispose of it.
If you can beat Miasma Hulks, you're probably ready for Fuse's Lair. But we still don't know the exact location of the candy. Too bad about my bone. Whimper!
Head out to the Firepits. You will find some really scary creatures there. Whimper! You need to fight the Miasma Hulks to get my bone back!
Defeat the Miasma Hulks.
Great. Coordinates confirmed. Now find the second Terrafuser!
While the Dexbot calibrates the capacitor, you should help Dexter with his request. Go to Orchid Bay and look for the Boardwalk Brawlers.
Courage knows a thing or two about scary monsters, huh? He's a strange dog. When you're done, pick up the trail of the Crazy Brain Candy. We're counting on you! -Edd
You got it, but it is covered in yucky Fuse goo.
Thanks for getting my bone back, but it's covered in disgusting Fusion glop. You need to take it into the infected zone and get rid of it.
Dispose of Courage's bone.
Howl!
Oh, my poor bone! You can come back now.
My bone…another casualty. Arooo! Please come back to me in Nowhere, and I'll give you a reward.
Return to Courage.
You must really be brave if you can defeat scary monsters like the ones in Firepits. Here, take this Candy Pirate sword that I found. Go get that candy!
Root of Evil
Go to Orchid Bay.
Save the Magic Tree.
I just picked up a problem on my SACT scanner. The Dark Tree is spreading Fuse's infection through its roots, and it's gonna infect the Magic Tree!
I went to Huntor's Crest and tried to slow Fuse's infection to protect the Magic Tree at the Jungle Outpost.
Thanks for helping the Magic Tree. But the infection is still spreading. What do we do, what do we do, what do we do?!?
The Magic Tree once belonged to Nowhere. He grants wishes! Go check on him at the Jungle Outpost. He's sick as a dog. Whimper.
Talk to the Magic Tree.
Ugh…I don't feel so good. Something is attacking my roots. It's coming from the Darklands. Blech. Stupid alien invasion!
Whimper! You need to go to Huntor's Crest and defeat the Skull Bashers that are spreading the tree's infection!
Defeat eleven Skull Bashers.
Go to Huntor's Crest! Save the Magic Tree! Whine!
Request: Dexter requires Fusion Matter samples from the Boardwalk Brawlers in Orchid Bay. Please obtain these while capacitor is calibrated.
Oh, good. Please go check on the Magic Tree and see how he's doing.
Thanks for beating up the Skull Bashers. Please go check on the Magic Tree at the Jungle Outpost.
Talk to Magic Tree.
Yes, I feel a bit better. But something alien is still flowing into my roots. It itches!
The Magic Tree feels a little bit better, but we still have to help him. Come see me because I have something for you.
Return to Courage.
Okay. Come see me…I found something for you.
The Magic Tree is still feeling sick? We need to do something! Here, take this SACT helmet. I find these things all over Nowhere.
Swarm Reception
Fight Dark Fusionflies in the Dark Glade.
I am looking for the Boardwalk Brawler specimens. Collect three samples
More news from the SACT scanner. Dark Fusionflies in the Dark Glade are carrying the tree's infected seeds. You need to get rid of them!
I went to the Dark Glade and annihilated a swarm of angry Dark Fusionflies. I healed the Magic Tree and collected a Dark Tree seed.
Oh, I hope the Magic Tree feels better. Now we need to get that Crazy Brain Candy back from Fuse, or there will be a disaster. I hate disasters!
Dark Fusionflies are carrying the Dark Tree's seeds. You need to go to the Dark Glade to eliminate them. Try to collect a seed.
Defeat Dark Fusionflies.
I'm glad you helped the Magic Tree, but when you are done, we really need to find the Crazy Brain Candy! -Edd
Whoah, that was scary! Now can you go check on our friend the Magic Tree?
Now that the Dark Fusionflies are destroyed, go see how the Magic Tree is feeling. He's at the Jungle Outpost.
Talk to Magic Tree.
Whew…I'm feeling much better, thanks. But as long as that Dark Tree stands, it poses a threat to the entire land.
You need to defeat the Boardwalk Brawlers and collect the Fusion Matter samples that they leave behind. Dexter needs three.
Woof! It's great that the Magic Tree is feeling better. But that Dark Tree is still really scary!
Bring Dark Tree seed to Courage.
Good work! Come back for a reward. And bring the Dark Tree seed.
Thanks for your help. The Magic Tree is better, so we gotta start looking for the Crazy Brain Candy. I think we can use this Dark Tree seed. And here's some more SACT gear for you. Woof!
Plant Plan
Locate the Crazy Brain Candy.
I think I know how you can find the candy. Take the Dark Tree seed to Hero's Hollow. If you plant it in the right spot, it might lead us to the candy's location.
I went to Hero's Hollow with the Dark Tree seed. I learned that the Crazy Brain Candy is stored underneath Fuse's Lair in a subterranean cavern.
The candy is hidden deep below Fuse's Lair! Whimper! You should probably go see Samurai Jack about this. He's in the Forsaken Valley.
Take the Dark Tree seed to Hero's Hollow. I think I know a good spot to plant that seed.  You will need to clear out some monsters before you can safely plant the seed. Defeat six Eyebulbs. Woof!
Defeat the Boardwalk Brawlers.
Defeat six Eyebulbs.
Okay, now plant the seed in the special spot that I found.
Plant the seed in a special spot I sent to you. The seed won't grow, but it will tell us where Fuse has hidden the Crazy Brain Candy.
Plant the Dark Tree seed.
Don't worry, the seed can't take root, but it should tell us where the candy is.
The candy is in an underground cave! You need to go see Samurai Jack. Howl!
Shell Game
Collect the shell of a Great Shellworm.
Fuse is hiding the foul magical candy in a subterranean cavern deep inside his lair. It is impossible to access. But I believe I know of a way to destroy it.
Jack had a plan to destroy the candy. He sent me to the Precipice to collect the shell of a Great Shellworm.
Good work. Dexbot Q-12 will have the capacitor waiting for you when you arrive.
With the Great Shellworm's shell in our possession, our plan can proceed. But you must venture deeper into the Darklands, and it will be dangerous.
Proceed to the Precipice. You will be doing deeper into the heart of his vile network, so stay on your guard. You must defeat the Great Shellworms to collect one of their shells.
Collect a Great Shellworm shell.
Woo…Samurai Jack. I've heard he's the toughest guy on the planet. If anyone can help us destroy the Crazy Brain Candy, he can! Good luck, partner. -Edd
Good work. Please bring the shell to me.
Return to me with the Great Shellworm's shell.
Deliver shell to Jack.
This shell will be able to transport the sap of an Eyebore, which is highly acidic. We can pour the Eyebore's sap into the earth to destroy the candy below.
Good job collecting the shell of a Great Shellworm!
I never want to meet a Great Shellworm in person.
You should bring those special Fusion Matter samples to Dexbot Q-12 back at City Station. Don't forget to get the capacitor!
Thanks for defeating the Great Shellworms!
Sap Attack
Collect sap from an Eyebore.
We must collect the acidic sap from an Eyebore monster. You can safely transport it to the center of Fuse's Lair inside the Great Shellworm shell.
I collected sap from Eyebore monsters to bring to the heart of Fuse's Lair.
Excellent. I have placed the sap deposits in the Great Shellworm's shell. Now all that remains is to take the sap into Fuse's Lair to destroy the mystical candy.
You must proceed to the Green Maw. Look for the Eyebores. Defeat them until you have collected six sap deposits. Then return to me.
Collect the Eyebore sap.
How's it going? It sounds like Jack has you on the right path. Just watch out for scary creeps!! -Edd
You have what you need. Return to me, please.
Deliver samples to Dexbot Q-12.
You have collected enough of the Eyebore's sap. Return to me at once.
Deliver sap to Jack.
You have safely placed the Eyebore's sap into the Great Shellworm's shell. You must now take this and destroy the candy. This equipment from Courage will help you.
Candy No More
Destroy the Crazy Brain Candy.
You must take this Eyebore sap into Fuse's Lair and pour it into a hole over the candy chamber. This will melt the Crazy Brain Candy inside. You can do this.
Using the Eyebore's sap in a Great Shellworm's shell, I melted the Crazy Brain Candy, ensuring that Fuse would not be able to give it to kids. Edd and Courage were very proud!
Excellent work, young pupil. You have come a long way. With the evil mystical candy destroyed, Fuse will not be able to tighten his grip on the children. Well done.
You must go to the heart of Fuse's Lair. Be warned: this is the most dangerous and polluted area on the planet.
Proceed to Fuse's Lair.
Excellent. Evidence indicates that you are not as stupid as you look. Here is the capacitor. You may take it to Max Tennyson.
Hey, you're at the final stage of your adventure! Great work! Take care of that Crazy Brain Candy, then come down to the Cul-de-Sac and we'll celebrate. -Edd
Steel yourself. You must now enter the infected zone.
You must now find the hole above the candy chamber and pour the sap inside. This will melt the candy, and victory will be ours.
Pour the sap in the hole.
I will direct you to the hole above the candy chamber.
Good! The candy is melting as we speak. You have won the day.
You have won. Your friend Edd would like to thank you in person. He is waiting for you at the Cul-de-Sac.
Talk to Edd at Cul-de-Sac.
You did it! Come on down to the Cul-de-Sac so I can thank you in person.
Wowee, you destroyed the Crazy Brain Candy! I can't believe it! We've really experienced a lot together, you and I. Now candy consumption is safe for all ages.
Good work. Now you need to find the next Terrafuser and send the coordiantes to me.
Good job. Bring the capacitor back and I'll give you a reward.
Finally, you should talk to our loyal friend Courage the Cowardly Dog. You could not have succeeded without him.
Talk to Courage in Nowhere.
You should go talk to Courage. I know he wants to say "thanks" as well.
Aroo! You destroyed the bad magic candy! I was a little scared, there. But you did it. Here, take these SACT Wrist Rockets. I found them near an abandoned UFO. You deserve them. Howl!
Hooray. You destroyed the Crazy Brain Candy.
I am so glad you were able to destroy the Crazy Brain Candy.
I thought Crazy Brain Candy sounded cool…
Yay! The Crazy Brain Candy can't hurt us, thanks to you.
Fuzzy Wuzzy
Proceed deeper into the jungle.
Deliver capacitor to Max.
I don' wanna help no Mojo! Mojo sez yew oughta go talk to Hex in the Devil's Bluff village. He be mean, too. Now git offa my propity!
Fuzzy asked me to get off of his property. Dexter sent me an email, and he said that Mojo's new Chemical X formula is very dangerous! He asked me to find Mandy in Devil's Bluff.
Thank yew most kindly fer getting' offa my propity.
Mojo sez there is an evil guy called Hex in Devil's Bluff. Now git offa my propity!
Talk to Hex.

Emergency! I've fully analyzed Mojo's combination of Chemical X and Fusion Matter. If he uses it, he will unknowingly create an army of super-powered Fusion monkeys! Once you have talked to Hex, I want you to find Mandy. She will help us put a stop to Mojo's scheme. -Dexter
What? Some ingrate called Mojo Jojo wants assistance from me? I scoff at such requests. Begone!
That smart guy Dexter sez talk to Mandy. She be in Devil's Bluff, too. Now git!
Talk to Mandy.
I am most displeased that Fuzzy and Hex refused to help us! Double curses!!!
You got the capacitor? Well done. Bring it to me, please.
What do you want? How about a reward? I found it in the Hani-Baba Ruins.
Water You Doing?
Place Current Diverter in the falls.
Dexter sent you to me? That's nice. I don't like the idea of Mojo Jojo building an army of alien monkeys. I'm trying to build my own army, in fact. You can help me.
I went to the Forgotten Falls and placed a Current Diverter in the water to change the flow of the river.
Good work. Just let Mojo think all is going according to plan. Pretty soon, we'll be ready to spring our trap.
So, Mojo wants you to place a Current Diverter in Forgotten Falls to change the flow of water. Then he's going to dump his Chemical X. But we'll surprise him. You need to head out to Forgotten Falls.
Go to Forgotten Falls.

Why are you wasting your time with that Mandy girl? This is not a good use of your time, this is a bad use of your time. Ask her to help us, or move along. I have sent a device that you will need. A Current Diverter! -Mojo
To make the area safe to work, you need to eliminate some monsters.
I'll get this to Ben right away. Things are getting pretty bad down there at the space port.
Before you place the Current Diverter in the river, you need to defeat six Slizzards.
Defeat six Slizzards.
Destroy those Slizzards so they can't tamper with the equipment.
Good. Now place the Current Diverter in the water. I know a good spot.
You need to place the Current Diverter in the water. Mojo wants to divert the flow of the river so he can pour his Chemical X into the falls and then to Monkey Mountain.
Place Current Diverter.

Ha, ha! I will send a ship to dump my special Chemical X into Forgotten Falls, and then divert the river so that the Chemical X goes right into the heart of Monkey Mountain! Then I will have a new army for me, Mojo Jojo! -Mojo
Good work. Get back over here.
Now that you've placed the Current Diverter, come back to me and I'll tell you the next part of the plan.
Return to Mandy.
Hanging out at the zoo with the other monkeys?

Excellent! With the Current Diverter in place, the river's current will be diverted! Then I can dump my special Chemical X into the river without fear of my Special Chemical X being sent away from Monkey Mountain! -Mojo Jojo
Mojo is none the wiser. But you still need to make him think we're helping him out. It won't be long before we spring our trap. Take this armor as a reward. I found it in the Ruins.
Post Hypnotic Infection
Collect a charm from the Monkey Foothills.
It's now time for the next part of my plan. We need to get a Hypnotic Charm from the Monkey Foothills. I'll explain everything once you get it.
I went to the Monkey Foothills and collected a Hypnotic Charm for Mandy.
Thanks for this Hypnotic Charm. It should be handy for persuading kids to join my cause. Now let's talk about what we need to do to stop this crazy monkey dude.
If you want my help with Mojo, you're gonna need to help me, too. Head over to the Monkey Foothills.
Go to Monkey Foothills.

Greetings. I hope Mandy is helping you to sabotage Mojo Jojo's plan. We cannot allow him to create an army of Fusion Monkeys. That will spell disaster! Fortunately, Mandy is a very clever ally. Just be careful…she's tough! -Dexter
I hope Ben's Omnitrix continues to work.
The Monkey Foothills are a pretty wild place.
Collect a Hypnotic Charm from those Volcano Vaulters. If you can bring it back to me in one piece, we can talk about what we need to do to stop Mojo Jojo's plans.
Defeat the Volcano Vaulters.
Get the Hypnotic Charm from those Volcano Vaulters. Bring it back, and we'll talk.
Cool. You got it. Bring it back here. And try not to get killed.
Now that you have the Hypnotic Charm, return it to me. Then we can talk about taking care of this Mojo Jojo loser.
Bring charm to Mandy.

I am pleased that you placed the Current Diverter in Forgotten Falls. I am just now preparing to send a transport ship filled with my new Chemical X. When I dump it into the falls, it will flow right into Monkey Mountain! Yesss! -Mojo
Thanks. This Hypnotic Charm should be helpful for making new friends. Now let's talk about stopping Mojo. You should take more of this Forever Knights armor.
Monkey Shines
I like feeding the penguins!
Hypnotize Mojo's minions.
Now it's time to turn the tables on Mojo. I want you to take the Hypnotic Charm to Monkey Mountain. Look for the monkeys named Nicka Bocka and Pogo Loco.
I went to Monkey Mountain and pinned a post-hypnotic suggestion on two of Mojo's minions. They'll be sure to screw up Mojo's plans when the time comes.
When Mojo tries to dump his Chemical X into the falls, he'll be in for a surprise. Those two monkeys will sabotage the Current Diverter and ruin his plan.
You need to go out to the Monkey Foothills. You need to find Nicka Bocka first. Use the Hypnotic Charm. When the time comes, he'll sabotage Mojo's plans for us.
Talk to Nicka Bocka.

My plan is nearby ready to commence! I will soon send a ship to drop the Chemical X into the waterfall in the near future. Then all the monkeys at Monkey Mountain will answer to me, Mojo Jojo! Ha ha ha! Ha! Ha! Ha ha ha! -Mojo
We'll plant a suggestion that will unravel Mojo's plans.
Whadda you want? Oooh, what's that shiny thing you have? It's so pretty. I could stare at it all day. On second thought, I changed my mind. Go away!
Good work with Nicka Bocka. Now you need to find the monkey named Pogo Loco and do the same thing. He's further up the mountain.
You're amazing! Ben told me so.
Talk to Pogo Loco.
Good. Now you need to use the charm on Pogo Loco.
Gee, that sure is a purty necklace you got. It makes me feel all tingly in my brain. But I don't have time for this. I am waiting for orders from my master, Mojo Jojo!
Now that we've planted those post-hypnotic suggestions, you need to bring the Hypnotic Charm back to me.
Return Hypnotic Charm to Mandy.
Done. Bring the Hypnotic Charm back to me.
Monkeys are so dumb. When Mojo tries to dump his Chemical X into the falls, his minions will turn off the Current Diverter. Now it's time to spring our trap.
All Systems Go, Mojo
Execute Mandy's plan.
It's time to tell Mojo to send his Chemical X to the falls. I'll be here to make sure our plan goes off without a hitch. That dumb monkey has no idea!
Appetite for Destruction

Mojo launched his ship loaded with Chemical X. But then Mandy told me that the Hypnotic Charm's energy was fading. I had to race my way to the top of Monkey Mountain to boost the charm's energy. It worked, and Mojo's Chemical X went out to sea.
Nice. We totally tricked Mojo, and now his Chemical X concoction has been thrown out to sea. You left the Hypnotic Charm on Monkey Mountain, right?
Mojo is preparing to send his shipment of Chemical X. We're ready to spring our trap. I want you to go see Pogo Loco at Monkey Mountain and make sure that the post-hypnotic suggestion is working.
Talk to Pogo Loco.

Are all my plans in place? I will now send a ship loaded with my special Chemical X to the falls, where it will flow into the mountain. Then, all will fear the name Mojo Jojo! Because that is my name! Mojo Jojo! -Mojo Jojo
I can't talk right now! My master, Mojo Jojo, just told me to go down to Forgotten Falls to make sure that the Current Diverter is working. So git!

Mojo's Chemical X shipment is en route to the Wilds. But we have a problem. The Hypnotic Charm's energy is failing. We need to boost its power to make sure those monkey minions stay hypnotized. You can do it from the top of Monkey Mountain.
Go to mountain infected zone.
Uh-oh. The Hypnotic Charm's energy is failing. Go to the infected zone.
You need to enter the infected zone right away.
Stop Fusion Coop's Doomdozers from attacking the space port!
You need to reach Monkey Mountain's peak in order to boost the power of the Hypnotic Charm. Hurry.
Climb to top of mountain.
Get to the mountaintop to boost the charm's power before time expires. Hurry.
Yes. Mojo's minions are sabotaging his equipment. The Chemical X is gone.
You didn't get to the top of the mountain in time, but we have another chance. Return to the start and try again.
Return to start.
Time's up. But we have another chance if you go back to the start right now.
Don't screw it up this time.

Heh, heh. Mojo's careful plans have been ruined, thanks to us. You did very well. I could use someone like you. Job well done. Go see Mojo and rub it in. Make sure you leave the Hypnotic Charm at the top of the mountain.
Talk to Mojo.
Locate the second Terrafuser.
Fusion Coop is assembling a crew of Doomdozers to level the space port! Now's your chance to show Fuse what you're really made of. You ready?
Curses! What happened? Why did my monkeys betray me? Come see me now!
If I find out that you were responsible for the failure of my plan, then you will be part of my next plan, which will be to send you into space without a spacesuit!! Oh, Mandy sent something for you.
No new monkey army for Mojo, huh?
Good work tricking Mojo. His Chemical X was very dangerous.
I don't wanna be in the monkey army!
Thanks for stopping Mojo's plans!
Double Doublecross
Return to Mandy at Devil's Bluff.
So, this one named Mandy thinks she can toy with me, Mojo Jojo? We shall see about that! I am wise to her plan, and now we shall turn the tables on her!
Mojo told me to go speak to Dexter, who said that Mandy was planning to use the Hypnotic Charm for her own schemes. So I returned to Mandy to secretly figure out how to thwart her plan.
I defeated Fusion Coop's Doomdozers at Morbucks Towers.
Ha ha ha! If Mandy thinks it is fun to doublecross someone, wait until she is doublecrossed! Then she can decide whether or not it is fun to be doublecrossed.
Your friend Dexter, who is smart but not as smart as me, says that he has some information about Mandy, the one who tricked me! To make up for your disobedience, you will go talk to Dexter at once!
Talk to Dexter.
I'm pleased that Mandy helped you sabotage Mojo's plan, but I'm afraid her motives were not very honorable.
You see?!? This Mandy thinks she can make a fool of Mojo Jojo, but Mojo Jojo is no fool! Return to Devil's Bluff and make Mandy the fool, instead!
Go to Mandy at Devil's Bluff.
Mandy is trying to create her own army of loyal followers by using the magnified power of that Hypnotic Charm. Go back to Mandy and we'll show her the error of her ways.
I'll bet Mojo turned an even brighter shade of green when he saw you. Good work. Now let's discuss how we can make some improvements around here. I've got a nice weapon for you, too.
Know Your Roots
Investigate the roots of the Dark Tree.
Hey, that was some awesome stuff at Morbucks Towers. I was worried about Fusion Coop's Doomdozers, but you saved the day. Nice work, hero.
Have you heard of the Dark Tree? It's in the Darklands, and it's spreading Fuse's infection far and wide. I want to know more about this thing.
I went to Dark Tree South and defeated a number of Wooly Behemoths. Mandy and I determined that the roots of the Dark Tree go even deeper than we thought.
Disturbing. The Dark Tree's roots spread all the way down to the edge of the wilderness. That's a lot of reach. Very interesting, indeed.

I want to know more about the Dark Tree. I've given you a Fusion Divining Rod to take some measurements. Head into the Darklands and go to Huntor's Crest, an ancient village lying due south of the Dark Tree.
Go to Huntor's Crest.

Please tell me that you have figured out a way to humiliate that infernal Mandy! I despise her almost as much as I despise the Powerpuff Girls! And I despise the Powerpuff Girls very, very much. -Mojo
You cannot safely use the Fusion Divining Rod. The area is hostile.
Once you have defeated eight Wooly Behemoths, you can use the Fusion Divining Rod to examine the roots of the Dark Tree.
Defeat eight Wooly Behemoths.
Defeat eight Wooly Behemoths to clear out the area.
You need to get over to Morbucks Towers right away. Fusion Coop is preparing to attack the space port.
Good. Now I'll tell you where to use that Fusion Divining Rod.
Use the Fusion Divining Rod to determine how deep and wide the roots of the Dark Tree go. I am most curious.
Use Fusion Divining Rod.
It will tell us how deep and wide the Dark Tree's roots go.
Incredible. The Dark Tree is spreading Fuse's infection for miles and miles.
I am amazed at how far the Dark Tree's roots go. It raises quite a few…possibilities. Well, return to me with the Fusion Divining Rod.
Return to Mandy.
I think I know what Mandy is up to. She is going to use the roots of the tree to augment the messages from her Hypnotic Charm. But we won't let her do that, right? Right. -Dexter
Thanks. I've got a really cool reward for you. And I've got an idea about what we can do with that Dark Tree. Heh.
Tree Trapped
Head to Morbucks Towers.
Place a Signal Smasher in the Dark Glade.
I've got a weird piece of tech that I found in the Ruins. It's called a Signal Smasher. I think we can use it to stop the Dark Tree's roots from spreading its infection.
Mandy gave me a Signal Smasher to put into the Dark Tree, but Dexter told me that it was really a Signal Augmentor! He told me to throw it into the Firepits, instead.
I guess Dexter figured out my plot. I knew it was too good to be true. That kid really is smart. But I'll come up with another plan, just you wait.
Go to the Dark Glade and defeat the Skull Crushers. Then you should be able to place the Signal Smaher inside the Dark Tree.
Defeat seven Skull Crushers.

Urgent! Mandy is up to her old tricks. She did not give you a Signal Smasher. She gave you a Signal Augmentor! She's going to try to use the Dark Tree's roots to spread her hypnotic message. Mandy is a strong ally, but sometimes her nefarious instincts get the better of her. You need to put a stop to this. -Dexter
Excellent. Now put that Signal Smasher inside the Dark Tree.
Place the Signal Smasher inside the Dark Tree, and my plan will be complete.
Destroy Signal Smasher in Firepits.
Take out the Doomdozers. They could really wreck the space port.
Don't do it! Mandy is lying! Destroy it in the Firepits infected zone!
Hey, what did you do? The Signal Smasher is not responding.
Oh, Dexter had me figured out, did he? I guess that will teach me to try and fool a genius. Well, I'm impressed. Come back and I'll give you something.
Return to Mandy.
Nice try, Mandy. But I was on to you. Your Signal Augmentor is useless now.
You really are pretty clever. You have my respect, I guess. Take this reward. But watch out, I have lots of other tricks up my sleeve.
Funny when you can trick a trickster.
Good job foiling Mandy's plot.
I don't wanna be mind-controlled!
You saved us from Mojo and Mandy!
Careful, you're in Fusion Coop's territory now. You need to thin the ranks of his Doomdozer minions. Defeat six of them.
The Lair Out There
Track the Hypnotic Charm.
