Mandark thinks I do not notice things that are easy to notice. He suspects I am up to no good, but it is Mandark who is up to no good! Let's catch him.
Deliver Spectre Detector to Max.
I planted Fusion Matter Detectors in Mandark's lab.
It is done! Your superb sneaking will surely reveal Mandark's suspicious sneaking. Then we will both laugh when his sneaking ceases. Ha ha ha!

I, Mojo Jojo, have come to suspect Mandark of plotting with Fuse's minions. After all, he fell in love with Fusion Dee Dee, did he not? We need to place devices in his laboratory. Devices that will detect Fusion Matter. I call them…Fusion Matter Detectors!
Place first Fusion Matter Detector.
First, you shall place the first Fusion Matter Detector.
Secondly, you will place the second Fusion Matter Detector.

I, Mojo Jojo, have come to suspect Mandark of plotting with Fuse's minions. After all, he fell in love with Fusion Dee Dee, did he not? We need to place devices in his laboratory. Devices that will detect Fusion Matter. I call them…Fusion Matter Detectors!
Place second Fusion Matter Detector.
Lastly, you will place the third Fusion Matter Detector. That totals three.

I, Mojo Jojo, have come to suspect Mandark of plotting with Fuse's minions. After all, he fell in love with Fusion Dee Dee, did he not? We need to place devices in his laboratory. Devices that will detect Fusion Matter. I call them…Fusion Matter Detectors!
A Spectre Detector? Very well, as long as it lets us know if Ghostfreak is around. I will continue to study the information you obtained from the Plumber data miner.
Place third Fusion Matter Detector.
Now that you have completed the task that I asked you to complete, return to me.
Good work placing the Fusion Matter Detectors at Mandark Industries. This was the task that I gave you, and you completed it, so now you may come back to see me. Yesss!
Talk to Mojo Jojo.
Incoming message. Please come to see me as soon as you are available.
With those Fusion Matter Detectors in place, we will be able to detect Fusion Matter at Mandark Industries. Once it is detected, we will prove that Mandark is working with Fuse. Ha ha ha!
Stealing Secrets (Part 4 of 5)
Remove eavesdropping devices.
We have reason to believe that Mojo and Mandark are trying to steal tech secrets from each other. Can you help stop them?
I removed the eavesdropping devices I planted at Mandark and Mojo's. But why do they need to steal tech from each other? Shouldn't we all be working together to defeat Fuse?
Everyone says you are awesome. Sigh.
Mission accomplished. Thank you for removing those devices from Mojo's Volcano and Mandark Industries. Won't those two ever learn?

Mojo is actually using those Fusion Matter Detectors to steal secrets from Mandark. Mandark is doing the same with his Spybot Monitors in Mojo's Volcano. Mission: remove these devices and remind those two that they need to play nice.
Remove first Spybot Monitor.
Once you reach Mojo's Volcano, you must collect Mandark's Spybot Monitors.
Good. Now remove the second monitor.

Mojo is actually using those Fusion Matter Detectors to steal secrets from Mandark. Mandark is doing the same with his Spybot Monitors in Mojo's Volcano. Mission: remove these devices and remind those two that they need to play nice.
Remove second Spybot Monitor.
Excellent. Now remove the last monitor.

Mojo is actually using those Fusion Matter Detectors to steal secrets from Mandark. Mandark is doing the same with his Spybot Monitors in Mojo's Volcano. Mission: remove these devices and remind those two that they need to play nice.
Remove last monitor.
I'm fascinated by the spectre detector!
Mission accomplished. Now to Mandark Industries.Please recover Mojo's Fusion Matter Detectors.

Mojo is actually using those Fusion Matter Detectors to steal secrets from Mandark. Mandark is doing the same with his Spybot Monitors in Mojo's Volcano. Mission: remove these devices and remind those two that they need to play nice.
Remove first Fusion Matter Detector.
Now collect the second Fusion Matter Detector.

Mojo is actually using those Fusion Matter Detectors to steal secrets from Mandark. Mandark is doing the same with his Spybot Monitors in Mojo's Volcano. Mission: remove these devices and remind those two that they need to play nice.
Remove second Fusion Matter Detector.
Well done. You must collect one more Fusion Matter Detector.

Mojo is actually using those Fusion Matter Detectors to steal secrets from Mandark. Mandark is doing the same with his Spybot Monitors in Mojo's Volcano. Mission: remove these devices and remind those two that they need to play nice.
Remove third Fusion Matter Detector.
Very good. Please return those objects to me.
Bee-booda-badda!

Mojo is actually using those Fusion Matter Detectors to steal secrets from Mandark. Mandark is doing the same with his Spybot Monitors in Mojo's Volcano. Mission: remove these devices and remind those two that they need to play nice.
Return to Computress
Thank you. Both Mandark and Mojo will soon realize that if we are to achieve victory in our war with Fuse, they will need to cooperate.
Dark Engine Days (Part 1 of 4)
Fight the Gear Goliaths in Steam Alley.
Fuse's Dark Engine is spewing more Fusion Matter than we can handle. Are you ready for a real challenge in the fight against Fuse?
Be careful around the Dark Engine. If you go on Vilgax’s missions, watch your back. He's helping us now, but can that alien really be loyal to our cause?
Be careful around the Dark Engine. If you go on Vilgax’s missions, watch your back. He's helping us now, but can that alien really be loyal to our cause?
You are ready to enter the very dangerous Steam Alley area. If you can stop spawns from spreading Fusion Matter, you can slow the construction of Fuse's evil machine!
Go to Steam Alley.
I wish I could be like you.
Watch yourself. The Dark Engine is spreading Fusion Matter everywhere.
You are ready to enter the very dangerous Steam Alley area. If you can stop spawns from spreading Fusion Matter, you can slow the construction of Fuse's evil machine!
Defeat ten Gear Goliaths.
Excellent! That will slow the further development of Fuse's Dark Engine.
Gear Goliaths? Oh, scary!
The Dark Engine is a dangerous place. Be careful.
Gear Goliaths make me cringe.
Way to get those Gear Goliaths!
Dark Engine Days (Part 2 of 4)
Defeat the Oil Ogres in Steam Alley.
Tough Cell
You are operating around Offworld Plaza without my permission. If you want to be effective here, you will undertake the missions I dispense.
I brought Vilgax the Fusion Compressors. He wouldn't tell me about them, and complained about their condition. But he took them. What's he afraid of telling me?
Since you have completed this assignment without serious incident, I will provide you with a second.

Defeat five Oil Ogres in Steam Alley and collect each one's Fusion Compressor. Do not ask me to divulge the secrets of the Oil Ogres or why I need such things. For the likes of you, service to Vilgax should be sufficient.
Defeat the Oil Ogres.
Very good. Bring those Fusion Compressors to me.
Now that you have the Fusion Compressors, return them to me at Offworld Plaza.
Give Vilgax the Fusion Compressors.
Next time try not to damage the items I send you to retrieve.
Dark Engine Days (Part 3 of 4)
Recover the other half of the Plumber energy cell for Max.
Defeat the Putrid Spawns.
Against my better judgment, I will agree to give you another assignment in Steam Alley. Are you prepared?
I brought Vilgax eight Putrid Spawn Rebreathers, but he claims they don't work. He's pretty steamed. He thinks I betrayed him somehow. But he didn't even tell me why he wanted them.
Do you expect me to believe you don't know why these Rebreathers don't work? Ben Tennyson must have asked you to sabotage my mission.
Defeat the Putrid Spawns in Steam Alley and collect eight Rebreather apparatuses. And ask no further questions.
Defeat the Putrid Spawns.
That is sufficient. Bring the Rebreathers to me.
Return to me at Offworld Plaza with the Rebreathers that you collected.
Give Vilgax the Putrid Spawn Rebreathers.
What? These Rebreathers have all been rendered inert. They are useless to me!

Buttercup’s alter-ego Mange uses fire to stun enemies in the target area.
This scary roar makes your enemies take damage from just how frightening it is!
Jack helps your group jump good!
Samurai Jack uses his mystical sword to slash a targeted foe.
Samurai Jack always protects the innocent, especially from toxic Fusion Matter.
Aku casts an evil glare at enemies in front of you, stunning them.
Aku’s a master at amassing wealth, so he’ll easily grant you additional Taro rewards.
Aku smites enemies before you with a powerful magic storm.
Humungousaur erupts the earth around enemies, obstructing their path.
The alien giant goes wild, saving you from the enemy's special attacks.
Humungousaur slams the ground, doing big damage to all enemies in the area.
Eduardo shows you where monsters are, so you know how to stay away from them!
Eduardo heals you with french fries: bite-sized potatoes! This spud's for you.
This icy blast stuns all enemies unfortunate enough to get in the way.
Let freedom ring! Blossom’s alter-ego protects you from Fusion Matter!
Because she’s just so darn nice, Blossom protects your group from special attacks!
Wilt’s excessively long legs make him great at jump shots. Use that to get some crazy air!
Wilt’s defense maneuvers slow enemies down within the target zone.
Mixing her love of ponies and dancing, Dee Dee circles and ensares enemies with ballet!
POW! With a punch and a kick, Diva Dynamite will patriotically fight!
A swarm of blood gnats infest all enemies ahead of you, doing damage over time.
After a long adventure, a nap is just what you need. Or... what the monsters need.
Buttercup’s warcry pumps up your group, healing their injuries.
Help your friends find their inner peace and be born anew!
Is the dock on fire? Nope! It's just the foot burn. Keep your feet off the ground!
Ain't Johnny pretty? One good look at him stuns all monsters in front of you.
Johnny hears momma callin' in the distance. Use that speed boost to get back home.
Johnny is way too good looking to go out like that. You'll be revived if things go bad.
Buttercup intimidates friend and foe alike to get you even more Fusion Matter!

Buttercup intimidates friend and foe alike to get you even more Fusion Matter!
Wilt dunks nearby monsters into a basketball net, damaging them.
Coop uses his video game expertise to get you extra money out of Fusion Monsters!
Coop tastes the Fusion creeps and gets some Fusion Matter for you! (It tastes like jelly).
Coop reroutes all power to The Jammer and releases his "stunning" voice.
Ride those sonic waves! Belladonna helps you rebel against gravity with the power of punk!
Belladonna may not remember who she is, but she remembers where you’ve been!
Royalties from sales of the Gangreen Gang’s latest album increase the taros you earn.
Using the Fusion Matter Booster, Computress is able to increase Fusion Matter earned!
Computress encrypts your health data on a secure network, away from monsters!
Computress, ever alert, protects you from special attacks with her firewall.
Runty taps into the fusion hivemind and tricks all enemies nearby into taking it slow!
Numbuh Five uses a D.F.I.B.U.L.A.T.U.H. to revive you!
Runty sacrifices his energy to take out a huge chunk of the enemy’s health.
Runty looks just like a Fusion Spawn! He blends in, letting you sneak past monsters!
Panini spins her ears fast enough to become airborne and help you get extra height!
Panini puts you back on your feet by baking you some Powdered Flarts.
Like you're her baby Bruised Bluenana, Panini brings out her inner black cat to stun foes.
Jack renders enemies open to critical attacks by tickling them into submission.
Jack gets the last laugh by unleashing a barrage of pranks, slowing the enemy.
Cheat death just like Jack! Don't worry, you'll come back with your head intact.
Finn helps you leap into action!
Finn will help you to recover if you fall in combat.
Numbuh Five’s secret agent training will help your group be stealthy.
Finn will slay anything that's evil.
Rex will pound your foes senseless.
Rex has a Big Freakin' Sword!
Speed along using Rex's Boogie Pack.
Healing light bathes all nearby allies.
AlienX creates a small black hole to slow foes near the target.
Alter reality to warp to a recall point in an infected zone.
More Fusion Matter for Cheese (and you).
Abby gets a kick out of beating bad guys, and steals their energy to boot!
Van Kleiss will drain your foes' very life essence.
Take advantage of Van Kleiss' regenrative nanites.
Nanite infused plants will ensnare your foes at Van Kleiss' command.
Rigby will pound your foes using his mastery of Death Kwon Do!
Rigby's Java Jolt will keep you working for the weekend.
Rigby's Magical Keyboard will take everyone home, sorta.
Glide into action on Jake's magical ears.
Jake will help his friends step right out of harm's way.
Jake's soothing melody can put those nearby into a gentle slumber.
Make Chowder's greed work for you, too!
If all doesn’t go according to plan, Edd brings you back to a safe spot.
Having trouble sleeping?  Try some blormed milk.
Stop your foes in their tracks with Johnny's Hurricane Hands.
Blast the bad guys with Johnny's Power Poots!
Leap into action using Johnny's Turbo Action Backpack.
The symbionic sword can cleave a mutraddi mega-beast in two!
Know where your foes are before they even know you're coming.
It takes a lot of thrust to get a giant robot into the air!
Zak can teach you a thing or two about pounding on creeps!
Zak's magical claw can keep your enemies from reaching you.
The Meddal Detector will reveal treasures on your NanoCom’s mini-map!
No one can track monsters like the Secret Saturdays!
Freeze your foes with the Ice King's shockingly cool bolts.
With a beard this cool, there is no holding you down!
When building an army of Penguins, it helps to start with the eggs.
Mr. Watterson taught Gumball this special fighting technique.
Half bear, half shark, half alligator!
Ampfibian will put out your enemies' lights.
Fry your foes' synapses with Ampfibian's electric attack!
Protect your batteries (and your potions) with the Surge Protector!
Nearby monsters experience the crash felt after a sugar rush and slow down.
Nothing can restrain an enraged Apoplexan.
Unleash Rath's wrath and crush your foes like grapes.
Rath's speeches are good for one thing - napping.
Let Darwin show you his approach to survival.  Run away!
If you can't run, Darwin can always help you hide.
If running and hiding didn't work, it might be time for Trauma Therapy.
A true master of Death-kwon-do can even block Death!
Mordecai will show your foes why no one beats him at Punchies.
Need a little extra cash?  Mordecai knows all about how to get some.
Normally too much candy will keep you awake, but not with this power.
Courage howls and leaves enemies vulnerable to a critical strike.
Hopefully you won't turn into a zombie.
Free money translates directly into cheap candy.  Right?
Van Kleiss will drain your foes' very life essence.
Take advantage of Van Kleiss' regenrative nanites.
Nanite infused plants will ensnare your foes at Van Kleiss' command.
Earn extra Taros from Fusion Monsters.
Collect extra Fusion Matter from Fusion Monsters.
Stun enemies in a cone in front of you.
This power doesn't seem to do anything at the moment.
This power doesn't seem to do anything at the moment.
You wouldn’t think a giant robot could sneak past monsters, but...
This power doesn't seem to do anything at the moment.
Buttercup intimidates friend and foe alike to get you even more Fusion Matter!
Megas performs an epic ground slam to KO monsters and exposes their weak spots.
Billy can’t comprehend enemies’ stupefying effects, so they don’t work!
Billy channels his Inner Frat Boy to paddle monsters into a weakening, deep sleep.
Billy’s schnozz is full of boogers, and can be used as deadly projectiles!
Swampfire unleashes a heatwave that saps energy from an enemy.
Using his Powerprof Rocket Pack, Utonium gives your group a jump boost!
Using the power of science, the Professor will propel you upward, even in midair!
Him's terrifying guffaw damages all monsters in the area.
Him’s chortle gives a health boost to you and your allies nearby.
A burst of demonic power will protect you from enemy debuffs!
Fully Amped Shoes Travel Far, Exceeding Estimated Tempo. Simply put: you run faster!
Whipsmart McCoy shows treasures on your mini-map! You can be his butler, Wimpy.
Bloo ensnares your enemies with some glue taken from Herriman’s office.
Bloo annoys nearby monsters with a juicebox fueled burp. How rude!
Bubbles uses super breath to slow down your enemies with a tornado.
Bubbles uses her Harmony Bunny Pogo Stick to give you a jump boost!
Bubbles’ laser vision blasts your target for hardcore damage!
Demongo's blazing attack will damage all foes in the area.
Demongo slows all monsters nearby with one of his enchanted skulls.
Demongo imbues you with a warrior’s essence to revive you in battle.
Four Arms gives monsters in the area a good bonk, leaving them open to a critical attack.
Hoagie uses S.C.A.M.P.E.R. technology to propel you forward and dodge attacks!
Four Arms grabs even more Fusion Matter rewards with his extra arms!
Four Arm’s sheer power weakens your enemies and strengthens you!
Send a wide blast of spitballs at your foes for big damage.
Nigel uses his First Aid training to patch you up, restoring health.
Numbuh One uses a C.H.A.N.G.E.M.A.K.E.R. to grant extra Taro rewards.
You’re unstoppable! No special attacks will harm you thanks to Mojo’s protection!
Mojo drains an enemy of its energy. That is to say, it will have less energy than it did before!
Mojo uses his immaculate brain to formulate a plan to protect you from enemy attacks.
Mandark’s hi-tech Bio-Dome shields you from all toxic materials, including Fusion Matter!
Stun monsters with the dark forces Mandark uses to power his inventions! Ha ha ha!
Numbuh Two uses his “skills” from yipper card trading to earn more taros.
Mandark sets off powerful thrusters, giving your group boosted jump power!
Some Heebie Jeebie Juice gives a health boost to everyone in your group.
Grim grants your group a speed bonus that lets you run like bats out of heck!
It’s against his job description, but Grim can revive your group members if they’re KO’d.
Dexter provides Dexlabs gliding technology to extend your jumps.
The patented Dexlabs Inviso-Ray grants stealth to your entire group.
Use Dexter's Teleporter to return to a safe area, or calibrate it to a recall point.
Vilgax’s highly advanced sensors can detect monsters and display them on your mini-map.
Vilgax lets you run at light speed via the tech he uses to travel the galaxy.
Vilgax's knowledge of the Null Void Frontier phases you through dimensions to avoid foes.
Eddy reluctantly shares a jawbreaker with you for a quick burst of health.
The Prof.'s parental instincts kick in as he hits a monster to set up a critical strike.
Swampfire produces a noxious methane gas to make enemies helpless to a powered-up attack.
Swampfire lets you sneak past your foes like a slowly creeping vine.
Mandy slaps your group on the behind for a speed boost for all.
Treasures will appear on your mini-map if they know what’s good for them.
Mandy uses an artifact stolen from Grim to warp you to a recall point or Resurrect 'Em.
Coco lays a powerful egg shell to encase you in battle and protect you from harm.
Coco goes loco and protects your group from special attacks.
Coco lays an exploding egg that stuns all monsters in the area!
Mac goes hyperactive after downing Fizzy Rox Candy and launches you into the air.
Jig’s up! Eddy knows how to move quickly when a scam’s gone wrong!
Mac uses stealth learned from avoiding surprise parties to sneak past monsters!
Mac bores enemies into a defenseless sleep with his complicated homework problems.
Numbuh Three shares a sweet health boost with everyone in your group.
Everybody QUIET!!! Kuki’s trying to help your group sneak!
Anything can be made better by hugging a Rainbow Monkey!
Hex uses a powerful charm to make monsters in the area fall into a weakening slumber.
Hex summons wind at your back that accelerates your movement.
Hex uses the Charm of Telekinesis to push you and dodge past enemies.
Using her superhuman abilities, Juniper Lee gives you a jump boost.
Using a mystical spell, June steals an enemy’s energy and gives it to you!
Eddy's Protektion Servizes don't come cheap, but he'll spot you for some enemy damage.
June gets the drop on monsters in your area and ensnares them all with mystical energy.
Numbuh Four inspires you to return to the fight if you get knocked out.
Never say Wally’s not one to lend a hand - he’ll heal you up, along with allies nearby.
Numbuh Four uses his combat skills to knock some pain into all monsters in the area.
Dr. Ed prescribes sleeping pills to nearby monsters, leaving them open. Nighty-night!
Ed knows a lot about monsters, and can show you where they are on your mini-map!
Big Ed ensnares nearby monsters in a lung-crushing group hug! Aww!
Megas unleashes a familiar energy blast, burning your target with extra damage.
Courage does a cute little dance that heals you emotionally and physically.
Cowardice can pay off! Courage cautiously collects additional Fusion Matter rewards.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.1.str_c: What's this I hear about Tech Square sleeping with the fishes?
We be down to two sugar rations per day!
The Kids Next Door done help us all fight Fuse!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.1.str_n: Mayhap ol' Stickybeard will return. But don't get yer hopes up!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.10.str_: The Dexlabs Headquarters was destroyed! I would cry...if my programming allowed it.
Sensors indicate an anomaly in the time-space continuum nearby.
Mandark can help rebuild Dexter's time machine. Warning: do not trust Mandark.
We must protect the secrets that lie below in Dexter's old laboratory.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.100.str: I have been programmed to set up defensive equipment.
This unit cannot wait until the weekend.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.101.str: We must slow Planet Fusion's descent.
Fusion Matter is a complex material. Further investigation required.
Professor Utonium is almost as intelligent as Dexter.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.102.str: Stop at Tech Square if you travel Downtown.
This unit must secure the perimeter.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.103.str: These monsters are going to destroy my garden!
Have you visited Dexlabs downtown headquarters?
I saw a Fusion ballerina monster nearby!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.104.str: Who wants to join the KND?
If you're with Fuse, then you're gonna lose!
I'm only interested in meeting the toughest and smartest kids.
Numbuh Five is ready to kick Fuse's butt! Who's with me?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.105.str: If you've seen Buttercup, please let me know.
I'm Professor Utonium. Welcome to Genius Grove!
Please be careful out there. It's dangerous!
Fuse's infection is taking over Mandark's house!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.106.str: Look too fast and you might miss me. I don't have lips so you can't kiss me.
This war is a real bore.
Wishing Skulls all in a line. Wishing Skulls that number nine.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.107.str: What are your material needs today, humans?
Mandark Industries welcomes you to Genius Grove.
Annoying human called "Billy" is located in Endsville.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.108.str: Who requires coverage for their lower extremities?
Dexbot Q-60 is stationed at the nuclear power plant.
Robots do not wear pants. Humans require pants.

entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.339.str: You should see some of the gear I've got for sale.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3399.st: For some reason this reminds me of Giant Robot Week.
I came off my ship with some Clydes to try to find repair parts but it seems like they wanted to come here.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.34.str_: Fuse sucked up entire chunks of our planet. It's true.
Don't bother looking for Foster's. It's not there anymore.
Those Painsaws are ruining my day.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.340.str: I heard that Camp Kidney had to be evacuated.
Apparently, there's a spaceship hovering near Haunted Ridge.
What's this I hear about Ghostfreak coming back?
I wonder what it would take to get a ship to Planet Fusion.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3406.st: I believe I saw a rock monster here earlier, this could be profitable after all.
Does that fat blue child have a tail?
I see you're admiring my Megatooth Shark skin cape. You have a sharp eye.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.341.str: What can I get for you?
I heard there's a giant meteor in Haunted Ridge.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.342.str: We need to get the infection under control.
I've got armor if you're interested.
Is Leakey Lake still a mess?
A Fusion haunts the Crystalline Caverns.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.343.str: If you're looking for stuff to do, you should head down to Bravo Beach.
Maybe I shoulda been a Candy Pirate.
Max Tennyson is the greatest living Plumber.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3430.st: Wish I'd seen Six's face when he found the tracking device.
This is all Six's fault. He needs to learn to trust me more.
I wonder if Holiday was worried about me.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3431.st: Maybe we need to find a new place to hide the tracking device.
This is probably the monkey's fault.
Something has started interfering with Rex's nanites.
I wonder if Holiday has had any word from Rex.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3432.st: It's not a diaper! It??s a simian under-garment!
This is totally not my fault.
Think I'm gonna have to start carrying two guns.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3434.st: We need to assimilate with the Earthlings.
Perhaps I should use my holo-matrix to project a human disguise.
It would seem that the humans here have there hands full with these Fusions.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3435.st: The king made me responsible for Ilana's safety.
Weren't we supposed to keep a low profile?
We can't fight these Fusions.  We are supposed to be in hiding.
These Fusions pose an immediate threat to the Princess's safety.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3436.st: I can take care of myself, regardless of what Lance thinks.
We really should find a way to unite these people as one.
These Fusions are no better than the Mutradi.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3438.st: I'm totally going to tear this park up once I get my hands on my sisters' scooters.
No, he is not a dog.  He's a kid with a hair condition.
That tree down the road sure scared Dukey!  I guess it didn't appreciate being watered like that!
People cannons! Jump pads! Slides!  This park has it all!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3439.st: Careful in this park.  It's fun, but there are crazy creatures all over.
Uh-oh, Johnny has that look in his eye.  I think this power plant means trouble.
That kid down the road sure is dumb, and I have dealt with some dim bulbs.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.344.str: I can't survive on berries and leaves!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3441.st: I will eventually tell you "I told you so".  See?  There it was.
Do hurry up, I have some-when else to be.
Why hello there, my young friend.  Time truly appears to be on your side.
Its true, I have always said time travel is only for imortals and fools.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3442.st: Where did Vilgax obtain the time travel technology?  He must have had help from somewhere.
Vilgax must have found a way to interfere with the Omnitrix's connection to Primus.
Its times like this that make me question whether letting Tennyson keep the Omnitrix was a good idea.
The only way Vilgax could have found the parts necessary to repair the Chimerian Hammer on this planet would be to time travel to the future!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3443.st: Where did they get all these Ben Tennyson hoverboards?
. . . and so Azmuth is in charge because he has whiskers?  That hardly seems fair.
No wonder Vilgax has so many minions.  Those suits are really cool.
Explain to me why Ship is bigger on the inside again.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3444.st: Where did they get all these Ben Tennyson hoverboards?
. . . and so Azmuth is in charge because he has whiskers?  That hardly seems fair.
No wonder Vilgax has so many minions.  Those suits are really cool.
Explain to me why Ship is bigger on the inside again.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3445.st: Where did they get all these Ben Tennyson hoverboards?
. . . and so Azmuth is in charge because he has whiskers?  That hardly seems fair.
No wonder Vilgax has so many minions.  Those suits are really cool.
Explain to me why Ship is bigger on the inside again.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3446.st: Where did they get all these Ben Tennyson hoverboards?
. . . and so Azmuth is in charge because he has whiskers?  That hardly seems fair.
No wonder Vilgax has so many minions.  Those suits are really cool.
Explain to me why Ship is bigger on the inside again.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3447.st: Where did they get all these Ben Tennyson hoverboards?
. . . and so Azmuth is in charge because he has whiskers?  That hardly seems fair.
No wonder Vilgax has so many minions.  Those suits are really cool.
Explain to me why Ship is bigger on the inside again.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3449.st: Tennyson will finally pay for his meddling once I return to the past!
This "fusion matter" is very interesting.  Perhaps there is a way for me to harness its power.
Where is IT ?!?!? I have crossed time itself to find the necessary pieces.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.345.str: Welcome to ze Forest of Really Twisted!
Can I help you today with ze purchases?
Who needs ze Boosts or ze Potions?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3450.st: Well I . . . Eahahahahah . . . Brahhhh! . . . excuse me.
Now I know what you're thinking, but you got a job to do.
Careful now, you're about to open my inner rage with all that yappin'.
I bet you're wonderin' how all these fellers are gonna get back home.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3453.st: Did you know that Jake is actually a magical dog? Just ask him.
That Ice King really doesn't understand Princesses.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3454.st: Abandon hope all ye who enter!  You can leave it over there.
Hey kid, want some free adventure?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3457.st: I can't wait to see Ben again!
That cake would make for a soft landing, but they won't let me near in my Heatblast form.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3458.st: These Megawhatts certainly wreak havoc with my gear, its gonna be great to see what they do when we let'em loose on Vilgax's ship.
There's supposed to be some alien technology out in Nowhere.  Maybe I'll go check it out.
I wonder what I could do with a Megawhatt trapped in a spark plug.
Ya know, it'd save a lot of time if the Professor would just tell us what plan actually works.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.346.str: Can we get back to conquering this planet, yet?
Did you see the weird castle?
Chickens weren't meant to live in caves.
I swear my allegiance to General Tso!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3464.st: We're the apprentices of Dr. Barber, ever heard of him?
It's nice to be out of the rain. You wouldn't believe the weather in Stormalong!
If you see the sweeper in Orchid Bay, you'll be able to change even more about yourself!
We've been trained by the finest barber in all of Stormalong!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.3465.st: We're the apprentices of Dr. Barber, ever heard of him?
It's nice to be out of the rain. You wouldn't believe the weather in Stormalong!
I'm just a temporary fill-in for Dr. Barber but I can do all the things he can!
We've been trained by the finest barber in all of Stormalong!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.347.str: Fusion Eggplants are trying to start a war with the Chickens From Outer Space!
The eggplant's leader is called Mel Anzana.
I'm not fond of clever names.
Humans, help me find my feathered friends. Bock!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.348.str: At ease, Chickens From Outer Space!
Is the eggplant my enemy, or is Fuse the true enemy?
If the eggplants want a war, they're messing with the wrong chicken. Bock!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.349.str: Fuse has created Fusion Space Chickens and is trying to start a war with the eggplants. Bock!
I don't think the eggplants are to blame for this trouble.
Tell General Tso to send reinforcements! Bock!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.35.str_: Peach Creek was actually pretty nice before Fuse got here.
I think Fuse is gonna beat us if we don't do something soon.
I recommend the Giant Turkey Leg. You got one of those?
Thank heavens the Kanker sisters moved away. They were so annoying!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.350.str: I'm-a gonna get those fake eggplant monsters!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.351.str: Fuse is making big trouble down here! Bock!
There's an eggplant camp deeper in the catacombs.
Attention! Fuse has captured some Chickens From Outer Space!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.354.str: You'll need your best gear now.
I've heard of Fuse's Lair, but I've never seen it.
If you're not strong enough to handle it, you can always go back to the mainland.
The Dinosaur Graveyard is extremely infected.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.355.str: Did you see the shops at the floating research station?
If you can get through Dinosaur Pass, you will reach the Firepits.
Do you think we will ever see Fuse's face?
Fusion Numbuh Four is around here somewhere.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.356.str: The village of Huntor's Crest lies on the other side of the Fireswamps.
I need to get out of here. This place has me spooked.
Our research indicates that Fuse is able to spread his infection underground.
The Fusion Kanker sisters patrol the valley.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.357.str: It's dangerous out here! And hot as anything!
You ready to take on Fuse?
Who's in the mood to squash some monsters?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.358.str: The journey ahead will be most perilous.
It is time to become the warrior that you were destined to be.
You have arrived at the gateway to the Darklands.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.359.str: Planet Fusion is perhaps the greatest threat that this galaxy has ever faced.
Any friend of Benjamin Tennyson's is a friend of mine.
You do not need the strength of the Omnitrix to be a powerful ally.
I am Tetrax, and I vow to help all those who oppose Fuse.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.36.str_: Ask me about how we saved the Great Machine!
Wanna to see my Urban Ranger Bandana Pin of Flatulence?
Ha, ha! The Trojan Hamburger fell in the creek!
Have you met Eduardo? He's hilarious!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.360.str: Rumor is that Fuse creates his Fusions in the Darklands.
Have you heard of something called the Master Arsenal?
Mandark built this floating research facility to study the unusual local wildlife.
Fuse's Lair lies at the heart of the Darklands.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.361.str: Climb aboard. We always got room.
I can take you back to the mainland.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.362.str: I'll give you a lift...for a fee.
Ask about my frequent flyer deals.
Don't be shy. I showered today!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.363.str: Be warned: the monsters in this vicinity eat humans for lunch.
The Darklands is a dark place. Surprise.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.364.str: If you require Boosts and Potions, now is your opportunity to purchase them.
Mandark has provided robot sentries for this outpost.
WTS Weapon Boosts and Nano Potions.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.365.str: This unit has armor. For sale.
This unit wishes for a new post.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.366.str: Many robots are assembled here for future battles.
Samurai Jack is a strange human.
State what you need or go away.
This research facility was built by Mandark Industries.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.367.str: Do you require shoes for your human feet?
Don't fall off the platform and break your fragile human bones.
I do not offer any discounts.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.368.str: You are privileged to buy from Mandroid M-37.
How is life in Tech Square?
This floating research center was built before the war.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.369.str: This is it. Fuse's Lair lies just to north.
Are you ready? Make sure you are fully prepared.
The Green Maw will swallow you whole.
You gotta be brave to come here.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.37.str_: Some day, I'd like to meet Ben Tennyson. I heard he helped everyone make it out of Tech Square!
The Kanker sisters used to live at the Park n' Flush, but I haven't seen them for a long time.
Planet Fusion absorbed big pieces of our world, and now we're hanging on by a thread.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.370.str: Complete my mission and get to wishin'.
Did you find the other eight? That's just great.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.371.str: Our only chance is to take this fight to Fuse's front door.
Fuse creates his Fusions in this area. They grow stronger every day.
We are searching this area for survivors and salvageable equipment.
Fuse's power is vast. He controls magic and technology.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.372.str: I'm not getting any life readings.
Dexter and Mandark pooled their resources. The Powerpuff Girls fought hard. But it was not enough.
It's a shame we lost this battle. We may not have another chance.
The Battle of Hero's Hollow was fought here.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.373.str: Only the strongest warriors dare tread here.
I am Demongo, the Soul Collector!
I am not one to trifle with, human.
Fuse's evil spreads far and wide.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.374.str: I've got lots of accessories here.
Wow, you made it through the Firepits?
What can I get for you.
I've seen a Samurai Jack Fusion pass through here!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.375.str: Have you seen the massive gate leading to the Dark Glade?
Yes, I was at the battle of Hero's Hollow.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.376.str: I think I just saw a cryptid!
Anybody tape last night's episode of "Weird World"?
To the west of here lies Hero's Hollow.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.377.str: Would you like to try an exotic elemelon?
The Fusions that hide in the Dark Glade are very powerful.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.378.str: My shoes are in excellent shape.
Looks like you need new shoes, chief.
Welcome to Huntor's Crest, the armpit of the Darklands.
SACT just brought in new gear.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.379.str: You'll need good weapons if you hope to survive the Dark Glade.
Billy is a good friend of mine. Have you been to Endsville?
Watch yourself. The Fusionflies are dangerous.
Have you seen the Fusions that lurk in the Dark Glade?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.38.str_: Did Ranger Jenny say anything about me?
That Eduardo dude has a funny accent.
I heard the battle of Tech Square was really nasty.
Pssst! You know the Urban Rangers handshake?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.380.str: Somebody has to take Fuse down.
If you need accessories, I can make you a deal.
I heard the monsters in Fuse's Lair are unlike any you've ever seen.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.381.str: If you're going to go into the lair, you better get some Boosts and Potions.
I've had it up to here with Fuse.
I'm starting to get a little freaked out.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.382.str: If you rip a hole in these pants, don't come crying to me.
I heard Fuse is vulnerable to Imaginary Energy.
If you want some pants, I'll sell 'em to you.
I also sell computers on the side.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.383.str: We need to keep Plumber gear out of Fuse's hands.
Now I know why they call it the Darklands.
I'd like to get back to the city.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.384.str: Don't mess with a Doom Strider.
Have you been inside Fuse's Lair, yet?
I say we pack it up and take the war to Planet Fusion!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.385.str: Fuse's Lair is right around the corner!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.387.str: Bock bock! Come and talk to me when you're ready to leave. Happy Spring!
If you don't have a Nano with Freedom powers, try to get them from a Coco egg. Bock!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.388.str: I have no idea why this thing isn't working.
Did I put too much garlic in the Croc Pot yesterday?
Sorry, the Croc Pot's not in the mood to mix up anything today.
The Croc Pot isn't cooperating today.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.389.str: I'll mix you up something good to wear.
Fuse is here to "stir" up some trouble. Hah get it?
Three years of culinary school for this?
Bubble, bubble, toil and trouble. Wait, how does that go again?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.39.str_: If you're looking for Samurai Jack, he's down at the junk yard.
Don't let the Newsprint Ninjas sneak up on you!
No one knows what Lord Fuse looks like!
If you see the Morbucks kid inside the Cul-de-Sac, he'll store items for you.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.390.str: Hot peppers can be used in a pinch to blind an attacker.
The KND field manual lists over 100 ways to disarm an attacker using only a banana.
A wooden spoon makes a great improvised weapon.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.391.str: Yeah, I know some of it stuck to the bottom of the pot and burned, but it's still perfectly edible. Try some!
I hope you don't mind your new outfit smelling like soup. I was hungry.
I have no idea why all these stray cats keep hanging around. I barely feed them at all.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.392.str: What is your preference for paint color on this unit, human? Blue or red?
Mandark Industries is happy to meet all your costuming needs.
The humans here have made some unusual clothing choices. This unit has never seen so many capes before.
This unit would also like to change its appearance.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.393.str: Sorry about that, did I hurt your ears?
I'll make you a costume that kicks serious butt.
I can make a new costume for you before you have time to say, 'Wall of Sound.'
No, I can't make you your own Omnitrix. Don't ask.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.394.str: Sorry, I don't have any vehicles on the lot right now.
I would love to sell you a transport, but I don't have any left to sell.
I'm just a small businessman trying to eke out a living.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.395.str: Say, you're going awfully fast. Slow down!
There's no reason to be in such a hurry!
Make sure you're wearing your helmet.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.396.str: I need some new shoes, these are thrashed.
Check out this sick kick flip! Rad, right?
If you're going to bail, you might as well have fun with it. Give your buds something to laugh at.
I'm the best skater in the KND. But don't tell Numbuh Three I said that.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.397.str: Please do not mistake that odor for this unit's exhaust.
Travel in style with genuine Dexlabs vehicles.
This unit is programmed to sell transports.
For once, this unit is happy that it lacks olfactory receptors.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.398.str: I can help you get to where you need to be.
With my vehicles, you'll be tooling around in no time flat.
Wall of Sound does nothing to keep out the smell from the clouds.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.399.str: Do you like my Candy Pirate uniform?
I wonder if Stickybeard will like me?
I want to set sail for the Sea of Lost Adventures.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.4.str_c: Where is the wee landlubber that will save our sorry behinds?
I'd give me best treasure for a lollipop!
Fuse and his no-good band of scurvy dogs are gonna pay!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.4.str_n: Arrr! The Sweet Revenge has been destroyed!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.40.str_: There's a SCAMPER pilot here that can take you to Sector V.
You can use the Great Machine to change your Nanos' powers. Try it!
You'll find lots of shopkeepers and stuff here in the Cul-de-Sac.
Step right up to see the big purple monster dude!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.400.str: Stickybeard is just one of the lads.
That's how a real Candy Pirate does it!
I miss the open sea.  Also candy.
Do you have any candy on you?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.401.str: Just wait until you see the LOCONUT in action!
There sure are a lot of Monkeys around here.
Be careful monkeying around with that LOCONUT, it could go off. Ha! I made a pun!
The LOCONUT will turn the tide of the war!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.402.str: Let us know ASAP if you see any alien activity in the sector.
SACT is here to serve: provided your problems involve hostile alien lifeforms.
SACT is ready to deal with any threat.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.403.str: That Fusion Matter is some nasty stuff.
Doctor J.C. is one smart cookie.
Peggy Danger says the Ghastly Growths come from the Dark Tree itself.  I don't know if I believe her.
The Dark Tree needs our help!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.404.str: These Spore Pods are a curious phenomenon. I don't think they're popping up anywhere else with nearly this much size.
There is a connection between the Ghastly Growths and the Fusionflies. I just need to see it.
Now where did I leave that specimen jar?
The Dark Glade was once a beautiful retreat. Look what's become of it!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.405.str: The only thing better than doing something yourself is tricking someone else into doing it for you.
Have you been to Argost's TV Studio yet? The man's a genius!
I hear Munya is even uglier in person.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.406.str: Yes, we get it, you're the "Soul Collector." Why are you here instead of fighting Fuse?
Demongo's complaining is almost as loud as the Skull Bashers.
SACT has the best gear.  The KND stuff is a joke.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.407.str: Dexter will be pleased with my efforts.
With some help, this unit can rebuild many of these Dexbots.
So much to clean. Where to start?
This unit wishes for a new post.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.408.str: Warning: fluctuations are appearing in my personality circuits.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.409.str: You humans don't know what you're missing.
Master Mojo wouldn't like us trading with you.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.41.str_: I'm the Urban Ranger troop leader. Oooh, look! A bird!
Edd built this cardboard castle. It keeps us safe from the monsters!
There's a monkey here at the Cul-de-Sac that will fly you around and stuff.
Welcome to the Cul-de-Sac of Peach Creek Commons, travelers!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.410.str: Dracula's got plenty of these C.R.A.T.E. Pumpkins lyin' around. Make Dracula an offer.
Dracula only here because he feels obligated. As soon as this Halloween thing is over, Dracula’s going home.
Beauty may be skin deep, but dumb goes all the way to the bone.
Dracula ain't got no time for your babblin'. You wanna buy this junk or not?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.411.str: I'm the best there is at what I do.
Go over the bridge to get to Pokey Oaks.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.412.str: Let's sing some Urban Ranger campfire tunes.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.413.str: If you could just sign this photo release, please?
Have an appetite for the bizarre? It's a feeding frenzy on this week's episode of Weird World.
I am but a simple showman. My goals are to entertain and enlighten.
I see you're admiring my Megatooth Shark skin cape. You have a sharp eye.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.414.str: Make sure you bring your Fusion Blowfish repellant along with your sunscreen to Bravo Beach. That's where Cootie makes her home.
If you find yourself in the middle of Nowhere, you just might find a Fusion Blowfish named Judy.
I was once lost in the Monkey Foothills and was almost eaten by a giant Fusion Blowfish named Tootie.
There's a giant Fusion Blowfish named Rudy that's been spotted near Camp Kidney.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.415.str: Hey, dummy! Wanna see Dracula dance?
Does it LOOK like Dracula at the zoo!? Quit your starin’, dummy!
Just because Dracula outside don’t mean you need gather around him like moths to a flame!
Get away from Dracula! Dracula don’t need no senior care, Dracula can take care of himself!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.416.str: Um, when do we get shiny orange box thingies? I would really like a shiny orange box!
I like nachos, can we please get some nachos? I would really like nachos!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.417.str: We baked the gazebo into a delicious Schmingerbread House! Some short guy at City Hall is pretty mad at us. What’s a permit?
Every year, Knish Krinkle appears and vomits presents for children who build him a Schmingerbread House that he likes!
The Puckerberries are still pretty sour about me evicting them from my mouth. That Sour Ron is a bad bluenana!
Someone stole all my Knishmas presents! They said they wanted to trade, but they scammed me! You’ve got to help me get the presents back!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.418.str: I tried hugging Bubbie really really hard, but I don’t think love is enough to cure her tummy troubles!
I used to think strangers were just friends you haven’t made yet, but I don’t think Fuse wants to be friends…
Wow, look at all of this land! Is this one big island?
Wait until Captain K’nuckles hears about this crazy adventure!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.419.str: Fuse, huh? I am sickened... but curious.
You might want to hold on to something, because these pecs will blow you away. HOO, HA, HUH!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.42.str_: I like to call it the Castle-de-Sac!
I heard everything west of Genius Grove is gone!
As Planet Fusion got closer, it started sucking up big pieces of the Suburbs.
Be careful when you cross those bridges. You wouldn't want to fall into the goo!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.420.str: This fancy Clockwork gear is one of a kind. Er- where did I get it? Heh, would you look at the time!
You're not a time cop, are you?
Wow, a fellow time traveller? It's about TIME! Hah, get it? Time?....Whatever....
Hey listen kid, time travel is no joke! What do you even know about time travel anyway?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.422.str: I've got temporal contraband to dispose of. You wouldn't mind helping me out, would ya?
Hey keep this interaction on the downlow. Last thing I want is another write-up.
Be on the lookout for a suspicious time traveler, do not approach if spotted.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.423.str: The time machine will technically function in it's current state, but it could be repaired further!
Many of Mandroid Relocation Unit's parts were melted down to create a new hover propulsion system for this unit.
Come over here after you get your Eduardo nano for an important assignment.
You require Mandark's assistance! Find him in Genius Grove after you get your Eduardo nano!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.424.str: A vehicle vendor sits atop this massive cake. Go rent some awesome vehicles!
Step right up folks! Win prizes by destroying the Party Poppers around the cake! Normal birthday party stuff!
Come hang out and knock down Fuse's Party Poppers for some awesome prizes.
Want to play our party game? Destroy Fuse's Party Poppers to win prizes!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.425.str: The Grinch? Never heard of him.
Kid, you're blowing my cover! Get lost!
I will make sure to make this a particularly SOUR season!
Keep it down Max, we're supposed to be hiding!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.426.str: This certainly isn't an EVIL charity drive. It's eh- for the kids!
Buy somethin' will ya? We're tryin' to make a quick buck here.....For the kids of course.
I'd be careful taking a bite of that schmingerbread gazebo. It may taste a little sour, hehehe.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.428.str: Edd has some of the coolest gear around, including an Urban Ranger outfit, a Bloo Skate Set, and the SACT Armor!
Come to me if you need to grab the guide items you've lost. Buy some duplicates too, I could use the money.
We're here so you don't have to worry about misplacing your guide items. If you do, you can buy them back from us!
Missplaced Edd's valuable guide items? No worries, I can help you out.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.429.str: Ben has some of the coolest gear around, including a Heatblast outfit, Sumo Slammers armor, and Plumber Armor!
Come to me if you need to grab the guide items you've lost. Buy some duplicates too, I could use the money.
We're here so you don't have to worry about misplacing your guide items. If you do, you can buy them back from us!
Missplaced Ben's valuable guide items? No worries, I can help you out.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.43.str_: The Great Machine can be used to modify your Nanos.
Mandark is alive and well in Genius Grove. You may find him there.
Robots are superior to humans, but Mandark is superior to all.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.430.str: Mojo has some of the coolest gear around, including Battle Ready Armor, a Monkey Minion outfit, and the Mask of the Beast Armor!
Come to me if you need to grab the guide items you've lost. Buy some duplicates too, I could use the money.
We're here so you don't have to worry about misplacing your guide items. If you do, you can buy them back from us!
Missplaced Mojo's valuable guide items? No worries, I can help you out.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.431.str: Dexter has some of the coolest gear around, including a Blossom Dynamo armor, a Skeleton outfit, and Dexstar armor!
Come to me if you need to grab the guide items you've lost. Buy some duplicates too, I could use the money.
We're here so you don't have to worry about misplacing your guide items. If you do, you can buy them back from us!
Missplaced Dexter's valuable guide items? No worries, I can help you out.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.432.str: This is a quarantine zone. We’re trying to keep these Blood Gnats from totally taking over the suburbs.
Be careful, this area is highly infested with dangerous Blood Gnats from Blood Island.
We Blood Gnat Exterminators take pride in squashing out each and every case of Blood Gnat infestations.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.433.str: You know what’s the worst? Being roommates with a couple million other strands of DNA. Roughin’ it outdoors is way better! Ook eek!
For the last time, I’m not Ben Tennyson! Actually, I kind of am. It’s probably best not to put too much thought into it. Ook!
Ook, ook! That Omnitrix was so stuffy! It’s always good to stretch all six limbs now and again!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.434.str: “Watt” is the big deal? It’s not that weird to see one of Ben’s alien forms next to Ben himself, is it? I suppose it would be a little shocking…
All of the other aliens have run off! Not me though, I’m feeling pretty attached to this place, it must be static cling!
Being separated from the Omnitrix was quite the jolt, but I must say that I’m ex-static to be here!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.435.str: Argh, I am once again craving that most disgusting of foods; chili fries! Do you know how hard it is to get Burger Frenzy to deliver out here?
My plan is working perfectly! All I need now is a few unsuspecting pawns to help me round up all of these Sonorosians, er, Echo Echos.
Thanks to my Kineceleran form, it is possible for me to travel between Offworld Plaza and the Precipice very quickly. Explaining how I, BEN TENNYSON, can seemingly be in two places at once!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.436.str: Hey guys look, it’s the REAL Ben Tennyson! Oh, and all this time I thought it was an act!
Albedo wants to stuff us into a watch? It’s a good thing the “real” Ben Tennyson is here to “protect” us!
No, I can't make you your own Omnitrix. Do I look like a galvan?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.437.str: Hey guys look, it’s the REAL Ben Tennyson! Oh, and all this time I thought it was an act!
Albedo wants to stuff us into a watch? It’s a good thing the “real” Ben Tennyson is here to “protect” us!
No, I can't make you your own Omnitrix. Do I look like a galvan?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.438.str: Man, Dad sure is missing out. This would have been a great father-son bonding experience!
Fred here can stick not one, but TWO fingers in his belly button! Isn’t that amazing!?
Did you know that the average person swallows up to 16 spiders a year? Well, those are my kids, stop it!
This looks like a great place to lay my eggs!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.439.str: If you're looking for potions, you've come to the right place!
You ever notice how Mount Blackhead kind of looks like a giant tree stump? I wonder if there's anything to that....
I wish I had Morbucks money!
Psst! A secret snail told me that you can redeem 'BeMore' to get a cool backpack....Whatever that means!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.440.str: Planet Fusion is even worse than those crummy Powerpuffs!
You're real lucky our band took off with "Belladonna" or you'd have a real problema!
Hair this perfect is only possible with my love, Maria Conchita Teresa Rosalita.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.441.str: Boss says to keep quiet on "uttercupbay."
Drums are real fun to play!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.443.str: Ever sssince "Belladonna" joined our band, Ace hasss been ssso busy making sure she ssstays Belladonna! He barely talksss to usss anymore!
These fusionsss are cramping our cool, green ssstyle!
Don't tell Ace, but I think thessse leather jacketsss are kinda lame!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.444.str: I’m so excited for the next issue of “Justice Friends versus The Powerpuff Girls: Revenge of the Glorft."
Sometimes I go for days without showering. Speaking of not showering, have you ever been to a fan convention?
You should really check out this fan server I play on for Sumo Slammers Online. It’s a continuation of the original game from before they added the controversial expansion.
Have you seen my good friend Johnny Bravo recently? He hasn’t answered my calls in weeks. He usually picks up every few days to tell me to stop calling.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.445.str: Coop here is surprisingly well-versed in robotics. I feel good as new!
Things were so much easier before Time Squad switched to using those dreadfully cramped time pods.
I don’t suppose you have any moist towelettes? This place is a dump...Literally!
Oh dear, I hope Tuddrussel’s time pod didn’t get knocked too far off course.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.446.str: One-two-three-four-five-six-seven-eight… Wait, are there less penguins than the last time I counted?
I wonder if Marceline would want to come over for a jam sesh. The acoustics in my sweet new crib are amazing!
I turned the A/C on full blast to make the penguins more comfortable, but then all this ice appeared! I didn’t realize how powerful modern air conditioning units were!
I should really start charging entry for this awesome ice fortress I apparently built.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.447.str: Did you know the Great Machine is responsible for creating every one of your nanos? Your nanocom sends the necessary data remotely no matter where you are in the world
Nanos are a creation of both Dexlabs and Mandark Industries. For merchandising and licensing inquiries, please visit our site on the NeuroWeb. Keyword: NANOS
Alongside being incredible scientific achievements, nanos are just so darn cute! ...in this unit’s professional opinion.
This unit is proud to call itself one of Dexlabs’ lead nano researchers!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.448.str: Mandark is the genius who discovered that toxic Fusion Matter could be turned into Nanos through the use of imaginary energy. Don’t let the Dexlabs funded news media tell you otherwise.
Mandark Industries reserves the right to change the appearance of the Unstable Nano at any time without your prior knowledge or consent.
The Unstable Nano can only hold a solid form for a limited time, and will eventually revert back to the state you see in this container.
Pledge your loyalty to Mandark Industries by creating your very own Nano Mandark!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.449.str: Schnitzel is busy delivering the other Shmingerbread Gazebo to Townsville Center. I heard he's having issues with some rich customer though!
Do you know if after this event is over they'll let us take the Shmingerbread to the break room?
Mung said he wanted to come but he's too busy with Knishmas orders.
Man, did you hear there's a king nearby? Maybe he'll hire us to cook him a feast!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.45.str_: Stay away from the edge, please.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.450.str: I don't get why Finn's got a Nano but I don't! Don't you just wanna take a Jake everywhere you go?
Finn's busy doing some science-y stuff Downtown, too bad for him he's missing this par-tay.
What's this ominous feeling in the air...? Eh, I'm pretty sure it's the weather.
I haven't seen BMO around, maybe the lil guy wandered off.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.451.str: If you're looking for a conversation, go bother some of these party losers.
I'm not in a mood to celebrate until I find a certain Ben Tennyson.
You don't look so tough, don't be trying to step up to me.
If you see some snotrag with a glowing green watch just point me to him.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.452.str: I don't really get the meaning of this celebration, isn't there an alien invasion to worry about?
You know there's other people to bother here? I'm not exactly a party-goer like everybody else.
Unless you know someone who specializes in offworld mechanical parts then I think you should leave me alone.
No matter what Coop tells you, Megas is MY robot.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.453.str: For some reason this reminds me of Giant Robot Week.
I came off my ship with some Clydes to try to find repair parts but it seems like they wanted to come here.
I think Toonami's probably gone all static now.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.454.str: You want a slice of cake? No don't get up, I'll get it for you!
I'm so glad the Pumpkin Spawns didn't follow us out of the Underworld this time.
Man, you guys really know how to party up here!
I wish my dad was here to see this giant cake!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.455.str: Red over there makes being here all worth it.
I'mma take a slice of this cake home to my momma.
Didya hear they're developing a mini-me? Ain't as good-looking as the real thing but I hope I can get my momma one.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.456.str: This cake is as big as Bubbie!
If only K'nuckles were here to see this... I'll have to tell him all about it when I see him again!
This cake is making me think about just how amazing Candied Island must be!
Woah, wait 'til I tell Bubbie about this cake!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.458.str: Our business being here is STRICTLY in the name of raising funds, no sourness here.
Sour Ron can give you some fast vehicles if you donate only a small amount!
We'd sour this Shmingerbread stuff but we're scared of Knish Krinkle's wrath!
Don't you want to donate to a charitable cause?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.459.str: Can you help me get out of here? I don't have any monkeys registered.
Just between you and me, I didn't come up with this.
What a nice saturday morning for an invasion, right?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.46.str_: We are lost without our master, Mojo Jojo!
Just think. I could be flying humans around for Taros!
Buttercup is in Sector V, but we can't find the other Powerpuff Girls!
Negative. No sign of Blossom or Bubbles.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.460.str: Take advantage of your chance to test out these sweet rides during the party before they make it to market.
That retired Birthday Basher guy is creeping me out, who invited him?
Wouldn't be a party without a giant cake! Mung Daal Catering Company did a fantastic job.
Hope you're enjoying the party! Just go down and get rid of those pesky Party Poppers and Birthday Bashers to earn exclusive items!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.461.str: People are giving me strange looks but I'm here on behalf of a lot of needy Fusions.
C'mon, no change for a Fusion who REALLY needs it?
Grab some items of Birthday past over here, buying some supports a great cause!
Woooo, it's a party... I wasn't invited but I'm here anyway.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.462.str: I believe I saw a rock monster here earlier, this could be profitable after all.
Does that fat blue child have a tail?
I see you're admiring my Megatooth Shark skin cape. You have a sharp eye.
Have an appetite for the bizarre? Perhaps you've heard of my show, Weird World.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.463.str: I like... I like to sing and I like to spell and I like cake.
I wanna be friends with the big guy! Yes, the big guy!
Fred fred fred fred, fred fred FRED! Yes.
My name is Fred Fredburger. F-r-e-d-f-r-e-d-b-u-r-G-G-G-e-r. YES!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.464.str: I got all kinds of weapons. What do you need?
If you want to master combat, you're gonna need a nice weapon.
Urban Rangers are real in touch with nature! In fact, a little birdie told me that you can redeem the code "inmyelement" for something exclusive!
Did you squash any bugs today?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.465.str: I like... I like to sing and I like to spell and I like cake.
I wanna be friends with the big guy! Yes, the big guy!
Fred fred fred fred, fred fred FRED! Yes.
My name is Fred Fredburger. F-r-e-d-f-r-e-d-b-u-r-G-G-G-e-r. YES!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.466.str: If you ain't dripping, you're drowning!
Get fresh for your next fight!
Don't just buy one, buy two! One to rock and one to stock!
My work is gonna be the next big brand!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.467.str: Due to there being no other local optometrists, we also carry frames in the style of the CEO of a neighboring company!
Unfortunately, we do not carry Dex-Specs with red lenses.
Studies have been unable to confirm the benefits of eating carrots on eyesight but our glasses are guaranteed to help.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.47.str_: If we can't find the Powerpuff Girls, who are we supposed to fight with? These stupid aliens?!?
Townsville could be ours! But I think Fuse might have absorbed it...
It's hard out here for a minion!
No Powerpuff Girls in sight. No Professor Utonium, either.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.48.str_: I possess a few different lines of dialogue that I enjoy saying at irregular intervals.
Want to see my opposable thumbs?
I want to go back to my life of crime!
Why do all humans smell like nacho cheese and chocolate milk?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.49.str_: I used to think time travel was a myth.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.5.str_c: I'll give you a lift...for a fee.
Ask about my frequent flyer deals.
Don't be shy. I showered today!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.50.str_: It's true, I lost my memory and joined a rock band. So what?
I haven't seen Blossom or Bubbles since the battle of Tech Square.
Where's that kid who's gonna save the planet?
Has anyone received word from Blossom?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.51.str_: The time machine must be repaired.
Once you have obtained a few Nanos, please proceed to the Cul-de-Sac.
I am Computress. Welcome to Sector V.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.52.str_: Go over to the tree house to meet Numbuh Two!
I want to meet the time traveler!
There's shopkeepers on the tree house platform.
The training ground is totally infected with goo!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.53.str_: Wanna buy something? Let's do this!
I see monsters everywhere I go!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.54.str_: I've got special deals going on all day long.
What did the daddy tomato say to the baby tomato?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.55.str_: What can I help you with today?
You'll be at a disadvantage if you don't have the right equipment.
I've got 2 x 4 technology, and it's priced to sell.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.56.str_: The Cul-de-Sac is in Peach Creek Commons, in case you were wondering.
This Shabby Camper Actually Makes a Perfect Emergency Rescumabob!
My SCAMPER is in tip-top shape!
If you need to go the Cul-de-Sac, I'm your guy.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.57.str_: Get the right gear and you'll be unstoppable.
Numbuh Two shops here all the time.
Let me know if I can help you today.
We can beat Fuse. I just know it!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.58.str_: Hi! Can I help you with something?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.59.str_: Where's that kid I met in Tech Square?
Numbuh Five has had it up to here with this Fuse dude.
Fuse has just about infected the whole world.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.6.str_c: Dexlabs reminds you that it is always a fine day for science.
This unit welcomes you to Genius Grove.
Warning: Dee Dee is in the vicinity.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.6.str_n: This unit sells Nano Potions and Weapon Boosts.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.60.str_: Has anyone seen the kid from the time machine?
Man, alien invasions give me an appetite.
Our tree house used to float, but Fuse put an end to that!
I can't reach anyone in Tech Square!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.61.str_: Buttercup is in Pokey Oaks North!
I'm not sure I'm ready to fight a Fusion.
We need to stop the infection in Pokey Oaks!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.62.str_: I don't think anybody has heard from Numbuh One since the battle of Tech Square!
Don't go down to the training area. It's infected!
If you go over to the tree house, you can meet Numbuh Two!
Use the bridges to get over to the tree house platform.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.63.str_: If you want to find Buttercup, she's in Pokey Oaks North.
I heard Numbuh Two has a timelab. He's totally a genius.
Onward to victory, Kids Next Door!
Cross the bridge to get to Pokey Oaks North.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.64.str_: You can find a bunch of KND shopkeepers over near the tree house.
Be careful where you walk. A lot of this Fusion Matter stuff is toxic.
We managed to hold the Suburbs together with bridges. But there's Fusion Matter everywhere!
We've gotta keep this area secure, or Fuse will absorb Sector V!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.7.str_c: Oh, where has Dee Dee gone?
No one has heard from Dexter since the battle of Tech Square. What a relief!
Thanks to my genius, I've learned how to send messages back through time.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.7.str_n: Ha ha ha! Fuse will learn to bow to my genius! Ha ha ha ha ha!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.75.str_: Stickybeard 'tis the finest candy captain of all the world!
Have ye tried to reach the Sweet Revenge's crow's nest?
A lad named Edd taught me the magic o' jawbreakers.
Arrr! The Sweet Revenge has been run aground!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.76.str_: Avast! Fuse be stealin' our candy!
My sweet tooth done been soured by this invasion.
Have ye heard of a young lad named Flapjack?
We be standin' guard to protect our village.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.77.str_: I'll give you a lift...for a fee.
Ask about my frequent flyer deals.
Don't be shy. I showered today!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.78.str_: Fuse has stolen me ship from me! 'Tis the ultimate insult!
Me candy booty still be aboard the Sweet Revenge.
I be looking for some brave young swashbucklers!
Fusion Numbuh Five was seen aboard me ship!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.79.str_: Yer standin' in the presence of the great Candy Pirate, Stickybeard!
Have ye heard of Crazy Brain Candy? 'Tis real!
We gotta run Fuse and his band offa our ship!
Welcome to the Candy Pirate village, me hearties!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.8.str_c: Change your Nano's power with Power Items.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.8.str_n: I am programmed to sell Power Items.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.80.str_: The Sweet Revenge won't last much longer, me hearties.
Tharrr be a Fusion creeping aboard this ship!
Tis time for Fuse to walk the plank!
Arrr! I got mutiny on me mind!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.81.str_: I ain't gonna go down with this ship.
Fuse is sure to destroy the Sweet Revenge!
Arrr! I need me some fresh caramel.
Arrr, I don't trust Stickybeard no more.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.83.str_: Have you met my little pal, Runty?
I made a mattress out of egg noodles!
Fuse wants to be the dominant species on the planet, and he'll destroy us all to make it happen!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.84.str_: I enjoy my monsters baked, fried, or turned into goo.
Oh, Powerpuff Girls? Care to save the day before bedtime?
Come talk to me. I won't bite.
I grow bored of this alien invasion nonsense.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.85.str_: I can help you out. Whadda you need?
A Fusion Him was spotted in the cemetery.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.86.str_: Can I help you with something today?
My cousin built the skate park.
Don't go Downtown unless you're ready!
The bravest of the brave shop with me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.87.str_: SACT has supplied me with quality gear.
Charles Darwin Middle School lies to the west.
We're gonna beat Fuse. Don't give up.
Report to me if you need something.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.88.str_: Have you seen the farting ghost duck?
I'd be careful around those Bloodsuckers, if I were you.
Did anyone tell you about the Wishing Skulls? I wish someone would...
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.89.str_: Go south from here to head into Downtown.
Let's kick Fuse back to Planet Fusion!
Be careful if you go into the Reactor Works.
Him could tell you a thing or two about the magical Wishing Skulls.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.9.str_c: Reports indicate that Fusion Eddy is in Mandark's yard. These reports are wrong.
Warning: the infected zone is very dangerous.
Please refrain from trotting through the flowers.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.9.str_n: Sensors indicate that Planet Fusion will soon enter our atmosphere.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.90.str_: Someone told me there's a Fusion Billy running around Dizzy World.
If you're tough, I'll sell you some stuff.
Would you like to join the Special Alien Capture Team?
The nuclear power plant lies north of here.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.91.str_: It's hard to rhyme all of the time.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.92.str_: Don't worry, my little Beanie Baggies! I will protect you!
Azul told me he was going to the Dizzy World fun park.
If you help me, I give you a potato.
What will we do with all these monsters around? No es bueno!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.93.str_: I wish I could blame this whole thing on Bloo.
Did you see Wilt at the Cul-de-Sac?
I so totally need a vacation.
Seriously, I think someone is walking around here pretending to be me.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.94.str_: Planet Fusion really has my dander up!
Welcome to Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends!
Thank goodness for the efforts of our planet's youth.
Please, no running in the foyer!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.95.str_: Camp Kidney lies to the north.
Do some shopping with me today!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.96.str_: Have you ever met Grandpa Max? He's a legend.
I wonder what Mandark Industries is building next door.
If you get past Leakey Lake, you should stop at the Jungle Outpost.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.97.str_: There is a zipline north of here that will take you deeper into the Wilds.
What do you need? I probably have it!
When this invasion is over, consider joining the Plumbers.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.98.str_: Got feet? Then you need foot gear!
If Ace is only 17, does that make the Gangreen Gang a boy band?
My imaginary friend used to live here!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_barker.99.str_: Mandark is smarter than the average genius.
Stay away from this site, humans!
Imaginary friends are stranger than humans.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1004.st: These vehicles are guaranteed to outperform Mandark Industries vehicles, despite what the misinformed Mandroid unit over there may tell you.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1005.st: Do not listen to that unit across the square, all Mandark Industries vehicles outperform Dexlabs vehicles.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1007.st: You must be very brave to be here!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1183.st: You're gonna do great. Make us proud! Sniff! I promised myself that I wouldn't cry...
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1187.st: Fusion Blossom is taking over Pokey Oaks Junior High! Maybe you can stop her.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1189.st: I saw a Fusion Him around here. He's up to no good, I just know it! Eek!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1190.st: Father done promised us sweet riches if we sign up with him.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1191.st: Send a greeting to me comrade, Brittle Butter, if ye see him.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1192.st: This unit is the Dexbot sentry for the nuclear power plant. Fuse will not secure this location.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1206.st: I like the tech you're carrying. It's very nicely designed.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1210.st: My vehicles are out of this world!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1486.st: Even if you get me out of my bind, you still have eight more skulls to find.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1487.st: Once you complete a task for me, you should find Wishing Skull number three.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1488.st: The first three skulls have been found. The next three skulls lie Downtown.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1634.st: If you go to Monkey Mountain, say hello to my friends, Nicka Bocka and Pogo Loco.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1703.st: I am programmed to assist Computress and Dexter.
