entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1704.st: I have never met a carbon-based lifeform that didn't annoy every circuit in my body. This includes you.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1706.st: The space port is a really tricky infected zone. You're gonna want a Nano with Jump or Rocket powers!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1859.st: The other Wishing Skulls are around. They are just waiting to be found.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1860.st: Don't fret and don't frown. Thromnambular VI is somewhere Downtown.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1861.st: The last three Wishing Skulls, my child, are located somewhere in the wild.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1907.st: If you go north of Leakey Lake, you'll find the KND's Jungle Outpost, gateway to the jungle!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1908.st: The Special Alien Capture Team has encountered unusual spectral phenomena on the Haunted Ridge.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1909.st: Kevin Levin was spotted in Nowhere. That kid once gave us a really hard time.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1910.st: I grew up in Nowhere, but I moved here many years ago. Have you met Courage the Cowardly Dog?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1911.st: Fuse has trapped me here. Send word to Mel Anzana.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1912.st: Monsters have kidnapped me and my friends. Can you help us?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1913.st: Did Mel Anzana send you? Me'n my brother are trapped down here.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1914.st: We're supposed to be finding new minions for Master Mojo. But then Fuse took over Monkey Mountain.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.1915.st: No disrespect, but is it true that humans actually enjoy bathing themselves every single day?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2148.st: Hey, you must be pretty strong if you made it this far! I'm afraid it only gets tougher.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2471.st: You know how Fuse makes Fusions, right? He steals stuff from the heroes, like Numbuh One's glasses.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2502.st: One time, Buttercup lost her memory and disappeared. Did you know she joined a rock band?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2503.st: Stickybeard left to requisition heself another ship and crew. But he ain't been seen since.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2504.st: This wormhole is the product of a tear in space-time.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2507.st: You'll need an emerald membership to bank here! Talk to the Morbucks Accountant to get started!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2516.st: I hate to say it, but I think Fuse is winning this war. He's already absorbed big chunks of our world.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2517.st: Did you really travel through time and stuff?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2520.st: The area beyond Genius Grove has already been absorbed by Planet Fusion.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2521.st: Were you in Tech Square when it was destroyed?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2523.st: Leave me alone, you carbon-based lifeform.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2526.st: I have been advised that you are the human child who will save our world.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2527.st: Your primary directive is to rebuild Dexter's broken time machine.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2532.st: Fuse destroyed my favorite comic book store, so if you've got the latest issue of "Teen Tyrants" let me know!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2533.st: Go right in. There's a funny purple monster down there named Eduardo. But he's not one of the Eds!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2534.st: Father was building a new housing development in Peach Creek Estates, but that creep took off.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2535.st: Did you hear about how the Kankers built a Trojan Hamburger to try and sneak into the Cul-de-Sac?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2536.st: When Fuse attacked City Hall, the Great Machine was almost destroyed, but I helped the KND move it here safely.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2537.st: Wow, you were in Tech Square? Did you meet Dexter?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2538.st: Wanna hear something cool? Edd's cardboard castle actually protects the Cul-de-Sac from monsters.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2539.st: Is it true that you traveled through time?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2540.st: If you're gonna save us, you better get started. Like, yesterday.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2541.st: Fuse's monsters are pretty dangerous, but they don't seem to want to get too close to Edd's castle.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2547.st: The time machine is now fully functional. It is time for you to return to the past to save our planet.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2548.st: Say hi to Dex for me when you get there!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2549.st: Go and give Fuse a couple kicks in the butt for me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2550.st: Remember, when you get back to the past, tell them you couldn't have done it without Mandark. Ha!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2551.st: Adios, mi favorite friend from the past. You go now and make these yucky monsters go bye-bye.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2552.st: Do you get time travel sickness? I'll sell ya a paper bag for cheap!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2553.st: The path of the hero is never easy. But I see within you the strength to save this world from destruction.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2555.st: It is a welcome relief to see you once again. I will aid you in any way I can.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2561.st: I can help you if you need to send something to Mojo.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2562.st: Mandark can be found at Mandark Industries in Tech Square.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2564.st: We're trying to improve the Nano creation process. You can help by collecting some creation items for me.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2582.st: This road used to lead to Endsville. Now it leads nowhere.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2586.st: You'll need a gold membership to bank here! Talk to the Morbucks Accountant to get started!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2587.st: Interested in opening a local bank account? We have a variety of options for modest prices!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2629.st: Don't get too excited if you beat a Fusion. Fuse always makes more.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2630.st: That weird Father guy is building a housing development in Peach Creek Estates.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2631.st: Nobody can explain why Edd's fortress keeps the monsters out.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2632.st: If you think you're ready, you can head out to Camp Kidney. It's north of Foster's.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2633.st: I'm not picking my nose, kid! It just itches really bad!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2634.st: If you head south of here, you'll find Stickybeard's pirate ship. Fuse has infected it with his disgusting goo!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2635.st: You seem nice. We should hang out some time!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2636.st: Did you check out the Park n' Flush trailer park across the creek?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2637.st: The Urban Rangers are here to help. I even have the Hatpin of Helpitude!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2638.st: Think you're fast? I'll bet you can't beat my time in the Delightful Developments race!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2639.st: Dexlabs and Mandark Industries gave us the tech to raise the tree house.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2641.st: If we're not careful, Fuse is gonna infect our training area.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2642.st: The plan is to raise the tree house to prevent Fusion invaders.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2643.st: If you get out to the Wilds, you need to visit the KND Jungle Outpost.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2644.st: Fuse can make lots of Fusions. So even when you beat one, they seem to come back again. Figures.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2645.st: I useta think them Kids Next Door was scurvy scamps, but they done help us fight Fuse!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2646.st: Tharrr be a magic candy that scrambles yer brains. We can't let Fuse get it!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2647.st: We've discovered a wormhole that sends messages from the future. Fascinating!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2648.st: This is no way to treat Charles Darwin alumni.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2649.st: This swirling time vortex is sending messages from the future. Eek, eek!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2650.st: Weird stuff keeps popping out of this thing. I wonder if it goes through time!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2651.st: I'm spying on Father. He's building a new housing development nearby!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2652.st: Dexbots in this area have been programmed to establish a defensive perimeter.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2653.st: Query: Fusion Dee Dee more annoying than regular Dee Dee? Answer: need more input.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2654.st: Were you the human volunteer for Dexter's time travel experiment?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2655.st: This unit has detected multiple transfers across the space-time continuum via this wormhole.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2806.st: If you go north from here, you will enter the Monkey Foothills, in the shadow of Monkey Mountain.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2807.st: Monkey Mountain has a great view. You might find another Wishing Skull, too.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2808.st: If you help me with my mission, I will help you with your wishin'.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2809.st: I am Wishing Skull number nine. The very last skull you need to find.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2838.st: If you do not have business with Master Mojo, you should probably move along. Eek, eek.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2842.st: Yeah, I'm a mutant eggplant. Got a problem with that, kid? Watch the roots!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2846.st: This unit is searching for technology stolen from Dexlabs.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2847.st: Mandark is building a facility here so he can better study imaginary friends.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2853.st: Are you not the human that volunteered for Dexter's time experiment?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2854.st: Nothing to see here, we're just a group of tourists exploring the Dexlabs campus. Move along.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2855.st: Would ye like to join our motley crew of candy adventurers?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2856.st: Did ye meet Grim? He would make a fine Candy Pirate mascot, don't ye think?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2857.st: We pirates bring in supplies for all ye landlubbers.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2858.st: I've seen both a Fusion Ben and a Fusion Gwen inside the space port.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2859.st: If we can make the space port operational again, we can find out what happened to the moonbase.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2860.st: Have you seen Ben use the Omnitrix? It's awesome! That is, when it works.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2861.st: We're keeping this area locked down until the space port can be cleaned up.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2862.st: If you don't like chickens, wait until you hear about the mutant eggplants.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2863.st: To be honest, I don't even believe in Chickens from Outer Space.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2864.st: If you don't like chickens, wait until you hear about the mutant eggplants.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2865.st: If you don't like chickens, wait until you hear about the mutant eggplants.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2866.st: Grandpa Max is working on a surveillance satellite to study the surface of Planet Fusion.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2868.st: If you head out into the wilderness, make sure you look for Numbuh Three and Numbuh Four at the KND's Jungle Outpost.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2874.st: The Rustbucket RV looks old, but Max has some amazing tech on board.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2875.st: If you haven't checked out Leakey Lake, you probably should. It's near the KND's Jungle Outpost.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2876.st: I heard the Toiletnator is at Camp Kidney. What a weirdo!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2941.st: I don't consider this Spring-Green Squeaker film to be canon.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2943.st: Is Brain Sucking Aliens from the Moon a documentary?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2944.st: I was fighting Fuse all day. I need to take a break!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2945.st: Hurry up! I'm gonna miss the show!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2946.st: If you haven't seen T-Rexatron Alien Wolf II, you totally won't understand T-Rexatron Alien Wolf III.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2948.st: Robot Rebel Ranch got a great review in the Townsville Tribune.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2949.st: Someone needs to make a movie about Planet Fusion.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2950.st: I hope I get to see a trailer for the new Ben 10 movie!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2954.st: It appears that Fusion Matter can actually contain data. This is how Fuse communicates with his troops.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2956.st: If you see a mutant eggplant, don't tell them you saw us. Or I will blast you with my Chicken Ray!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2957.st: We are trying to find the Chickens From Outer Space. They are causing trouble in Nowhere.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2959.st: What's up, human? Who's your monkey?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2961.st: We were visiting Camp Kidney when Fuse attacked! Now we don't know where to go.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2962.st: We're out here attempting to tag alien wildlife. Maybe we should call in the Special Alien Capture Team.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2963.st: SACT has studied the Fusions. It appears that Fuse can create multiples, though it costs him considerable energy.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2964.st: The Plumbers specialize in the investigation of strange and otherworldly activity.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2966.st: We're surveying this area, trying to determine how bad the infection is.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2967.st: Tetrax is a Petrosapien mercenary that used to work undercover for Vilgax. He knows a lot about Fuse.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.2969.st: If you don't like bridges, you can also use the jump pads to get up on the tree house platform.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3024.st: I wouldn't get too close to that wormhole, if I were you.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3025.st: These wormholes can transmit data and inactive matter, but I would keep organic matter free and clear.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3026.st: Hey, you know anything about the space-time continuum or quantum theory?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3027.st: You used to be able to get up to Foster's and Camp Kidney this way. Well, not any more.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3028.st: Planet Fusion has absorbed everything north of here.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3029.st: Everything west of here has been absorbed by Planet Fusion!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3031.st: Arrr! I hear talk that yer the rascal that done sailed through time. Well done, matey!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3032.st: After the Sweet Revenge ran aground, Fuse's infection took hold and destroyed that fair vessel.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3033.st: The minions have not heard from Mojo Jojo in weeks. So we just wander around Pokey Oaks.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3034.st: You gonna get into a time machine and save the world? Hurry up, human!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3061.st: Don't tell General Tso that you saw us. He'd roast me for sure!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3062.st: I fell in love with a Chicken From Outer Space. It could have happened to anyone.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3070.st: Is it true that you traveled through time? That's awesome!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3071.st: Believe it or not, Fusion Matter seems to have the ability to contain data. Strange!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3072.st: I've been in SACT for ten years, and I've never seen anything like this.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3074.st: Mandark Industries is busy creating a new nano that changes its form based on creation items sent to it remotely.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3075.st: Dexlabs and Mandark Industries are begrudgingly cooperating to create a new type of nano that can change its form.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3077.st: I think Fuse is trying to start a war between us eggplants and them chickens. Can you help?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3078.st: We been seein' Fuse haulin' stashes o' candy down here. But then he moved it all.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3079.st: We gots a mutant eggplant camp down here. Didja see them chickens on yer way down?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3080.st: There's a funny robot down here named Robot Randy. But he been sleepin' lots.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3081.st: Space Chicken report: Fuse monsters have been seen bringing candy into the Catacombs. Bawk!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3082.st: General Tso sent a platoon down to the Space Port to see if we can get off the planet.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3083.st: Area 51.5 has lots of strange artifacts inside. Go look into it. B'gawk!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3084.st: Fuse is kidnapping chickens! Or is it the eggplants? Who cares? Just let me blast something!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3085.st: Tennis is not a game of power. It is a game of accuracy.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3086.st: Master Mojo ordered us to find Buttercup. She has disappeared!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3087.st: Mayhap more Candy Pirates will be arriving soon with candy reinforcements.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3088.st: We must be watchful for monsters that come in from the sea!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3089.st: Cap'n Stickybeard has ordered us to hide the Crazy Brain Candy from Fuse.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3090.st: We be watchin' this beach for invaders...and reinforcements!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3091.st: Buttercup? Have you seen her? Where?!?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3092.st: For a human, your odor is remarkably inoffensive.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3093.st: Travel to all major destinations from City Station, human! This message has been brought to you by Dexlabs.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3094.st: Mojo Jojo is the greatest evil genius to ever acquire an oversized brain and to hate the Powerpuff Girls.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3095.st: Hello, human. Don't worry. We'll get back to conquering you soon.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3096.st: Hello, human. Can I interest you in some stereo equipment?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3099.st: Go to the north side of the Monkey Foothills. There's a transport that will take you to the Darklands.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3100.st: Fuse seems obsessed with Imaginary Friends. He was trying to catch Coco, but we saved her.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3101.st: I'll give you my theory: Fuse doesn't have an imagination of his own.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3102.st: After Fuse invaded, Numbuh One sent Numbuh Three and Numbuh Four out here to guard the jungle.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3103.st: We've got a special Jungle Training Area here, but it's been infected.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3104.st: Some kid named Ed fancies himself a king. He likes swinging from the treetops...and falling on his head.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3105.st: Sorry, when I'm on guard duty, I try to sound official and stuff.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3106.st: Have you seen the monkey lines? They are zip lines that will carry you all across the jungle!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3108.st: The Battle of Hero's Hollow was not that long ago. We fought hard. It just shows you what we're up against.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3110.st: The heroes thought they could make one final stand to drive Fuse from our world. You can see how it turned out.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3123.st: Rada radarada rada RADA! Rada rada.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3124.st: You'll need a ruby membership to bank here! Talk to the Morbucks Accountant to get started!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3125.st: I’m waiting for Lenny Baxter to open up so I can be the first in line to purchase a brand new issue of my favorite comic book series, but he’s running super late. What could possibly be inconveniencing daily life on such a massive scale to cause this?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3126.st: Welcome to our spring celebration! Enter this special dungeon for a fun Coco egg hunt. To exit, just look for me inside!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3127.st: Welcome to our spring celebration! Enter this special dungeon for a fun Coco egg hunt. To exit, just look for me inside!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3128.st: Rada radarada rada RADA! Rada rada.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3129.st: You'll need a sapphire membership to bank here! Talk to the Morbucks Accountant to get started!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3131.st: Run around and collect all the eggs you can. Don't give up until you get a special prize. Watch out for Rotten Eggs!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3132.st: Run around and collect all the eggs you can. Don't give up until you get a special prize. Watch out for Rotten Eggs!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3133.st: Run around and collect all the eggs you can. Don't give up until you get a special prize. Watch out for Rotten Eggs!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3135.st: I'll be the best Candy Pirate there ever was.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3136.st: I dunno where Jordan got the idea that I'm the recruiter for the Candy Pirates, but I might as well 'ave fun with it, aye?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3147.st: I admire your enthusiasm, but only those who have acquired their Eduardo Nano may embark upon the Fusion Blowfish hunt. Insurance regulations, you see.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3148.st: Merry Knishmas! I’ve lost all of the presents I was going to give to my friends, can you help?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3150.st: I’m on a super important adventure to help save my friend Bubbie!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3157.st: Is that banana pudding I smell?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3202.st: I had no idea these Croc Pots could be so tempermental.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3204.st: Always be on your guard, operative.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3205.st: I'm the best cook in the KND. Numbuh Two once called my chocolate chip cookies, "Tasty."
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3206.st: It is my prime directive to make your wardrobe fabulous.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3207.st: Have you seen any of my doubles around?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3208.st: These hand-crafted vehicles will get you where you need to go, Eddy’s guarantee!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3209.st: Selling marked police cars is totally legal, and anyone who says otherwise is just jealous of my sales!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3210.st: Looking for some vehicles that run on 2x4 tech? You’ve come to the right treehouse!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3211.st: Mandark Industries claims no responsibility for any injuries sustained as a result of a vehicle malfunction.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3212.st: Our vehicles are so fast, you’ll know what it’s like to be XLR8!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3221.st: Ever vigilant. That's the SACT motto. What do you mean it's not? That's what it should be.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3222.st: I don't know about you, but fighting Fuse sure makes me thirsty. Do you like Lemonade?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3223.st: I know it seems hopeless, but we must save the Dark Tree. It can't defend itself.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3224.st: Are you another goody-goody like the Saturdays?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3225.st: Those Skull Bashers are making a heck of a racket.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3232.st: This unit was hiding in a broom closet during Fuse's attack. Self-preservation is a prime directive.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3233.st: This unit hopes to be a success like DOC-26.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3242.st: Smell that hickory smoke.  It makes the bananas even more delicious.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3268.st: Dracula noticed that you’ve been running around doing other people’s work for them, so Dracula decided to step outside and take advantage of that.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3269.st: Some Fusion monster buttface took over my Ice Kingdom! Until my besties can fix things back home, I live HERE now. Deal with it.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3270.st: The Cul-de-Sac is east of here in Peach Creek Commons. Eddy hangs out there.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3273.st: There's a Fusion hanging out inside our training area. I'm sure of it!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3275.st: My vehicles run on tech developed by the Secret Scientists. They don’t exactly know I’m selling these things, so maybe keep it on the down low.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3282.st: The Mayor personally guarantees the safety of all these hover vehicles, as far as you know!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3283.st: This unit is assisting Dexter in clearing out unwanted inventions from his old laboratory. Would you care to make a purchase?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3292.st: What, what do you want?! Can’t a puckerberry and his dog watch a movie in peace? If you’re looking for stolen presents, I’m not your guy.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3298.st: Watch out for those Pumpkin Spawns if you’re going into the graveyard. If you want a special reward, complete my mission before the Halloween season is over.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3299.st: Watch yourself around those Blood Gnats, kid. They’re disgusting parasites that will suck your blood and make you all loopy like these poor people.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3310.st: Um, I like Halloween because you get candy and you get to talk to strangers. I like strangers! Yes!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3311.st: Thanks for taking part in this year's charity drive. I, the SOUR KING am a man of my people! Every purchase goes toward helping a little sour ball in need of a mouth.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3313.st: Hey, kiddo! I was told there’d be babes here, but it’s looking more like snoozeville right about now. I’ll stay here and keep watch, come back later when the party starts!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3368.st: Oh say, can you see the fireworks in the sky!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3370.st: I can't seem to get me mojo flowing , there is definitely supernatural activity going on here. If you stumble upon a book called de Necronomicon, stay away from dis place. It could cause all sorts of demonic messes as fun as dat sounds.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3391.st: Fuse's monsters took one of my dog collars! I think they're making a Fusion me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3392.st: Dude, they're making a little Nano me! That's totally mathematical!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3395.st: I'm here to deliver this delicous, delectable, salvating..... Uhhh, oh right! This Shmingerbread Gazebo! Doesn't it look yummy?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3396.st: Didya think you could throw a party with a big birthday cake without me?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3397.st: I don't know how I ended up here or who you are but back off.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3398.st: While I don't mind the festivities, could you please direct me towards the professor? He doesn't seem to be home right now.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3399.st: I'm looking for some ship parts but the Clydes directed me towards here.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3401.st: This seems like the perfect place to lay my eggs after the party's over!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3402.st: Woah, that red-haired babe just drove this party away from being Snoozeville.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3404.st: I couldn't believe it when I heard there was a giant cake here, you don't see sweets this big on Stormalong!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3406.st: Greetings and bienvenue. I am V.V. Argost. I was here to investigate a reported cryptid however it seems all that's going on is some sort of celebration with this giant cake.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3407.st: I like parties, YES! I like parties. I do.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3410.st: Hey, these goggles are hand-crafted, and mass-produced, to help assist in your fuse-fighting capabilities. The sniffer helps!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3411.st: Welcome to the party! Grab a suit, Blank Bubblehead and a vehicle to start your celebration right!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3412.st: Hey, would you like to help a Fusion in need? My Lord's kind of homeless.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3418.st: I will help you with any of your optometry needs.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3420.st: See this gear? You're looking at all the trendiest designs in the scene. You won't be able to find a better price for them!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3430.st: Six is always worried.  I'm not a kid, I don't need a babysitter.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3431.st: Rex is always getting into trouble.  I'm starting to think he needs a babysitter.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3432.st: What do I look like? Rex's babysitter?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3434.st: Greetings Earthling, my name is Octus.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3435.st: Stay away from the princess, errr, I mean my sister.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3436.st: The heart, body and mind join as one!  Salutations friend.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3438.st: This park rules!  I wonder if my sisters have any scooters for me to test.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3439.st: Nuclear power plant, amusement park; after living with the Tests, they're about the same.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3441.st: I remember you! You helped us thwart Vilgax or rather, you will soon enough.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3442.st: We need to stop Vilgax from blocking the Omnitrix and figure out how he's traveling through time!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3449.st: Consider yourself lucky I am too busy to crush you at the moment! Now go away!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3453.st: Be sure to come back after you've created a Fourarms Nano.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3454.st: This gateway leads to CERTAIN DEATH!!!  Well, mostly certain death, but also adventure and some pretty sweet shirts!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3457.st: Hey there, pleased to meet you.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3458.st: Heya.  Turns out the big rubber band ball held a bunch of Megawhatt aliens.  Seems it might come in handy after all.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3463.st: Привет! Я Отто. Это тестовая реплика.
Если ты видишь меня на карте, импорт NPC работает.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3464.st: Even though the Omnitrix is busted, I’ve gotta admit; having a bunch of my alien forms running around on their own is actually kind of cool!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3465.st: I've been receiving emails from someone in Nowhere. He seems to know a lot about extraterrestrial activity!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3466.st: The sweet old lady who lives here is letting me stay with them until I can get my car fixed up, but man, this place gives off some bad vibes.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3467.st: Ah, yes! Greetings again, my good friend. Seeing as I am, in fact, the real Ben Tennyson, I require your assistance getting all of these Sonorosians back into my watch, where they belong.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3468.st: Fuse is supposedly attempting to awaken an ancient creature that sleeps at the base of the Fissure.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3469.st: My mom's an eye doctor so if your friends need any glasses, tell them to come by!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3471.st: We've been trained by the finest Barber in all of Stormalong!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3472.st: We've been trained by the finest Barber in all of Stormalong!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.3475.st: Hey, you've got any tips on stories?

entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.643.str: If you've lost some of Edd's guide items, you can buy them back from me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.644.str: If you've lost some of Edd's guide items, you can buy them back from me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.645.str: If you've lost some of Ben's guide items, you can buy them back from me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.646.str: If you've lost some of Ben's guide items, you can buy them back from me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.647.str: If you've lost some of Mojo's guide items, you can buy them back from me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.648.str: If you've lost some of Mojo's guide items, you can buy them back from me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.649.str: If you've lost some of Dexter's guide items, you can buy them back from me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.650.str: If you've lost some of Dexter's guide items, you can buy them back from me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.664.str: Yeah, Larry's so incompetent Time Squad sent in more of us....Me? Oh I'm here for morale!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.665.str: If you’re looking for a ride with some Foster’s flare, this is the place!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.681.str: I can take you to the Mega Fusion Echo Echo Containment Area if you get some Null Void Coordinate Data.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.689.str: You need a lift back to Peach Creek? Hop in!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.692.str: Coop here is surprisingly well-versed in robotics. I feel good as new!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.694.str: Our primary goal is to duplicate enough Echo Echoes to blow Fuse away for good with a Sonic Scream! We’d probably be ready by now if the other Echoes didn’t keep wandering off...
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.697.str: Ah, yes! Greetings again, my good friend. Seeing as I am, in fact, the real Ben Tennyson, I require your assistance getting all of these Sonorosians back into my watch, where they belong.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.698.str: Heya, sparky! I’m really amped up to help take down this Fuse guy. Where do we start?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.699.str: Eek! Fuse’s monkey monsters are giving us Arachnichimps a bad name!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.701.str: Hi! You must be pretty brave. Do you think you can figure out what's going on in my brother's old lab?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.702.str: Before Fuse arrived, Buttercup was knocked into the ocean during a battle with Mojo Jojo. No one has seen her since.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.703.str: Hi, I'm Blossom! We're trying to contain Fuse and his monsters here in Sector V. Want to lend a hand?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.704.str: You know, I designed some of the KND's best gear. There's shops here to sell stuff to you if you need it.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.705.str: People told me they saw a Fusion Numbuh Five on the Sweet Revenge and another one near Foster's Home. Crazy!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.706.str: Arrr, I suspect there be traitors in me midst! If ye help me, I'll fix ye with a fine reward!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.707.str: Someone told Father that I was making trouble at his new housing development. Untrue!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.708.str: If you got a jawbreaker, I'll tell you about the Fusion Eddy that's running around Endsville.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.709.str: I'm looking for talented kids like you to send them on dangerous missions. Extremely dangerous!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.710.str: There's supposed to be a Fusion Billy in the cemetery! Oooh, spooky!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.711.str: Would you believe that there is a Fusion Him at Charles Darwin Middle School? The nerve!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.712.str: Those stupid Eds built a cardboard fortress around the Cul-de-Sac, and now we can't get in!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.713.str: We built a giant Trojan Hamburger! I'm gonna hide inside it and we're gonna wheel it down to the Cul-de-Sac.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.714.str: I think Mac went out into the jungle to look for Coco. Maybe he's at the KND's Jungle Outpost.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.715.str: Rubbish, I say! A Fusion monster cannot adopt an Imaginary Friend. The idea is preposterous!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.716.str: Fuse is muy interested in Imaginary Friends. His monsters keep coming to our house!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.717.str: Hey, welcome to our Cul-de-Sac castle! I’d head back to Foster’s, but what if someone needs help opening this huge door?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.718.str: That creep Fuse trapped Megas in a gooey prison. Now the big guy can't help save the world! Oh well, let's eat.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.719.str: There's a Fusion at the amusement park givin' me a bad name. Let's go teach him a lesson!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.720.str: Yo, this Fuse guy is totally lame! Want to help the Gangreen Gang rock his world?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.721.str: Since nobody knows what happened to Buttercup, now's my chance to take her place!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.722.str: Good gravy, what can we do about this terrible alien problem? Someone should talk to the Mayor. Oh, wait! That's me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.723.str: Some bloke named Fusion Vilgax is causing real trouble for us here at the Fissure. Wanna help?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.724.str: Travelers tell of a Fusion Scotsman that haunts the Leakey Loch!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.725.str: Fuse is supposedly attempting to awaken an ancient creature that sleeps at the base of the Fissure.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.726.str: I heard Fusion Bloo was trying to sneak into Foster's, but I saw one at Dizzy World, too!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.727.str: Fuse is terrorizing the animals that used to live in the park. We need to help them!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.728.str: I am so pleased to see you! We have much work to do if we intend to send Fuse back to his own galaxy.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.729.str: Dexter thinks that he can improve Nano technology, but only I can make the Great Machine perform at its optimum level! Ha ha ha!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.730.str: Reports indicate that Fusion Max is attempting to breach security here at Dexlabs.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.731.str: I have a secret plan in the works, and if I divulge to you the details of this plan, it will no longer be a secret plan!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.732.str: Even though the Omnitrix is busted, I’ve gotta admit; having a bunch of my alien forms running around on their own is actually kind of cool!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.733.str: I have forged an uneasy alliance with Ben Tennyson, at least until this Fuse business is resolved.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.734.str: Fuse keeps taking me shrunken heads. Do ya tink dat's what he uses to make dem Fusions?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.735.str: I don't wanna talk to you anymore until I find my Ed!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.736.str: You think I wanna work for Fuse? I wanna get rid of him as bad as you!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.737.str: This Fuse feller done ruined the lake and forest. I hate him bad!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.738.str: I've been receiving emails from someone in Nowhere. He seems to know a lot about extraterrestrial activity!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.739.str: When you see Double D, tell him I really like the jungle. I don't wanna come home!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.740.str: Who's Mandy? She sounds like a grump. Maybe you should give her a hug!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.741.str: Fuse stole one of my footballs! I hear that's how he makes Fusions.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.742.str: Coco said that she saw an alien version of me running around Forgotten Falls!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.743.str: Coco, cocococo co-coco. Coco coco coco co-coco.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.744.str: Mojo Jojo may want to build a new monkey army, but I think I'll build an army of my own.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.745.str: Unless you can help me with my plans, I suggest you find something else to do with your time.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.746.str: Fuse's monsters took one of my dog collars! I think they're making a Fusion me!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.747.str: You meet that strange magic man hanging around here? I oughta kick him in the chops.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.748.str: If you see my pal Grim down in Orchid Bay, tell him that I miss him!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.749.str: The sweet old lady who lives here is letting me stay with them until I can get my car fixed up, but man, this place gives off some bad vibes.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.750.str: I fear that Fuse is working on strengthening his armies in the Darklands. There are even reports that Fusions are being created here.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.751.str: Fusion Demongo stole my powers, and his lair lies somewhere north of here.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.752.str: Fusion Jack was the first Fusion created on this planet. To face him means certain doom.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.758.str: Kid scientists are trying to make the Nanos more powerful. Wanna help?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.765.str: I thought the Space Chickens were attacking us, but now I suspect Fuse is behind it.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.766.str: The Caponata Catacombs are not safe for a human such as you. Beware! Bock!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.768.str: What's up? Glad you made it safely out of Tech Square. That scene was bad.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.769.str: Hey, I remember you! You're the kid from Tech Square. You'd better get some Nanos before we send you back to the past.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.771.str: If you plan to rebuild the time machine to return to the past, you will require my assistance!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.772.str: You will require Mandark's genius if you want to rebuild Dexter's faulty time machine.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.773.str: I heard that you're the kid who's gonna save the world. Better get started!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.774.str: They say you're an important kid. Whatever. Wanna buy something?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.776.str: If you are the one who is destined to save us, I pledge my loyalty to you. We must rebuild the time machine.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.778.str: We are needing a hero to save the day! Are you the one from the time machine?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.779.str: I'm helping the humans with Nano research. We are gathering Nano creation items for study.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.780.str: My deals on wheels are so good it’s just plain spooky!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.781.str: All our vehicles are organically grown!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.782.str: Human! Your assistance is required in Genius Grove after you obtain your Eduardo nano.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.783.str: Looking for someone, Human? This unit is here to inform you that Mandark has relocated to Genius Grove. Samurai Jack can now be found in Goat's Junkyard. Get lost. Or don't, there are words on the street telling you where to go.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.784.str: We managed to cram all the power of one of Mojo Jojo’s famous city destroying robots into the engine of a hover vehicle!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.785.str: Have you heard? We've lost contact with the KND moon base!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.786.str: I done seen one or two Fusion scallywags on our ship!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.791.str: Dexlabs is participating in a Nano enhancement project. We are improving the Nanos you use every day.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.792.str: You should check out the skate park. It's infected, but it's still fun.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.793.str: Fuse's goo sent Stickybeard's ship, the Sweet Revenge, right to Davy Jones' locker.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.794.str: Have you heard of Fusions? Fuse made them. They're horrible evil versions of the world's greatest heroes.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.795.str: Have you tangled with Fusion Numbuh Two yet?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.796.str: Sector V looks peaceful, but it's still pretty dangerous. You should get some gear from the shops.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.797.str: Hey, are you that kid from the past? I heard all about you!
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.977.str: You look a little old to be with the Kids Next Door, are you some kind of spy?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.978.str: Watch it! This whale has a tummy ache! Don’t worry though, the SKWID Squad is on the case! We sent that Flapjack kid out to Leaky Lake with a list of stuff we need. If you see him give him a hand, yeah?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.979.str: Watch it! This whale has a tummy ache! Don’t worry though, the SKWID Squad is on the case! We sent that Flapjack kid out to Leaky Lake with a list of stuff we need. If you see him give him a hand, yeah?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.980.str: If you’re lookin’ for Flapjack, he and his whale friend went back to Stormalong Harbor.
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.981.str: I am programmed to bully anyone with glasses. Want to buy a pair, four-eyes?
entries.content.tabledata.npc.npc_string.983.str: We've got plenty of frame styles to accomodate ANY look!

Welcome to Croc Pot Catering Company!
The Croc Pot Catering Company creates delicious new combinations from your armor and weapons. It's simple: from MY STUFF, select the item with the STYLE that you want, then choose the item with the STATS you want. We'll throw them into our special Croc Pot and spit out a new item for you. Sound cool? It is!
* The items you wish to combine must be of the
       same type. 
 
     * An item for the opposite gender cannot go in   
       the STYLE slot.

     * GUIDE items cannot go in the STATS slot.

Remember, combinations are not 100% guaranteed.  If the combination fails, don't worry, you can always try again. But we'll still take your Taros!
Thanks for Choosing Croc Pot Catering Company for Your Custom Item Needs!
entries.content.tabledata.rules.rules_string.2.s: Welcome to Kevin's Hot Rod Rentals!
entries.content.tabledata.rules.rules_string.4.s: Kevin's Hot Rod Rentals wants to put you in a new vehicle right now! Vehicles are a speedy form of transportation to help you get around the world faster.
entries.content.tabledata.rules.rules_string.6.s:
Vehicles are available for rental only, not for purchase. Detailed rental information is available on the vehicle's info card. When a vehicle's rental period expires, it disappears from your inventory.

You can equip a vehicle the same way you equip armor, accessories and weapons. Simply go to MY STUFF and select the vehicle you would like to equip, then click HOP ON. To mount and dismount your vehicle in the world, hit the "V" key.
entries.content.tabledata.rules.rules_string.7.s: Remember: at Kevin's Hot Rod Rentals, all the vehicles go to eleven!

entries.content.tutorial.message.minimap_numbuh_: I need some help with a sooper important mission! Report to me right away!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.1.1:
DEXLABS HEADQUARTERS,
TIME CAPSULE.
BEFORE THE INVASION.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.1.2: DEXTER: Hello? It is I, Dexter. Can you hear me in there?
entries.content.tutorial.scene.1.3: DEXTER: Thank you for volunteering for this important time travel experiment. I'm going to need you to input your profile into the system before we begin. Stand by and I'll bring it up on your monitor.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.1.4: DEXTER: Excellent. Bio-scan is complete. Let's make sure your communicator is functioning.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.1.5: COMPUTRESS: All communication systems are functional, Dexter. I will be able to reconnect with the volunteer upon arrival in the future.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.1.6: DEXTER: Affirmative. All right, I'm powering up the main engine now. You may feel a little bump.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.1.7: DEXTER: Wow, are you seeing these readings? A fine day for science, indeed!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.1.8: DEXTER: Prepare for launch. Three. Two. One...
entries.content.tutorial.scene.1.9: DEE DEE: (Off-screen) Oooh, what's this button do?
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.1: COMPUTRESS: Error. You have been sent much farther into the future than Dexter intended.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.10: COMPUTRESS: Excellent. Now push the mouse forward to look up.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.11: COMPUTRESS: Very good. Now pull the mouse back to look down.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.12: COMPUTRESS: Good. To move backwards, press and hold the "S" key.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.13: COMPUTRESS: Very good. While moving, you can steer left and right by using the mouse. Try holding down the "W" key to run while steering with the mouse.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.14: COMPUTRESS: Excellent. You can also move side-to-side by using the "A" and "D" keys. Now move to the marker near the ledge.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.15: COMPUTRESS: To jump, press the Space Bar. To jump forward, hold the "W" key while jumping. Please jump onto this ledge to join Ben and Numbuh Five.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.16: BEN: Look, it's a bunch of Fusion Spawns. You get those, we'll handle this guy!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.17: NUMBUH FIVE: Here, take this weapon.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.19: BEN: Those creeps turn back into Fusion Matter when you beat 'em. Make sure you collect as much as you can. It's real important stuff.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.20: COMPUTRESS: You will automatically collect Fusion Matter from defeated enemies. The amount of Fusion Matter you have is displayed in your Fusion Matter Meter. As you defeat more enemies, your Fusion Matter Meter will continue to fill up.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.23: BEN: It's a Cyberus! Let's take 'im down!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.25: NUMBUH FIVE: Nice shooting, by the way. You know, I just realized who you are. You're the kid from the past that Dexter told us about. Well, you're in a world of trouble now.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.26: NUMBUH FIVE: Look up in the sky. That's Planet Fusion, ruled by some nasty guy named Fuse. Fuse has covered the world with gross green goo, and those disgusting Fusion Spawns are wrecking everything.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.27: BEN: Fuse's monsters have evolved and adapted to our planet. You should see some of 'em! They use things called Terrafusers to infect everything with goo. If the infection gets bad enough, Planet Fusion will absorb our world.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.28: BEN: Now that you're up to speed, can you go help Numbuh Two? We gotta go help the others.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.29: COMPUTRESS: To attack, you must first target your enemy. Use your mouse to center a monster in your screen. A white box will appear if your target is close enough.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.3: NUMBUH FIVE: Holy cannoli! Where did you come from?
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.30: COMPUTRESS: To fire at your target, click the Left Mouse button. Hold the Left Mouse button down for continuous fire. You can also use the "Z" key to attack.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.31: Click the Left Mouse button to attack. Hold the button down for continuous fire.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.32: COMPUTRESS: You can tell how much damage you are doing by looking at your target's Health Bar at the top of your screen.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.33: COMPUTRESS: Damage to you is indicated on your Health Bar. If your health reaches zero, you will be knocked out.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.34: COMPUTRESS: Your communicator comes with a built-in mini-map. It will show you how to reach Numbuh Two.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.35: COMPUTRESS: You are the marker in the center of the mini-map.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.36: COMPUTRESS: The red marker on the mini-map is Numbuh Two.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.37: COMPUTRESS: As you move, check your mini-map to make sure that you are going in the right direction. Note that you may need to go around large objects, like buildings, to reach your target.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.38: COMPUTRESS: Look for the glowing energy rings to help you find Numbuh Two.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.39: COMPUTRESS: Characters with a mission for you will have a floating exclamation mark over their heads.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.4: BEN: Not now, Numbuh Five. We gotta move! Follow us!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.40: COMPUTRESS: A character's available missions will display in a mission menu. Select Numbuh Two's mission "Transmitter Critters" to continue.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.41: COMPUTRESS: Characters with a mission to update will have a floating question mark over their heads. To update the mission "Transmitter Critters", select it from the mission menu.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.43: BUTTERCUP: You're ready for a Nano! And I need your help. Dexter's in trouble.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.44: COMPUTRESS: Congratulations. By successfully completing the mission from Numbuh Two, you have filled up your Fusion Matter Meter. When this meter fills up, you will automatically receive a new Nano mission. Completing Nano missions will reward you with new Nanos.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.45: COMPUTRESS: To talk to Numbuh Two, get close to him and center him in your screen. A talk symbol will appear. Then click the Left Mouse button.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.46: NUMBUH TWO: This attack was no accident. Oil Ogres are using a transmitter to broadcast our position. We need to find those monsters and get that transmitter! You ready?
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.47: COMPUTRESS: To accept the mission from Numbuh Two, click the "Accept Mission" button at the bottom of your screen.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.48: COMPUTRESS: To exit the mission menu, click the "Close" button.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.49: COMPUTRESS: The mission's current objective is displayed on your screen. Your first task is to defeat the Oil Ogre that stole the transmitter. Use your mini-map to locate your target.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.5: COMPUTRESS: Use the W, A, S and D keys to move. You may also use the arrow keys.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.50: NUMBUH TWO: Nice work! Bring that transmitter back to me.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.51: COMPUTRESS: Since you have completed your first task, your mission journal has updated. To open your mission journal, press the "Enter" key to access the main menu on the right side of your screen. Then select "Journal".
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.52: COMPUTRESS: Your mission journal contains information on all your missions.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.53: COMPUTRESS: It tells you who gave you the mission.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.54: COMPUTRESS: It tells you what you need to do.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.55: COMPUTRESS: It also tells you the reward you will receive once you complete the mission.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.56: COMPUTRESS: Click the X in the upper-right corner of your screen to close the journal.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.57: COMPUTRESS: Your new task is to deliver the transmitter to Numbuh Two. Note that your current objective has been updated and a new red marker has been set to Numbuh Two.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.58: COMPUTRESS: Click on Numbuh Two to talk to him and update your mission.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.59: COMPUTRESS: To accept your reward, click the "Complete Mission" button at the bottom of your screen.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.6: COMPUTRESS: To move forward, press and hold the "W" key.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.60: COMPUTRESS: Click the "Close" button to exit the mission menu.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.61: BUTTERCUP: The most infected areas on the planet are called infected zones, thanks to Fuse's Terrafuser machines. Fusion Matter is totally out of control inside. Good thing Dexter set up energy shields to contain the infection.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.62: DEXTER: It is you! I knew we would meet again! My stupid sister messed up the timejump sequence and destroyed the time capsule. We need to get you back to the past so you can save our world.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.63: DEXTER: Fusion Buttercup is in the next room. We must stop her before she can cause any more damage.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.64: DEXTER: Fusions are dark, twisted versions of this planet's heroes, created by Fuse himself.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.65: DEXTER: They are extremely dangerous, but I think you can handle it. Are you ready? Let's go!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.66: DEXTER: Congratulations, you have made your first Nano. Like Fusions, Nanos are made of Fusion Matter. You have used the Fusion Matter you collected in your Fusion Matter Meter to create Nano Buttercup. Don't be discouraged by her size. She may be small, but she is powerful!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.67: COMPUTRESS: Your communicator is now a NanoCom. It has the ability to store up to three Nanos.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.68: DEXTER: Whoa! That does not sound good. You can escape to Dexlabs using the warp gate I have set up. I must search this area and make sure Fusion Buttercup did not steal anything from my headquarters.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.69: DEXTER: I am trapped in Fusion Buttercup's lair! Quickly, find the Fusion Portal!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.70: COMPUTRESS: Use the floating platforms to get across this dangerous pit of Fusion Matter to reach the Fusion Portal.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.71: DEXTER: Thank goodness, you made it. I am over here! Come talk to me. Hurry!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.72: COMPUTRESS: Go to the warp gate to exit the area.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.73: COMPUTRESS: To use the warp gate, target the Dexbot attendant and click on it.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.74: Select the Dexbot attendant to use the warp gate.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.75: COMPUTRESS: Select Buttercup's mission "A Fusion Matter" to continue.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.76: BUTTERCUP: Dexter has disappeared. You gotta see if he's in the infected zone. I'll check out here. There's no time to lose!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.77: COMPUTRESS: Click the "Close" button on the mission menu to continue.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.78: COMPUTRESS: Your new task is to enter the infected zone to find Dexter. You can enter infected zones using warp gates.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.79: COMPUTRESS: To use the warp gate, target the Dexbot attendant and click on it.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.8: COMPUTRESS: Please move the mouse to the right to look at the marker.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.80: Click the "Warp" button to enter Fusion Buttercup's lair.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.81: COMPUTRESS: You can enter a Fusion Portal the same way you enter a warp gate. First, select the Fusion Portal's alien tentacles.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.82: COMPUTRESS: Now click the "Warp" button to enter Fusion Buttercup's lair.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.83: COMPUTRESS: Select "A Fusion Matter" to continue.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.84: NUMBUH TWO: We can't hold Tech Square anymore! Get to the SCAMPER! Hurry!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.85: NUMBUH TWO: You did great, but it looks like Buttercup and the rest weren't able to handle those other Terrafusers in time. Dexter says we gotta find Mandark so we can rebuild the time machine and send you back to the past. Let's get out of here!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.86: DEXTER: Despite our best efforts, Tech Square has been lost. But this war is not over yet. Not by a long shot. Our time-traveling friend here is just the hero we need. Between Mandark and Numbuh Two, I am sure you will be able to rebuild my time capsule. Don't worry about me. I will be fine. Get back to Sector V and to safety. Dexter, out.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.87: NUMBUH TWO: All right, everyone! Next stop Hero Square, Sector V!
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.88: COMPUTRESS: To use Buttercup's power, click the Right Mouse button when your Buttercup Nano is active. You can also use the "X" key.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.89: COMPUTRESS: Buttercup's power will stun your enemies. Target the Tech Wing in front of you and click the Right Mouse button to stun it.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.9: COMPUTRESS: Good. Now move the mouse to the left to look at the next marker.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.90: COMPUTRESS: Nanos have powers that they can use to help you in battle. To summon your Buttercup Nano, press "1" on your keyboard.
entries.content.tutorial.scene.2.91: COMPUTRESS: Now that your enemy is stunned, you can get to the SCAMPER safely.

entries.tabledata.npc.service.1.str_service: Need to upgrade your arsenal? We've got lots of ways to turn Fuse's minions back into goo!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.11.str_service: Dracula makin' a killing from these fools! You can get these Pumpkin C.R.A.T.E.s for free by beatin' up Fuse's goons.
entries.tabledata.npc.service.12.str_service: Our Holosuits are perfect for any occasion. That's because they can change their appearance!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.13.str_service: This time travel gear is pretty spiffy, if I say so myself. You'd better hurry and get some, I have places to be.
entries.tabledata.npc.service.14.str_service: You like watching anime after hours and sci-fi space robots? Yep, sounds like Toonami is for you.
entries.tabledata.npc.service.15.str_service: This temporal contraband fetches a pretty penny on the black market. No, that is NOT a suggestion!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.16.str_service: This Secret Saturdays inspired gear might give you a leg up on those nasty Fusion Blowfish.
entries.tabledata.npc.service.17.str_service: Psst, hey kid, you looking for some exclusive invisible gear? I think I have exactly what you're looking for....For the right price.
entries.tabledata.npc.service.18.str_service: If you've lost your guide's cool, unique items, you can buy them back here!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.19.str_service: You're lucky you found me in such a crowd! You better grab some of these hats before I split!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.2.str_service: If you want to protect yourself in battle and sport a new look, we have lots of great tops that will do the trick.
entries.tabledata.npc.service.20.str_service: This Egg Generating Gizmo Ejects Rewards, and even sells limited time vehicles! The Easter E.G.G.s contain exclusive items!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.21.str_service: Running out of bank space? Purchase one of our membership cards to gain access to even more storage space!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.22.str_service: Take my advice bucko, yer gonna want to put on some green before ye get pinched!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.23.str_service: These goggles are a passion project of mine. Can you please buy one?
entries.tabledata.npc.service.24.str_service: Hiya! Take a peek at our exclusive previews for upcoming vehicles for the party as well as grab a Blank Bubblehead and Birthday Suit!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.25.str_service: Buying one of these items goes directly to helping the Retired Birthday Basher Foundation.
entries.tabledata.npc.service.26.str_service: Welcome to DexLabs Optometry. We provide frames based on Dexter, CEO of DexLabs, as well as the CEO of a neighboring company who did not account for there being no other local optometrists.
entries.tabledata.npc.service.27.str_service: Buy it now before prices soar 'cuz of scalpers!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.28.str_service: Think you've got a scoop? Well... if you slide over some taros I can give you this handy camera! Yes, the shirt being included is non-negotiable.
entries.tabledata.npc.service.3.str_service: Always remember that your butt's first line of defense is the pair of pants that you put it in!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.4.str_service: Our quality footwear was built for speed, comfort and protection. Choose your favorite pair!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.5.str_service: Our accessories won't offer additional protection, but they look great and give every outfit a personal touch!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.6.str_service: Make sure you stock up on Weapon Boosts and Nano Potions before every adventure!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.7.str_service: You will require Power Items if you choose to change your Nano's power.
entries.tabledata.npc.service.8.str_service: This Egg Generating Gizmo Ejects Rewards! Choose your E.G.G. type and pop it open for a surprise. Don't worry, Everyone Gets Goods!
entries.tabledata.npc.service.9.str_service: Want to get around a bit faster, or just look cooler doing it? Well, you've come to the right place!
entries.tutorial.chat.intro.ben: BEN: Not now, Numbuh Five. We gotta move! Follow us!
entries.tutorial.chat.intro.numbuh_five: NUMBUH FIVE: Holy cannoli! Where did you come from?

entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iBarkerNumber: Select a set of NPC ambient speech lines. Zero disables the set.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSTItemID: Quest items required to start this stage. Each slot pairs with the starting item count in the same position.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSTItemNumNeeded: Quest item counts required at the start, paired with the required item IDs. These are not reward counts.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSTRReqNano: Nano IDs the player must already own. Each zero leaves a prerequisite slot unused.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSTReqMission: Mission IDs that must already be completed. Zero leaves the element unused.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSTTrigger: Reference to a task used by the mission trigger. Zero disables this reference; it is a task ID, not a mission ID.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSUCheckTimer: Objective time limit in seconds. Zero means no time limit.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSUDEFNPCID: NPC type to escort or defend. Creating a new NPC type does not place it in the world.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSUDEPNPCFollow: Whether the escort NPC follows the player. 0 Disabled, 1 Enabled. The server also derives escort behavior from the destination NPC.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSUEnemyID: NPC IDs for the defeat objective. Each element pairs with the same element in Required defeat counts; zero leaves the slot unused.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSUItemID: Quest item IDs for the collection objective. Each element pairs with the same element in Objective item counts; zero leaves the slot unused.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSUItemNumNeeded: Required quest item counts, paired with Objective items by element position.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCSUNumToKill: Required defeat counts. Each element pairs with the same element in Target enemies.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCTRReqLvMax: Maximum level recorded by mission content. Zero means no configured maximum; do not assume the server enforces this field.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCTRReqLvMin: Minimum player level needed to start this stage. Zero means no minimum.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iCash: Money included in the mission reward.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iComment: Voice type: selects an NPC text record whose m_strComment2 is the audio prefix. Zero disables voice.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iDelItemID: Quest items removed when this mission is abandoned. Zero leaves the slot unused.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iDetaileMissionComp: Detailed journal description after completing the mission.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iDetaileMissionDesc: Detailed mission description shown when the mission is offered.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iDetailedTaskDesc: Detailed instructions for the active task in the mission journal.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iFDialogBubble: Text spoken above the linked NPC at this event. Search by text or ID, edit the linked text or create a new one. Zero disables the line; set the speaking NPC separately.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iFItemID: Quest item IDs changed on failure. Pair each with its failure item quantity.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iFItemNumNeeded: Signed quest item quantity change on failure: positive adds items, negative removes them.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iFJournalIDAdd: Journal entry used at this stage event. Search by its text or ID, or create a new entry here. Zero means no journal update.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iFMessageSendNPC: NPC type speaking the linked NanoCom message. Zero means no configured speaker.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iFMessageTextID: Text of the NanoCom message on failure. Select or create a mission text; its row index is stored.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iFMessageType: Message channel flags: 2 Nano-Com, 4 E-mail, 6 both. The original message handler ignores flag 1: 1 sends neither channel, 3 sends Nano-Com. Other flags are preserved.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iFusionMatter: Fusion Matter included in the mission reward.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iHCurrentObjective: Text describing the current objective to the player. A reference to a mission text row, not a numeric gameplay condition.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iHDifficultyType: Difficulty label in the mission journal: 0 Easy, 1 Normal, 2 Hard. Does not set enemy health or rewards.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iHJournalNPCID: NPC shown in the mission journal. Select an NPC type, not a spawned NPC instance.
entries.ui.editor.xdt.help.m_iHMissionName: Shared mission title stored in a text row. All stages of a mission normally share this title; creating a private text changes only this reference.

entries.ui.loading.tip.01: Always keep an eye on your active Nano's stamina. If your Nano gets tired, it will need to rest for a little while.
entries.ui.loading.tip.02: Keyboard shortcuts are useful! Press "I" to access your pack, "P" to access your mail and "M" to access the map.
entries.ui.loading.tip.03: Remember: shirts, pants and shoes are worn for protection. Items for your head, face and back are worn for fun!
entries.ui.loading.tip.04: Buy Power Items from Dexbot shopkeepers if you want to change your Nano's active power.
entries.ui.loading.tip.05: There are four different kinds of C.R.A.T.E.s. Standard, Special, Sooper and Sooper Dooper.
entries.ui.loading.tip.06: Defeating Fuse's monsters isn't the only way to collect Fusion Matter! Try running a race inside an Infected Zone.
entries.ui.loading.tip.07: Feed gumballs to your Nanos to make them temporarily more powerful!
entries.ui.loading.tip.08: Not sure where to go next? Check your email. Your guide will often send you helpful messages.
entries.ui.loading.tip.09: Remember: Adaptium beats Blastons, Blastons beat Cosmix, and Cosmix beats Adaptium.
entries.ui.loading.tip.10: If your Nano is low on stamina, hit the "C" key to use a Nano Potion.
entries.ui.loading.tip.11: If you want to swap out your Nanos or change their powers, visit a Nano Station!
entries.ui.loading.tip.12: Selling tip: click the Right Mouse button when selecting an item from your pack to automatically sell it to a shopkeeper.
entries.ui.loading.tip.13: Got too many items in your pack? Stop at Morbucks Savings and Loan to store your extra gear.
entries.ui.loading.tip.14: There are six different kinds of weapons: pistols, rifles, shatterguns, rocket, melee and thrown.
entries.ui.loading.tip.15: Ouch! Remember to watch out for toxic Fusion Matter patches on the ground.
entries.ui.loading.tip.16: Having trouble with the mouse? Use the arrow keys to move around instead. Press the "Z" key to attack and the "X" key to use a Nano power.
entries.ui.loading.tip.17: Need help finding your friends? Add your friends to your buddy list, then you can teleport to them using the Buddy Warp command.
entries.ui.loading.tip.18: Once you have acquired your Eduardo Nano, you will be ready to use the time machine to return to the past.

entries.ui.rule.combining.closing: Thanks for Choosing Croc Pot Catering Company for Your Custom Item Needs!
entries.ui.rule.combining.description: The Croc Pot Catering Company creates delicious new combinations from your armor and weapons. It's simple: from MY STUFF, select the item with the STYLE that you want, then choose the item with the STATS you want. We'll throw them into our special Croc Pot and spit out a new item for you. Sound cool? It is!
entries.ui.rule.combining.intro: Welcome to Croc Pot Catering Company!
entries.ui.rule.combining.rules:
* The items you wish to combine must be of the
       same type. 
 
     * An item for the opposite gender cannot go in   
       the STYLE slot.

     * GUIDE items cannot go in the STATS slot.

Remember, combinations are not 100% guaranteed.  If the combination fails, don't worry, you can always try again. But we'll still take your Taros!
entries.ui.rule.combining.title: WHAT IS COMBINING?
entries.ui.rule.vehicle.closing: Remember: at Kevin's Hot Rod Rentals, all the vehicles go to eleven!
entries.ui.rule.vehicle.description: Kevin's Hot Rod Rentals wants to put you in a new vehicle right now! Vehicles are a speedy form of transportation to help you get around the world faster.
entries.ui.rule.vehicle.details:
Vehicles are available for rental only, not for purchase. Detailed rental information is available on the vehicle's info card. When a vehicle's rental period expires, it disappears from your inventory.

You can equip a vehicle the same way you equip armor, accessories and weapons. Simply go to MY STUFF and select the vehicle you would like to equip, then click HOP ON. To mount and dismount your vehicle in the world, hit the "V" key.
